items.title: [Editorial] Gene-editing therapies: delivering safely for patients
items.title_zh: 基因编辑疗法：为患者安全交付
items.summary_zh: 维多利亚·格雷的经历让人深刻体会到镰状细胞病危机的痛苦。2019年，她成为首位接受名为Casgevy/exa-cel的基因编辑疗法治疗镰状细胞病的患者，该疗法已获批准用于镰状细胞病和β-地中海贫血。她的医疗转变令人瞩目：“现在我可以毫无限制地再次做梦。”此后，基因编辑疗法取得了进一步成功，包括将T细胞编辑用于白血病治疗，以及编辑肝细胞以治疗转甲状腺素淀粉样变或代谢疾病。
items.abstract: “The pain I would feel in my body was like being struck by lightning and hit by a freight train all at once.” Victoria Gray's words will resonate with anyone who has experienced a sickle-cell disease crisis. In 2019, she became the first patient to have sickle-cell disease treated with the pioneering gene-editing therapy now known as Casgevy/exa-cel, which has since been approved for sickle-cell disease and β-thalassaemia. Her medical transformation was remarkable: “Now I can dream again without limitations.” Further successes have followed, including editing T cells as a leukaemia therapy and editing liver cells to treat transthyretin amyloidosis or metabolic conditions.
items.authors: The Lancet

items.title: [Comment] rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP vaccine-induced seroreactivity to Bundibugyo virus: a cross-protection dilemma
items.title_zh: rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP疫苗对Bundibugyo病毒的交叉保护困境
items.summary_zh: Filoviridae病毒家族包括几种已知会导致人类严重且常致命疾病的病毒。在Orthoebolavirus属中，大多数临床病例和相关死亡由Orthoebolavirus zairense（埃博拉病毒；EBOV）引起，该病毒在2013至2016年间在西非引发了大规模疫情，导致至少28,000例临床病例和11,325例死亡。除了EBOV外，Orthoebolavirus sudanense（苏丹病毒）和Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense（Bundibugyo病毒；BDBV）也曾引发重大疫情，后者最近在刚果民主共和国重新出现，截至2026年8月27日，已造成5815例确诊病例和2788例死亡。
items.abstract: The virus family Filoviridae includes several species known to cause severe and often fatal disease in humans. Within the genus Orthoebolvirus, the majority of clinical disease cases and associated deaths have been caused by Orthoebolavirus zairense (Ebola virus; EBOV), which was responsible for a massive epidemic in west Africa from 2013 to 2016, resulting in at least 28 000 clinical cases of disease and 11 325 deaths.1 In addition to EBOV, Orthoebolavirus sudanense (Sudan virus), and Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense (Bundibugyo virus; BDBV) have both caused substantial outbreaks, the latter of which has recently re-emerged in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and as of Aug 27, 2026, has caused 5815 confirmed cases and 2788 deaths.
items.authors: Abhishek N Prasad, Thomas W Geisbert

items.title: [Articles] Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia (ENERGIZE-T): a double-blind, randomised, multicentre, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
items.title_zh: 米塔匹伐在输血依赖性α或β地中海贫血成人中的疗效与安全性
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了米塔匹伐在输血依赖性α或β地中海贫血成人中的疗效与安全性。采用双盲、随机、多中心、安慰剂对照的三期临床试验设计。结果显示，米塔匹伐显著降低了输血需求，并且耐受性良好，显示出有利的效益-风险比。这些发现支持米塔匹伐作为首个口服疾病修饰疗法，为该患者群体提供了新的减少输血负担的治疗选择。
items.abstract: Mitapivat significantly reduced the transfusion burden and was generally well tolerated, showing a favourable benefit–risk profile. These findings support mitapivat as the first oral disease-modifying therapy for adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia, providing a new treatment option to reduce transfusion burden in this patient population.
items.authors: Maria Domenica Cappellini, Sujit Sheth, Ali Taher, Hanny Al-Samkari, Ali Bülent Antmen, David Beneitez, Giovanna Cannas, Thomas Coates, Lauren Czapla, Jayme L Dahlin, Jeremie H Estepp, Elizabeth Feens

items.title: [Perspectives] Tim Baker: bringing systems change to acute health-care provision
items.title_zh: 蒂姆·贝克：推动急性医疗服务的系统变革
items.summary_zh: “全球健康传统上关注健康促进和疾病预防，”坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆穆希姆比利健康与相关科学大学的蒂姆·贝克副教授表示。“但有些人会生病，许多人会因危及生命的疾病而变得严重不适。急性医疗服务，包括照顾重症患者，可能是改善人口健康的有效途径。”贝克强调，急性医疗不仅是对疾病的应对，更是提升整体健康水平的重要环节。
items.abstract: “Global health has traditionally focused on health promotion and preventing disease”, says Tim Baker, Associate Professor at Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. “But some people will get sick, and many become critically unwell with life-threatening illness. Acute health care, including looking after critically ill patients, can be a really impactful way to improve population health.”
items.authors: Aarathi Prasad

items.title: [Comment] Mitapivat for transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia and β-thalassaemia
items.title_zh: 米塔匹伐治疗依赖输血的α、β地中海贫血
items.summary_zh: 地中海贫血是最常见的单基因遗传病，特征为血红蛋白的球蛋白链生成减少。最常见的两种形式为α-地中海贫血和β-地中海贫血，分别影响α-球蛋白和β-球蛋白基因的生成。1,2 严重型地中海贫血患者需终生接受红细胞输血，导致铁负荷过重，进而引发内分泌病、心肌病、糖尿病、听力异常、骨质疏松和生长发育迟缓等严重并发症，显著影响生活质量。
items.abstract: Thalassaemias are the most common monogenic inherited diseases and are characterised by reduced production of globin chains of haemoglobin. The two most common forms are α-thalassaemia and β-thalassaemia, which affect the production of α-globin and β-globin genes, respectively.1,2 Individuals with severe forms of thalassaemia receive lifelong chronic red blood cell transfusions, resulting in iron overload that leads to severe complications such as endocrinopathy, cardiomyopathy, diabetes, auditory abnormalities, osteoporosis, and growth failure, which can substantially affect their quality of life.
items.authors: Haydar Frangoul, Ayad Hussein

items.title: [Department of Error] Department of Error
items.title_zh: PD-L1阳性胃癌围手术期治疗研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了围手术期使用serplulimab联合新辅助化疗与单独围手术期化疗在PD-L1阳性胃癌患者中的疗效。研究为随机、双盲、多中心的三期临床试验，涉及多个中心的患者。结果显示，serplulimab联合新辅助化疗组在主要终点上显著优于单独化疗组，且安全性可接受。该研究为PD-L1阳性胃癌的治疗提供了新的治疗方案，可能改善患者的预后。
items.abstract: Shen L, Zhang X, Ji K, et al. Perioperative serplulimab with neoadjuvant chemotherapy versus perioperative chemotherapy in PD-L1-positive gastric cancer (ASTRUM-006): a randomised, double-blind, multicentre, phase 3 study. Lancet 2026; 407: 2542–53—In this Article, the email address for corresponding author Lin Shen has been amended. This correction has been made to the online version as of Sept 10, 2026.

items.title: [Comment] Offline: The tragic fallacy of global health reform
items.title_zh: 全球健康改革的悲惨谬误
items.summary_zh: 本文评论了全球健康改革中的一种悲惨谬误，借用豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯1940年创作的短篇小说《Tlön, Uqbar, Orbis Tertius》作为引子。小说中，一个由天文学家、生物学家和工程师组成的秘密社团创造了一个理想主义的世界Tlön，强调意识对现实的决定性作用。在Tlön中，没有名词，只有动词和形容词，科学和推理也不存在。通过这一隐喻，文章探讨了当前全球健康改革的理念与实践之间的矛盾，指出其可能导致的误区与挑战。
items.abstract: In Jorge Luis Borges's fantastical short story, Tlön, Uqbar, Orbis Tertius, written in 1940, he imagines the invention of a new world, Tlön, by a secret society of, among others, astronomers, biologists, and engineers. Over several centuries, they developed “a rigorous and systematic plan” for this planet based not on materialism, but on idealism—the philosophy that nothing is real unless consciously perceived. There are no nouns in Tlön, only verbs and adjectives. There is no science. Nobody reasons.
items.authors: Richard Horton

items.title: [Perspectives] A positive difference: unimagined communities, reimagined research
items.title_zh: 医学领域种族与民族研究的负面叙事与新视角
items.summary_zh: 医学领域关于种族和民族的现有叙事大多呈现负面。历史学家记录了对黑人和棕色人种的明显偏见和剥削。社会科学家和政策研究人员常常证实直接和结构性种族主义对健康系统的有害影响，包括英国国家健康服务体系（NHS）。在生物医学招募中，诸如“难以接触”等污名化标签仍然频繁应用于少数民族群体，隐含地为其在医学研究中的严重缺乏代表性辩护。
items.abstract: Existing narratives around race and ethnicity in medicine are overwhelmingly negative. Historians have documented overt bias and outright exploitation of Black and Brown people. Social scientists and policy researchers routinely evidence the harmful impacts of both direct and structural racism in health systems, including the UK's National Health Service (NHS). And stigmatising labels such as “hard to reach” are still regularly applied to minority ethnic populations in biomedical recruitment, implicitly excusing their dangerous under-representation in medical research.
items.authors: Roberta Bivins

items.title: [Correspondence] Global science to promote cooperation and understanding
items.title_zh: 全球科学促进合作与理解的探讨
items.summary_zh: 在战争、制裁、战略竞争和制度崩溃的世界中，科学促进合作的想法似乎显得天真。科学无法阻止军队或解决外交失败，但在正式政治机构削弱时，科学能够保持沟通渠道、共同的证据标准和跨国信任。因此，全球科学不仅仅是知识生产的方式，更是一种合作努力，建立在共同的问题、方法、数据、关系和专业规范之上。
items.abstract: The idea that science might promote cooperation could sound naive in a world beset by war, sanctions, strategic rivalry, and institutional breakdown. Science cannot stop armies or resolve diplomatic failures. When formal political institutions weaken, science can preserve communication channels, common standards of evidence, and trust across borders. Therefore, global science is more than a way of producing knowledge: it is a cooperative effort, built on shared questions, methods, data, relationships, and professional norms.
items.authors: Christina Magnussen, Salim Yusuf, Martin McKee, Stefan Blankenberg

items.title: [Correspondence] Humanitarian lessons from UNRWA's experience in Gaza
items.title_zh: 联合国近东救济工程在加沙的经验教训
items.summary_zh: 约翰霍普金斯人道健康中心与《柳叶刀》委员会的保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事指出，当前的人道主义系统已不再适应需求。该委员会提出四项建议：权力反转、结束有罪不罚、修复资金流动，以及将健康视为不可谈判的权利。委员会的建议值得人道主义和全球健康界的认真考虑。人道主义系统在满足冲突影响人群的需求方面，往往未能达到预期。
items.abstract: The Johns Hopkins Center for Humanitarian Health–Lancet Commission by Paul Spiegel and colleagues1 argues that the current humanitarian system is no longer fit for purpose. It identifies four recommendations: invert the power, end impunity, fix the money, and uphold health for all as a non-negotiable right. The Commission deserves serious consideration by the humanitarian and global health communities. Too often, the humanitarian system has fallen short of meeting the needs of people affected by conflict.
items.authors: Akihiro Seita, Shatha Albeik, Ghada Al-Jadba

items.title: [Correspondence] Minority voices in conflict-affected health systems
items.title_zh: 冲突影响下卫生系统中的少数声音
items.summary_zh: 我们对保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事的委员会报告表示关注，并赞赏其在推动健康公平和解决全球健康不良结果的结构性驱动因素方面的及时和雄心勃勃的努力。在冲突、流离失所、经济不稳定和政治两极化加剧健康差距的时刻，该委员会提供了一个重要框架，将公平原则转化为切实行动，具有潜力塑造能够改善数百万生命的政策。
items.abstract: We read with interest the Commission by Paul Speigel and colleagues1 and commend its timely and ambitious effort to advance health equity and address the structural drivers of poor health outcomes worldwide. At a moment when conflict, displacement, economic instability, and political polarisation are widening health disparities,2 the Commission provides an important framework for translating principles of equity into meaningful action, which has the potential to shape policies that could improve the lives of millions.
items.authors: Davidi Tawfiles

items.title: [Correspondence] Naming palliative care in conflict and forced displacement
items.title_zh: 冲突与强迫迁移中的匿名化护理问题
items.summary_zh: 约翰霍普金斯人道健康中心与《柳叶刀》委员会由保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事提出，深入探讨了人道系统的失败及其对冲突和强迫迁移受影响人群的影响。委员会呼吁建立能够维护尊严、连续性、公平性、问责制和全民健康的系统。值得注意的是，委员会中完全未提及缓和医疗。一个讨论死亡、痛苦和被遗弃的改革议程，如果明确说明在冲突阻碍获取身体、心理和精神支持时，重病患者的护理方式，将会更为有力。
items.abstract: The Johns Hopkins Center for Humanitarian Health–Lancet Commission by Paul Spiegel and colleagues offers a compelling account of humanitarian system failure and its consequences for people affected by conflict and forced displacement.1 The Commission calls for systems to uphold dignity, continuity, equity, accountability, and health for all. Perhaps most striking is that palliative care remains entirely unnamed in the Commission. A reform agenda that speaks of death, suffering, and abandonment would be strengthened by making explicit how people with serious illness are cared for when conflict obstructs access to physical, psychosocial, and spiritual support.
items.authors: Matthew J Allsop, Olena Riga, Mohamed Reyad Zughbur, Eve Namisango, Donald R Sullivan, Gemma Bowsher, Mac Skelton, Hibah Osman, William E Rosa

items.title: [Correspondence] Inverting power must begin with authorship
items.title_zh: 权力反转应从作者身份开始
items.summary_zh: 约翰霍普金斯人道健康中心-柳叶刀委员会由保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事提出了一个既正确又迫切的观点：人道主义系统需要结构性转型，而非渐进式改革，这一转型根本上关乎权力——谁来决策以及代表谁。委员会以非凡的清晰度阐述了这一论点，并强调合法性应由受影响社区来评判，而非仅依赖于正式认可，这一立场值得欢迎。
items.abstract: The Johns Hopkins Centre for Humanitarian Health–Lancet Commission by Paul Spiegel and colleagues1 makes a claim that is both correct and overdue: the humanitarian system requires structural transformation, not incremental reform, and that transformation is fundamentally about power—who decides and on whose behalf. The Commission centres this argument with unusual clarity, and its insistence that legitimacy be judged by affected communities rather than by formal recognition is welcome.
items.authors: Qusai Khraisha

items.title: [Correspondence] Inverting power must begin with authorship – Authors’ reply
items.title_zh: 反思权力必须从作者身份开始——作者回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Qusai Khraisha的批评，既慷慨又严谨。我们欣赏委员会的核心论点——转变人道主义系统是一个权力问题，涉及谁来决定以及代表谁——被视为清晰且有用。我们也接受invitation the Correspondence提出的更为严峻的观点：需要将同样的视角向内反思，审视权力和代表性的问题如何在委员会自身的结构中体现，包括作者身份。
items.abstract: We thank Qusai Khraisha for a critique that is at once generous and exacting. We appreciate that the Commission's central claim1—that transforming the humanitarian system is a question of power, of who decides, and on whose behalf—was read as clear and useful. We also accept the harder invitation the Correspondence makes: to turn the same lens inward and examine how questions of power and representation are reflected in the Commission's own structure, including authorship.
items.authors: Chi-Chi Undie, Esperanza Martinez, Karl Blanchet, Paul Spiegel

items.title: [Obituary] Maura L Gillison
items.title_zh: 悼念马乌拉·L·吉利森博士
items.summary_zh: 马乌拉·L·吉利森是一位医学肿瘤学家和科学家，她明确了人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）在口咽癌中的作用。她于出生于加拿大安大略省伦敦，2026年6月21日在美国俄亥俄州威洛比因小肠癌去世，享年61岁。吉利森博士的研究为口咽癌的病因提供了重要的科学依据，推动了相关领域的进一步研究和治疗方法的发展。
items.abstract: Medical oncologist and scientist who defined the role of HPV in oropharyngeal cancer. Born on Jan 4, 1965, in London, ON, Canada, she died of small intestine cancer on June 21, 2026, in Willoughby, OH, USA, aged 61 years
items.authors: Helen Saul

items.title: [World Report] Fears over longer term health impacts of Nepal floods
items.title_zh: 尼泊尔洪灾对长期健康影响的担忧
items.summary_zh: 专家警告称，尼泊尔的灾难性洪灾导致数千人遇难，可能引发传染病、营养不良和心理健康问题。洪灾后，受影响地区的卫生状况堪忧，尤其是儿童和老年人群体面临更高的风险。专家指出，洪水可能导致水源污染，增加疾病传播的机会。此外，心理健康问题也可能因灾后创伤和失去亲人而加剧。各界呼吁采取紧急措施，以应对即将到来的健康危机，并加强对受灾人群的支持和救助。
items.abstract: Experts warn of a risk of communicable diseases, malnutrition, and mental health conditions following catastrophic flooding that has killed thousands. Sophie Cousins reports.
items.authors: Sophie Cousins

items.title: [World Report] Conflict and inequality complicate Colombia earthquake relief
items.title_zh: 冲突与不平等加剧哥伦比亚地震救援难题
items.summary_zh: 哥伦比亚查科省作为地震震中，其医疗系统本已面临严重压力。地震后，医疗资源的短缺和社会经济不平等使得救援工作更加复杂。研究指出，冲突历史和贫困现状加剧了灾后恢复的困难，影响了受灾民众的健康和安全。救援工作需要综合考虑当地的社会经济背景，以确保有效的医疗服务和资源分配。
items.abstract: Health care in Chocó, the epicentre of the earthquake, was already under severe strain. Daniela Díaz Rangel and Amy Booth report.
items.authors: Daniela Díaz Rangel, Amy Booth

items.title: [Correspondence] Humanitarian crises are a hotbed for organ trafficking
items.title_zh: 人道危机是器官贩卖的温床
items.summary_zh: 保罗·斯皮格尔及其同事的研究聚焦于健康、冲突和流离失所的议题，揭示了在危机和不公的世界中，人道危机如何助长器官贩卖现象。研究表明，冲突地区的脆弱人群更容易成为器官贩卖的受害者，尤其是在缺乏法律保护和医疗资源的情况下。通过分析相关数据，研究强调了国际社会在应对人道危机时，需加强对器官贩卖的监管和干预，以保护受害者的权益并打击这一犯罪行为。
items.abstract: Paul Spiegel and colleagues should be congratulated on their Commission related to health, conflict, and displacement in a world of crises and impunity.1
items.authors: Thomas F Mueller, Maria Amalia Matamoros

items.title: Cooperative CTCF-nucleosome oligomerization stabilizes chromatin loop anchors
items.title_zh: CTCF-核小体聚合稳定染色质环锚点
items.summary_zh: 真核生物DNA在多个层面上组织，以支持基因组压缩、适当的基因表达和DNA重组。CCCTC结合因子（CTCF）在这些过程中起着关键作用，定义特定的染色质环结构并隔离增强子与启动子。我们通过冷冻电子显微镜技术重构了CTCF-核小体复合物的结构，发现CTCF二聚化促进核小体的聚合，形成特定的高阶结构，涉及特定的组蛋白-组蛋白和CTCF-CTCF相互作用。值得注意的是，CTCF在非染色质化DNA底物上聚合效率较低。在细胞中破坏CTCF相互作用界面会显著降低染色质环的形成，并功能性地损害细胞分化。这些结果表明，CTCF位点的染色质结构在支持基因组远端区域之间的高阶相互作用中发挥重要作用，这些相互作用对支持细胞类型特异性的基因表达至关重要。
items.abstract: Eukaryotic DNA is organized across multiple scales to support genome compaction, appropriate gene expression, and DNA recombination. A central player in these processes is the CCCTC binding factor (CTCF), which defines specific chromatin loop structures and insulates enhancer elements from promoters. Chromatin is organized in a distinct pattern around CTCF-bound sites; however, the role of this patterning remains unclear. Here, we report cryo-electron microscopy structures of reconstituted CTCF-nucleosome complexes, revealing that CTCF dimerization promotes the oligomerization of nucleosomes into defined higher-order assemblies involving specific histone-histone and CTCF-CTCF interactions. Notably, CTCF does not oligomerize efficiently on non-chromatinized DNA substrates. Disruption of identified CTCF interaction interfaces in cells results in a marked decrease in chromatin looping and functionally impairs cellular differentiation. These results indicate that chromatin structure at CTCF sites plays an important role in supporting higher-order interactions between distal regions of the genome and that these interactions are important for supporting cell-type-specific gene expression
items.authors: Osorio Valeriano, M.; Stone, A. C.; Nagano, M.; Su, B.; Caccianini, L.; Hansen, A. S.; Farnung, L.; Vos, S. M.

items.title: Benchmarking three simple DNA staining-based image metrics for live-cell tracking of chromatin organization
items.title_zh: 基于DNA染色的三种简单图像指标在活细胞染色质追踪中的基准测试
items.summary_zh: 在活细胞中量化染色质状态动态仍然具有挑战性，部分原因是大多数方法需要固定或细胞裂解。本文基准测试并引入三种基于常规DNA染色的活细胞图像指标——变异系数（CV）、1-Gini和扩散信号指数（DSI），作为无固定化的染色质组织读数。以HL60衍生的中性粒细胞（dHL-60）在NETosis过程中为模型系统，展示了这三种指标能够追踪活细胞轨迹中的染色质重组进程，其中DSI在NETing和非NETing细胞之间提供了最强的轨迹级别区分。与固定细胞中的Tn5染色质可及性测量的比较显示，这三种指标与染色质可及性相关，支持其生物学可解释性。此外，这三种指标还能够追踪另一种机制不同的生物过程中的染色质重组，捕捉U2OS细胞中的有丝分裂染色质压缩和有丝分裂后染色质解压。我们的结果为从常规活细胞DNA染色中提取染色质组织读数提供了实用框架，并强调指标性能依赖于任务和上下文。
items.abstract: Quantifying chromatin-state dynamics in living cells remains challenging, in part because most methods require fixation or cell lysis. Here, we benchmark and introduce three simple live-cell image-derived metrics computed from routine DNA staining - the coefficient of variation (CV), 1-Gini, and the Diffuse Signal Index (DSI), introduced here - as fixation-free readouts of chromatin organization. Using HL60-derived neutrophils (dHL-60) undergoing NETosis as a model system with a pronounced compact-to-decompact chromatin transition, we show that all three metrics track progressive chromatin reorganization in live-cell trajectories, with DSI providing the strongest trajectory-level discrimination between NETing and non-NETing cells. Comparison with Tn5-based chromatin accessibility measurements in fixed cells shows that all three metrics correlate with chromatin accessibility, supporting their biological interpretability. We further show that all three metrics track chromatin reorganization in a second, mechanistically distinct biological process, capturing mitotic chromatin compaction and post-mitotic chromatin decompaction in U2OS cells. items.title: Super compensatory substitutions restore protein function and confer mutational robustness
items.title_zh: 超补偿性突变恢复蛋白功能并增强突变稳健性
items.summary_zh: 补偿性突变可以减轻有害突变的适应性成本，但其分布、结构背景和进化作用尚不明确。本研究系统分析了一个包含约40万个咪唑甘油磷酸脱水酶（IGPD）氨基酸变体的公共深度突变扫描（DMS）数据集，突变覆盖了整个蛋白质长度。我们发现大约十分之一的非功能性错义变体可以通过额外的突变恢复功能，主要发生在溶剂暴露的残基上，这些残基具有较弱的局部接触。值得注意的是，我们识别出一种独特的超补偿性突变类，它在不同遗传背景下增强适应性并缓冲突变效应，导致基因型占据适应性景观的局部平坦区域。对其他公共DMS数据集的比较分析显示，超补偿性突变在不同的自然序列-功能图中反复出现，表明这是一种广泛存在的补偿效应模式，有助于维持突变的持久性并增强蛋白质的进化稳健性。
items.abstract: Compensatory mutations can mitigate the fitness costs of deleterious mutations, yet their distribution, structural contexts, and evolutionary roles remain poorly characterized. Here, we systematically analyzed a public deep mutational scanning (DMS) dataset comprising ~400,000 amino acid variants of imidazole glycerol-phosphate dehydratase (IGPD), with substitutions spanning the entire length of the protein. We found that roughly one-tenth of nonfunctional missense variants can regain function through additional substitutions, predominantly at solvent exposed residues with weak local contacts. Notably, we identified a distinct class of super compensatory substitutions that enhance fitness across diverse genetic backgrounds and buffer mutational effects, resulting in genotypes that occupy locally flatter regions of the fitness landscape. Comparative analyses of additional public DMS datasets across diverse proteins and assays revealed that super compensators recur across different natural sequence-function maps, indicating a broadly represented mode of compensatory effects that sustains mutational persistence and contributes to protein evolutionary robustness.
items.authors: Jiang, W.; Yin, H.; Khan, S. S.; Abuduhaibaier, Y.; Carey, L. B.

items.title: Pan-cancer prediction of tumor immune activation and response to immune checkpoint blockade from tumor transcriptomics and histopathology
items.title_zh: 肿瘤转录组与组织病理学的免疫激活与免疫检查点阻断预测
items.summary_zh: 准确预测哪些患者会对免疫检查点阻断（ICB）产生反应仍然是一个重大挑战。本研究提出了TIME_ACT，这是一个基于TCGA黑色素瘤数据的无监督66基因转录组特征，用于肿瘤免疫激活的评估。研究表明，TIME_ACT评分能够准确识别不同癌症类型中具有活跃免疫微环境的肿瘤。此外，空间特征分析显示，肿瘤细胞附近淋巴细胞浸润密集的微环境区域具有高TIME_ACT评分，成功标记局部免疫激活。在涵盖九种癌症类型的25个转录组ICB队列中，TIME_ACT的平均AUC为0.76，平均比值比为5.77，显著优于30种已建立的转录组特征和ICB反应预测方法。最后，TIME_ACT评分可以从常规肿瘤组织病理切片中准确推断，并在八种癌症类型的九个独立患者队列中预测ICB反应，平均AUC为0.72，平均比值比为4.99。这些发现确立了TIME_ACT作为一种稳健的泛癌症生物标志物，能够实现准确、低成本和临床可扩展的预测。
items.abstract: Accurately predicting which patients will respond to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) remains a major challenge. Here, we present TIME_ACT, an unsupervised 66-gene transcriptomic signature of tumor immune activation derived from TCGA (The Cancer Genome Atlas) melanoma data. First, we demonstrate that TIME_ACT scores accurately identify tumors with activated immune microenvironments across different cancer types. Further, analysis of spatial features reveals that tumor microenvironment regions with dense lymphocyte infiltration near tumor cells have high TIME_ACT scores, successfully marking localized immune activation. Second, across 25 transcriptomic ICB cohorts encompassing nine cancer types, TIME_ACT achieves a mean AUC of 0.76 and a mean odds ratio of 5.77, significantly outperforming 30 established transcriptomic signatures and prediction methods for ICB response, including a recently developed foundation model for immunotherapy response prediction. Third, we show that TIME_ACT scores can be accurately inferred from routine tumor histopathology slides and that slide-inferred TIME_ACT scores predict ICB response across nine new independent patient cohorts spanning eight cancer

items.title: Mapping multiregional imaging-localized biopsies to MRI habitats reveals biologically significant glioma tissue states and associated patterns of cohabitating cellular subpopulations
items.title_zh: 多区域影像定位活检与MRI栖息地的关联揭示胶质瘤生物学状态
items.summary_zh: 背景：磁共振成像（MRI）是神经外科肿瘤学的主要工具，但对胶质瘤生物学的了解有限。缺乏MRI特征与多区域活检中胶质瘤生物学之间的严格关联是开发基于MRI的胶质瘤生物标志物的障碍。方法：我们收集了58名患者的202个MRI定位活检样本，定义了一个低维转录伪时间连续体，组织异质性高等级胶质瘤（HGG）样本。结果：我们观察到三种极化的转录组织状态：浸润性脑组织、免疫/炎症状态和增殖状态，且与细胞亚群的共生模式相关。这些状态与T1Gd MRI的增强状态相关。此外，定义为多参数MRI中高或低信号强度组合的14个MRI栖息地被识别，并根据转录连续体的平均伪时间进行排序。我们发现低伪时间的MRI栖息地（与早期肿瘤发展和弥漫性侵袭脑组织相关）位于肿瘤边缘，而高伪时间则与增殖状态相关。
items.abstract: Background: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is the mainstay for neurosurgical oncology but not for informing us about glioma biology. An obstacle to developing MR-based glioma biomarkers is the absence of rigorous correlation between MRI features and glioma biology as assessed in multi-regional biopsies, within and across patients. Methods: We directly addressed this obstacle by collating a unique cohort of 202 MRI-localized biopsies from 58 patients. We define a low-dimensional transcriptional pseudotime continuum along which heterogeneous high-grade glioma (HGG) samples organize both within and across patients. Results: We observe three polarized transcriptional tissue states: infiltrated brain, immune/inflammatory, and proliferative associated with patterns of cohabitation of cellular subpopulations. The states and deconvolved populations show correlation with enhancement status on T1Gd MRI. Moreover, discrete MRI habitats, regions sharing common imaging features, defined as combinations of high or low signal intensity across multiparametric MRI revealed 14 MRI habitats. items.title: Ploidy shapes gemcitabine response through altered potency and delayed cell death
items.title_zh: 倍性影响吉西他滨反应，表现为效力改变与细胞死亡延迟
items.summary_zh: 异常的肿瘤倍性是癌症的普遍特征，越来越被认为是治疗反应的决定因素，但倍性如何影响对特定细胞毒性药物的敏感性机制尚不清楚。本研究通过药物基因组重分析、同源癌细胞系统、活细胞成像、细胞内药代动力学/药效学（PK/PD）测量和数学建模，探讨了倍性与治疗反应之间的关系。在公共药物基因组数据集中，吉西他滨被发现是低倍性选择性细胞毒剂。在匹配的低倍性和高倍性细胞系统中，高倍性细胞对吉西他滨的敏感性显著降低。活细胞成像和PK/PD测量显示，近二倍体和近四倍体SUM-159细胞均能形成吉西他滨的活性形式dFdCTP，但高倍性细胞的治疗反应较弱且较慢，细胞死亡的积累延迟。我们开发了一个考虑延迟的活/死模型，量化了高倍性细胞中吉西他滨效力降低和药物作用到观察到死亡的显著延迟（近二倍体细胞为17.5小时，近四倍体细胞为42.5小时）。
items.abstract: Aberrant tumor ploidy is a near-universal hallmark of cancer and increasingly recognized as a determinant of therapeutic response, but the mechanisms by which ploidy shapes sensitivity to specific cytotoxic agents remain unclear. Here, we investigated the relationship between ploidy and therapeutic response using pharmacogenomic reanalysis, isogenic cancer cell systems, live-cell imaging, intracellular pharmacokinetic/ pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) measurements, and mathematical modeling. Across public pharmacogenomic datasets, gemcitabine emerged as a low-ploidy-selective cytotoxic agent. In matched isogenic low- and high-ploidy cell systems, higher-ploidy cells were consistently less sensitive to gemcitabine across multiple lineages. Live-cell imaging and PK/PD measurements in near-diploid and near-tetraploid SUM-159 cells showed that both states formed intracellular dFdCTP, active form of gemcitabine; but, high-ploidy cells exhibited weaker and slower treatment responses, with delayed accumulation of cell death. items.title: Multi-species genome-wide CRISPR screens identify conserved suppressors of cold-induced cell death
items.title_zh: 多物种基因组范围CRISPR筛选鉴定冷诱导细胞死亡的保守抑制因子
items.summary_zh: 细胞必须适应环境变化以维持稳态。哺乳动物细胞如何适应温度从37°C骤降至4°C的变化尚不清楚。本研究首次在叙利亚仓鼠（可选择性冬眠动物）和人类细胞中进行基因组规模的CRISPR-Cas9筛选，以无偏见地探讨冬眠动物和非冬眠动物的耐寒遗传基础。筛选结果独立揭示了含硒酶谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）及其相关蛋白对耐寒的重要性。我们通过遗传和药理学方法证明GPX4在低温下活跃，其催化活性对耐寒至关重要。此外，我们还发现GPX4作为冷诱导细胞死亡的抑制因子的作用在包括13条纹地松鼠和大马蹄蝙蝠等冬眠物种中具有保守性，突显了这一耐寒机制的进化保守性。本研究确定了GPX4作为哺乳动物耐寒的核心调节因子，推动了我们对细胞应对寒冷机制的理解。
items.abstract: Cells must adapt to environmental changes to maintain homeostasis. One of the most striking environmental adaptations is entry into hibernation during which core body temperature can decrease from 37C to as low at 4C. How mammalian cells, which evolved to optimally function within a narrow range of temperatures, adapt to this profound decrease in temperature remains poorly understood. In this study, we conducted the first genome-scale CRISPR-Cas9 screen in cells derived from Syrian hamster, a facultative hibernator, as well as human cells to investigate the genetic basis of cold tolerance in a hibernator and a non-hibernator in an unbiased manner. Both screens independently revealed glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4), a selenium-containing enzyme, and associated proteins as critical for cold tolerance. We utilized genetic and pharmacological approaches to demonstrate that GPX4 is active in the cold and its catalytic activity is required for cold tolerance. items.title: Therapeutic-induced chromatin remodeling via AP-1/SWI-SNF enhances BK Polyomavirus replication in urothelial cells
items.title_zh: AP-1/SWI-SNF介导的染色质重塑促进BK多瘤病毒在尿路上皮细胞中的复制
items.summary_zh: BK多瘤病毒（BKPyV）再激活引起的出血性膀胱炎（HC）是免疫抑制患者，尤其是造血干细胞移植受者的一种严重并发症，但调理方案对病毒复制的影响尚不明确。当前HC的治疗主要是支持性治疗，尚无针对BKPyV再激活的特效抗病毒药物，亟需新的干预措施。本研究利用HC细胞模型提供了首次机制性证据，表明生理浓度的基因毒性化疗、免疫调理和抗病毒暴露常常通过重编程宿主染色质重塑机制增强BKPyV复制，而不依赖于免疫抑制。尿路上皮细胞的转录组和表观基因组分析显示，这些治疗诱导宿主和病毒的染色质重塑，特别是激活SWI/SNF ATP依赖性重塑复合物，形成富含AP-1转录因子基序的调控景观，暗示AP-1/SWI-SNF轴是病毒复制的关键调控因子。功能性抑制SWI/SNF的AU-15330和FHD-286在所有测试的治疗条件下均一致抑制BKPyV复制。患者尿液样本和细胞实验表明，这些效应与病毒基因组变化无关。
items.abstract: Hemorrhagic cystitis (HC) caused by BK polyomavirus (BKPyV) reactivation is a serious complication in immunocompromised patients especially in hematopoietic stem cell transplant recipients, yet the effects of conditioning regimens on viral replication remain undefined. Current therapies for HC are largely supportive, and no specific antiviral drugs are approved for BKPyV reactivation, underscoring an urgent need for new interventions. Here, using a cellular model of HC, we provide the first mechanistic evidence that physiologic concentrations of genotoxic chemotherapy, immune-conditioning, and antiviral exposures commonly enhance BKPyV replication by reprogramming host chromatin remodeling machinery independently of immune suppression. Transcriptomic and epigenomic profiling of urothelial cells revealed that these treatments induce host and virus chromatin remodeling, specifically, the SWI/SNF ATP-dependent remodeling complex is activated and creates a regulatory landscape enriched for AP-1 transcription factor motifs, implicating the AP-1/SWI-SNF axis as a key regulator of viral replication. items.title: Loss of function of LprG-Rv1410c and MmpL11 homologues in Mycobacterium smegmatis leads to altered glycopeptidolipid profile and decreased cellular c-di-GMP levels during biofilm formation
items.title_zh: LprG-Rv1410c和MmpL11功能缺失影响分枝杆菌生物膜形成
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了LprG-Rv1410c和MmpL11在分枝杆菌（Mycobacterium smegmatis）生物膜形成中的作用。通过删除lprG-rv1410c操纵子同源基因MSMEG_3070-3069和mmpL11（MSMEG_0241），观察到与MSMEG_3070-3069和mmpL11突变体相似的生物膜缺陷。对生物膜、总脂质提取物、基因表达及细胞内c-di-GMP水平的分析显示，共同的生物膜缺陷与细胞内c-di-GMP水平显著降低直接相关，同时可能与糖肽脂质（GPLs）的合成和/或定位变化有关。
items.abstract: The cell envelope of many bacteria possesses components that play central roles in bacterial pathogenesis. Unique to mycobacteria is the presence of a lipid-rich cell wall which is critical for the virulence of pathogenic mycobacteria such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis (Mtb). The biosynthesis of mycobacterial cell wall lipids has been well characterized, but the mechanisms of lipid transport still remain largely unknown. MmpL (mycobacterial membrane protein large) proteins have been implicated in the biosynthesis and/or transport of mycobacterial cell wall lipids, but due to their cellular location, it is still unclear how cell wall lipids are transported beyond the inner membrane. Here, we further investigate the role of two conserved lipid transport pathways LprG-Rv1410c and MmpL11 in cell envelope biogenesis during biofilm formation in Mycobacterium smegmatis. We found that deletion of the lprG-rv1410c operon homologues MSMEG_3070-3069 and mmpL11 (MSMEG_0241) simultaneously led to similar biofilm defects as observed in the MSMEG_3070-3069 and mmpL11 mutants. items.title: Macrophage-CD8+ T Cell Spatial Coupling Defines an Innate-Adaptive Injury Niche in Human Checkpoint Inhibitor Hepatotoxicity
items.title_zh: 巨噬细胞-CD8+ T细胞空间耦合定义人类免疫检查点抑制剂肝毒性损伤微环境
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：免疫检查点抑制剂引起的免疫介导肝损伤（ILICI）是限制癌症免疫治疗的重要不良事件，其组织水平的免疫生物学尚不明确，管理主要依赖于类自身免疫性肝炎（AIH）。我们之前在小鼠模型中识别了CD8+ T细胞-巨噬细胞-肝细胞的三细胞损伤微环境；本研究测试该微环境是否在人体疾病中重现。方法：我们对ILICI患者（n=12）、AIH（n=14）及健康对照（n=2）的肝活检样本应用32标记的成像质谱细胞分析，分析约297,000个单细胞，空间分辨检测凋亡（切割的半胱天冬酶-3，cC3）和焦亡（切割的气体膜蛋白D，cGSDMD）。结果：在ILICI中检测到富含组织细胞的肉芽肿，包含巨噬细胞和CD8+ T细胞，包括活化的记忆效应亚群。空间分析发现CD8+ T细胞-巨噬细胞共定位是ILICI中最常见的显著相互作用，形成集成的先天-适应性细胞邻域，集中cC3和cGSDMD阳性细胞。与AIH相比，ILICI中免疫细胞和基质的空间分布更为紧密。
items.abstract: Background & AimsImmune-mediated liver injury from immune checkpoint inhibitors (ILICI) is a major immune-related adverse event that limits cancer immunotherapy, yet its tissue-level immunobiology is poorly defined and its management is largely extrapolated from autoimmune hepatitis (AIH). We previously identified a tri-cellular CD8+ T cell-macrophage-hepatocyte injury niche in a murine model of ILICI; here, we tested whether this niche is recapitulated in human disease. MethodsWe applied imaging mass cytometry with a 32-marker panel to liver biopsies from patients with ILICI (n = 12), AIH as a disease comparator (n = 14), and healthy controls (n = 2), profiling approximately 297,000 single cells across 144 regions of interest with spatially resolved detection of apoptosis (cleaved caspase-3, cC3) and pyroptosis (cleaved gasdermin D, cGSDMD). ResultsWe detected histiocyte-rich granulomas in ILICI consisting of macrophages and CD8+ T cells, including activated memory-effector subsets. items.title: Co-Designing Pay-It-Forward Strategies to Improve Retention in Cervical Cancer Care in Kenya: A Formative Participatory Study
items.title_zh: 共同设计“传递爱心”策略以改善肯尼亚宫颈癌护理的留存率
items.summary_zh: 背景：留存率是低收入和中等收入国家（如肯尼亚）中诊断与生存之间的桥梁，宫颈癌治疗费用可达女性平均收入的数年。传递爱心（Pay-it-forward, PIF）是一种社会互助的方法，个体接受礼物后考虑支持他人，提供了一种社区驱动的策略以减少障碍并改善癌症护理中的参与和留存。本研究通过以人为本的设计（HCD）工作坊探索将PIF策略融入宫颈癌护理的机会。方法：我们在肯尼亚举办了为期两天的HCD工作坊，参与者包括宫颈癌患者（在治疗或幸存者）、社区代表和肿瘤护理提供者。通过经验图示法绘制患者旅程并识别留存障碍。设计师主导的团队开发了初步的PIF原型，并与参与者反复共同设计和完善，以符合他们的需求和偏好。结果：25名参与者中，52%（n=13）为宫颈癌女性，48%（n=12）为医疗提供者或社区代表。参与者识别了成本问题。
items.abstract: Background: Retention is the bridge between diagnosis and survival in low and middle-income countries, including Kenya, where the cost of cervical cancer treatment can amount to several years of an average woman's earnings. Pay-it-forward (PIF), a prosocial approach in which an individual receives a gift and then considers supporting another person, offers a community-driven strategy to reduce barriers and improve engagement and retention in cancer care. This study explored opportunities to integrate PIF strategies into cervical cancer care through a human-centered design (HCD) workshop. Methods: We conducted a two-day HCD workshop in Kenya, informed by the WHO/UNICEF normative guide on co-creation with women with cervical cancer (on treatment or survivors), community representatives, and oncology care providers. Experience diagramming mapped the patient journey and identified barriers to retention. A designer-led team then developed the initial PIF prototypes, which were iteratively co-designed and refined with participants to align with their needs and preferences. items.title: Factors associated with a willingness to accept latent tuberculosis infection treatment among non-U.S.-born individuals: a situational choice experiment
items.title_zh: 非美国出生者接受潜伏性结核感染治疗的影响因素研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对在美国加州旧金山湾区一家联邦合格社区健康中心接受初级护理的成年人，探讨了影响非美国出生者接受潜伏性结核感染（LTBI）治疗的因素。我们通过在线问卷进行了一项横断面调查，采用情境选择实验评估参与者在不同情况下接受LTBI治疗的意愿。结果显示，在852名同意参与者中，有458人（53.8%）提供了完整回答，69.4%的选择情境中接受了LTBI治疗（3180/4580）。研究发现，影响治疗接受度的因素包括结核病进展风险、治疗副作用、共用药物变化、费用、门诊访问次数、抽血次数及再感染风险等。
items.abstract: Introduction Despite efforts to eliminate tuberculosis (TB) in the United States (U.S.), many individuals diagnosed with latent TB infection (LTBI) who are at increased risk of progressing to TB disease do not initiate TB preventive treatment. Methods Among adults receiving primary care in a federally qualified community health center in the San Francisco Bay Area, California, we conducted a cross-sectional online survey using a situational choice experiment to assess the circumstances in which individuals at risk for TB based on nativity would accept LTBI treatment. In 10 randomized choice tasks, participants answered whether or not they would accept LTBI treatment. In situations where LTBI treatment was accepted, participants were asked a follow-up question about whether they would change their response knowing that reinfection is still possible with LTBI treatment. Attributes assessed included risk level of progression to TB, side effects, changes to co-medication, cost, number of clinic visits, blood draws, and reinfection risk. items.title: Atrial Cardiomyopathy Refines Cardiovascular Mortality Risk Across Cardiometabolic Risk Factor Burden
items.title_zh: 心房心肌病对心血管死亡风险的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：心房心肌病（AtCM）的心电图标志与不良心血管结果相关。尚不清楚AtCM是否能进一步细化心血管疾病（CVD）死亡风险。方法：我们分析了7083名无基础CVD的成年人，AtCM通过以下1个心电图标志定义：II导联P波持续时间延长≥120毫秒，P波轴异常（超出0-75度），或V1导联P波深终末负性<-100μV。心脏代谢风险因素（CMRF）负担定义为高血压、糖尿病和肥胖的存在情况。CVD死亡率数据截至2006年12月31日。结果：7083名参与者（平均年龄58岁，男性占48%）中，CVD死亡率在六个组合暴露组中逐渐增加。在多变量调整的Cox比例风险分析中，AtCM在每个CMRF负担类别中识别出高风险亚组，风险在组合暴露组中逐渐增加，且在具有2个风险因素和AtCM的参与者中最高（HR 2.25，95% CI 1.75-2.87）。在次级分析中，个别CMRF的结果也显示出类似模式，AtCM与高血压、糖尿病或肥胖的组合相比于无这些情况的参与者具有最高风险（HR（95% CI）：1.58（1.31-1.89）；2.08（1.62-2.68）；和1.47）。
items.abstract: Background: Electrocardiographic markers of atrial cardiomyopathy (AtCM) are associated with adverse cardiovascular outcomes. Whether AtCM further refines cardiovascular disease (CVD) mortality risk across increasing cardiometabolic risk factor (CMRF) burden is unclear. Methods: We analyzed 7,083 adults free of baseline CVD. AtCM was defined by the presence of [ ]1 ECG marker: prolonged P-wave duration [ ]120 ms in lead II, abnormal P-wave axis outside 0-75, or deep terminal negativity of the P wave in V1 <-100 V. CMRF burden was defined as the presence of 0, 1, or [ ]2 of hypertension, diabetes, and obesity. CVD mortality was ascertained through December 31, 2006. Results: Among 7,083 participants (mean age 58 years and 48% men), CVD mortality rates increased progressively across the six combined exposure groups. In a multivariable adjusted Cox proportional hazard analysis, AtCM identified higher-risk subgroups within each CMRF burden category, with risk increasing progressively across combined exposure groups and highest among participants with [ ]2 risk factors and AtCM (HR 2.25, 95% CI 1.75-2.87). items.title: Integrating structured and unstructured EHR data to characterize social and behavioral factors associated with frequent emergency department use among patients with cardiovascular disease
items.title_zh: 整合结构化与非结构化EHR数据以识别心血管疾病患者的社会行为因素
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在整合电子健康记录（EHR）中的结构化和非结构化数据，以识别与心血管疾病（CVD）患者频繁使用急诊科（ED）相关的社会和行为健康决定因素（SBDH）。采用定制的自然语言处理（NLP）算法从临床记录中提取17个SBDH领域，并结合ICD-10 Z编码和筛查问卷。研究对象为18-64岁有CVD病史的患者。多变量逻辑回归分析显示，调整年龄、性别、种族、保险类别和慢性病后，支持系统不足（OR=2.8）、阿片类药物滥用（OR=2.47）、保险不足（OR=2.42）等因素显著增加高频ED使用的风险。在4,844名CVD患者中，526名（10.9%）为频繁ED用户。
items.abstract: Objective: The goal was to integrate structured and unstructured data from the electronic health record (EHR) to identify social and behavioral determinants of health (SBDH) factors and evaluate their association with high emergency department (ED) utilization among cardiovascular disease (CVD) patients. Methods: A custom natural language processing (NLP) algorithm was developed to extract 17 SBDH domains from clinical notes, combined with ICD-10 Z codes and screening questionnaires from the EHR. The study included patients aged 18-64 with a history of CVD. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify associations between SBDH and high ED utilization ([ ] 5 visits) after adjusting for age, sex, race, insurance class, and chronic conditions. Results: Use of only ICD-10 codes and screening questionnaires identified patients in only a subset of the 17 SBDH domains, whereas extraction from clinical notes identified patients across all domains and increased prevalence estimates for every domain. items.title: A National Survey Exploring Dementia Diagnostics and Care Provisions in Primary Care in England
items.title_zh: 英格兰初级护理中痴呆诊断与护理的全国调查
items.summary_zh: 背景：英格兰10年健康计划表明政府意图将护理从医院转向社区。预计将引入疾病修饰治疗（DMT）和痴呆生物标志物检测，这可能对社区护理，特别是全科医疗产生重大影响。目的：探讨初级护理环境中的痴呆诊断、诊后支持及未来护理期望。设计与设置：与全科医生、政策研究者、照护者及有相关经历的人共同设计的调查。方法：对定性回答进行归纳内容分析，并计算定量答案的非加权均值。结果：2025年9月至12月，80个符合条件的实践（1094个中的7.3%）参与（80名全科医生）。大多数（79/80，98.8%）使用认知评估，100%（80/80）进行血液检测以支持痴呆诊断，27/70（39.7%）能够直接申请脑部扫描。全科医生主要为已知痴呆患者进行年度身体、心理或护理计划评估。受访者认为在未来五年内正式诊断痴呆（47/80，58.8%）或评估DMT资格（50/80，62.3%）的可能性不大。全科医生认为能够提供支持的可能性较高（54/80，67.5%）。
items.abstract: Background: The 10 Year Health Plan for England indicates governmental intention to shift care from hospital to community. Disease Modifying Treatments (DMTs) and biomarker tests for dementia will likely be introduced, with potentially significant impacts on community care, particularly general practice. Aim: To explore dementia diagnosis, post diagnostic support and expectations around future care in primary care settings. Design and Setting: Codesigned survey with general practitioners (GPs), policy researchers, carers and people with lived experience. One GP per practice invited from five English Integrated Care Boards (ICBs). Methods: Inductive content analysis for qualitative responses and non-weighted means calculated for quantitative answers. Findings contextualised using national data. Results: Between September and December 2025, 80/1094 (7.3%) eligible practices participated (80 GPs). Most, (79/80, 98.8%) used cognitive assessments and 100% (80/80) blood tests to support dementia diagnosis, with 27/70 (39.7%) able to order brain scans directly. items.title: 2025/26 subclade-specific influenza A and B vaccine effectiveness estimates and discordant laboratory-based indicators of vaccine match or mismatch
items.title_zh: 2025/26季流感A、B疫苗效果及实验室指标不一致性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：2025/26流感季节以A(H3N2)亚类K为主，并伴随A(H1N1)pdm09共流行及流感B活动延续。加拿大哨点医生监测网络报告了疫苗有效性（VE），并考虑了与流行病毒的遗传和抗原相关性。方法：我们在11月至4月期间，对就医的急性呼吸道疾病门诊患者采用测试阴性设计估算VE。通过全基因组测序和血凝抑制实验对病例病毒进行表征。结果：在2809/9047（31%）流感阳性样本中，82%（2306/2809）为流感A，18%（504/2809）为流感B。亚型流感A中，85%（1848/2169）为A(H3N2)。我们对59%（1099/1848）A(H3N2)病毒进行了测序，其中87%（956/1099）为亚类K，与亚类J.2疫苗抗原不匹配。针对A(H3N2)和亚类K的VE分别为38%（95%置信区间：27%-47%）和33%（19%-45%）。我们对69%（222/323）A(H1N1)pdm09病毒进行了测序，几乎全部（n=218）为5a.2a.1类，包括亚类D.3.1（21%；n=47）和D.3.1.1（77%；n=171），与亚类D疫苗抗原匹配。针对A(H1N1)pdm09、亚类D.3.1和D.3.1.1的VE分别为28%（4%-47%）、-21%（-144%-40%）和44%（14%-64%）。我们对82%（413/504）流感B病毒进行了测序，均为B/Victoria，包括抗原不匹配的亚类C.3。
items.abstract: Background: The 2025/26 influenza season included A(H3N2) subclade K predominance with A(H1N1)pdm09 co-circulation and subsequent prolonged influenza B activity. The Canadian Sentinel Practitioner Surveillance Network reports vaccine effectiveness (VE) in the context of genetic and antigenic relatedness to circulating viruses. Methods: We estimated VE by test-negative design among outpatients with medically-attended acute respiratory illness between November and April. We characterized case viruses by whole genome sequencing and hemagglutination inhibition assay. Results: Among 2809/9047 (31%) influenza-positive specimens, 82% (2306/2809) were influenza A with 18% (504/2809) influenza B. Of subtyped influenza A, 85% (1848/2169) were A(H3N2). We sequenced 59% (1099/1848) of A(H3N2) viruses, with 87% (956/1099) subclade K, antigenically-mismatched to subclade J.2 vaccine. VE against A(H3N2) and subclade K was 38% (95% confidence interval: 27%-47%) and 33% (19%-45%). We sequenced 69% (222/323) of A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses, virtually all (n=218) clade 5a.2a.1, including subclades D.3.1 (21%; n=47) and D.3.1.1 (77%; n=171), antigenically-matched to subclade D vaccine. items.title: Continuous theta-burst stimulation to a lesion network in cervical dystonia: a randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled, pilot trial
items.title_zh: 连续θ波刺激颈部肌张力障碍病灶网络的随机对照试验
items.summary_zh: 背景：颈部肌张力障碍的机制尚不明确，限制了有效非侵入性治疗的发展。研究定位了一个源自病灶的脑网络，主要集中在体感皮层，作为非侵入性脑刺激的潜在靶点。目的：本研究进行了一项随机、假对照、交叉试验，向S1病灶网络中心施加连续θ波刺激（cTBS），测试其对颈部肌张力障碍症状的调节效果。方法：13名特发性颈部肌张力障碍患者（57.85 ± 10.85岁）接受了两组各10次的双侧体感皮层cTBS（主动或假刺激；平衡设计）。主要结果为颈部肌张力障碍症状的变化，通过多伦多西部痉挛性斜颈量表（TWSTRS）测量。可穿戴运动传感器客观测量头颈部运动模式的变化。运动诱发电位和静息态fMRI评估cTBS引起的皮质脊髓兴奋性和功能连接的变化。结果：与假刺激相比，主动cTBS未显著减少颈部肌张力障碍症状（条件×时间点交互：p = .149）。主动cTBS显著增加了运动范围（p = .015）。假刺激后皮质脊髓兴奋性下降（p = .042）。
items.abstract: Background: The mechanisms driving cervical dystonia remain unclear, limiting effective, non-invasive treatment development. Lesion network mapping previously localized a brain network derived from lesions causing cervical dystonia, with a network hub in the somatosensory cortex, a viable target for non-invasive brain stimulation. Objectives: We conducted a randomized, sham-controlled, crossover trial administering continuous theta-burst stimulation (cTBS) to the S1 lesion network hub, testing whether modulating this network reduces CD symptoms. Methods: Thirteen idiopathic cervical dystonia patients (57.85 {+/-} 10.85 years) received two 10-session blocks of bilateral somatosensory cortex cTBS (active or sham; counterbalanced). The primary outcome was change in cervical dystonia symptoms, measured by the Toronto Western Spasmodic Torticollis Scale (TWSTRS). A wearable motion sensor objectively measured change in head and neck movement patterns. Motor evoked potentials and resting-state fMRI assessed cTBS-induced changes in corticospinal excitability and functional connectivity, respectively. items.title: Effective tumor kinetics inferred from single routine H&E biopsies enable counterfactual virtual radiotherapy trials
items.title_zh: 从常规H&E活检推断肿瘤动力学以支持虚拟放疗试验
items.summary_zh: 常规H&E组织病理学捕捉肿瘤生态系统的空间快照，但计算病理学通常将其视为纹理，未明确与基础动力学关联。我们展示了如何从单次活检中推断出特定患者的机械反应-扩散模型参数。通过将细胞核点模式与分析的二点相关函数和功率谱密度联合拟合，恢复了来自十一项多中心队列的患者特异性增殖和扩散速率。推导的扩散长度和前沿速度定义了机械表型，能够分层无进展生存期和总生存期，并提供独立于常规协变量的信息。我们在胶质母细胞瘤中展示了反事实放疗模拟，结果表明将组织学校准的快速生长肿瘤降级为低分次放疗，同时对慢生长肿瘤进行剂量强化，能够在标准治疗基础上增加96.7天的限制性平均无进展生存期（随机分配至相同组的置换p<0.001）。这为从常规组织病理学向机械解释的模型基础前向模拟提供了低门槛的过渡。
items.abstract: Routine H&E-histopathology captures spatial snapshots of tumor ecosystems, yet computational pathology largely treats them as textures without explicit links to underlying kinetics. We show that patient-specific parameters of a mechanistic reaction-diffusion model can be inferred from a single biopsy. Cell-nucleus point patterns are fitted jointly to the analytical two-point correlation function and power spectral density, recovering patient-specific mechanistic proliferation and diffusion rates across eleven multicenter cohorts. Derived dispersion length and front velocity define mechanistic phenotypes stratifying progression-free and overall survival and adding information independent of routine covariates. We illustrate counterfactual radiotherapy simulations in glioblastoma and show that a virtual clinical trial deescalating histology-calibrated faster-growing tumors to hypofractionation while dose-intensifying slower-growing tumors adds 96.7 days of restricted mean progression-free in silico survival over standard of care (permutation p<0.001 against random allocation to the same arms). items.title: Resource Overlap and Reporting of Independence in Public Prostate Cancer Research
items.title_zh: 公共前列腺癌研究中的资源重叠与独立性报告
items.summary_zh: 重要性：公共前列腺癌数据可能在不同的数据库标识符或版本下出现，同时代表重叠的患者、标本或样本记录。这对报告的分析独立性在资源和出版层面上都需要评估。目的：描述选定公共前列腺癌资源之间的非独立性，并评估相关资源在出版物中报告的重叠控制。设计：横断面方法审计。资源记录的对账截至2026年9月2日；保留来源的恢复和裁定持续到2026年9月8日。通过语言模型提取和针对原始来源的检查进行确定性分类。作者在2026年9月手动验证所有阳性发现，包括补充材料。设置：公共前列腺癌数据库及欧洲PMC和PubMed检索，出版截止日期为2026年8月15日。参与者：189个数据库研究记录和108个出版/版本记录，贡献230个出版-资源-对记录。主要结果和测量：支持的身份水平和可解析的患者标识符计数；在需要独立性的关联分析中报告的重叠控制。
items.abstract: Importance Public prostate cancer data may appear under different repository identifiers or releases while representing overlapping patients, specimens, or sample records. The implications for reported analytic independence require assessment at both resource and publication levels. Objective To characterize supported nonindependence among selected public prostate cancer resources and assess reported overlap control in publications using related resources. Design Cross-sectional methodological audit. Resource records were reconciled through September 2, 2026; recovery of retained sources and adjudication continued through September 8, 2026. Language-model extraction and targeted original-source checks informed deterministic classification. The authors manually verified all positive findings, including supplementary materials, in September 2026. Setting Public prostate cancer repositories and Europe PMC and PubMed retrieval, with a publication cutoff of August 15, 2026. Participants A nonrepresentative frame of 189 repository study records and 108 publication/version records contributing 230 publication-resource-pair records. items.title: Aspergillus and Candida in primary and secondary immunodeficiencies in USIDNET
items.title_zh: 美国免疫缺陷网络中曲霉菌与念珠菌的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨曲霉菌感染与免疫缺陷之间的关系。我们利用美国免疫缺陷网络（USIDNET）患者注册数据，提取了诊断为念珠菌和曲霉菌的患者的临床状况和实验室数值，重点关注深部感染。结果显示，41名患者被诊断为曲霉菌感染，相关诊断包括T细胞疾病、抗体疾病及预期的髓系疾病，骨髓移植被识别为潜在的诱发条件。同时，64名患者被诊断为念珠菌感染，发现与T细胞疾病、抗体疾病和髓系疾病相关。结论是，念珠菌和曲霉菌通常被视为髓系疾病和T细胞疾病的哨兵感染，但我们发现这些感染与多种先天性免疫缺陷相关，提示在面对这些感染患者时应扩大诊断检测范围。
items.abstract: Abstract Objective Fungal infections can represent opportunistic infections leading to the diagnosis of immunocompromise. Specific inborn errors of immunity are associated with aspergillus but it is unclear how sensitive aspergillus is for the subsequent diagnosis of those inborn errors of immunity. Methods The patient registry USIDNET was utilized to extract clinical conditions and laboratory values from patients with candida and aspergillus diagnosis codes. We restricted the diagnoses to deep infections and then identified the associated clinical conditions along with potential settings, such as bone marrow transplant. Results We identified 41 patients with aspergillus as a diagnosis code. The types of diagnoses associated with aspergillus included T cell disorders, antibody disorders, as well as the anticipated myeloid disorders. Bone marrow transplant was identified as a potential predisposing condition. 64. Patients were identified with candida as a diagnosis code. Similarly, T cell disorders, antibody disorders, and myeloid disorders were found. items.title: The ''Hamburg Life After Cancer Program'': Development, Implementation and Evaluation of a Structured Survivorship Program - Study Protocol of a Hybrid Effectiveness-Implementation Study
items.title_zh: 汉堡癌后生活计划：结构化生存计划的开发与评估
items.summary_zh: 背景：多模式肿瘤治疗的进展提高了生存率，导致癌症幸存者人数增加。然而，许多幸存者在完成积极治疗后仍经历身体和心理的长期影响，亟需超越肿瘤监测的随访护理。方法：本研究为前瞻性单中心单臂干预研究，旨在开发、实施并系统评估汉堡癌后生活计划。采用混合型2级效果-实施设计，主要目标是提高参与者（n = 500，年龄18-65岁，完成初级治疗的癌症幸存者）的健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）。次要目标包括改善多种生物-心理-社会结果，并与接受常规护理的外部对照组（n = 250）进行HRQoL的探索性比较。结果将在基线、26周和52周进行评估，实施效果将通过混合方法进行评估。干预内容包括患者导航、多维评估、生存咨询和跨学科生存委员会等。
items.abstract: Background: Advances in multimodal oncological treatment have improved survival, resulting in a growing population of cancer survivors. Yet, many survivors experience physical and psychosocial late and long-term effects after completing active cancer treatment, highlighting the need for follow-up care that extends beyond tumor surveillance. However, structured survivorship programs addressing survivors' broader needs and evidence on their effectiveness and implementation remain limited. Methods: This prospective, single-center, single-arm intervention study with an external control cohort aims to develop, implement, and systematically evaluate the Hamburg Life After Cancer Program. Applying a hybrid type 2 effectiveness-implementation design, the primary aim is to improve health-related quality of life (HRQoL) among program participants (n = 500), namely cancer survivors aged 18-65 years who completed primary treatment. Secondary objectives include improvements in various bio-psycho-social outcomes, as well as an exploratory comparison of HRQoL with an external control cohort receiving usual care (n = 250). Outcomes are assessed at baseline, 26 weeks and 52 weeks. Implementation is

items.title: AI detects a distributed blood metabolomic Systemotype associated with early stage ovarian cancer
items.title_zh: AI检测与早期卵巢癌相关的血液代谢组系统型
items.summary_zh: 早期卵巢癌的检测仍然是临床挑战，因为现有的血液生物标志物缺乏进行人群筛查所需的敏感性和特异性。我们研究了早期卵巢癌是否与循环代谢组中的分布生理状态相关。分析了两个独立回顾性队列的非靶向代谢组谱：91个血清样本（59个卵巢癌，32个健康对照）和83个血浆样本（63个卵巢癌，20个健康对照）。在每个队列中，使用五折交叉验证训练和评估特定检测的增强决策树。选定操作点时，血清的平均交叉验证敏感性和特异性分别为99.0%和99.8%，血浆为97.7%和99.7%。限制输入为强失调特征并未改善整体敏感性与假阳性率的权衡，较小的面板降低了敏感性。两个队列共享239个一致改变的注释特征，涵盖脂质、氨基酸、类固醇、中心碳和氧化还原代谢。这些发现与肿瘤和宿主之间的分布代谢反应一致，尽管未测量组织贡献。我们提出分类器识别代谢组系统型，这是一种反映在循环代谢物中的综合生理状态。
items.abstract: Early detection of ovarian cancer remains a clinical challenge because available blood biomarkers lack the sensitivity and specificity required for population screening. We tested whether early-stage ovarian cancer is associated with a distributed physiological state in the circulating metabolome. We analyzed untargeted metabolomic profiles from two independent retrospective cohorts: 91 serum samples (59 ovarian cancer, 32 healthy controls) and 83 plasma samples (63 ovarian cancer, 20 healthy controls). Assay-specific boosted decision trees were trained and evaluated independently within each cohort using five-fold cross-validation repeated over 50 randomized rounds. At selected operating points, mean cross-validated sensitivity and specificity were 99.0% and 99.8% in serum and 97.7% and 99.7% in plasma. Restricting inputs to strongly dysregulated features did not improve the overall sensitivity false positive rate trade off, and smaller panels reduced sensitivity. The cohorts shared 239 concordantly altered annotated features spanning lipid, amino-acid, steroid, central-carbon, and redox metabolism. items.title: Self-supervised plasma proteomic representations for prospective disease prediction across varying protein availability
items.title_zh: 自监督血浆蛋白组表示法在疾病预测中的应用
items.summary_zh: 大规模血浆蛋白组学为表征疾病易感性和改善前瞻性风险预测提供了机会，但由于不同队列、研究阶段和检测配置中测量的蛋白质集合不同，跨数据集转移蛋白质预测因子仍然具有挑战性。本文开发了一种自监督的蛋白质标记Transformer，将每个样本中观察到的蛋白质映射到固定维度的参与者表示，从而允许省略不可用的蛋白质。利用来自UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project的53,014名参与者的血浆蛋白组数据，我们通过掩蔽蛋白重建预训练了编码器，并评估了基于2920种蛋白质的疾病模型是否可以与预定义的1460种蛋白质子集重用。在144种疾病中，全面覆盖下的中位AUC为0.679，而在不重新拟合的部分覆盖表示中应用相同编码器和疾病模型时为0.637；仅重新训练特定疾病模型使中位AUC提高至0.673。在部分覆盖下，蛋白质标记蛋白组风险评分（ProRS）比系数截断的LASSO ProRS中位AUC高出0.027，且与使用结果标签重新拟合的LASSO ProRS相当，中位差异为0.003。性能在心血管疾病中相对稳定。
items.abstract: Large-scale plasma proteomics offers opportunities to characterize disease susceptibility and improve prospective risk prediction, but transferring proteomic predictors across datasets remains challenging because measured protein sets differ across cohorts, study phases and assay configurations. Here we developed a self-supervised protein-token Transformer that maps the proteins observed in each sample to a fixed-dimensional participant representation, allowing unavailable proteins to be omitted rather than imputed. Using plasma proteomic profiles from 53,014 participants in the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project, we pretrained the encoder by masked-protein reconstruction and evaluated whether disease models developed from comprehensive 2,920-protein profiles could be reused with a predefined subset of 1,460 proteins. Across 144 diseases, median AUC was 0.679 with comprehensive coverage and 0.637 when the same encoder and disease models were applied to partial-coverage representations without refitting; retraining only the disease-specific models increased median AUC to 0.673. Under partial coverage, protein-token proteomic risk scores (ProRS) exceeded coefficient-truncated LASSO

items.title: Mechanosignaling Promotes Macrophage Apoptosis Resistance in Pulmonary Fibrosis via Metabolic Reprogramming
items.title_zh: 机械信号促进肺纤维化中巨噬细胞抗凋亡能力
items.summary_zh: 特发性肺纤维化（IPF）及其他间质性肺病的进展机制尚不明确。细胞外基质刚度增加是纤维化肺病的特征。单核细胞来源的巨噬细胞可促进纤维化进展，但机械微环境的特性如何影响巨噬细胞表型仍不清楚。研究表明，机械激活的巨噬细胞表现出抗凋亡特性，伴随抗凋亡蛋白Bcl-xL表达增加及线粒体氧化磷酸化增强。关键是，机械激活巨噬细胞的代谢重编程依赖于谷氨酰胺代谢。抑制谷氨酰胺代谢减弱了机械激活巨噬细胞的抗凋亡能力。此外，体内抑制Bcl-xL可保护小鼠免受实验性肺纤维化的影响。最后，机械激活的IPF巨噬细胞在精密切割的肺片中产生更多促纤维化细胞因子并促进细胞外基质的生成。
items.abstract: The mechanisms underlying the progression of pulmonary fibrosis in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and other interstitial lung diseases remain unclear. Increased extracellular matrix stiffness is a hallmark of fibrotic lung diseases. Monocyte-derived macrophages can promote fibrosis progression. However, there is limited understanding of how the mechanical properties of the fibrotic microenvironment influence macrophage phenotypes. Profibrotic macrophages are apoptosis-resistant, and this phenotype is modulated by enhanced mitochondrial bioenergetics. The objective of the study was to determine how lung tissue stiffness impacts macrophage phenotypes and fibrotic progression. We demonstrate that mechanoactivated macrophages exhibit apoptosis-resistance, increased expression of the antiapoptotic protein Bcl-xL and increased mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation. Critically, the metabolic reprogramming observed in mechanoactivated macrophages is dependent on increased glutaminolysis. items.title: Development of Longitudinal, Linked Maternal-Infant Cohorts using the Epic Cosmos Electronic Health Record Dataset
items.title_zh: 利用Epic Cosmos电子健康记录数据集构建母婴纵向队列
items.summary_zh: 背景：Epic Cosmos是一个相对较新的集中式电子健康记录数据集，在围产期流行病学研究中具有较高的潜在应用价值。目的：本研究旨在开发可复制的步骤，以在Cosmos中创建纵向的母婴队列，评估关键变量的完整性，评估因限制纵向医疗接触而可能产生的选择偏倚，并提供一个流行病学分析示例。方法：我们通过从2023-2024年记录的出生数据表中提取活产数据，并根据需要与其他数据表连接，创建母婴队列。我们选择并创建了围产期特征、常见合并症以及常规测量的生命体征和实验室值的变量，并评估了变量的完整性。我们依次限制出生队列以实现母婴链接和从妊娠早期产前护理到出生住院后12周内的婴儿随访护理的纵向医疗。最后，我们分析了妊娠早期高收缩压（≥140 mm Hg）与慢性高血压患者后期妊娠高血压先兆症的关联。结果：总链接出生队列包括2,624,186例妊娠。大多数评估变量的完整性超过90%，但某些变量的完整性为77%。
items.abstract: Background: Epic Cosmos is a relatively new centralized electronic health record dataset with high potential utility in perinatal epidemiologic research. Objectives: The study objectives were to develop replicable steps to create longitudinal, linked maternal-infant cohorts in Cosmos, assess completeness of key variables, evaluate potential selection bias with restrictions for longitudinal healthcare encounters, and provide an example epidemiologic analysis. Methods: We created maternal-infant cohorts by starting with live births during 2023-2024 recorded in the BirthFact data table and joining with additional data tables as needed. We selected and created variables for perinatal characteristics, common comorbidities, and routinely measured vital signs and laboratory values, and assessed variable completeness. We sequentially restricted the birth cohort for maternal-infant linkage and longitudinal healthcare from first-trimester prenatal care encounter through infant follow-up care within 12 weeks post-discharge from birth hospitalization. items.authors: Leonard, S. A.; Dysart, K.; Callahan, A.; Siadat, S.; Zhang, J.; Handley, S. C.; Huybrechts, K. F.; Igbinosa, I.; Bateman, B. T.

items.title: Modifiers of Influenza Vaccine Immunity from over Ten Years of Serological Data
items.title_zh: 流感疫苗免疫性的修饰因素：十年血清数据分析
items.summary_zh: 年度流感疫苗接种是季节性保护的基础，但个体和时间上的抗体反应差异显著。为系统评估这种异质性的决定因素，我们汇总了来自14项新疫苗研究和50项先前研究的21,373个血凝抑制和中和滴度数据，参与者共4,453人，时间跨度为2010-2023年。季节性、年龄、疫苗品牌和接种前抗体滴度是影响接种后滴度的主要且一致的修饰因素，超越了性别、传代或接种历史的影响。B Yamagata的滴度在所有年份中保持稳定，表明其独特的持久性及可能导致谱系灭绝的原因。接种时间被发现是一个重要且之前未被充分重视的免疫决定因素，季节晚接种的个体表现出更高的接种后滴度。未接种或接种活减毒的FluMist疫苗在随后的季节显著增强了对灭活疫苗的反应，分别在53%或67%的队列中，而高剂量疫苗在调整年龄和季节性后提高了接种后滴度。这些发现量化了年龄如何以空前的分辨率影响流感抗体反应，并识别了接种时间和季节背景的重要性。
items.abstract: Annual influenza vaccination is the cornerstone for seasonal protection, yet antibody responses are highly variable across individuals and over time. To systematically assess the determinants of this heterogeneity, we compiled 21,373 hemagglutination inhibition and neutralization titers from 4,453 participants enrolled in 14 new vaccine studies we conducted and 50 prior studies that collectively span 2010-2023. Seasonality, age, vaccine brand, and pre-vaccination antibody titers were the largest and most consistent modifier of post-vaccination titers, outweighing the influence of sex, passaging, or vaccination history. Titers to B Yamagata remained steady throughout all years examined, suggesting unique durability and a potential reason for lineage extinction. Vaccine timing emerged as a strong and previously underappreciated determinant of immunity, with individuals vaccinated later in the season exhibiting larger post-vaccination titers. items.title: Detection and Continuous Monitoring of Memory Dysfunction in Mild Cognitive Impairment and Healthy Aging Through Adaptive Computational Phenotyping
items.title_zh: 通过自适应计算表型检测和监测轻度认知障碍的记忆功能
items.summary_zh: 随着与年龄相关的记忆障碍的普遍性上升，及时检测和监测记忆功能下降变得愈发紧迫。传统评估方法因需面对面进行且无法频繁重复而难以满足需求。本研究展示了通过在线评估平台与计算表型相结合，能够远程识别和监测异常记忆功能的可能性。51名老年参与者（包括24名有记忆障碍的轻度认知障碍患者和27名匹配的健康对照）完成了为期一年的每周8分钟在线记忆评估。每周测试数据被拟合到记忆巩固和遗忘的正式模型中，得出了个体化的记忆功能指数——西雅图-格罗宁根记忆评估（SGMA）分数。SGMA分数可靠性高，评估间平均相关性为r = 0.70，且在不同研究材料中稳定，仅受练习效应轻微影响（平均每次评估增加0.2%）。最后，SGMA分数具有诊断能力，能够以高达87%的准确率检测轻度认知障碍。
items.abstract: With the rising prevalence of age-related memory impairments, efficiently detecting and monitoring decline is increasingly urgent. Unfortunately, traditional assessment methods fall short of these needs, as they typically require in-person administration and cannot be repeated frequently. Here, we demonstrate that remote identification and monitoring of abnormal memory function is possible by combining an online assessment platform with computational phenotyping, allowing repeatable, unsupervised remote observations from patients. Fifty-one well-characterized older individuals, including 24 patients with amnestic mild cognitive impairment and 27 age- and education-matched healthy controls, completed a series of longitudinal, unsupervised, remote weekly 8-minute online memory assessments for up to one year. Weekly test data were fit to a formal model of memory consolidation and forgetting, yielding an individualized index of memory function, the Seattle-Groningen Memory Assessment (SGMA) score. items.authors: Hake, H. S.; van der Velde, M.; Grabowski, T.; van Rijn, H.; Stocco, A.

items.title: Prenatal and postpartum tobacco use in adolescents and young adults: a qualitative study
items.title_zh: 青少年及年轻人产前与产后烟草使用的定性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：年轻的产科患者在怀孕期间更可能使用可燃烟草产品和/或大麻，且在戒烟后更容易复吸。针对这一人群的产前烟草使用背景的研究较少。本研究通过定性访谈，探讨年轻孕妇的信念、态度、尼古丁和烟草使用原因及戒烟经历。方法：从匹兹堡的产前门诊招募22岁以下的孕妇进行队列研究，部分参与者接受了关于烟草和大麻使用的半结构化访谈。两名编码员独立使用开放式归纳方法对所有访谈记录进行编码，研究团队通过定性描述方法进行主题分析。结果：我们对46名年龄在17至23岁（平均19.7岁）的参与者进行了57次访谈。大多数参与者（n=33）为黑人/非裔美国人，9人为白人，4人为双种族。38名参与者在怀孕期间接受访谈（n=13为妊娠早期，n=18为妊娠中期，n=12为妊娠晚期），14名在产后接受访谈。我们识别出以下主题：1）产前烟草使用的影响因素。
items.abstract: Background: Younger obstetric patients are more likely to use combustible tobacco products and/or cannabis during pregnancy and, among those who quit, are more likely to relapse in the postpartum. Few studies have explored the context of prenatal tobacco use in this population from the narratives and perspectives of these patients. We performed a qualitative interview study of young pregnant people, their beliefs, attitudes, reasons for nicotine and tobacco use, and tobacco cessation experiences to address this gap. Methods: Pregnant patients under the age of 22 were recruited from prenatal clinics in Pittsburgh for a cohort study. A subsample of participants were invited to participate in semi-structured interviews about tobacco and cannabis use. Two coders independently coded all transcripts using an open, inductive approach. The research team then used a qualitative description approach to perform thematic analysis by reviewing high frequency codes, identifying patterns and categories, and identifying themes. items.title: Global determinants of vector-targeted insecticide use in public health: a modeling and mapping analysis
items.title_zh: 全球公共卫生中针对病媒的杀虫剂使用的决定因素分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：杀虫剂是控制人类病原体传播媒介的关键，但其全球使用模式及其社会经济和环境驱动因素尚不明确。了解杀虫剂的使用情况及原因对优化控制措施至关重要。方法：我们分析了1990年至2019年间123个国家的年国家级针对病媒的杀虫剂使用数据，包括杀虫剂处理网（ITNs）、残留喷洒（RS）、空间喷洒（SS）和幼虫控制（LA）。采用广义线性混合模型和障碍模型量化部署与蚊媒传播疾病发生率、人类发展指数（HDI）、人口、温度和降水之间的关联。模型通过重复交叉验证进行评估，并用于生成全球子国家行政区域的杀虫剂使用预测。发现：杀虫剂的部署与蚊媒传播疾病发生率呈正相关，但在高HDI国家中反应更强，表明部署依赖于社会经济能力和疾病负担。不同干预类型表现出不同模式，ITN和RS与按蚊传播疾病发生率相关，而SS和LA则与按蚊传播疾病发生率相关。ITN使用随降水和温度增加而增加，而SS使用则随降水减少。
items.abstract: Background. Insecticides are the cornerstone of control for vectors of human pathogens, yet global patterns of deployment and their socioeconomic and environmental drivers are poorly characterized. Understanding where and why insecticides are used is essential for optimizing control efforts. Methods. We analyzed annual national vector-targeted insecticide-use data spanning 123 countries (1990-2019) for insecticide-treated nets (ITNs), residual spraying (RS), space spraying (SS), and larviciding (LA). Generalized linear mixed models and hurdle models quantified associations between deployment and mosquito-borne disease incidence, human development index (HDI), population, temperature, and precipitation. Models were evaluated using repeated cross-validation and applied to generate downscaled predictions of insecticide use at subnational administrative regions globally. Findings. Insecticide deployment increased with mosquito-borne disease incidence, but this response was stronger in higher-HDI countries, indicating that deployment depends on socioeconomic capacity as well as disease burden. items.title: State-Adaptive Versus Target-First Music Sequencing for Working Adults With Occupational Stress: Affective Dynamics and Symptom Outcomes in a Home-Based, Web-Delivered Randomized Trial
items.title_zh: 针对职业压力的音乐序列干预：状态适应与目标优先比较
items.summary_zh: 背景：基于网络的音乐干预具有可扩展性，但自动化交付需要决定音乐的序列方式。本研究将iso原则操作化为会话级状态适应序列策略（ISO），并与目标优先直接提升交付（DUL）进行比较。方法：在一项两组随机试验中，120名报告职业压力的中文工作成年人以1:1的比例分配到ISO或DUL组。参与者在五天的预干预观察期后，完成五个连续的晚间音乐会话，音乐通过网络平台在其家庭环境中远程交付。主要结果为职业压力、焦虑和抑郁症状的基线到即时后变化，使用意向治疗混合效应模型进行分析。研究发现两种序列策略在日常使用条件下的情感动态表现。
items.abstract: Background: Web-based music interventions are scalable, but automated delivery requires decisions about how music should be sequenced. The iso principle provides a rationale for beginning with mood-matched music and gradually progressing toward an affective target, but translating this therapist-guided principle into a reproducible digital intervention requires formalizing it as explicit rules for music selection and sequencing. Methods: We operationalized the iso principle as a session-level state-adaptive sequencing strategy (ISO) and compared it with target-first direct-uplifting delivery (DUL) in a home-based web-delivered intervention, testing two automated routes toward the same affective target. In a two-arm randomized trial, 120 Chinese-speaking working adults reporting occupational stress were allocated 1:1 to ISO or DUL. Following a common five-day pre-intervention observation period, participants completed five consecutive evening sessions of music delivered remotely through a web-based platform in their own home environments, allowing the two sequencing strategies to be evaluated under repeated, everyday-use conditions. items.title: Effects of Deficient Glycosylation and Deglycosylation on Sperm Condition in Zebrafish (Danio rerio)
items.title_zh: 缺乏糖基化和去糖基化对斑马鱼精子状态的影响
items.summary_zh: 糖基化和去糖基化的先天性疾病是罕见且严重的疾病，影响人类健康。CDGs和CDDGs导致功能丧失的酶，无法合成或分解蛋白质上的寡糖，进而产生蛋白质聚集和活性氧物质，损害细胞，最终导致自噬和凋亡。由于精子中含有高浓度的不饱和脂肪酸，因此对这些影响特别敏感，这被认为是人类男性不育的主要因素之一。斑马鱼的精子发育与人类相似，是研究人类生殖健康和遗传疾病的有用模型。对携带杂合ALG1或DPAGT1 CDGs或NGLY1 CDDG的斑马鱼精子进行分析，评估了精子浓度、运动能力、状态、活力和低渗透膨胀。结果显示，与野生型相比，所有突变斑马鱼的精子浓度、运动能力和低渗透膨胀显著降低。这表明CDGs和CDDGs影响精子的产生量、活动精子细胞的百分比及细胞膜的完整性。
items.abstract: Congenital disorders of glycosylation and deglycosylation are rare, serious, and lethal disorders afflicting humans. CDGs and CDDGs result in loss of function enzymes which fail to build or break down oligosaccharides on proteins. This can produce protein aggregates and, in turn, reactive oxygen species that harm the cell eventually leading to autophagy and apoptosis. Because sperm contain high concentrations of polyunsaturated fatty acids, they are especially sensitive to these effects, which is understood as one of the leading factors in human male infertility. Sperm are developed in zebrafish similarly to humans and are useful models to examine human reproductive health, as well as genetic disorders. The combination of these advantages makes the analysis of sperm from zebrafish with heterozygous ALG1 or DPAGT1 CDGs or the NGLY1 CDDG suitable. Analysis of sperm concentration, motility, status, viability, and hypoosmotic swelling demonstrated the effects of these disorders on sperm quality. Results showed a significant decrease in sperm concentration, motility, and hypoosmotic swelling for all mutant zebrafish compared to the wild type. This suggests that CDGs and CDDGs influence
items.authors: McGraw, K.; Mooney, M.

items.title: Spectral normative modeling of brain structure
items.title_zh: 脑结构的光谱规范建模
items.summary_zh: 神经科学中的规范建模旨在表征脑表型的个体间变异，并建立参考范围或脑图，以便进行比较。传统的规范模型因计算限制通常局限于粗略的空间尺度，限制了其空间特异性。此外，依赖固定的分区图谱也限制了其对替代分区方案的适应性。为克服这些关键限制，我们提出了光谱规范建模（SNM），利用脑的特征模式高效生成任意定义的感兴趣区域的规范范围。在超过78,000个健康脑扫描上训练SNM，我们生成了不同空间尺度（从毫米到整个脑）的准确生命周期厚度增长图。这些图揭示了三个主要的厚度增长梯度，将神经典型皮层变化与既定的解剖、遗传和功能层级对齐。我们进一步通过阐明阿尔茨海默病中神经退行性变异的高分辨率个体皮层萎缩模式，展示了SNM的实用性。SNM为新一代空间精确的脑图奠定了基础，具有推动个性化精准医学进展的巨大潜力。
items.abstract: Normative modeling in neuroscience aims to characterize interindividual variation in brain phenotypes and establish reference ranges, or brain charts, against which individuals can be compared. Normative models are typically limited to coarse spatial scales due to computational constraints, limiting their spatial specificity. Furthermore, dependence on fixed parcellation atlases limits their adaptability to alternative parcellation schemes. To overcome these key limitations, we propose spectral normative modeling (SNM), which leverages brain eigenmodes to efficiently generate normative ranges for arbitrarily defined regions of interest. Training SNM on over 78,000 healthy brain scans, we generate accurate lifespan thickness growth charts across different spatial scales, from millimeters to the whole brain. These charts reveal three principal thickness growth gradients, aligning neurotypical cortical change with established anatomical, genetic, and functional hierarchies. We further demonstrate SNM's utility by elucidating high-resolution individual cortical atrophy patterns that characterize the heterogeneous expression of neurodegeneration in Alzheimer's disease. items.title: Speech Intelligibility Index (SII) as a Potential Referral Metric for Adult Cochlear Implant Candidacy Evaluation
items.title_zh: 语音可懂度指数（SII）作为成人人工耳蜗候选评估的潜在指标
items.summary_zh: 目的：本研究旨在探讨（1）语音可懂度指数（SII）是否可以用于识别符合人工耳蜗（CI）植入标准的耳朵，超出“60/60”转诊指南，以及（2）患者自用助听器（HAs）与最佳适配的临床助听器之间的SII关系，以便患者自用助听器可作为最佳适配助听器的代理，从而作为转诊指标。方法：前瞻性研究，参与者为23名（[ ] 18岁）双侧中度至重度感音神经性听力损失的CI候选者。使用Verifit II设备记录SII-Clinic（SII-C）值，语音刺激在60 dB A下进行评估。参与者自用助听器的SII值作为更大研究协议的一部分记录，称为SII-P，使用Verifit I设备在65 dB A下进行粉红噪声刺激的探头麦克风测量。未佩戴助听器的参与者未计算SII-P。数据在耳朵间合并，进行SII与最佳辅助辅音-元音-辅音（CNC）之间的相关性分析。基准SII值通过最佳拟合线推断，反映不同辅助CNC评分的CI候选率。
items.abstract: Objectives: The purpose of this pilot study was to investigate (1) if the Speech Intelligibility Index (SII) could be used to identify ears that meet cochlear implant (CI) candidacy beyond the "60/60" referral guidelines and (2) investigate the relationship between SII from patients' own hearing aids (HAs) and SII from optimally fit clinic-stock HAs such that a patient's own HAs can act as a proxy for an optimally fit HA and thus as a referral metric. Design: Prospective study of 23 participants ([ ] 18 years) with bilateral moderate to profound sensorineural hearing loss who were CI candidates in at least one ear. SII-Clinic (SII-C) values were recorded with probe-microphone measures using a Verifit II device (NAL-N2 targets) with speech stimuli presented at 60 dB A during patient CI evaluation in either their own HAs or clinic-stock HAs. SII values from participants' own HAs were recorded as part of a larger research protocol, thus SII-Personal (SII-P), with probe-microphone measures using a Verifit I device (NAL-RP targets) with pink noise stimuli presented at 65 dB A. items.title: An automated genetic screen identifies modulators of stress-induced sleep in Caenorhabditis elegans
items.title_zh: 自动化遗传筛选识别线虫应激诱导睡眠调节因子
items.summary_zh: 动物在生病时会增加睡眠。在秀丽隐杆线虫（C. elegans）中，应激诱导睡眠（SIS）发生在细胞损伤后，例如紫外线（UV）照射。SIS的遗传调控因子尚未完全明确。我们使用虫子挑选机器人、多孔WorMotel成像和关联分析，对941个全基因组测序的百万突变项目（MMP）菌株进行了半自动化筛选。我们在紫外线照射前后量化了行为活动和静止状态。应用序列核关联测试（SKAT）对这些行为数据进行分析，优先考虑了6,663个基因，并观察到已知SIS遗传调控因子的显著富集。基于这些结果，我们进行了候选基因的验证筛选，识别出三个基因（strd-1、egl-8、cla-1），其突变可重复影响SIS。这些发现为理解SIS的分子基础提供了潜在的研究方向，并建立了结合基因关联的自动化行为表型分析管道，以加速线虫神经遗传学研究。
items.abstract: Animals sleep more when they are sick. In C. elegans, stress-induced sleep (SIS) follows cellular injury such as exposure to ultraviolet (UV) light. The genetic regulators of SIS remain incompletely defined. Using a worm picking robot, multi-well WorMotel imaging, and association analysis we performed a semi-automated screen of 941 whole genome sequenced Million Mutation Project (MMP) strains. We quantified behavioral activity and quiescence before and after ultraviolet (UV) radiation. We applied the Sequence Kernel Association Test (SKAT) to this behavioral data to prioritize 6,663 genes and observed significant enrichment of known SIS genetic regulators. Based on these results, we conducted a candidate validation screen for additional genes regulating SIS. We identified three genes (strd-1, egl-8, cla-1), mutations in which reproducibly influence SIS. Further exploration of these genes holds potential for enhancing our understanding of the molecular basis of SIS. These findings establish a pipeline for automated behavioral phenotyping coupled with gene-based association to accelerate studies of C. elegans neurogenetics.
items.authors: Li, Z. J.; Honarpisheh, H.; Kutagulla, S.; Lecure, K.; Liang, J.; Raizen, D. M.; Fang-Yen, C.

items.title: Benchmarking methods integrating GWAS and single-cell transcriptomic data for mapping trait-cell type associations
items.title_zh: 整合GWAS与单细胞转录组数据的性状-细胞类型关联方法基准评估
items.summary_zh: 全基因组关联研究（GWAS）发现了众多与性状相关的变异，但其生物学背景尚不明确。将GWAS汇总统计与单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据整合，可以优先考虑这些变异影响性状的细胞类型。现有方法主要有两种策略：单细胞到GWAS，识别细胞类型特异性基因并测试其在GWAS信号中的富集；GWAS到单细胞，从GWAS优先基因开始，根据其表达谱对细胞或细胞类型进行评分。我们开发了一种基于文献的基准，通过整合PubMed证据与大语言模型辅助的文献综合，评估了20种性状-细胞类型映射方法。我们识别出CATCH作为最稳健的方法，能够在模拟和真实数据基准中始终保持高统计功效和有效的假阳性控制。此外，我们还确定了性能的关键决定因素，包括细胞类型特异性指标、GWAS统计功效和scRNA-seq参考数据集的多样性，为性状-细胞类型映射方法的开发和应用提供了实用指导。
items.abstract: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have discovered numerous trait-associated variants, but their biological context remains unclear. Integrating GWAS summary statistics with single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) data enables prioritization of cell types in which these variants influence traits. Existing methods broadly follow two strategies: single cell to GWAS, which identifies cell-type-specific genes and tests their enrichment in GWAS signals, and GWAS to single cell, which begins with GWAS-prioritized genes and scores cells or cell types according to their expression profiles. Here, we developed a literature-informed benchmark by integrating PubMed evidence with large language model-assisted literature synthesis to evaluate 20 trait-cell type mapping methods. We identify CATCH, a Cauchy combination of complementary methods, as the most robust overall approach, consistently achieving high statistical power while maintaining effective false-positive control across simulations and real-data benchmarks. We further identify key determinants of performance, including cell-type specificity metrics, GWAS statistical power, and the diversity of scRNA-seq reference datasets, providi
items.authors: Li, A.; Allen, P.; Wang, Y.; Cui, H.; Lin, T.; Sun, Y.; Wang, X.; Tan, X.; Walker, A.; Wang, S.; Yao, Z.; Zhao, R.; Yang, J.; Yao, S.; Hjerling-Leffler, J.; Sullivan, P. F.; Wray, N. R.; Zeng, J.

items.title: Clonal Haematopoiesis Tracks Alzheimer's-like Cortical Atrophy in Community-Dwelling Older Adults
items.title_zh: 克隆性造血与阿尔茨海默样皮质萎缩的关系研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：克隆性造血（CH）是指与年龄相关的突变血干细胞扩增，约10%的七十岁人群中可检测到，且随着年龄增长显著增加，与多种疾病相关。其与神经退行性疾病的关系仍存在争议，关于对阿尔茨海默病（AD）的保护或有害作用的证据不一。方法：本研究应用COMET，一种基于甲基化的克隆性造血负担预测工具，分析了Lothian Birth Cohort 1936中克隆负担与脑结构的纵向关联。此外，我们开发了CIMS，一种新型的甲基化评分，反映突变和野生型血免疫细胞的表观遗传特征。研究对象为1,091名参与者，包含808（pVAF）和836（CIMS）提供克隆性数据，744名参与者有脑MRI数据。结果显示，克隆性造血的纵向轨迹与脑结构变化存在显著关联。
items.abstract: Background: Clonal haematopoiesis (CH), the age-related expansion of mutated blood stem cells, is detectable in around 10% of people in their seventies, rises steeply with age, and is associated with several diseases. Its relationship with neurodegeneration remains contentious, with conflicting evidence for both protective and detrimental effects on Alzheimer's disease (AD). Methods: Here, we applied COMET, a mutation-agnostic, methylation-based predictor of clonal haematopoiesis burden that estimates predicted VAF (pVAF), to examine longitudinal associations between clonal burden and brain structure in the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936. In addition, to capture broader clonal burden, we developed CIMS, a novel methylation-based score derived from clonal haematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP) EWAS summary statistics, which reflects the epigenetic profile of both mutant and wild-type blood immune cells. Blood DNA methylation and structural MRI data were available at three timepoints spanning ages 73-79 years. The analytic dataset comprised 1,091 participants, of whom 808 (pVAF) and 836 (CIMS) contributed clonality data and 744 had brain MRI; 479-481 had complete baseline and lo

items.title: Reverse Engineering the Programming Logic of Cytoskeletal Dynamics
items.title_zh: 细胞骨架动力学编程逻辑的逆向工程
items.summary_zh: 真核细胞通过细胞骨架丝状结构生成机械力，这些结构由分子马达家族主动重组。然而，马达序列如何指定丝状结构的组织动态仍不清楚。我们开发了ActiveDROPS，一个无细胞平台，在细菌裂解液滴中表达动力蛋白变体，并将结果微管动态定量映射到共同表型空间。在十二种动力蛋白-1同源物的库中，我们观察到三种表型：“慢-持续”流动在8小时后激活，达到峰值平均速度24 nm/s，并在约32小时后衰减；“快-爆发”流动在几分钟内激活并在2小时内消散，速度高达900 nm/s；以及约36小时的“多相”进程，经历了向列、旋转和收缩状态。微管滑动实验和使用AlphaFold预测结构的分子动力学模拟将“快-爆发”表型与通常更快的运动性和更有利的马达-微管相互作用联系起来。通过将“慢-持续”马达的微管结合区域替换为“快-爆发”马达的区域，我们生成了一个“快-持续”嵌合体，其流动在1小时内激活，峰值达到70 nm/s，并持续16小时，显示重组可以重新编程微管-马达自组织的速度与时间关系。
items.abstract: Eukaryotic cells generate mechanical forces through cytoskeletal filaments actively reorganized by families of molecular motors. However, how motor sequence specifies filament organization dynamics remains unclear. We developed ActiveDROPS, a cell-free platform that expresses kinesin variants in bacterial lysate droplets and quantitatively maps the resulting microtubule dynamics into a common phenotype space. Across a library of twelve kinesin-1 homologs, we observed three phenotypes: "Slow-Sustained" flows that activate after 8 h, reach peak mean velocities of 24 nm/s and decay after [~]32 h; "Fast-Burst" flows that activate within minutes and dissipate within 2 h, reaching velocities up to 900 nm/s; and a [~]36-h "Multiphase" progression through nematic, rotational, and contractile states. Microtubule gliding assays and molecular dynamics simulations using AlphaFold-predicted structures linked the "Fast-Burst" phenotype to generally faster motility and more favorable motor-tubulin interactions than "Slow-Sustained". By replacing the microtubule-binding region of a "Slow-Sustained" motor with that of a "Fast-Burst" motor, we generated a "Fast-Sustained" chimera with flows that act
items.authors: Larios, D.; Najma, B.; Miao, J.; Lee, H. J.; Thomson, M.; Phillips, R.; Liu, S.

items.title: USP15 REGULATES NEUROINFLAMMATION AND DRIVES PATHOGENESIS IN SYNUCLEINOPATHIES
items.title_zh: USP15调控神经炎症并驱动突触核蛋白病的发病机制
items.summary_zh: 神经炎症在包括帕金森病在内的神经和神经退行性疾病的发病机制中起着重要作用。我们发现，在星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞中去除Usp15能够在体内保护免受致命的神经炎症。在突触核蛋白病的小鼠模型中，Usp15缺失减少了大脑中的α-突触核蛋白沉积，减缓了疾病进展，并延长了生存时间。Usp15的神经保护作用与炎症通路的差异性表达相关，包括干扰素刺激基因。这些在体内的USP15依赖性效应在原代人类小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞中得到了重现。我们在帕金森病患者的小胶质细胞中检测到高水平的USP15表达，并与LRRK2和SNCA表现出强烈的共表达。在人类中，我们发现一个强大的顺式作用eQTL引导CD14+髓系细胞中高水平的USP15表达。驱动该eQTL的等位基因与疾病风险增加相关，连接了髓系USP15表达、帕金森病患者中升高的USP15血浆水平与遗传易感性。
items.abstract: Neuroinflammation strongly contributes to the pathogenesis of neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, including Parkinson's disease. We show that ablation of Usp15 in astrocytes and in microglia protects against lethal neuroinflammation in vivo. In a mouse model of synucleinopathy, Usp15 deletion diminishes alpha-syn deposits in the brain, slows disease progression, and increases survival time. The neuroprotective effect of Usp15 is associated with differential expression of inflammatory pathways in situ including interferon stimulated genes. These USP15-dependent effects in vivo are recapitulated in vitro in primary human microglia and astrocytes. We detect high USP15 expression in microglia from Parkinson's patients with strong co-expression with LRRK2 and SNCA. In humans, we detect a strong cis-acting eQTL directing high USP15 expression in CD14+ myeloid cells. The allele driving this eQTL is itself associated with increased disease risk, linking myeloid USP15 expression, elevated USP15 plasma levels in Parkinson's patients, to genetic susceptibility.
