items.title: Air temperature limits aerobic capacity and scope in active birds
items.title_zh: 空气温度限制活跃鸟类的有氧能力和范围
items.summary_zh: 热耐受性限制是物种对气候变化脆弱性的一个重要决定因素。然而，目前对热耐受性的了解主要集中在静息动物上，这可能导致对活跃动物在空气温度变化下反应的预测不准确。为深入了解活跃鸟类的温度调节限制，我们在实验室中诱导斑胸草雀在12-36°C的空气温度下持续运动，同时测量其代谢率、体温和蒸发水分损失。研究发现，鸟类在远低于其静息热耐受性限制的空气温度下过热，且在最高温度下有氧范围减少了22%。尽管在最高温度下，斑胸草雀的蒸发水分损失增加了8倍，但仍不足以弥补活动中产生的热量显著增加。这可能解释了为何鸟类在较高空气温度下出现高热症和代谢率下降。因此，我们的研究结果为热量如何限制活跃鸟类的有氧能力和范围提供了机制解释，支持了空气温度升高可能导致自由生活鸟类亚致死适应成本的证据。
items.abstract: Thermal tolerance limits are an important determinant of species vulnerability to climate change. However, most of our knowledge of thermal tolerance pertains to resting animals, which could yield unrealistic predictions about how air temperature will affect animals when they are active. To gain a better understanding of thermoregulatory contstraints in active birds, we induced zebra finches in captivity to exercise continuously in air temperatures ranging from cool to warm (12- 36 C) while we simultaneously measured their metabolic rate, body temperature, and evaporative water loss. During activity, birds overheated in air temperatures well below their resting thermal tolerance limit, and aerobic scope was reduced by 22% at the warmest temperature. Although zebra finches showed a 8-fold increase in evaporative water loss during exercise in the warmest temperature, this was not sufficiently high to compensate for the substantial increase in heat produced during activity. This could explain why birds became hyperthermic and showed reductions in metabolic rate in the higher air temperatures. Thus, our results provide a mechanistic explanation for how heat could limit aerobic capacity
items.authors: Engert, E. R.; Nilsson, A.; Andreasson, F.; Nord, A.; Nilsson, J.-A.

items.title: Dynamic structural equation models for ecosystem-based fisheries management: case studies and a practical guide
items.title_zh: 基于生态系统的渔业管理动态结构方程模型研究
items.summary_zh: 采用基于生态系统的渔业管理（EBFM）面临的主要挑战之一是理解和预测生态系统动态的相互关联过程、反馈和时间依赖性。结构方程模型（SEM）和结构因果模型（SCM）能够量化相互关系并评估因果性，但难以处理复杂系统中常见的不完整和不规则采样数据。动态结构方程模型（DSEM）能够估计SEM，同时适应滞后效应、缺失数据以及非线性和非平稳效应。本文通过三个案例研究，展示了在EBFM背景下理解生态系统过程的不同推理目标。首先，我们量化了生态系统级指标以支持气候驱动的生态系统变化监测。其次，我们检验了假设的直接和间接生态系统联系是否改善了鱼类补充预测。最后，我们比较了对鱼类生产力因果驱动因素假设的支持。我们总结了经验教训，提供了DSEM应用的工作流程，建议第一步是明确推理目标。
items.abstract: Once central challenge in adopting ecosystem-based fisheries management (EBFM) is understanding and predicting the interconnected processes, feedbacks, and temporal dependencies that characterize ecosystem dynamics. Structural equation models and structural causal models (SEM and SCM) quantify interconnected relationships and evaluate causality from observational data but cannot readily accommodate the incomplete and irregularly sampled data typical of complex systems. Dynamic structural equation models (DSEM) estimate SEMs but accommodate lagged effects, missing data, and non-linear and non-stationary effects. However, there is little guidance regarding how DSEM can be used to support EBFM, particularly within governance and decision-making contexts. Here, we present three case studies that highlight distinct inferential goals for understanding ecosystem processes in the context of EBFM. First, we quantify ecosystem-level indicators to support monitoring of climate-driven ecosystem changes. items.title: Polygenic Risk and Genetic Predisposition in Post-Traumatic Epilepsy: A Framework for Risk Estimation
items.title_zh: 创伤后癫痫的多基因风险与遗传易感性研究框架
items.summary_zh: 背景：创伤后癫痫（PTE）可能是创伤性脑损伤（TBI）的终身并发症。我们假设PTE的发生遵循“两击假说”，第一击为遗传易感性，第二击为TBI。方法：从筛选的数千名退伍军人中招募PTE患者（n=28）及无PTE的TBI对照组（n=22），并进行全外显子测序（WES）。比较每个受试者约375000个变异与ClinVar中约15000个已验证的癫痫相关变异。使用Fisher精确检验识别与PTE相关的变异，并将其分类为PTE易感或保护性。计算变异和受试者水平的比值比（OR）。使用受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线分析评估预测模型，并用第二个数据集验证模型，进行逻辑校准以估计PTE发生的概率。结果：识别出30个PTE易感变异和56个保护性变异，具有相应的大效应OR。ROC分析显示出良好的区分能力（AUC=0.9）。
items.abstract: Background Post-traumatic epilepsy (PTE) can be a lifelong complication of traumatic brain injury (TBI). We hypothesize that PTE develops according to a Two-Hit Hypothesis, in which the first hit is a genetic predisposition and the second hit is the TBI. Using two independent datasets, we provide the first evidence that PTE is a polygenic disorder, and we propose a whole-exome sequencing (WES) based framework to estimate the risk of developing PTE. Methods From a pool of thousands of screened veterans, we recruited a cohort of PTE subjects (n=28) and a control cohort of TBI subjects without PTE (n=22) and then performed WES. Approximately 375000 variants identified in each subject were compared to approximately 15000 verified epilepsy-associated variants from ClinVar. Fisher's exact test was used to identify variants associated with PTE, which were subsequently classified as either PTE-prone or PTE-protective. Odds ratios (ORs) were calculated at both the variant and subject levels. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis was used to evaluate the predictive model. items.authors: Chen, J. W.; Le, C.; Cui, K.; Alexeeva, O. M.; Joo, J.; Bailey, J.

items.title: Dynamic tracking of social variables in simultaneous brain recordings from socially interacting monkeys
items.title_zh: 猴子社交互动中的神经活动动态追踪
items.summary_zh: 灵长类动物高度社会化，但理解其神经基础一直具有挑战性，因为之前只能记录单只猴子与社交伙伴的互动。本研究在自然、无约束的环境中，对两只社会互动的猕猴进行了同时无线神经记录。每只猴子的神经活动编码了关键的社交变量，如互相梳理状态、伙伴身份和共同动作。值得注意的是，每只猴子高层视觉皮层中的神经元持续追踪社交偏好信号，即给予与接受的互相梳理净持续时间，为梳理互惠提供了神经基础。在每只猴子中，神经活动更好地被其伙伴的关节和神经活动预测，尤其是在给予而非接受梳理时。因此，接受梳理的猴子驱动了社交互动，而非梳理者。综上所述，我们的发现阐明了灵长类动物社交互动在生态有效环境中的丰富和动态神经基础。
items.abstract: Primates are deeply social, but understanding the neural basis has been challenging since it has previously only been possible to record from single monkeys interacting with a social partner. Here, we performed simultaneous wireless neural recordings from two macaque monkeys interacting socially in a natural, unconstrained setting. Neural activity in each monkey encoded key social variables such as allogrooming state, partner identity and joint movements. Interestingly, neurons in the high-level visual cortex of each monkey continuously tracked a social favor signal, i.e. net duration of allogrooming given versus received, providing a neural basis for grooming reciprocity. In each monkey, neural activity was predicted better by his partners joints and neural activity, particularly while giving compared to receiving grooming. Thus, the receiver of grooming drove the social interaction, not the groomer. Taken together, our findings elucidate the rich and dynamic neural basis of primate social interactions in an ecologically valid setting.
items.authors: Simon, S.; Bhadra, D.; Saha, S.; Munda, S.; Das, J.; Arun, S.

items.title: During natural vision, semantic novelty modulates fixation-related processing in primate cortex
items.title_zh: 自然视觉中语义新颖性调节灵长类动物皮层的注视相关处理
items.summary_zh: 我们通过短暂的注视和眼动采样视觉场景。尽管低层次整合已有所了解，但注视间的中央视觉语义整合仍不清楚。我们假设大脑对每次注视间语义信息的变化作出反应，因此推测每次眼动与语义新颖性相关的神经信号。通过深度网络的不同层次测量新颖性。研究发现，只有语义新颖性调节了男性和女性在自然观看完整电影（3.4x10^6次眼动）时的前额和枕叶注视相关电位。对男性和女性人类（9.0x10^4次眼动）及女性非人灵长类动物（猕猴；3.3x10^4次眼动）的颅内记录显示，只有语义新颖性在场景特定的腹侧视觉和前额脑区引发宽带高频活动调制。此调制在电影中比静态图像更强，且前额调制早于枕叶调制，暗示自上而下的效应。这一注视相关活动的调制表明，在自然观看中，中央表征在注视间被整合以构建场景表征。
items.abstract: We sample visual scenes with short gaze fixations separated by saccades. While low-level integration is known, semantic integration of foveal vision across fixations remains unclear. We hypothesized that the brain responds to changes in semantic information from one fixation to the next, and therefore postulated a neural signal associated with semantic novelty for each saccade. Novelty was measured from different layers of a deep network on foveal vision. Only semantic, and not low- or mid-level, novelty modulated frontal and occipital fixation-related potentials in male and female human scalp EEG during natural viewing of full-length movies (3.4x106 saccades). Intracranial recordings in male and female humans (9.0x104 saccades) and female non-human primates (Macaca mulatta; 3.3x104 saccades) revealed broadband high-frequency activity modulations in scene-specific ventral visual and frontal brain areas only for semantic novelty. This modulation was stronger for movies than static images, and frontal modulation occurred early alongside occipital modulation, suggesting top-down effects. items.title: Laser-driven VHEE pulsed fast fractionation (PFF): second-scale inter-pulse timing can modulate normal tissue toxicity in vivo
items.title_zh: 激光驱动的超高能电子脉冲快速分割：秒级脉冲间隔调节正常组织毒性
items.summary_zh: 放射治疗（RT）受到肿瘤控制与正常组织毒性之间狭窄治疗窗口的限制。尽管已有研究表明，超高剂量率（UHDR）下的FLASH RT可以降低正常组织毒性并保持肿瘤控制，但常规分割与FLASH之间的中间时间机制的放射生物学潜力仍未被充分探索。本研究显示，在超高瞬时剂量率下，采用秒级脉冲间隔的超短（fs-ps）剂量递送脉冲可以差异性调节体内外的生物反应。样本使用激光等离子体加速器（LPA）产生的超高能电子（VHEEs，50 MeV至300 MeV）进行照射，采用我们称之为脉冲快速分割（PFF）的时间照射模式，瞬时剂量率超过10^12 Gy/s。通过在保持每脉冲剂量和总剂量不变的情况下，将脉冲间隔从1秒调节至10秒，调节了体内外模型的生物反应。在最短的脉冲间隔（θ = 1s）下，MRC5-hTERT人类成纤维细胞表现出更高的存活率，而HCT116结肠癌细胞在相同剂量条件下则表现出较低的存活率。
items.abstract: Radiotherapy (RT) is constrained by the narrow therapeutic window between tumour control and normal-tissue toxicity. While FLASH RT has been reported to reduce normal-tissue toxicity at ultra-high dose rates (UHDR) while preserving tumour control in several preclinical models, the radiobiological potential of intermediate temporal regimes between conventional fractionation and FLASH remains largely unexplored. Here, we show that temporal separation of ultrashort (fs-ps) dose-delivery pulses delivered at ultra-high instantaneous dose rate, with second-scale inter-pulse intervals, can differentially modulate biological response in vitro and in vivo. Samples were irradiated with very high-energy electrons (VHEEs, 50 MeV to 300 MeV) generated by a laser-plasma accelerator (LPA), using a temporal irradiation modality we term pulsed fast fractionation (PFF), with instantaneous dose rates exceeding 10^12 Gy/s. Varying the inter-pulse interval from 1 s to 10 s while maintaining dose per pulse and total dose constant modulated biological response in both in vitro and in vivo models. items.authors: Giaccaglia, C.; Bayart, E.; Varma, C.; Goddet, J.-P.; Gautier, J.; Tafzi, A.; Manant, E.; Lamarre-Jouenne, I.; Heinrich, S.; Fouillade, C.; Flacco, A.

items.title: CasanovoGUI: a cross-platform desktop application for deep learning-based de novo peptide sequencing with Casanovo
items.title_zh: CasanovoGUI：跨平台深度学习新肽测序桌面应用
items.summary_zh: 新肽测序直接从串联质谱中检测肽，而无需蛋白质序列数据库，深度学习显著提升了其性能。Casanovo是一个广泛使用的模型，作为Python命令行程序分发，安装和配置GPU及依赖项对许多实验科学家而言具有挑战性，并且容易出错。我们提出了CasanovoGUI，这是一个基于Java的开源桌面应用，通过点击界面在Windows、macOS和Linux上提供Casanovo的主要分析功能。首次使用时，CasanovoGUI会自动安装私有Python环境和与GPU匹配的Casanovo版本，无需先前的软件设置。该GUI提供Casanovo的分析功能和配置参数，实时进度流，并集成结果解释：在PDV查看器中显示带有每个残基置信度评分的注释谱图，以及将新肽容错映射回参考蛋白组。CasanovoGUI可在https://github.com/Noble-Lab/CasanovoGUI获取。
items.abstract: De novo peptide sequencing detects peptides directly from tandem mass spectra without a protein sequence database, and deep learning has substantially advanced its performance. Casanovo, one such widely used model, is distributed as a Python command-line program. Consequently, installation, GPU and dependency configuration, and manual parameterization can be challenging for many bench scientists and are a recurring source of errors. Interpreting and validating the resulting predictions poses a further challenge. We present CasanovoGUI, an open-source Java-based desktop application that makes all of Casanovo's main analysis functions available through a point-and-click interface on Windows, macOS, and Linux. On first use, CasanovoGUI automatically installs a private Python environment and Casanovo with a GPU-matched build, requiring no prior software setup. The GUI provides access to Casanovo's analysis functions and configuration parameters, streams live progress, and integrates results interpretation: annotated spectra with per-residue confidence scores in the PDV viewer, and mismatch-tolerant mapping of de novo peptides back to a reference proteome. CasanovoGUI is available at ht
items.authors: Wen, B.; Li, K.; Riffle, M.; MacCoss, M. J.; Bittremieux, W.; Noble, W. S.

items.title: Uncovering the representational geometry of durations
items.title_zh: 揭示持续时间的表征几何结构
items.summary_zh: 人类心智中是否存在时间的几何结构？心理学中时间的经典测量是持续时间，它是可量化的时间间隔。持续时间被认为沿着心理时间线排列：一种一维、线性且空间化的时间表征。我们研究了这种心理时间线是否足以解释持续时间的体验。通过两个实验测试相同的参与者：一个行为相似性判断任务，参与者评估持续时间对的相似性；另一个是脑电图（EEG）实验，参与者在序列中检测异常持续时间。行为和EEG数据用于构建表征不相似性矩阵，并与持续时间组织的理论模型进行比较。结果显示，行为相似性判断的大部分方差由三个潜在维度解释：大小（持续时间的单调排序）、上下文编码（与持续时间集合几何均值的距离）和周期成分。这三个维度与潜在的广义螺旋模型一致，该模型对行为数据拟合良好。个体螺旋模型参数与静息状态下测量的内源性神经振荡相关，表明个体的持续时间体验与神经活动密切相关。
items.abstract: Is there a geometry of time in the human mind? A canonical measure of time in psychology is duration, a time interval quantifiable as a magnitude. Durations have been proposed to be arranged along a mental timeline: a unidimensional, linear, and spatialised representation of time. Here, we asked whether such a mental timeline is sufficient to account for the experience of duration. To address this, we tested the same participants in two experiments: a behavioural similarity judgment task, in which participants rated the similarity of duration pairs, and an electroencephalography (EEG) experiment in which they detected oddball durations in a sequence. Behavioural and EEG data were used to construct representational dissimilarity matrices, whose geometry was compared against theoretical models of duration organisation. Our results reveal that most variance in behavioural similarity judgements is explained by three latent dimensions, interpretable as: magnitude (monotonic ordering of durations), contextual encoding (distance to the geometric mean of the duration set), and a periodic component. items.authors: Grasso, C. L.; Nalborczyk, L.; van Wassenhove, V.

items.title: Large-Vessel Venous Signal Confounds Apparent Amygdala Activation in BOLD fMRI
items.title_zh: 大血管静脉信号干扰BOLD fMRI中杏仁体激活的表观性
items.summary_zh: 杏仁体在BOLD fMRI研究人类情绪和情绪障碍中被广泛报道。尽管现代采集方法提高了图像质量，但BOLD信号的血流动力学特性仍然使得对这些反应的解释复杂化。我们展示了在视觉和听觉任务中，杏仁体的BOLD信号受到附近深静脉（包括罗森塔尔基底静脉）信号的显著干扰。与之前的研究不同，我们发现杏仁体在参与时是该静脉信号的主要但非唯一贡献者。该信号对杏仁体的参与敏感，但并不特异。此干扰导致表观激活的错误定位，阻碍了将信号可靠归因于杏仁体亚核。我们进一步表明，空间平滑加剧了这种错误定位，将杏仁体周围的静脉信号与解剖学上的杏仁体合并。我们在来自人类连接组计划的更大样本中重复了我们的发现。基于解剖学杏仁体内未平滑信号的广泛结论仍然有效，但仅依赖传统fMRI得出的亚核功能进一步结论需谨慎对待。
items.abstract: Amygdala responses are widely reported in BOLD fMRI studies of human emotions and mood disorders. Although modern acquisition methods have improved image quality, the hemodynamic nature of the BOLD signal continues to complicate interpretation of these responses. Across an array of both visual and auditory tasks, we here show that apparent amygdala BOLD signal is substantially confounded by signal from nearby deep veins, including the basal vein of Rosenthal. In contrast to prior work, we show that the amygdala, when engaged, is the leading but not exclusive contributor to this venous signal. Across the tested conditions, this signal was sensitive to, but not specific for, amygdala engagement. This confound mislocalizes apparent activation and prevents reliable attribution of signal to amygdala subnuclei with conventional BOLD fMRI. We further show that spatial smoothing exacerbates this mislocalization by merging peri-amygdalar venous signal with the anatomical amygdala. We reproduce our findings from precision imaging in a larger sample obtained from the Human Connectome Project. items.authors: Diamandis, Z.; Tyszka, J. M.; Adolphs, R.

items.title: Caregiver-Rated Inappropriate Speech and Post-cTBS Motor Cortical Facilitation in Autism: A Pilot Biomarker Study
items.title_zh: 自闭症照顾者评估的不当言语与运动皮层促进的初步生物标志研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究纳入19名年龄在15至40岁的自闭症参与者，分析左侧初级运动皮层的连续θ波刺激（cTBS）生物标志协议。基线及刺激后5至60分钟进行了七次运动诱发电位测量。采用线性混合效应模型评估临床指标是否影响刺激后运动诱发电位的对数反应比。对照顾者评估的15名参与者进行的异常行为清单（ABC）和减弱行为问卷（ABQ）分析显示，ABC不当言语与刺激后促进作用呈正相关（标准化时间与不当言语交互作用：beta = +0.688，SE = 0.210，95% CI +0.276至+1.099；Holm调整后的P = .008）。两个与言语相关的项目（“过度交谈”和“自言自语”）在假发现率校正后仍然显著。
items.abstract: Transcranial magnetic stimulation can provide noninvasive measures of cortical excitability and plasticity, but relationships between these measures and clinically observable features of autism are not fully characterized. Nineteen autistic participants aged 15 to 40 years were included in the analysis of a left primary motor cortex continuous theta-burst stimulation (cTBS) biomarker protocol. Motor evoked potentials were measured at baseline and at seven assessments from 5 to 60 min after stimulation. Linear mixed-effects models evaluated whether clinical measures moderated the post-stimulation motor evoked potential log-response ratio over time. Aberrant Behavior Checklist (ABC) and Attenuated Behavior Questionnaire (ABQ) analyses were restricted to the same 15 participants with caregiver-informant assessments. Catatonia severity, social impairment, ABQ Motor Total, ABQ Total, and cognitive ability did not significantly moderate the post-stimulation response. items.title: Development and Validation of a 12-Item Form of the Participation Questionnaire for Preschoolers
items.title_zh: 学龄前儿童参与问卷12项简表的开发与验证
items.summary_zh: 目的：开发并验证学龄前儿童参与问卷的12项简表（PQP-12）。方法：在一项横断面研究中（n = 164，年龄3-6岁），根据项目-总分相关性选择了12个项目（每个因素3个），并保留四因素结构；进行了确认性因素分析、内部一致性和构念效度分析。在一项队列研究中（n = 275，年龄5-6岁），在独立样本中重新进行确认性因素和内部一致性分析，并检查了重测信度（组内相关系数[ICC]）、测量误差（测量标准误[SEM]、最小可检测变化[MDC]）和响应性。结果：四因素模型在两个样本中均拟合良好（比较拟合指数 = 0.999/0.996），优于一因素模型。Cronbach's α为0.75和0.80（子量表：0.46-0.92），因素2的低值可能反映了老年样本的天花板效应。PQP-12与原始PQP强相关（r = 0.86-0.95）；构念效度假设的支持率为78%，响应性假设的支持率为80%。重测信度良好（ICC = 0.79-0.90），并报告了SEM和MDC。结论：PQP-12保留了原始PQP的结构和测量特性，同时减轻了受访者负担。
items.abstract: Aims: To develop and validate the 12-item short form of the Participation Questionnaire for Preschoolers (PQP-12). Methods: In a cross-sectional study (n = 164 aged 3-6 years), 12 items (three per factor) were selected based on item-total correlations while retaining the four-factor structure; confirmatory factor, internal consistency, and construct validity analyses were conducted. In a cohort study (n = 275 aged 5-6 years), confirmatory factor and internal consistency analyses were reperformed in an independent sample, and test-retest reliability (intraclass correlation coefficients [ICCs]), measurement error (standard error of measurement [SEM], minimal detectable change [MDC]), and responsiveness were examined. Results: The four-factor model fit well in both samples (comparative fit index = 0.999/0.996) and was superior to the one-factor model. Cronbach's was 0.75 and 0.80 (subscales: 0.46-0.92), with Factor 2's low value likely reflecting ceiling effects in the older sample. The PQP-12 correlated strongly with the original PQP (r = 0.86-0.95); 78% of construct-validity hypotheses and 80% of responsiveness hypotheses were supported. items.title: Service Provider Competence, Motivation, and Resource Availability as Determinants of Quality Healthcare Delivery: A Cross-Sectional Study at Makeni Regional Hospital, Sierra Leone
items.title_zh: 服务提供者能力、动机与资源可用性对医疗质量的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了服务提供者的能力、动机和资源可用性对塞拉利昂马肯尼地区医院医疗质量的影响。采用横断面研究方法，对155名服务提供者进行调查，样本量依据Yamane公式确定。通过结构化问卷收集数据，并使用STATA分析能力、动机、资源可用性与医疗质量之间的关系。结果显示，大多数服务提供者（74.8%）认为自己具备所需的专业技能，91.6%认为能力强的员工能提高医疗质量，94.8%认为能力强的人员能改善患者结果。然而，动机水平较低，仅7.1%的受访者高度积极，16.1%有一定动机，40.65%稍有动机，所有受访者（100%）一致认为动机影响医疗质量。资源可用性与医疗质量结果关联最强，99.4%的受访者确认充足的资源影响医疗质量，95.5%认为资源充足是关键。
items.abstract: Quality healthcare delivery in low- and middle-income countries remains constrained by workforce and resource limitations. This study assessed service provider competence, service provider motivation, and resource availability as determinants of quality healthcare delivery at Makeni Regional Hospital in Northern Sierra Leone, from the service providers' own perspective. A cross-sectional study, descriptive in type, was conducted among 155 service providers, with sample size determined using the Yamane formula. Structured questionnaires were administered and analyzed using STATA to assess the relationship between competence, motivation, resource availability, and quality healthcare delivery. Most service providers (74.8%) reported possessing the required professional skills, and 91.6% perceived that competent staff resulted in improved delivery of quality healthcare; 94.8% associated competent personnel with improved patient outcomes. Motivation levels were markedly lower: only 7.1% of respondents were highly motivated, 16.1% were motivated, and 40.65% were somewhat motivated, while all respondents (100%) agreed that motivation influences quality of care delivery. items.title: Self-organized Regulation of Group Size and Number in Natural and Artificial Collectives
items.title_zh: 自然与人工集体中群体规模与数量的自组织调节
items.summary_zh: 从动物社会到自组织多智能体系统，集体根据任务和环境调整其群体结构。然而，如何确定适当的群体规模和形成子群数量仍不清楚。我们提出了群体规模与数量调节问题（GSNRP），探讨个体如何仅利用局部信息调节群体规模和数量。首先，我们建立了一个图论模型，表明简单的跟随行为足以形成符合理论预期的群体结构，但不足以主动调节群体规模和数量。其次，我们在基于感知群体规模的去中心化裂变-融合机制中操作化个体的群体规模偏好。通过多智能体模拟，我们验证该机制在三种信号传递模式下实现了稳定收敛。利用野生白鼻浣熊的数据，我们校准了个体的群体规模偏好，显示控制器能够恢复所选的群体规模、子群数量和转变统计。这项案例研究表明与自然裂变-融合动态的描述一致性，但未建立其基础行为机制。
items.abstract: From animal societies to self-organizing multi-agent systems, collectives adapt their group structure to tasks and environments. However, how they determine appropriate group sizes and the number of subgroups to form remains unclear. We formulate the Group Size and Number Regulation Problem (GSNRP), which asks how individuals regulate group sizes and numbers using only local information. In a first step, we establish a graph-theoretic model demonstrating that simple following behavior suffices to form group structures that match theoretical expectations, but is insufficient for active regulation of group size and number. In a second step, we operationalize individual group-size preferences in a decentralized fission-fusion mechanism based on perceived group size. Through multi-agent simulations, we validate that this mechanism achieves stable convergence across three signaling regimes, from position-only sensing to continuous group-size communication. Using tracking data from wild white-nosed coatis (mammals in the raccoon family), we calibrate individual group-size preferences and show that the controller recovers selected group-size, subgroup-count, and transition statistics. items.title: Amplification and delay of auditory feedback for walking: effects on variability, cadence, and temporal cortex activity
items.title_zh: 步态行走中的听觉反馈放大与延迟：对变异性、步频和颞叶皮层活动的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了自我产生的脚步声的延迟和放大如何调节步态。研究对象为30名健康年轻成年人，他们在行走时接收来自自己脚步声的实时侧向播放。放大听觉反馈（AAF）在无延迟、短延迟或长延迟下提供，且放大倍数为全幅或半幅。使用移动功能近红外光谱（fNIRS）同时记录前额叶和颞叶感兴趣区域的皮层血流动力学反应。分析结果显示，无延迟的放大显著减少了近10%的步态变异性，表明通过增强对脚与地面相互作用动态的感知访问，强化了感觉运动耦合。延迟则增加了步频而非减少。在血流动力学反应层面，包含上颞回（STG）的感兴趣区域在行走时相较于静立时表现出增加，尤其是在无延迟和全幅放大的条件下。
items.abstract: When we walk, our footsteps generate rich acoustic information about foot timing, dragging, loading rate, etc. The role of self-generated or endogenous auditory feedback for gait control remains underexplored. We investigated how delay and amplification of self-produced footstep sounds modulate gait. Thirty healthy young adults walked overground while receiving real-time lateralized playback of the sound produced by their feet. Amplified auditory feedback (AAF) was delivered with no, shorter, or longer delay, and either at full or half amplification. Cortical hemodynamic responses were recorded concurrently in prefrontal and temporal regions of interest (ROI) with mobile functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS). Spatiotemporal gait parameters were analyzed as change relative to baseline. We found that amplification without delay reduced variability by almost 10%, consistent with strengthened sensorimotor coupling via enhanced perceptual access to foot-ground interaction dynamics. Delay increased cadence instead of reducing it. items.authors: Gu, J.; Honeyman, P.; Gao, Y.; Dotov, D.

items.title: Hydraulic modelling reveals untreated sewage, not pharmaceutical waste, drives antimicrobial resistance in a small river running through a big city
items.title_zh: 水力模型揭示未处理污水驱动城市小河抗微生物抗性
items.summary_zh: 量化接收各种废水流的河流中的抗微生物抗性（AMR）来源对制定减缓策略至关重要。本研究结合现场监测、水力模型和质量平衡计算，分析了印度海得拉巴市穆西河中的AMR来源。我们在干季和湿季对水和沉积物样本中的抗生素抗性基因（ARGs）、抗性细菌（ARBs）及理化参数进行了量化。城市中的ARG和ARB丰度显著上升，随后在下游下降。污染水平在上游、城市和下游段及季节之间存在显著差异。水力模型显示，干季和湿季城市河水中分别有60-80%和20-40%来自未处理污水，确立了市政废物而非药物来源为穆西河AMR的主要驱动因素。线性判别分析表明，溶解氧和总氮是区分AMR污染与较少污染地点的可靠指标。穆西河的污水处理不足和点源负荷稀释有限，反映了资源有限国家许多城市河流的典型特征，强调了改善的迫切需求。
items.abstract: Quantifying sources of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in rivers receiving various waste streams is essential for targeting mitigation strategies yet rarely performed. This study combined field monitoring with hydraulic modelling and mass balance calculations to attribute sources of AMR in the Musi River running through Hyderabad, India, a city renowned for pharmaceutical manufacturing. We quantified antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs), resistant bacteria (ARBs), and physicochemical parameters in water and sediment samples in the dry and wet season. Absolute ARG and ARB abundances spiked in the city, declining again downstream. Changes were more gradual in the wet season. Pollution levels were significantly different between upstream, city and downstream stretches and seasons. Hydraulic modelling revealed that 60-80% or 20-40% of the river water in the city derived from untreated sewage during the dry or wet seasons, respectively. This established municipal waste, not pharmaceutical sources, as the dominant driver of AMR in the Musi. Linear discriminant analysis identified dissolved oxygen and total nitrogen as reliable proxies for distinguishing AMR-polluted from less-polluted sites

items.title: Post-attack bioluminescence is an aposematic signal in luminin ostracods
items.title_zh: 攻击后生物发光作为亮色警告信号的研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了攻击后生物发光是否可以作为亮色警告信号，影响捕食者的防御效果。我们观察了捕食鱼类对产生生物发光的壳舟类（Ostracoda, Cypridinidae）猎物的反应。通过操控猎物的潜在化学防御，并比较生物发光与非生物发光猎物的捕食反应，我们提供了多项证据表明生物发光猎物不易被捕食，并利用攻击后的生物发光作为亮色警告信号。首先，活的生物发光猎物仅在被攻击后分泌生物发光。其次，捕食鱼类很少捕食生物发光猎物，尤其是与非生物发光猎物相比。最后，随着捕食者对生物发光展示的累积暴露增加，它们捕食生物发光猎物的可能性降低，表明生物发光猎物具有某种未识别的防御机制。
items.abstract: Aposematic signals convey information about prey unpalatability to potential predators. Such signals are defined as advertisements, with prey usually signalling unpalatability before an attack. Overlooked, however, is whether signals presented after an attack can function as aposematic warnings and influence the efficacy of defense. Here, we test if post-attack signals can be aposematic by observing fish predators responding to prey (Ostracoda, Cypridinidae) that produce bioluminescence following an attack. By manipulating potential chemical defenses of prey, and by comparing feeding responses to both bioluminescent and nonluminescent prey, we provide multiple lines of evidence to show bioluminescent prey are unpalatable and use post-attack bioluminescence as an aposematic signal. First, live, bioluminescent prey secrete bioluminescence only after being attacked. Second, predatory fishes rarely consumed bioluminescent prey, especially compared to nonluminescent alternatives. Third, because fishes readily ate bioluminescent prey that had been treated (frozen or boiled), which should remove defenses, bioluminescent species likely possess some unidentified defense over nonluminescent

items.title: Acoustofluidic Active Flow Sculpting Enables Dynamic, Reconfigurable Cross-Sectional Patterning
items.title_zh: 声流动主动流动雕刻实现动态可重构横截面图案
items.summary_zh: 利用流动光刻技术制造的软材料，其功能性取决于前驱流体的形状和材料组成，应用范围包括组织工程和防伪。然而，现有制造技术主要依赖静态喷嘴几何形状或被动水动力聚焦，限制了在连续流动中主动重新配置材料结构的能力。本文介绍了ActiSculpt，一个声流动平台，通过动态、可编程的非侵入性元件替代物理结构来配置连续流动。我们利用层流稳定性与声流动之间的相互作用，将确定性流体变形与混沌混合解耦，实现了横截面流动结构的精确雕刻。我们展示了高通量生成具有可调转动惯量的水凝胶颗粒，并进一步展示了在实时变化声学参数下的连续纤维制造，利用时间控制在纤维长度上编码结构变化。最后，我们将该平台转化为运动控制的3D打印机，确认了完全固化和半固化纤维配置的可打印性。
items.abstract: Soft materials created with flow lithography exhibit distinct functionality depending on the shape and material composition of the precursor fluids, enabling applications ranging from tissue engineering to anti-counterfeiting. However, current manufacturing techniques largely rely on static nozzle geometries or passive hydrodynamic focusing, which commit to a fixed structure during fabrication and limit the ability to actively reconfigure material architecture in continuous flow. Here, we introduce ActiSculpt, an acoustofluidic platform that replaces physical constructions with dynamic, programmable, non-invasive elements to configure the continuous flow. By exploiting the interplay between laminar stability and acoustic streaming, we decouple deterministic fluid deformation from chaotic mixing, enabling the precise sculpting of cross-sectional flow structures. We demonstrate the high-throughput generation of a diverse library of hydrogel particles with continuously tunable moments of inertia. We further demonstrate continuous fiber fabrication in which acoustic parameters are varied in real time, using temporal control to encode structural variation along the fiber's length. Final

items.title: Genotype-dependent reductions of competition are associated with yield maintenance in a modern common wheat Triticum aestivum L. cultivar
items.title_zh: 基因型依赖的竞争减少与现代小麦产量维持相关
items.summary_zh: 现代作物育种在单作条件下提高了产量，但其机制尚不完全清楚。本研究测试了基因型依赖的竞争减少是否有助于现代普通小麦品种的产量维持。我们进行了根系分泌物应用实验和两次竞争实验，使用了三种普通小麦地方品种和一个现代品种Norin 61。结果显示，Norin 61在面对同品种根系分泌物时，根茎分配变化不大，而在不同品种的根系分泌物下，根茎分配增加。此外，根茎分配随着邻近品种之间遗传关系的降低而增加。在竞争实验中，较高的根茎分配与对竞争者的抑制增强相关。Norin 61在同品种竞争下维持了谷物生物量，但在与不同品种竞争时产量显著下降，而地方品种则表现出较弱或缺乏这种模式。这些结果表明，基因型依赖的竞争减少可能有助于现代小麦的产量维持。
items.abstract: Modern crop breeding has increased yield under monoculture stands, but the mechanisms underlying this improvement remain incompletely understood. We tested whether genotype-dependent reduction of competition, whereby plants adjust competitive responses according to neighbor genetic identity, contributes to yield maintenance in modern common wheat cultivars. We conducted a root-exudate application experiment and two competition experiments using three common wheat (Triticum aestivum L.) landraces and one modern cultivar, Norin 61. Norin 61 exhibited little change in shoot-to-root allocation in response to root exudates from the same cultivar compared with distilled water, whereas it increased shoot-to-root allocation exposed to root exudate from different cultivars. Moreover, shoot-to-root allocation increased with decreasing genetic relatedness between neighboring cultivars in common wheat plants. In competition experiments, greater shoot-to-root allocation was associated with stronger suppression of competitors. items.authors: Kosugi, N.; Kaneko, T.; Yoshida, K.; Yamawo, A.

items.title: Stoichiometric Aquatic Food-Web Models Coupling Pelagic and Benthic Zones
items.title_zh: 耦合浮游与底栖区的化学计量水生食物网模型
items.summary_zh: 生态化学计量学使我们能够研究食物质量如何影响食物网种群动态。我们考虑在一个封闭系统中，底栖和浮游磷酸盐池分开的情况下，附生植物、浮游植物和共享的水蚤消费者。生产者具有可变的磷碳比，而消费者保持恒定比率。我们构建了模型，确定了在特定条件下的有界性，描述了无食草动物的平衡家族及其局部谱，推导了消费者正增长的条件，并考察了光依赖的承载能力变化下的数值分岔结构。分岔图包含稳定和不稳定的平衡分支以及一个稳定的周期家族，揭示了对光增强的反应比单一的稳态和振荡序列更为复杂。消费者平衡分支的下降表明，光照充足并不一定增加消费者生物量。我们随后引入周期性变化的承载能力，并比较了弱和强季节性强迫。更强的强迫在高光照情况下产生了短暂的消费者反弹，尽管峰值在显示的时间间隔内减小。整体而言，增长条件和分支图为根据食物数量和质量解释种群动态提供了框架。
items.abstract: Ecological stoichiometry allows us to investigate how food quality affects food-web population dynamics. We consider periphyton, phytoplankton, and a shared Daphnia consumer in a closed system with separate benthic and pelagic phosphate pools. The producers have variable phosphorus-to-carbon ratios, while the consumer maintains a constant ratio. We construct the model, establish boundedness under stated conditions, characterize its grazer-free equilibrium families and their local spectra, derive conditions for positive consumer growth, and examine its numerical bifurcation structure as light-dependent carrying capacity varies. The bifurcation diagrams contain stable and unstable equilibrium branches together with a stable periodic family, revealing a more complex response to light enrichment than a single sequence of steady states and oscillations. A descending consumer equilibrium branch illustrates that greater light availability need not increase consumer biomass. We then introduce periodically varying carrying capacities and compare weak and strong seasonal forcing. items.title: Trends and drivers of prairie stream fish community persistence: implications for climate refugia
items.title_zh: 草原溪流鱼类群落持久性的趋势与驱动因素
items.summary_zh: 识别多种物种气候避难所的特征变得愈发紧迫。我们在美国北部大平原的溪流中进行了多次鱼类群落调查，以表征历史与当代调查之间的占用变化，并识别与群落变化相关的变量。所有地点的平均群落更替率为56%，本土物种持久性为60%，当代调查中37%为新殖民物种（本土或引入）。群落更替主要由物种丧失和殖民驱动。个别物种的占用趋势差异显著，本土平原小鱼（Hybognathus placitus）、北方红腹鱼（Chrosomus eos）、长吻鲶（Catostomus catostomus）和扁头鲤（Platygobio gracilis）显著下降，而引入的小嘴鲈（Micropterus dolomieu）和本土沟鲶（Ictalurus punctatus）则显著增加。与个别物种持久性和殖民相关的因素各异，但温暖的气温和农业与群落变化最为相关。重要的是，凉爽的水温似乎能缓冲受农业中度影响地点的鱼类群落更替。因此，保护凉水避难所对农业地区鱼类的持久性至关重要。
items.abstract: Identifying the characteristics of climate refugia for multiple species is becoming increasingly urgent. We used repeated, fish community surveys in streams of the northern Great Plains, USA to characterize occupancy change between historical and contemporary surveys. We then identified variables correlated with community change. Across all sites, average community turnover was 56%, native species persistence was 60%, and contemporary surveys consisted of 37% colonizing species (native or introduced). Community turnover was driven about equally by species loss and colonization. Individual species showed highly variable trends in occupancy with native plains minnow (Hybognathus placitus), northern redbelly dace (Chrosomus eos), longnose sucker (Catostomus catostomus), and flathead chub (Platygobio gracilis), declining substantially, and introduced smallmouth bass (Micropterus dolomieu) and native channel catfish (Ictalurus punctatus) increased considerably. While factors associated with individual species persistence and colonization varied, warm temperatures and agriculture were most associated with community change. items.title: Healthcare Providers Acceptability of Breast Milk Donation and Banking, and Factors Influencing Adoption in Rwanda: A Mixed-Methods Study
items.title_zh: 卢旺达医疗服务提供者对母乳捐赠和银行的接受度研究
items.summary_zh: 母乳对新生儿，尤其是早产和低出生体重婴儿的营养和生存至关重要。当母亲的乳汁不可用时，捐赠母乳是推荐的替代方案。当前，卢旺达缺乏认证的母乳捐赠系统和母乳银行，医疗服务提供者对其潜在实施的看法尚不明确。本研究旨在评估母乳捐赠的接受度，并探讨影响其在卢旺达两家地区医院采用的潜在因素。研究采用定性主导的平行收敛设计，在Kirehe地区医院和Ruhengeri二级教学医院的新生儿科进行。通过结构化问卷收集41名医疗服务提供者的定量数据，使用六项李克特量表测量接受度，得分≥2.4表示高接受度。通过对10名医疗服务提供者的深入访谈获得定性数据，并采用归纳主题分析法进行分析。结果显示，母乳捐赠的整体接受度较高，82.9%的医疗服务提供者表示支持。
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Breast milk is essential for optimal neonatal nutrition and survival, particularly among preterm and low-birth-weight infants. When a mothers own milk is unavailable, donor breast milk is the recommended alternative. However, Rwanda currently lacks accredited breast milk donation systems and milk banks, and little is known about healthcare providers perspectives on their potential implementation. The main objective of the study was to assess the acceptability of breast milk donation and explore the potential factors that could influence its adoption among healthcare providers in two Rwandan district hospitals. A convergent parallel design with a qualitative-dominant approach was conducted in the neonatology units of Kirehe District Hospital and Ruhengeri Level-II Teaching Hospital, Rwanda. Quantitative data were collected from 41 healthcare providers using structured questionnaires, including a six-item Likert scale (0=strongly disagree to4=strongly agree) to measure acceptability. items.title: Nerve injury-induced protein 2 preserves lysosomal membrane integrity to suppress ferroptosis
items.title_zh: 神经损伤诱导蛋白2保护溶酶体膜完整性以抑制铁死亡
items.summary_zh: 神经损伤诱导蛋白1（NINJ1）是一种细胞粘附分子，在细胞溶解性死亡过程中聚合并介导细胞膜破裂，释放大分子以传播炎症反应。我们发现NINJ2，NINJ1的近亲，不促进细胞膜破裂，而是对溶酶体膜的完整性至关重要，以保护细胞免受铁死亡。具体而言，NINJ2定位于溶酶体并与溶酶体膜锚定糖蛋白LAMP1相互作用。NINJ2缺失加剧溶酶体膜通透性（LMP），导致可溶性铁等溶酶体内容物选择性泄漏到细胞质中，从而增加细胞内可溶性铁积累并降低铁蛋白表达。机制上，NINJ2缺失促进溶酶体中铁蛋白FTH降解，且可通过敲低LAMP1逆转。此外，NINJ2缺失使细胞对RSL3和Erastin诱导的铁死亡敏感，这与近期研究表明NINJ2缺失使小鼠易患慢性炎症一致。这些发现揭示了NINJ2在细胞保护中的新功能。
items.abstract: Nerve injury-induced protein 1 (NINJ1), a cell adhesion molecule, is oligomerized during lytic cell death and mediates plasma membrane rupture to release large intracellular molecules that propagate the inflammatory response. We and others previously showed that NINJ2, a close relative of NINJ1, does not promote plasma membrane rupture to spread inflammation. Here, we identify that NINJ2 is necessary for lysosome membrane integrity to protect cells from ferroptosis. Specifically, we found that NINJ2 localizes to lysosomes and interacts with LAMP1, an anchor glycoprotein of the lysosome membranes and a sensor of stressed lysosomes. We also found that loss of NINJ2 exacerbates lysosomal membrane permeabilization (LMP), which allows for selective leakage of lysosomal contents, such as labile iron, into the cytosol. Accordingly, loss of NINJ2 elevates cellular labile iron accumulation and decreases expression of ferritins, the primary intracellular iron storage protein complexes. Mechanistically, we found that loss of NINJ2 promotes ferritin FTH degradation in lysosomes, which can be reversed by knockdown of LAMP1. items.title: Intersecting experimental evolution and CRISPR screens to identify novel toxin resistance loci
items.title_zh: 交叉实验进化与CRISPR筛选识别新型毒素抗性位点
items.summary_zh: 理解昆虫的毒素抗性对于认识生态位适应至关重要，但由于其通常是多基因基础，研究仍然具有挑战性。以果蝇（Drosophila sechellia）与非洲木瓜（Morinda citrifolia）的特殊关系为例，该果实对其他昆虫有毒。主要毒素为辛酸（octanoic acid, OA），但不同物种对OA的敏感性或抗性机制尚不清楚。本研究通过实验进化D. simulans，提高其OA抗性，识别出多个选择位点。与D. melanogaster细胞系的全基因组OA抗性CRISPR筛选交叉参考，突出了两个蛋白：Kraken（假定的解毒酶）和Alkbh7（与脂肪酸代谢相关的线粒体蛋白）。这两个基因在D. sechellia和OA抗性D. simulans中表达升高。D. melanogaster中的kraken突变体对OA更敏感，而Alkbh7过表达则增强OA抗性。对D. sechellia中这些基因的突变降低了OA耐受性。我们的研究表明，互补选择方法能够深入理解毒素易感性和适应的复杂机制。
items.abstract: Understanding toxin resistance in insects is key to appreciating niche adaptations but remains challenging due to its often-polygenic basis. A well-known example is the specialized association of Drosophila sechellia with noni fruit ( Morinda citrifolia ), which is toxic to other insects, including Drosophila simulans and Drosophila melanogaster . The main noni toxin is octanoic acid (OA), but the mechanisms that determine sensitivity or resistance to OA in different species remain unclear. Here, we experimentally evolved D. simulans with increased OA resistance, identifying multiple loci under selection. Cross-referencing these with a genome-wide, OA resistance CRISPR screen in a D. melanogaster cell line highlighted two proteins: Kraken, a putative detoxification enzyme expressed in digestive and renal tissues, and Alkbh7, a mitochondrial protein linked to fatty acid metabolism. Both genes show elevated expression in D. sechellia and OA-resistant D. simulans . In D. melanogaster , kraken mutants are more OA-sensitive, while Alkbh7 overexpression increased OA resistance. items.title: Association Between Physical Therapy and Mortality in Older Patients with Heart Failure and Chronic Kidney Disease
items.title_zh: 老年心衰合并慢性肾病患者物理治疗与死亡率的关联
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：关于在心衰加重住院后短期内启动的门诊物理治疗（PT）对老年慢性肾病（CKD）患者预后影响的证据有限。本研究评估了出院后30天内启动门诊PT与出院后1年内全因死亡率的关联。方法：本回顾性多中心队列研究采用30天出院后标志性设计，排除了在出院后30天内死亡或再住院的患者，共纳入6359名符合条件的30天事件无发生的幸存者。其中244名（3.8%）在出院后30天内接受了门诊PT，其余患者在此期间未记录门诊PT。采用预设协变量估算倾向评分，并进行1:1匹配。通过Cox比例风险模型评估与1年全因死亡率、心血管（CV）相关再住院及其复合事件的关联。结果：出院后1年内，1099名参与者死亡，1586名因CV相关原因再住院，2325名经历了任一事件。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Evidence regarding the prognostic impact of outpatient physical therapy (PT) initiated shortly after discharge in older patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) hospitalized for worsening heart failure (HF) is limited. We evaluated the association between outpatient PT initiation within 30 days of discharge and the primary endpoint of all-cause mortality within 1 year after discharge. Methods: In this retrospective multicenter cohort study, we applied a 30-day post-discharge landmark design. Patients who died or were rehospitalized within 30 days after discharge were excluded, and 6359 eligible 30-day event-free survivors were included in the analysis. Of these, 244 (3.8%) underwent outpatient PT within 30 days of discharge, and the remaining patients had no documented outpatient PT within that period. Propensity scores were estimated from prespecified covariates and used for 1:1 matching. items.authors: Toshimi Sato, Tomoyuki Morisawa, Masakazu Saitoh, Kentaro Iwata, Michitaka Kato, Koji Sakurada

items.title: Real-World Analysis of Olanzapine and Functional Outcomes in Outpatient Cancer Rehabilitation
items.title_zh: 奥氮平在癌症康复中的应用及功能结果分析
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：恶病质是一种由炎症引起的多因素肌肉消耗综合症，导致代谢增加和食物摄入减少。将食欲刺激作为恶病质多学科康复的一部分是一种新兴策略。奥氮平最初作为一种非典型抗精神病药物开发，现已在脑损伤和化疗引起的恶心患者的康复策略中得到应用。2023年，美国临床肿瘤学会（ASCO）基于新证据发布了低剂量（2.5-5 mg）奥氮平改善晚期癌症恶病质患者食欲和体重的快速推荐。方法：我们回顾性评估了45名有食欲问题的癌症相关康复患者中奥氮平的影响。结果：尽管治疗组在基线时匹配良好，但组间结果（包括体重增加）没有统计学差异，与其他人群的发现相反。然而，疲劳是整个队列中物理治疗目标完成的重要预测因素（p = 0.017），强调了未来研究深入探讨这一关系的必要性。结论：这些结果提示需要进一步研究。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Cachexia is a multifactorial muscle wasting syndrome driven by inflammation, causing increased catabolism and decreased food intake. Using appetite stimulation as part of multidisciplinary rehabilitation for cachexia is an emerging strategy. Olanzapine was originally developed as an atypical antipsychotic and has since emerged in rehabilitative strategies in patients with brain injury and chemotherapy-induced nausea. In 2023, the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) issued a rapid recommendation for the use of low-dose (2.5–5 mg) olanzapine to improve appetite and weight in adults with advanced cancer cachexia, based on novel evidence of increased appetite and weight gain. Methods: We retrospectively evaluated the impact of olanzapine on a real-world cohort of 45 patients with appetite concerns undergoing cancer-related rehabilitation. Patients were retrospectively evaluated for changes in body composition metrics and physical therapy (PT) related outcomes. Results: While treatment groups were well matched at baseline, there were no statistical differences between group outcomes, including weight gain, contrary to findings in other populations. Howeve
items.authors: Ioanna Karras, Kayla Beck, Addison Barber, Kathryn Abplanalp, Ishan Roy

items.title: Research Progress on Bidirectional Regulation of the Microbiota–Gut–Brain Axis in Autism Spectrum Disorder Based on the Immune–Metabolic–Endocrine Interactive Network
items.title_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍微生物-肠道-大脑轴双向调节研究进展
items.summary_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种高度异质的神经发育障碍，主要特征为社交沟通缺陷和高发的胃肠道共病。随着全球发病率的持续上升，目前的治疗方法仍无法有效改善ASD的核心症状。微生物-肠道-大脑轴（MGBA）作为介导肠道微生物与大脑之间相互作用的重要通路，近年来被广泛研究与ASD的病理进展密切相关。然而，先前的研究主要集中于肠道微生物对大脑的单向调节，缺乏对免疫、代谢和内分泌系统双向调节的综合探讨。本文基于免疫-代谢-内分泌互动网络，系统阐述了MGBA在ASD中的双向调节机制，整合了微生物测序、动物模型和临床干预研究的最新证据，旨在澄清肠道微生态失调与ASD行为异常之间的双向因果争议。研究提出，在ASD儿童中，益生菌丰度降低和短链脂肪酸代谢特征紊乱共同影响其健康。
items.abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a highly heterogeneous neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by core features of social communication deficits and high prevalence of gastrointestinal comorbidities. With its continuously rising global prevalence, current therapeutic modalities remain unable to target and ameliorate the core symptoms of ASD. The microbiota–gut–brain axis (MGBA), a critical pathway mediating crosstalk between the gut microbiota and the brain, has been extensively documented to be deeply involved in the pathological progression of ASD in recent years. However, prior studies have predominantly focused on the unidirectional regulation of the brain by gut microbiota, lacking an integrated account of the bidirectional regulation across immune, metabolic, and endocrine systems. Centered on the immune–metabolic–endocrine interactive network, this review systematically delineates the bidirectional regulatory mechanisms of the MGBA in ASD by integrating recent evidence from microbiota sequencing, animal models, and clinical intervention studies, with the aim of clarifying the bidirectional causal controversy between intestinal microecological disturbance and ASD behavior
items.authors: Weiao Kong, Haoke Qiu, Yuhang Jiang, Huanhuan Ge, Wanyi Wu, Lefan Huang

items.title: Mechanisms of Resistance to MEK Inhibitors (RAS–MAPK Pathway) in Malignant Peripheral Nerve Sheath Tumors and Their Precursor Lesions (Plexiform Neurofibromas) Associated with Neurofibromatosis Type 1
items.title_zh: 恶性周围神经鞘瘤对MEK抑制剂的耐药机制研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：MEK抑制剂（selumetinib，mirdametinib）是唯一批准用于神经纤维瘤病1型（NF1）相关的丛状神经纤维瘤（PN）的靶向治疗，部分患者产生反应（成人可达63.6%；KOMET试验中客观反应率为19.7%，对照组为5.4%）。然而，反应通常不完全或不持久，在恶性周围神经鞘瘤（MPNST）中，单药MEK抑制临床效果不佳。对这些肿瘤中MEK抑制逃逸机制的研究仍不充分，文献中多为孤立的初步研究，缺乏综合分析。本文旨在系统化PN和MPNST中已知的MEK抑制剂耐药机制，以及从其他RAS驱动恶性肿瘤推测的生物学候选机制。方法：本研究为叙述性综述，系统检索了PubMed、PubMed Central、NCBI Bookshelf和Scopus等数据库，涵盖至2026年5月31日的文献，并于2026年8月更新，共引用96个来源。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: MEK inhibitors (selumetinib, mirdametinib) are the only approved class of targeted therapy for neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1)-associated plexiform neurofibroma (PN), producing partial responses in a substantial proportion of patients (up to 63.6% in adults; objective response rate 19.7% versus 5.4% with placebo in the KOMET trial). Responses, however, are rarely complete or durable, and in malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor (MPNST) single-agent MEK inhibition is clinically ineffective. Mechanisms of escape from MEK inhibition in these tumors remain poorly characterized and are reported in the literature as isolated primary studies without an integrative analysis. The aim of this review was to systematize both the established molecular mechanisms of resistance to MEK inhibitors in PN and MPNST and the biologically plausible candidate mechanisms extrapolated from other RAS-driven malignancies. Methods: This is a narrative review. A structured search was performed in PubMed, PubMed Central, NCBI Bookshelf, and Scopus, supplemented by clinical practice guidelines and regulatory documents; it covered publications up to 31 May 2026 and was updated in August 20
items.authors: Sergey I. Sologov, Diana Sologova, Denis Dubinin, George Anikin, Nana Bekhorashvili, Maria Rayisyan

items.title: Bridging the Gap in Psychogenic Erectile Dysfunction: A Narrative Review of Underexplored Therapeutic Options
items.title_zh: 心理性勃起功能障碍的治疗选择综述
items.summary_zh: 背景与目的：心理性勃起功能障碍（ED）是一种以心理或人际关系因素为主的临床状况。尽管其普遍存在，诊断标准仍然不统一，通常基于排除有机原因。目前的指南推荐认知行为疗法（CBT），可与磷酸二酯酶5型抑制剂（PDE5i）联合使用作为一线治疗。然而，关于替代保守和外科治疗的证据仍然有限。本综述旨在评估心理性ED治疗的现有证据。方法：通过PubMed、Scopus和MEDLINE进行全面文献检索，使用与心理性ED及治疗干预相关的MeSH术语和自由文本关键词。纳入的研究需涉及人类受试者，使用英语发表，并专门报告心理性或非有机ED的结果。排除了综述、病例报告和非全文文章。研究选择和数据提取由两位作者独立进行。由于异质性，进行了叙述性综合。结果：关于替代疗法的证据有限且异质，许多研究早于2000年。真空勃起装置（VEDs）可能改善结果，尤其是在合并症情况下。
items.abstract: Background and Objectives: Psychogenic erectile dysfunction (ED) is a distinct clinical condition characterized by predominant psychological or relational factors. Despite its prevalence, diagnostic criteria remain heterogeneous and are often based on exclusion of organic causes. Current guidelines recommend cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), eventually combined with medical therapy such as phosphodiesterase type 5 inhibitors (PDE5i), as first-line treatment. However, evidence regarding alternative conservative and surgical therapies remains limited. This narrative review aims to evaluate the available evidence on these treatments in psychogenic ED. Materials and Methods: A comprehensive literature search was conducted in PubMed, Scopus, and MEDLINE using MeSH terms and free-text keywords related to psychogenic ED and therapeutic interventions. Eligible studies included those involving human subjects, published in English, and reporting outcomes specifically for psychogenic or non-organic ED. items.authors: Marta Pezzoli, Elettra Fuligni, Mattia Lo Re, Andrea Cocci, Andrea Minervini, Damien Carnicelli

items.title: Association of Receipt of Human Papillomavirus Vaccination and Personal History of Cancer Diagnosis in the United States: A Cross-Sectional Study Using NHIS Data
items.title_zh: 美国人乳头瘤病毒疫苗接种与癌症病史的关联研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：癌症幸存者相较于普通人群，发展后续癌症（包括HPV相关癌症）的风险更高。然而，关于HPV疫苗接种与癌症诊断状态的证据有限。方法：我们分析了2019年和2022年国家健康访谈调查数据，重点关注18至45岁符合HPV疫苗接种条件的成年人。我们进行了描述性统计，并使用加权的双变量和多变量逻辑回归评估个人癌症病史与HPV疫苗接种之间的关联，同时调整社会人口学和行为因素。结果：在20,917名参与者中（平均年龄31.41岁），489名（2.0%）为癌症幸存者，其中99名（19.3%）接种了HPV疫苗。20,423名无癌症诊断的成年人中，5317名（27.8%）接种了HPV疫苗。癌症幸存者接种HPV疫苗的几率显著低于无个人癌症病史的成年人（调整后比值比[aOR]: 0.67, 95% CI: 0.52–0.87, p = 0.003）。居住在非城市地区、吸烟者（现吸烟者[aOR: 0.82, 95% CI: 0.71–0.94, p = 0.005]，前吸烟者[aOR: 0.75, 95% CI: 0.67–0.84, p = 0.001]）及非美国出生者的接种几率也较低。
items.abstract: Background: Cancer survivors are at increased risk for developing subsequent cancers, including HPV-associated cancers, compared to the general population. However, evidence regarding the receipt of HPV vaccination and cancer diagnosis status is limited. Methods: We analyzed 2019 and 2022 National Health Interview Survey data, focusing on adults aged 18–45 years who were eligible for HPV vaccination. We performed descriptive statistics and evaluated associations using survey-weighted bivariable and multivariable logistic regression to assess the association between a personal history of any cancer diagnosis and receipt of HPV vaccination, adjusting for sociodemographic and behavioral factors. Results: Among 20,917 participants (mean [SD] age (years): 31.41 [13.58]), 489 (2.0%) were cancer survivors; 99 (19.3%) received HPV vaccination. Among 20,423 adults without a cancer diagnosis, 5317 (27.8%) had received HPV vaccination. Five participants had missing data on cancer history. Cancer survivors had significantly lower odds of HPV vaccination compared to adults without a personal cancer history (Adjusted Odds Ratio [aOR]: 0.67, 95% CI: 0.52–0.87, p = 0.003). items.title: Diagnostic Approach and Therapeutic Management of Spontaneous Esophageal Perforation (Boerhaave’s Syndrome): A Systematic Review and Individual Patient-Level Pooled Analysis
items.title_zh: 自发性食管穿孔（博尔哈夫综合征）的诊断与治疗管理：系统评价与个体患者数据分析
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：博尔哈夫综合征（BS）是一种罕见且危及生命的疾病，死亡率高。本系统评价旨在总结成人BS患者的临床表现、管理和结局。方法：通过PubMed和Scopus搜索截至2026年6月12日的病例报告和病例系列，提取人口统计学、临床、诊断、治疗和结局数据。使用乔安娜·布里格斯研究所的批判性评估清单评估偏倚风险，并通过逻辑回归探讨与住院死亡率相关的因素。结果：共纳入427项研究，涉及694名患者。平均年龄为57.1岁，523名患者（80.6%）为男性。呕吐（79.5%）和胸痛（60.7%）是最常见症状，263名患者（67.6%）在诊断时符合SIRS标准。83.5%的病例涉及远端食管，CT是主要的诊断手段（55.5%）。手术是最常见的一线治疗（62.8%）。住院和30天死亡率分别为18.2%和15.4%。探索性分析显示，年龄增加和SIRS与住院死亡率相关。偏倚风险评估发现研究间存在方法学问题，主要由于选择性和不完整的结果报告。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Boerhaave’s syndrome (BS) is a rare, life-threatening condition associated with high mortality. This systematic review aimed to summarize the clinical presentation, management, and outcomes of adult patients with BS. Methods: PubMed and Scopus were searched through 12 June 2026 for case reports and case series reporting individual patient-level data. Demographic, clinical, diagnostic, therapeutic, and outcome data were extracted. Risk of bias was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute Critical Appraisal Checklist, and factors associated with in-hospital mortality were explored using logistic regression. Results: A total of 427 studies comprising 694 patients were included. Mean age was 57.1 years and 523 patients (80.6%) were male. Vomiting (79.5%) and chest pain (60.7%) were the most common symptoms, while 263 patients (67.6%) met SIRS criteria at diagnosis. The distal esophagus was involved in 83.5% of cases, and computed tomography was the predominant diagnostic modality (55.5%). Surgery was the most common first-line treatment (62.8%). In-hospital and 30-day mortality were 18.2% and 15.4%, respectively. In exploratory analyses, increasing age and SIRS

items.title: Prediction Model for Discharge Destination in Older Patients After Hip Fracture Surgery Using Early Predictors
items.title_zh: 老年髋关节骨折手术后出院去向预测模型研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：识别70岁及以上老年患者在髋关节骨折手术后出院去向的早期预测因子，利用荷兰髋关节骨折审计（DHFA）指标工作组数据库，开发并验证预测模型。方法：将术前居住在（养老）院的患者分为三组：回家（n = 1322）、老年康复（n = 2181）和护理院（n = 337）。数据集随机分为训练集（75%）和测试集（25%）。在手术后立即收集潜在预测因子，并在训练集中进行单变量测试。p值小于0.15的变量进入多项式回归模型，模型在测试集上进行验证。结果：训练集包含2878名患者（中位年龄：83岁（IQR 77–89岁），女性2012名（70%））。最终的多项式回归模型包括年龄、性别、PFMS、既往Katz-ADL、ASA评分、多重用药、痴呆病史、住院期间谵妄、过去六个月内跌倒、手术治疗、麻醉类型及老年医学科医生的共同治疗。模型预测出院去向的关联强度和方向在三组比较中有所不同。
items.abstract: Objectives: To identify early predictors of discharge destination in patients aged ≥70 years following hip fracture surgery, using the Dutch Hip Fracture Audit (DHFA) Indicator Taskforce database with the aim of developing and validating a prediction model. Methods: Patients living in a (residential) home prior to the hip fracture were categorized into three discharge groups: home (n = 1322), geriatric rehabilitation (n = 2181), and nursing home (n = 337). The dataset was randomly split into a training set (75%) and a test set (25%). Potential predictors of discharge destination were collected immediately after hip fracture surgery and first tested univariately in the training set. Variables showing p 0.15 were entered into a multinomial regression model. The model was validated on the test set. Results: The training set consisted of 2878 patients (median age: 83 years (IQR 77–89 years), 2012 females (70%)). The final multinomial regression model included age, gender, PFMS, premorbid Katz-ADL, ASA score, polypharmacy, history of dementia, delirium during previous hospital admissions, fall in the past six months, surgical treatment, anaesthesia type, and co-treatment by a geriatrici
items.authors: Sanne M. Krakers, Dieuwke van Dartel, Marloes Vermeer, Miriam M. R. Vollenbroek-Hutten, Johannes H. Hegeman

items.title: Factors Associated with Prolonged Hospitalisation in Women with Breast Cancer: Evidence from a Large German Multicentre Study
items.title_zh: 影响女性乳腺癌住院时间延长的因素：德国多中心研究证据
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：乳腺癌是全球女性中最常见的恶性肿瘤，对医疗系统造成重大负担。尽管已有证据表明治疗类型与住院时间（LOS）相关，但目前德国缺乏相关数据。本研究旨在识别与德国乳腺癌女性住院时间延长相关的临床和程序性因素。方法：本多中心横断面研究分析了来自38家德国医院的匿名住院数据，包括16,062例女性乳腺癌住院病例（由于匿名化，无法进行患者级别的关联）。主要结果为LOS；住院时间延长定义为LOS≥7天（第75百分位）。合并症使用Elixhauser分类评估（保留≥1%患病率）。主要多变量分析限于独立于住院过程记录的特征（年龄、肿瘤部位、转移状态、慢性合并症）。住院并发症、程序和时间不明确的诊断作为次要描述性关联单独分析。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Breast cancer is the most common malignancy among women worldwide and poses a significant burden on healthcare systems. Despite evidence that treatment type is associated with hospital length of stay (LOS), current Germany-wide data on this topic are lacking. The present study aims to identify clinical and procedural factors associated with prolonged hospitalisation in women hospitalised for breast cancer in Germany. Methods: This multicentre cross-sectional study analysed anonymised inpatient data from 38 German hospitals (IQVIA database), including 16,062 female breast cancer hospitalisation episodes (inpatient cases; patient-level linkage was not possible due to anonymisation, so these may not represent 16,062 distinct women) treated between January 2019 and December 2024. The primary outcome was LOS; prolonged hospitalisation was defined as LOS 7 days (75th percentile). Comorbidities were assessed using individual comorbidity categories defined according to the Elixhauser classification (retained at ≥1% prevalence). items.authors: Lisa Cordes, Karel Kostev, Matthias Kalder

items.title: Hydrus® Microstent Combined with Cataract Surgery in Pseudoexfoliation Glaucoma Versus Primary Open Angle Glaucoma
items.title_zh: Hydrus®微支架联合白内障手术在假性剥脱青光眼与原发性开角青光眼中的比较
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：本研究旨在比较Hydrus®微支架植入联合白内障手术在假性剥脱青光眼（PXG）和原发性开角青光眼（POAG）患者中的临床结果。方法：这是一项回顾性单中心比较队列研究，纳入2021年6月至2025年12月在德国慕尼黑路德维希·马克西米利安大学眼科医院接受联合手术的POAG和PXG患者。临床结果评估持续至手术后8-14个月。结果：共纳入74只眼，POAG 49只，PXG 25只。手术后，两个组的眼压（IOP）均显著下降（POAG: 17.6 ± 3.9降至13.8 ± 2.3 mmHg, p < 0.0001；PXG: 19.2 ± 4.3降至14.6 ± 2.7 mmHg, p < 0.0001），降压幅度无显著差异（p = 0.410）。两组降压药物数量显著减少（POAG: -1.20；PXG: -1.09，p = 0.724）。手术成功率相当。结论：Hydrus®微支架植入联合白内障手术在POAG和PXG患者中显示出相似的手术结果。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Our objective was to compare clinical outcomes of the Hydrus® Microstent implantation combined with cataract surgery in eyes with pseudoexfoliation glaucoma (PXG) and primary open angle glaucoma (POAG). Methods: This retrospective, single-center comparative cohort study included eyes with POAG or PXG undergoing combined cataract surgery and Hydrus® Microstent implantation between June 2021 and December 2025 at the University Eye Hospital of the Ludwig Maximilian University in Munich, Germany. Clinical outcomes were evaluated until 8–14 months after surgery. Results: A total of 74 eyes were included, comprising 49 POAG eyes and 25 PXG eyes. After cataract surgery plus Hydrus® Microstent, IOP decreased significantly in both groups from baseline to the final 8–14-month follow-up (POAG: 17.6 ± 3.9 to 13.8 ± 2.3 mmHg, p 0.0001; PXG: 19.2 ± 4.3 to 14.6 ± 2.7 mmHg, p 0.0001). The magnitude of IOP reduction did not differ between groups (p = 0.410). Meanwhile, the number of IOP-lowering medications decreased significantly in both groups with no between-group difference (POAG: −1.20 medications; PXG group −1.09 medications, p = 0.724). items.title: Use of Tacrolimus and Voclosporin as Induction Therapy in Lupus Nephritis: A Focused Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Evidence
items.title_zh: 他克莫司与伏克洛司作为狼疮性肾炎诱导治疗的系统评价
items.summary_zh: 背景：狼疮性肾炎（LN）是系统性红斑狼疮患者的重要致病因素，治疗抵抗仍然是临床挑战。钙调神经磷酸酶抑制剂（CNI），如他克莫司（TAC）和伏克洛司（VCS），已成为标准诱导治疗的辅助药物。本系统评价和荟萃分析识别并量化了TAC和VCS作为LN诱导治疗的随机证据，汇总了每种药物与其对照组的效果，并提供了探索性间接比较以生成假设。方法：遵循PRISMA指南，进行了全面的文献检索，截止至2025年6月。纳入的研究为随机对照试验，招募活跃的III、IV或V类LN成人患者，并报告TAC或VCS治疗后的完全或部分肾脏反应。结果：分析了五项多国随机对照试验，共1433名参与者。与传统诱导治疗相比，TAC显著改善了肾脏反应（RR，1.36；95% CI，1.00–1.86；p = 0.048），且异质性显著（I² = 73%）。VCS也显著改善了肾脏反应（RR，1.78；95% CI，1.35–2.34；p <）。
items.abstract: Background: Lupus nephritis (LN) remains a major cause of morbidity among patients with systemic lupus erythematosus, and treatment resistance continues to pose clinical challenges. Calcineurin inhibitors (CNIs), including tacrolimus (TAC) and voclosporin (VCS), have emerged as adjuncts to standard induction therapy. This systematic review and meta-analysis identified and quantified the randomized evidence for TAC and for VCS as induction therapy in LN, summarizing the pooled effect of each agent against its trial comparators, with an exploratory adjusted indirect comparison provided for hypothesis generation. Methods: Following PRISMA guidelines, a comprehensive literature search was conducted through June 2025. Eligible studies were randomized controlled trials enrolling adults with biopsy-proven active class III, IV, or V LN and reporting complete or partial renal response after TAC- or VCS-based therapy. Pooled risk ratios (RRs) were calculated using a random-effects model, and an indirect Bucher comparison was performed. items.authors: Urvi Zala, Rushi Patel, Jacob Thompson, Anil Regmi

items.title: A Multiphase Combined Treatment Including Individualized Multimodal Immunotherapy and Tumor Microenvironment Therapy for Glioblastoma: A Decade of Experience with Real-World Patients
items.title_zh: 多阶段联合治疗胶质母细胞瘤的个体化免疫治疗与肿瘤微环境疗法
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：通过回顾性真实世界数据分析，探讨个体化多模式免疫治疗（IMI）在多阶段联合治疗策略中的潜在关联及其对延长生存期的影响。方法：患者选择标准包括：2015年5月27日后治疗，年龄在18至70岁之间，确诊为胶质母细胞瘤且IDH1wt状态已记录，已知MGMT启动子甲基化状态（甲基化与非甲基化），已知生存状态，且无第二恶性肿瘤。IMI目前仅对KPI≥60且具备足够经济资源的患者可用。结果：共识别104名患者，按MGMT甲基化与非甲基化状态分布，女性18%/男性25%与女性23%/男性38%；入组时中位年龄分别为54岁与50岁；切除范围为12 R0、28 R0和三例未记录；入组时中位KPI为70。患者接受的调节电热疗程中位数为37次与31次，NDV注射为37次与32次，树突状细胞疫苗为2次与1次。中位生存期及2年生存率分别为33.1个月与69.7%对比19.0个月与35.4%。未出现重大不良反应，但使用检查点抑制剂时不良反应负担增加。对33名患者的健康相关生活质量（HRQoL）进行了分析。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: A potential association between individualized multimodal immunotherapy (IMI) within a multiphase combined treatment strategy and prolonged survival was explored through retrospective real-world data analysis. Methods: The patient selection criteria were as follows: treatment after 27 May 2015, adults between ages 18 and 70, GB diagnosis and IDH1wt status documented, known MGMT promoter methylation status (methylated versus unmethylated), known status of OS, and no second malignancy. IMI is currently only accessible to patients with a 60 KPI and sufficient financial resources. Results: A total of 104 patients were identified, distributed as per MGMT methylation versus unmethylation status, respectively, as 18% female/25% male versus 23% f/38% m; the median age at intake was 54 y versus 50 y; the resection extent was 12 R0, 28 R0 and three not documented versus 25, 28 and eight; and the median KPI at intake was 70 overall. Patients received a median of 37 versus 31 modulated electro-hyperthermia sessions, 37 versus 32 NDV injections, and two versus one dendritic cell vaccines. items.authors: Linde F. C. Kampers, Jennifer Kosmal, Peter Van de Vliet, Stefaan W. Van Gool

items.title: A RUBY-Based Visual Hairy Root Transformation and CRISPR-PTG Genome-Editing System in Eucommia ulmoides
items.title_zh: 基于RUBY的榆树毛根转化与CRISPR-PTG基因编辑系统
items.summary_zh: 榆树（Eucommia ulmoides Oliv.）是一种具有重要药用和工业价值的木本植物。然而，缺乏高效的遗传转化和基因编辑系统严重阻碍了其功能基因研究和分子育种进展。本研究成功建立了一种基于RUBY可视化报告基因的高效农杆菌介导的榆树毛根遗传转化系统。通过系统优化，确定了最佳转化条件为以OD600为0.6的K599农杆菌感染胚轴外植体20分钟。在此基础上，进一步构建了基于RUBY的CRISPR-PTG（多顺反子tRNA-gRNA）载体。以角鲨烯合酶（EuSQS）为靶基因，Sanger测序和ICE分析提供了CRISPR-PTG介导的EuSQS位点编辑的初步证据，尽管毛根的潜在嵌合特性可能导致观察到的编辑谱的变异。本研究建立的RUBY可视化毛根遗传转化系统为进一步优化和应用提供了有用基础。
items.abstract: Eucommia ulmoides Oliv. is a woody plant with significant medicinal and industrial value. However, the lack of an efficient genetic transformation and gene-editing system has seriously hindered the research on its functional genes and the progress of molecular breeding. To break through this technical bottleneck, this study successfully established an efficient Agrobacterium-mediated genetic transformation system for E. ulmoides hairy roots based on the RUBY visual reporter gene. Through systematic optimization, the optimal transformation conditions were identified as infecting hypocotyl explants with Agrobacterium strain K599 at an OD600 of 0.6 for 20 min. Based on this optimized system, a RUBY-based CRISPR-PTG (polycistronic tRNA-gRNA) construct was further generated. With squalene synthase (EuSQS) as the target gene, Sanger sequencing and ICE (Inference of CRISPR Edits) analysis provided preliminary evidence for CRISPR-PTG-mediated editing at the EuSQS locus in transgenic hairy roots, although the potentially chimeric nature of hairy roots may contribute to variation in the observed editing profiles. In this study, a RUBY-based visual hairy root genetic transformation system was
items.authors: Linqing Xu, Yani Zhou, Yongfeng Sun, Yating Dong, Rong Kang, Nan Yao

items.title: Integrative Proteogenomics and Single-Cell Transcriptomics Prioritize Candidate Causal Proteins and Therapeutic Targets in Age-Related Macular Degeneration
items.title_zh: 整合蛋白组学与单细胞转录组学优先筛选AMD致病蛋白
items.summary_zh: 年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）是导致不可逆视觉损伤的主要原因，但识别效应蛋白及其特定机制仍具挑战。本研究旨在系统优先筛选候选致病循环蛋白，并阐明其在AMD中的细胞和转录动态。我们整合了来自英国生物银行药物蛋白组学项目（UKB-PPP；N=53,022）的血浆蛋白定量性状位点（pQTL）汇总统计与FinnGen AMD基因组关联研究（GWAS）数据，采用蛋白组全基因组关联研究（PWAS）、基于汇总数据的孟德尔随机化（SMR）及HEIDI测试和贝叶斯共定位分析。优先筛选的候选蛋白在人体和小鼠视网膜单细胞/单核RNA测序图谱中进行了映射。转录响应在独立临床微阵列数据集（GSE103060）及人类视网膜色素上皮细胞（ARPE-19）中通过体外炎症刺激和RT-qPCR进行了验证。药物靶点可行性通过药理数据库进行评估。多阶段遗传筛选优先筛选出五种候选蛋白，分为两个置信层级：三个一级致病因子（PP4 0.80），包括风险因子CSF2、IL20RB和WARS1，以及两个二级候选蛋白。
items.abstract: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a major cause of irreversible visual impairment, yet identifying effector proteins and tissue-specific mechanisms underlying genome-wide association study (GWAS) loci remains challenging. This study aimed to systematically prioritize candidate causal circulating proteins and delineate their cellular and transcriptional dynamics in AMD. We integrated plasma protein quantitative trait loci (pQTL) summary statistics from the UK Biobank Pharma Proteomics Project (UKB-PPP; N=53,022) with FinnGen AMD GWAS data using proteome-wide association studies (PWAS), summary-data-based Mendelian randomization (SMR) with the HEIDI test, and Bayesian colocalization analysis. Prioritized candidates were mapped across human and murine retinal single-cell/single-nucleus RNA sequencing atlases. Transcriptional responsiveness was validated in an independent clinical microarray dataset (GSE103060) and in human retinal pigment epithelial cells (ARPE-19) via in vitro inflammatory stimulation and RT-qPCR. Target tractability was assessed using pharmacological databases. Multi-stage genetic screening prioritized five candidate proteins stratified into two confidence t
items.authors: Lei Wen, Fangran Li, Yuan Liu, Ka Zhang, Aiqin Mao, Liangju Liu

items.title: Influence of Acid–Base Synthesis Conditions on Metal-Oxide Catalysts for Sulfur Compound Removal from Natural Gas
items.title_zh: 酸碱合成条件对金属氧化物催化剂的影响
items.summary_zh: 乙基硫醇是天然气中最持久的含硫杂质之一，需要高效的吸附剂/催化剂系统在温和条件下去除。本研究制备了两种以高岭土为载体的金属氧化物催化剂，即基于锰和铜的催化剂，采用回流湿浸渍法，使用三种碱性沉淀剂（NaOH、Ca(OH)2、Ba(OH)2），并在合成过程中添加或不添加醋酸。研究旨在评估酸性和碱性合成环境对催化剂结构、表面化学、活性金属分布及乙基硫醇吸附性能的影响。催化剂的表征技术包括BET表面积分析、XRD、FTIR、SEM、EDS和XPS。结果表明，高岭土（载体）具有51.2 m²/g的中孔结构，金属的引入改变了载体的孔结构、表面组成、结晶性和形态。合成过程中添加酸产生了依赖于碱的效应：它改善了Mn-Ca(OH)2和Cu-NaOH催化剂的纹理特性，但通常降低了活性金属的表面分布。
items.abstract: Ethyl mercaptan is one of the most persistent sulfur-containing impurities in natural gas and requires efficient adsorbent/catalyst systems for removal under mild conditions. In this study, two types of halloysite-supported metal oxide catalysts, namely Mn- and Cu-based catalysts, were prepared via reflux-wet impregnation using three alkaline precipitation agents (NaOH; Ca(OH)2; Ba(OH)2), with and without the use of acetic acid added during the synthesis process. The objective was to evaluate how acidic and alkaline synthesis environments influence catalyst structure, surface chemistry, active metal distribution, and ethyl mercaptan adsorption performance. Characterization techniques used to examine the catalysts included Brunauer–Emmett–Teller surface area analysis (BET), X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS), and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The characterization results showed that halloysite (support) possessed a mesoporous structure with a surface area of 51.2 m2/g, while metal incorporation modified the pore structure, surface composition, crystallinity, and m
items.authors: Samuel Antwi, William Holmes, Dongmei Cao, Dhan Fortela, Tolga Karsili, Emmanuel Revellame

items.title: Green-Synthesized Nanomaterials for Kidney Cancer: Current Progress and Future Perspectives
items.title_zh: 绿色合成纳米材料在肾癌中的应用进展与前景
items.summary_zh: 肾脏是维持人体内稳态的重要器官，肾癌因其对传统治疗方法（如化疗、放疗和免疫疗法）的耐药性而成为重大临床挑战。纳米颗粒因其低毒性、生物相容性和靶向药物递送能力而受到广泛关注。本文综述了绿色合成纳米颗粒在肾细胞癌管理中的作用及其在靶向药物递送和癌症特异性靶向机制中的应用，强调了利用植物提取物和微生物等生物资源的环保绿色合成方法相较于传统合成方法的优势，包括生物相容性、可持续性和降低毒性。此外，讨论了纳米材料的治疗潜力，包括磁性纳米颗粒介导的热疗、光热疗法、基因递送系统和基于RNA干扰的策略。我们强调了纳米颗粒面临的挑战和局限性，包括体内毒性、生物分布、临床转化、大规模生产、批次间变异、长期安全性、可扩展性、重复性、监管和可重复性等问题。
items.abstract: The kidney is an essential organ that has a crucial role in preserving homeostasis within the human body. Kidney cancer is considered a major clinical challenge owing to its resistance to traditional treatments such as chemotherapy, radiotherapy, and immunotherapy. Nanoparticles (NPs) gain great attention in cancer therapy due to their low toxicity, biocompatibility, and targeted drug delivery capability. This review focuses on the current role of green-synthesized NPs in renal cell carcinoma management and their applications in targeted drug delivery and cancer-specific targeting mechanisms with the demonstration of the environmentally friendly green synthesis approaches utilizing biological resources such as plant extracts and microorganisms, highlighting their advantages over conventional synthesis methods in terms of biocompatibility, sustainability, and reduced toxicity. Moreover, the therapeutic potential of nanomaterials is discussed, including magnetic NP-mediated thermal therapy, photothermal therapy, gene delivery systems, and RNA interference-based strategies. We underscore the challenges and limitations of NPs, including in vivo toxicity, biodistribution, clinical trans
items.authors: Mariam R. Khalifa, Doaa S. R. Khafaga, Marwa T. Abo Gabal, Marwa Mohamed Abd El-Monem, Sara S. Zeidan, Shimaa S. Attia

items.title: Molecular Signaling Pathways, Regulatory and Coactivator Networks, and Emerging Mechanisms in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
items.title_zh: 肝细胞癌中的分子信号通路与调控网络研究
items.summary_zh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）是最常见的原发性肝恶性肿瘤，也是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。尽管在诊断和治疗方面取得了进展，但晚期HCC的预后仍然较差，原因包括晚期诊断、高复发率、治疗抵抗及显著的分子异质性。HCC的发展受复杂的体细胞基因改变、表观遗传重编程、信号通路失调、代谢变化及免疫抑制肿瘤微环境的驱动。分子分析研究已识别出与HCC进展相关的关键致癌通路，包括MAPK/ERK、Wnt/β-catenin、PI3K/AKT/mTOR、Hippo-YAP/TAZ等，这些通路协调细胞增殖、生存、代谢、侵袭及基因组稳定性等关键过程。此外，癌症干细胞可塑性、免疫逃逸、表观遗传失调及类固醇受体共激活因子依赖的转录调控等新兴机制也进一步促进了肿瘤进展和治疗抵抗。
items.abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the most common primary liver malignancy and a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Despite advances in diagnosis and therapy, the prognosis for advanced HCC remains poor due to late-stage diagnosis, high recurrence rates, therapeutic resistance, and pronounced molecular heterogeneity. HCC development is driven by complex somatic gene alterations, epigenetic reprogramming, dysregulated signaling pathways, metabolic changes, and an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. Molecular profiling studies have identified key oncogenic pathways involved in HCC progression, including MAPK/ERK (mitogen-activated protein kinase/extracellular signal-regulated kinase), Wnt/β-catenin, PI3K/AKT/mTOR (Phosphoinositide 3-kinase/Protein Kinase B/mechanistic Target of Rapamycin), Hippo-YAP/TAZ, (Yes-associated protein/transcriptional co-activator with PDZ-binding motif) cell cycle regulators, and p53-mediated tumor suppression. These pathways coordinate critical cellular processes such as proliferation, survival, metabolism, invasion, and genomic stability. items.title: Prognostic Value of Dynamic Hematologic Immune-Inflammatory Indices in Patients Undergoing Isolated Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting
items.title_zh: 动态血液免疫炎症指标在冠脉旁路手术患者预后中的价值
items.summary_zh: 背景：尽管外科和围手术期护理有所进步，孤立冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）后的早期死亡率和并发症仍然具有临床相关性。传统风险模型主要反映基线临床和手术特征，可能无法全面捕捉心肺旁路和手术创伤的动态免疫炎症反应。常规全血细胞计数衍生的血液指标可能为评估围手术期炎症负担提供实用且低成本的方法。方法：本单中心回顾性观察研究纳入了2020至2024年间接受孤立CABG的650名成人患者，评估了术前和术后的单核细胞与淋巴细胞比率（MLR）、全免疫炎症值（PIV）和中性粒细胞指数（DNI）。主要结果为院内死亡率，次要结果为包括机械通气延长、重症监护室逗留时间延长、正性肌力支持延长、肺炎或脓毒症在内的复合术后不良事件。结果：52名患者（8.0%）发生院内死亡，221名患者（34.0%）发生复合术后不良事件。非幸存者年龄较大，临床风险评分较高，射血分数较低，心肺旁路和主动脉夹闭时间较长，且预后较差。
items.abstract: Background: Despite advances in surgical and perioperative care, early mortality and postoperative complications after isolated coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) remain clinically relevant. Conventional risk models primarily reflect baseline clinical and operative characteristics and may not fully capture the dynamic immune-inflammatory response to cardiopulmonary bypass and surgical trauma. Hematologic indices derived from routine complete blood counts may provide a practical and low-cost assessment of this perioperative inflammatory burden. Methods: This single-center retrospective observational study included 650 adult patients who underwent isolated CABG between 2020 and 2024. Preoperative and postoperative monocyte-to-lymphocyte ratio (MLR), pan-immune-inflammation value (PIV), and delta neutrophil index (DNI) were evaluated. The primary outcome was in-hospital mortality, and the secondary outcome was a composite postoperative adverse event comprising prolonged mechanical ventilation, prolonged intensive care unit stay, prolonged inotropic support, pneumonia, or sepsis. items.title: Functional Status and Postoperative Outcomes After Left Pancreatectomy for Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumors: An Exploratory Analysis from the Prospective SPANDISPAN Study
items.title_zh: 左侧胰腺切除术后胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤功能状态与预后分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：肿瘤功能状态是否影响左侧胰腺切除术（LP）后胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤（pNET）的预后尚不明确。本研究评估了功能状态、围手术期管理与术后结果之间的关联。方法：本研究为前瞻性多中心SPANDISPAN研究的预先指定分析，纳入2022年2月至2023年1月在41家西班牙医院接受选择性LP的患者。98例pNET患者中，88例的功能状态可用（14例为功能性肿瘤，74例为非功能性肿瘤）。根据肿瘤功能状态比较围手术期特征、脾脏保留及术后结果。结果：功能性肿瘤的脾脏保留率为28.6%，非功能性肿瘤为18.9%（p = 0.472）。功能性肿瘤患者术后胰腺瘘发生率较低（7.1% vs. 36.5%；p = 0.032），住院时间较短（中位数4天 vs. 7天；p = 0.036），90天内无再入院（0% vs. 31.1%；p = 0.017）。结论：功能性肿瘤患者在术后表现出更好的预后。
items.abstract: Background: Whether tumor functional status influences postoperative outcomes after left pancreatectomy (LP) for pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (pNETs) remains unknown. We evaluated the association between functional status, perioperative management, and postoperative outcomes in a prospective nationwide cohort of patients undergoing LP for pNET. Methods: This prespecified analysis of the prospective multicenter SPANDISPAN study included consecutive patients undergoing elective LP at 41 Spanish hospitals between February 2022 and January 2023. Of 98 patients with pNET, functional status was available in 88 (14 functioning and 74 non-functioning tumors). Perioperative characteristics, spleen preservation, and postoperative outcomes were compared according to tumor functional status. Results: Spleen preservation was performed in 28.6% of functioning and 18.9% of non-functioning tumors (p = 0.472; risk difference 9.7 percentage points, 95% CI [confidence interval] −15.6 to 34.9). items.title: Clinical Characteristics and In-Hospital Outcomes of Traumatic Bladder Rupture: An 11-Year Retrospective Cohort Study at a Single Regional Trauma Center
items.title_zh: 创伤性膀胱破裂的临床特征及住院结果：单中心11年回顾性研究
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：创伤性膀胱破裂常伴随盆骨骨折，导致难以判断外腹膜膀胱破裂（EPBR）与内腹膜膀胱破裂（IPBR）之间的差异是否反映破裂部位或整体创伤负担。本研究旨在探讨破裂部位与住院时间的关系。方法：我们回顾性分析了2014年1月至2024年12月在单一区域创伤中心接受治疗的46例确诊创伤性膀胱破裂成人患者。破裂部位为主要暴露因素，住院时间为主要结果，重症监护室（ICU）住院时间为次要结果。结果：21例为IPBR，25例为EPBR，26例伴有盆骨骨折。在调整后的主要结果分析中，破裂部位与住院时间无明显关联（EPBR与IPBR调整比率为1.02；95% CI，0.59–1.76）。次要调整分析同样未显示与ICU住院时间的明显关联（调整比率为1.31；95% CI，0.77–2.21）。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Traumatic bladder rupture often accompanies pelvic fracture, making it uncertain whether differences between extraperitoneal bladder rupture (EPBR) and intraperitoneal bladder rupture (IPBR) reflect the rupture site itself or overall trauma burden. Prior multi-institutional evidence has focused on EPBR. We therefore examined whether rupture site was associated with hospital length of stay after accounting for concomitant pelvic fracture and injury severity. Methods: We retrospectively reviewed 46 adults with definite traumatic bladder rupture treated at a single regional trauma center from January 2014 through December 2024. Rupture site was the primary exposure, hospital length of stay was the primary outcome, and intensive care unit (ICU) length of stay was the secondary outcome. Parsimonious exploratory log-linear models included rupture site, concomitant pelvic fracture, and Injury Severity Score (ISS). Results: Twenty-one patients had IPBR, 25 had EPBR, and 26 had concomitant pelvic fracture. items.title: Non-Pharmacological Treatments for Oral Carcinogenesis: From Oral Lichen Planus to Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma
items.title_zh: 非药物治疗口腔癌变：从口腔扁平苔藓到口腔鳞状细胞癌
items.summary_zh: 口腔扁平苔藓（OLP）是一种慢性免疫介导的口腔黏膜炎症性疾病，被视为潜在恶性病变，其恶变率约为1-1.4%，在萎缩性溃疡和舌部病变中最高。其最严重的后果——口腔鳞状细胞癌（OSCC）5年生存率低于50%，并带来显著的临床、功能和经济负担。由于传统治疗方法（如OLP的局部类固醇和OSCC的手术及放疗）存在累积毒性和长期疗效有限的问题，非药物治疗策略受到越来越多的关注。本文综述了OLP到OSCC的相关证据，探讨了高能量消融激光、低能量激光治疗/光生物调节、光动力疗法、营养药物和植物治疗剂（如褪黑素、姜黄素、芦荟、椰子、锌和维生素D）、冷冻疗法、臭氧疗法、益生菌和心理干预等方法，以及OSCC的支持性措施，如口腔卫生管理和治疗相关毒性的光生物调节。证据表明，光生物调节在OLP中的效果最为显著，而其他疗法则因样本量小而限制了其应用。
items.abstract: Oral lichen planus (OLP) is a chronic, immune-mediated inflammatory disorder of the oral mucosa recognized as an oral potentially malignant disorder, with a pooled malignant transformation rate of approximately 1–1.4% that is highest in atrophic-erosive and tongue lesions. Its most feared outcome, oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC), remains associated with a 5-year survival below 50% and a substantial clinical, functional, and economic burden. Because conventional management, like topical corticosteroids for OLP and surgery with or without radiotherapy for OSCC, entails cumulative toxicity and limited long-term efficacy, non-pharmacological strategies are attracting growing interest. This narrative review critically appraises the available evidence across the OLP-to-OSCC continuum, examining high-power ablative lasers, low-level laser therapy/photobiomodulation, photodynamic therapy, nutraceutical and phytotherapeutic agents (including melatonin, curcumin, aloe vera, coconut, zinc, and vitamin D), cryotherapy, ozone therapy, probiotics, and psychological interventions, alongside supportive measures in OSCC such as oral hygiene management, photobiomodulation for treatment-related t
items.authors: Federica Re, Francesco Scilla, Mauro Labanca, Domenico Russo, Gioele Gioco, Gaia Favero

items.title: Liver Disease in Transaldolase Deficiency: Molecular Basis, Genotype–Phenotype Relationships, and Transplantation Outcomes—A Systematic Review
items.title_zh: 转醇酮酶缺乏症的肝病：分子基础与移植结果的系统评估
items.summary_zh: 转醇酮酶缺乏症（TALDO-D）是一种超罕见的非氧化磷酸戊糖途径疾病，主要表现为肝病及多元醇和七碳糖的全身积累。本研究系统回顾了肝脏表现、分子发现、基因型-表型关系及肝脏移植（LTx）经验。通过PubMed/MEDLINE和Europe PMC进行文献检索，涵盖至2026年8月10日，并进行了引用追踪；补充检索于2026年8月19日和9月1日在Scopus和Web of Science Core Collection完成。共纳入29篇主要临床报告。个体患者的整合确认了51例基因/生化确诊患者为主要分析集；包括一例基因型不确定的患者，形成52例的上限敏感性集。7名患者接受了LTx。TALDO1变异呈现异质性，家族内及基因型内的变异性使得基于基因型的预测不可靠。LTx可能为晚期肝病提供器官特异性救助，但持续的肾脏、内分泌、血液和代谢异常需要终身多系统监测。
items.abstract: Transaldolase deficiency (TALDO-D) is an ultra-rare disorder of the non-oxidative pentose phosphate pathway with prominent liver disease and systemic accumulation of polyols and seven-carbon sugars. We systematically reviewed hepatic manifestations, molecular findings, genotype–phenotype relationships, and liver transplantation (LTx) experience. PubMed/MEDLINE and Europe PMC were searched from inception to 10 August 2026, with citation tracking; supplementary Scopus and Web of Science Core Collection searches were performed on 19 August and 1 September 2026, respectively. Twenty-nine primary clinical reports were included. Individual-patient reconciliation supported 51 genetically/biochemically confirmed patients as the primary analytic set; inclusion of one diagnostically uncertain patient with a homozygous in-frame TALDO1 variant reported as a variant of uncertain significance produced an upper-bound sensitivity set of 52. Seven patients underwent LTx. TALDO1 variants were heterogeneous, and intrafamilial and intragenotypic variability precluded reliable genotype-based prediction.
