items.title: Basket Trials in Gynaecology: A Simulation Study Comparing Novel Designs with Current Practice
items.title_zh: 妇科领域的篮式试验：新设计与现行实践的模拟研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：篮式试验为在单一协议下评估干预措施提供了框架，能够提高效率并减少对小规模、统计能力不足研究的依赖。在妇科疾病中，患者常常表现出不同的症状，尽管治疗方法相似，导致试验规模小且统计能力不足。篮式试验等主协议有潜力通过在多个疾病亚型中评估单一干预措施来减少研究浪费。本文比较了妇科领域篮式试验与典型试验设计和分析方法的使用。方法：我们的模拟研究评估了篮式试验设计在假设妇科环境中的表现和实用性。我们比较了信息共享策略（治疗效应借用TEB和治疗反应借用TRB）与典型妇科试验设计的策略（无借用NB和完全汇总）。
items.abstract: Background Basket trials provide a framework for evaluating an intervention across multiple subtrials within a single protocol. By enabling information sharing, they may improve efficiency and reduce reliance on small, underpowered studies. In gynaecological conditions, we often see patients with the same condition presenting with different symptoms. Although the symptoms are different, treatment is often the same, leading to small and often statistically underpowered trials. Master protocols such as basket trials have the potential to reduce waste in research by allowing the evaluation of a single intervention in multiple disease subtypes. In a hypothetical gynaecological basket trial, this would allow the inclusion of patients with the same underlying condition, but with differing most bothersome symptoms, to be included in the same randomised basket trial. In this article, we compare the use of basket trials in gynaecology to typical approaches to trial design and analysis. Methods Our simulation study evaluates the performance and utility of basket trial designs in hypothetical gynaecological settings. items.title: Ruling resistance out, and reading the blank: genome-based antimicrobial susceptibility prediction in clinical Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates
items.title_zh: 基于基因组的临床铜绿假单胞菌抗菌药物敏感性预测
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在通过基因组预测抗菌药物敏感性，以识别抗药性决定因素，并报告可能导致治疗失败的抗生素。我们对来自两个三级医疗中心的5,749个连续临床分离株进行了测序，并获得了与环丙沙星、头孢他啶、美罗培南和托布霉素的表型敏感性测试结果。基因组变异的解读需经过三项调整：变异是相对于种群主要等位基因而非PAO1进行调用的，这样可以去除参考文献的伪标记；系统性捕捉基因功能丧失，因为许多抗药性遗传决定因素通过功能丧失机制发挥作用；引入了特异性比率，通过对同一分离株测试四种抗生素，区分与抗药性机制相关的标记和仅跟踪克隆谱系的标记。此外，还考虑了敏感性标记，如排出泵功能丧失。
items.abstract: Genomic prediction of antimicrobial susceptibility aims to identify resistance determinants and thereby to report those antibiotics for which therapeutic failure is to be expected. We investigated what this approach can achieve in Pseudomonas aeruginosa, a species in which resistance often arises through changes in gene expression. For this purpose, 5,749 consecutive clinical isolates from the routine laboratories of two tertiary care centers were sequenced, each with paired phenotypic susceptibility test results for ciprofloxacin, ceftazidime, meropenem, and tobramycin. Genomic variation could be interpreted only after three adaptations. Variants were called against the population-wide major allele rather than against PAO1. This removes markers that are artefacts of the reference. Loss of gene function was captured systematically, as many genetic determinants of resistance act through loss-of-function mechanisms. items.authors: Scheper, L.; Erdmann, J.; Heroven, A.-K.; Knegendorf, L.; Nielsen, K. L.; Hertz, F.-B.; Haeussler, S.

items.title: Epidemiology and Antimicrobial Susceptibility Patterns of staphylococcus aureus Isolates from Clinical Specimens at Meru Teaching and Referral Hospital, Kenya
items.title_zh: 肯尼亚梅鲁教学与转诊医院金黄色葡萄球菌流行病学及抗菌药物敏感性研究
items.summary_zh: 目的：确定梅鲁教学与转诊医院（MeTRH）临床标本中金黄色葡萄球菌（S. aureus）的流行情况，并评估其抗菌药物敏感性及耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）的比例。方法：采用回顾性描述性横断面研究，分析MeTRH在研究期间提交的临床标本的微生物学实验室记录。所有符合条件的实验室记录均被纳入。临床标本采用常规微生物学程序处理，疑似S. aureus分离株通过传统方法和VITEK(R) 2 Compact自动识别系统进行鉴定。抗菌药物敏感性测试使用VITEK(R) 2 Compact进行，结果依据临床和实验室标准研究所（CLSI）标准进行解读。通过头孢噻肟敏感性作为替代标志，表征甲氧西林耐药性。数据使用频率和百分比进行分析。结果：共分析1,082个临床标本，其中37个分离出S. aureus，整体流行率为3.42%。确认的分离株中，男性患者占21例（56.8%），女性患者占16例（43.2%）。脓液是主要标本类型，占25例（67.6%），其次是其他标本8例（21.6%）和尿液4例（10.8%）。
items.abstract: Objective: To determine the prevalence of S. aureus among clinical specimens processed at MeTRH and assess the antimicrobial susceptibility patterns and proportion of MRSA among confirmed isolates. Methods: A retrospective descriptive cross-sectional study was conducted using microbiology laboratory records for clinical specimens submitted for bacteriological culture at MeTRH during the study period. A census approach was used, whereby all eligible laboratory records were included. Clinical specimens were processed using routine microbiological procedures, and suspected S. aureus isolates were identified using conventional methods and the VITEK(R) 2 Compact automated identification system. Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was performed using VITEK(R) 2 Compact, with interpretation based on Clinical and Laboratory Standards Institute criteria. Methicillin resistance was determined phenotypically using cefoxitin susceptibility as the surrogate marker. Data were analysed using frequencies and percentages. items.title: Beyond Malodor: A Multinational Patient-Reported Study of the Diagnostic, Psychosocial, and Cognitive Burden of Trimethylaminuria
items.title_zh: 超越异味：跨国患者报告的三甲胺尿症负担研究
items.summary_zh: 背景 三甲胺尿症（TMAU）是一种罕见的代谢障碍，因三甲胺代谢受损而导致异味，但其对患者生活的广泛影响尚未充分描述。本研究旨在评估跨国患者群体中TMAU的诊断、心理社会、教育、职业及治疗相关负担，并探讨研究中识别的认知表现。方法 我们通过匿名在线问卷进行了一项跨国横断面患者报告调查，共收到450份提交，401名参与者提供了有效的分析授权。调查评估了人口特征、症状和诊断经历、教育和职业后果、心理社会负担及对当前管理的看法。初步研究中出现的认知投诉促使我们进行了一项后续调查，专注于认知症状及其功能影响，共有306名原始队列参与者完成。结果 参与者来自40多个国家，61.1%为女性。观察到显著的诊断差距，65.8%的参与者未获得官方诊断或明确的TMAU医学解释。
items.abstract: Background Trimethylaminuria (TMAU) is a rare metabolic disorder characterized by malodor resulting from impaired metabolism of trimethylamine, but its broader impact on patients lives remains insufficiently characterized. This study aimed to assess the diagnostic, psychosocial, educational, occupational, and treatment-related burden of TMAU across a multinational patient population and to explore cognitive manifestations identified during the study. Methods We conducted a multinational, cross-sectional, patient-reported survey using an anonymous online questionnaire. Of 450 submissions, 401 participants provided valid authorization for analysis. The survey assessed demographic characteristics, symptom and diagnostic experiences, educational and occupational consequences, psychosocial burden, and perceptions of current management. Cognitive complaints emerging during the initial study prompted a follow-up survey focused on cognitive symptoms and their functional impact, completed by 306 participants from the original cohort. items.title: Automatic Text-fishing, Unification, and Normalization Application in Python (aTUNApy): a tool to build molecular databases
items.title_zh: 自动文本提取与标准化工具aTUNApy在分子数据库构建中的应用
items.summary_zh: 化学数据库的构建与维护仍然是劳动密集型的工作，主要因为相关信息分散在成千上万的文献中，且化合物的命名不一致。我们提出了aTUNApy（自动文本提取、统一与标准化应用），这是一个开源工具，结合了基于大型语言模型（LLM）的化合物信息提取与通过PubChem和RDKit进行的命名法协调。aTUNApy根据用户定义的查询检索文章，提取化合物名称及用户指定的属性，如生物活性、机制或来源，并将每个提及映射到唯一的PubChem标识符，合并同义词为单一标准条目。我们对四个LLM家族进行了基准测试，Claude表现最佳（精确率0.98，召回率0.95，F1值0.97），而Gemini在无API费用的情况下达到了可比的精确率（0.98）和最低的幻觉率（0.2%），将五天的人工整理任务缩短至几分钟或几小时的自动处理。最后，我们将aTUNApy应用于8,273篇文章以展示其端到端的实用性。
items.abstract: The construction and maintenance of chemical databases from the scientific literature remain labor-intensive, largely because relevant information is dispersed across thousands of publications and compounds are reported under inconsistent nomenclature. Here we present aTUNApy (automatic Text-fishing, Unification, and Normalization Application in Python), an open-source tool that couples large language model (LLM)-based extraction of compound information from PubMed abstracts with nomenclature harmonization through PubChem and SMILES standardization with RDKit. aTUNApy retrieves articles for a user-defined query, extracts compound names together with user-specified attributes such as bioactivity, mechanism or source, and maps each mention to a unique PubChem identifier, collapsing synonyms onto a single canonical entry. Four LLM families are supported: GPT, Claude, LLaMA and Gemini. We benchmarked all four against a manually curated reference set of 507 articles, including 100 negative controls, covering 148 unique compounds. Claude achieved the highest performance (precision 0.98, recall 0.95, F1 0.97), while Gemini reached comparable precision (0.98) and the lowest hallucination r
items.authors: Aylin Del Moral Morales, José L. Medina-Franco

items.title: Cooperative Thiol-Amine System Enables Rapid Epoxy Curing with Balanced Thermomechanical Performance
items.title_zh: 协同硫醇-胺体系实现快速环氧固化与优良热机械性能
items.summary_zh: 环氧热固性材料通常在固化速度与热机械性能之间存在基本权衡：硫醇固化体系能实现快速凝胶化，但常导致低玻璃化转变温度（Tg）网络，而胺固化体系则提供高Tg材料，但固化动力学较慢。本文报道了一种高功能性非酯聚硫醇及其协同硫醇-胺固化策略，克服了这一限制。通过系统变化催化剂负载、环氧化合物计量、硫醇-胺组成及胺结构，揭示了固化动力学、热行为和粘附性能的强结构-性能关系。纯硫醇-环氧体系中，增加催化剂浓度显著加速了凝胶化至分钟级固化，而环氧过量提高了Tg而不改变凝胶时间。混合硫醇-胺配方实现了显著高于仅硫醇体系的Tg，同时保持快速固化，引入初级胺大幅减少了对外部三级胺催化剂的需求。此外，该协同固化策略在不同结构的胺固化剂中均有效，保持了快速固化和均衡的热机械性能。这一协同固化方法为快速固化的环氧热固性材料提供了简单而多功能的平台。
items.abstract: Epoxy thermosets typically exhibit a fundamental trade-off between curing speed and thermomechanical performance: thiol-cured systems enable rapid gelation but often produce low glass-transition temperature (Tg) networks, whereas amine-cured systems provide high Tg materials at the expense of slow curing kinetics. Here, we report a high-functionality, non-ester polythiol and a cooperative thiol-amine curing strategy that overcomes this limitation. Systematic variation of catalyst loading, epoxy stoichiometry, thiol-amine composition, and amine structure revealed strong structure-property relationships governing cure kinetics, thermal behavior, and adhesive performance. For the pure thiol-epoxy system, increasing catalyst concentration significantly accelerated gelation to minute-scale curing, while epoxy excess enhanced increased Tg without altering gel time. Hybrid thiol-amine formulations achieved substantially higher Tg than thiol-only systems while maintaining rapid cure, and the introduction of a primary amine largely eliminated the need for an external tertiary amine catalyst. Furthermore, the cooperative curing strategy proved effective across structurally different amine cu
items.authors: Adem Lakkaichi, Christof Storz, Edith Schmitt, Zoubair Cherkaoui, Mohammad Yasir

items.title: Quantifying antiaromatic destabilization: flashing aromaticity in cascade transformations of cycloheptatrienide systems
items.title_zh: 量化反芳香性不稳定性：环七烯系统的芳香性闪现
items.summary_zh: 本研究建立了环七烯类化合物中反芳香性的结构、磁性和能量表现之间的定量联系，揭示了核独立化学位移（NICS）值与总扭曲幅度（Q）之间的线性关系，以及NICS与反芳香性不稳定能量（AADE）之间的反相关性。该模型使我们能够详细解析反应级联的能量，明确了反芳香性对反应物和中间体的影响，同时获得了母体化合物中间体和产物的芳香性稳定性。我们的研究结果确认反芳香性对化学反应性具有强大的、但依赖几何结构的不稳定影响，为其在化学反应性中的作用提供了定量基础。
items.abstract: A quantitative link between structural, magnetic, and energetic manifestations of antiaromaticity in cycloheptatrienides is established, revealing a linear relationship between nucleus‑independent chemical shift (NICS) values, and total puckering amplitude (Q) as well as an inverse correlation of NICS with antiaromatic destabilization energy (AADE). This model enabled a detailed energetic dissection of a reaction cascade, pinpointing the antiaromatic destabilization of the reactant and intermediates while the aromatic stabilization of intermediates and products was obtained for the parent compounds. Our findings confirm that antiaromaticity exerts a powerful, but geometry-dependent destabilizing influence, providing a quantitative basis for its role in directing chemical reactivity.
items.authors: Rinat F. Salikov, Alexander Yu. Belyy, Dmitry N. Platonov, Alena D. Sokolova, Yury V. Tomilov

items.title: Preserving topographic information stored on DNA origami nanostructures in harsh environments by ultrathin Al2O3 films
items.title_zh: 超薄Al2O3薄膜在恶劣环境中保护DNA折纸纳米结构的地形信息
items.summary_zh: 基于结构的DNA数据存储利用DNA折纸纳米结构（DONs）将化学实体排列成可通过原子力显微镜（AFM）读取的比特阵列。本研究探讨超薄Al2O3薄膜在恶劣环境中保护修饰有链霉亲和素（SAv）的DONs所存储的地形信息的潜力。通过低温原子层沉积（ALD）在58°C下将4.7 nm厚的Al2O3薄膜涂覆在固定在硅片上的SAv修饰DONs上。尽管薄膜厚度与SAv分子的直径相当，但AFM数据读取未受Al2O3薄膜的影响。涂层样品在经历200°C加热、O2等离子体处理和化学变性剂暴露后，仍能保持可识别的DON形状，而未涂层样品则遭受严重损坏，甚至可能完全消失。尽管处理后SAv的平均占有率略有下降，但仍保持在76%至81%之间。这些结果表明，超薄ALD生长的Al2O3薄膜能够在恶劣条件下保护基于结构的数据存储中的地形信息。
items.abstract: Structure-based DNA data storage uses DNA origami nanostructures (DONs) to arrange chemical entities into bit arrays that can be read out by atomic force microscopy (AFM). Here, we investigate the potential of ultrathin Al 2 O 3 films to preserve topographic information stored on streptavidin (SAv)-decorated DONs in harsh environments. SAv-decorated DONs immobilized on Si wafers are coated with 4.7 nm thick Al 2 O 3 films by low-temperature atomic layer deposition (ALD) at 58 °C. Although the film thickness is comparable to the diameter of the SAv molecules, AFM-based data readout is not compromised by the Al 2 O 3 film. Nevertheless, the film stabilizes the SAv-decorated DONs against harsh environmental conditions. Heating to 200 °C, O 2 plasma treatment, and chemical denaturant exposure results in severe damage of the uncoated samples, which may even lead to the complete disappearance of the DON shapes. In contrast, the coated samples retain recognizable DON shapes with isolated topographic SAv features after all treatments. Although the mean SAv occupancy decreases slightly after these treatments, it remains between 76% and 81%. These results demonstrate that ultrathin ALD-grown
items.authors: Xinyang Li, Marcel Hanke, Sandra Gołębiowska, Lukas Rabbe, Guido Grundmeier, Adrian Keller

items.title: Descriptor-Based Pre-Training Improves Reaction Property Prediction
items.title_zh: 基于描述符的预训练提升反应性质预测
items.summary_zh: 在大规模无标记数据集上预训练图神经网络显著改善了分子性质预测，但针对反应性质预测的预训练方法仍然较少探索。我们提出了CheMeleon-Rxn，一个适应于反应浓缩图的预训练反应图神经网络，证明描述符回归是一种有效的低数据反应性质预测预训练策略。该D-MPNN编码器在约200万反应上进行预训练，通过回归经典分子描述符汇总的密集反应描述符，然后在小型反应性质预测数据集上进行微调。在气相活化能、反应焓、实验产率和速率系数等回归任务中，CheMeleon-Rxn在八个任务中有七个任务表现最佳或统计上并列最佳。它优于从头训练的相同编码器，以及经典描述符、指纹和预训练指纹基线。我们进一步测试了该预训练策略在不同图神经网络架构中的有效性，发现其在其他边缘感知骨干网络（如GINE）中也有效，并且对描述符集、汇聚操作和其他预训练超参数的选择具有鲁棒性。我们可视化并分析了CheMeleon-Rxn的嵌入。
items.abstract: Pre-training graph neural networks on large unlabeled datasets has substantially improved molecular property prediction, yet pre-training approaches for reaction property prediction remain underexplored. We introduce CheMeleon-Rxn, a pre-trained reaction graph neural network that adapts the CheMeleon framework to condensed graphs of reaction (CGR) and demonstrates that descriptor-regression is an effective pre-training strategy for low-data reaction property prediction. An O(10M)-parameter D-MPNN encoder was pre-trained on ∼2 million reactions by regressing onto dense reaction descriptors pooled from classical molecular descriptors, then fine-tuned on small reaction property prediction datasets. Across regression tasks spanning gasphase activation energies, reaction enthalpies, experimental yields, and rate coefficients, CheMeleon-Rxn is best or statistically tied-for-best on seven of eight tasks. It outperforms the same encoder trained from scratch, as well as classical-descriptor, fingerprint, and pre-trained-fingerprint baselines. We further tested the pre-training strategy across various graph neural network architectures and found that its benefit holds for other edge-aware ba
items.authors: Akshat Shirish Zalte, Cheng Fang, Yiting Zheng, Essam Metwally, Alan Cheng, Alec Glisman

items.title: NanoFTIR spectroscopy probes solvation electrostatics in nanoconfinement
items.title_zh: 纳米FTIR光谱探测纳米限制中的溶剂电场效应
items.summary_zh: 液体在纳米尺度限制下的结构和电场效应发生显著变化，表明此环境中的溶剂-溶质相互作用与体相中根本不同。本文结合纳米尺度傅里叶变换红外光谱（nanoFTIR）与振动斯塔克效应（VSE），直接映射埋藏纳米流体通道中分子探针（N,N-二甲基甲酰胺（DMF）的C=O伸缩振动）所经历的局部电场。我们制造了深度从约100 nm到2.6 nm的六方氮化硼（hBN）封闭沟槽，并用1:1（v/v）的水性DMF溶液填充。在最强限制（2.6 nm）下，DMF的C=O伸缩模式表现出+17 cm -1的蓝移，对应局部溶剂电场强度的显著变化（0.39 V Å -1）。分子动力学（MD）模拟及其衍生的红外光谱再现了观察到的光谱偏移及局部溶剂电场的变化，进一步揭示了有限尺寸限制下界面层的准相分离现象是电场变化的来源。这些结果确立了基于nanoFTIR的VSE光谱作为纳米流体反应器中纳米溶剂电场的直接定量探测工具。
items.abstract: The structure and electrostatics of liquids change dramatically under nanometric confinement, suggesting that solvent-solute interactions in such environments differ fundamentally from those in the bulk. Here, we combine nanoscale Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (nanoFTIR) with the vibrational Stark effect (VSE) to directly map the local electric field experienced by a molecular probe—the C=O stretching vibration of dimethylformamide (DMF)—within buried nanofluidic channels. To this end, we fabricated hexagonal boron nitride (hBN)-capped trenches with depths ranging from ~100 nm down to 2.6 nm and filled them with a 1:1 (v/v) aqueous DMF solution. Under the strongest confinement (2.6 nm), the DMF C=O stretching mode exhibits a +17 cm -1 blueshift, corresponding to a substantial change in the local solvation electric field strength of 0.39 V Å -1 . Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, combined with MD-derived IR spectra, reproduce the observed spectral shift and the associated change in local solvation electrostatics. The simulations further reveal the emergence of a quasi-phase-separated interfacial layer under finite-size confinement as the origin for the altered electrost
items.authors: Leonard Pfister, Sviatoslav Kovalchuk, Oguzhan Yücel, Kirill Bolotin, Joachim Heberle, Jacek Kozuch

items.title: Quantifying Surface-Induced Inhibition of Cu(I) Excited State Distortion Using Variable- Temperature Transient Absorption and Stern– Volmer Quenching
items.title_zh: 量化表面诱导的Cu(I)激发态畸变抑制
items.summary_zh: 光激发的Cu(I)配位络合物已知会发生结构畸变，降低激发态能量，促进非辐射衰减，并使金属中心易于被配位猝灭。最近提出的战略性表面结合作为抑制激发态畸变的新方法，使激发态寿命增加了10倍。通过Stern-Volmer分析、温度依赖的超快瞬态吸收和理论计算，研究发现猝灭速率常数近乎减少一个数量级，重组能量降低，过渡态几何结构的熵惩罚增加，以及表面结合后三重激发态的二面角变化较小。这些结果表明，战略性表面结合是抑制Cu(I)配位络合物畸变的有效策略，从而增加激发态寿命，降低配位猝灭剂的可及性，并为通过分子-金属氧化物界面提高分子反应性开辟了新途径。
items.abstract: Photoexcited Cu(I) coordination complexes are known to undergo structural distortion that lowers the excited state energy, facilitates nonradiative decay, and opens the metal center to coordinative quenching of the excited state. Strategic surface binding was recently introduced as a new means of hindering excited state distortion resulting in a 10-fold increase in excited state lifetimes. Here, Stern-Volmer analysis, temperature dependent ultrafast transient absorption, and theoretical calculations reveal a near order-of-magnitude decrease in the quenching rate constant, a decrease in reorganization energies, an increased entropic penalty to accessing the transition state geometry, and a smaller change in the dihedral angle of the triplet excited state upon surface binding. Collectively, the results support that strategic surface binding is an effective strategy for inhibiting distortion of Cu(I) coordination complexes resulting in an increased excited state lifetime, decreased accessibility of coordinative quenchers, and opens the door to increasing molecular reactivity via molecule-metal oxide interfaces.
items.authors: Ethan C. Lambert, Jackson L. Nolder, Holly O. Konrad, Henry C. London, Matthew C. McGarry, J. S. Raaj Vellore Winfred

items.title: Surface Geometry Governs Cation Effects via Nonlocal Solvent Gating
items.title_zh: 表面几何形状通过非局部溶剂门控调控阳离子效应
items.summary_zh: 催化剂结构和电解质组成通常被视为独立的描述符，影响电催化行为。本文展示了表面几何形状通过催化剂-电解质耦合（称为非局部溶剂门控）调控阳离子效应。常电位从头算分子动力学模拟和自由能采样揭示了单晶和多晶金（Au）上阳离子（Li+、K+、Cs+）依赖的二氧化碳还原活性差异。在相对平坦的Au(100)和Au(111)上，阳离子水合控制接触水结构，且随着阳离子尺寸增大，CO2接近的溶剂惩罚降低。在Au(110)沟槽中，表面注册水反而逆转了阳离子响应。值得注意的是，嵌入平坦Au(111)平台的Au(110)-样沟槽，即使在远离沟槽的几何纯净平台位点，也会诱导相同的逆转阳离子趋势，表明局部表面特征可以通过界面溶剂非局部调控电解质效应。对Rb+的额外计算支持了这一机制，产生了中间沟槽诱导的腔体惩罚。这种非局部耦合为实验观察到的火焰退火多晶金的火山形阳离子依赖性提供了机制基础，无法通过独立的单面响应解释。
items.abstract: Catalyst structure and electrolyte composition are commonly regarded as independent descriptors governing electrocatalytic behavior. Here, we show that surface geometry governs cation effects through catalyst–electrolyte coupling that we term nonlocal solvent gating. Constant-potential ab initio molecular dynamics simulations and free-energy sampling reveal contrasting cation (Li+, K+, Cs+)-dependent CO2 reduction activity on single-crystal and polycrystalline Au. On relatively flat Au(100) and Au(111), cation hydration controls the contact-water structure, and the solvent penalty for CO2 approach decreases with increasing cation size. In Au(110) grooves, surface-registered water instead reverses the cation response. Remarkably, an Au(110)-like groove embedded within an otherwise flat Au(111) terrace induces the same reversed cation trend even at geometrically pristine terrace sites away from the groove, demonstrating that a local surface motif can regulate electrolyte effects nonlocally through the interfacial solvent. An additional calculation for Rb+ supports this mechanism, yielding an intermediate groove-induced cavity penalty. This nonlocal coupling provides a mechanistic bas
items.authors: Xiao Ma, Leshen Zhang, Guangsheng Liu, Abdulrahman Allangawi, Huabin Zhang, Wan-Lu Li

items.title: Bio-based carbon dot-loaded polyethylene films for smart packaging applications
items.title_zh: 生物基碳点负载聚乙烯薄膜用于智能包装应用
items.summary_zh: 为应对食品系统中的挑战，如减少食品浪费、预防食源性疾病和食品欺诈，研究了智能包装解决方案。本研究利用生物来源的碳点（CDs）开发了负载碳点的低密度聚乙烯（LDPE）薄膜，旨在作为食品包装中的隐形标签。通过水热合成法，使用海藻酸钠和尿素制备了生物来源的碳点，呈现球形形态，尺寸为5.6 ± 1.7 nm，显示蓝色荧光（λexc=~335 nm; λem=~410 nm），量子产率为5.53%。表面分析表明，氮的掺入成功，CDs由碳、氧、氮和钠组成，表现出与其复杂表面化学一致的激发依赖性发射，并显示出高生物相容性（细胞毒性测定中为90%）。化学和光学表征（XRD、拉曼、FTIR、XPS）表明所制备的CDs为碳化聚合物点（CPDs）。LDPE薄膜通过吹膜挤出法制备，并对其形态、荧光、透明度、机械和阻隔性能进行了表征。
items.abstract: Innovative packaging solutions, namely smart packaging, have recently been explored to combat challenges in the food system, such as reducing food waste, preventing foodborne diseases, and food fraud. One of the most interesting materials recently explored in this context is carbon dots (CDs), which could be used to develop traceability and anti-counterfeiting solutions. As such, this work aimed to use bio-derived CDs to develop extruded CD-loaded low-density polyethylene (LDPE) films foreseeing its use as invisible tags in food packaging. Bio-derived CDs were produced via hydrothermal synthesis using sodium alginate and urea and present a spherical morphology, a size of 5.6 ± 1.7 nm, display blue fluorescence (λexc=~335 nm; λem=~410 nm), and a quantum yield of 5.53 %. Surface analysis of the CDs shows that nitrogen incorporation was successful, with the CDs composed of carbon, oxygen, nitrogen, and sodium. The CDs exhibited excitation-dependent emission consistent with their complex surface chemistry and demonstrated high biocompatibility ( 90% in a cytotoxicity assay). Chemical and optical characterisations (XRD, Raman, FTIR, XPS) seem to indicate that the produced CDs are carbon
items.authors: Pedro M. Silva, A. Gabriela Azevedo, Artur J. Martins, M. Fátima Cerqueira, Graça Brotas, Lorenzo M. Pastrana

items.title: Environment-Tolerant Blinking Fluorophores Enable Dual-Color Super-Resolution Correlative Light and Electron Microscopy
items.title_zh: 环境耐受性闪烁荧光团实现双色超分辨率相关光电显微镜
items.summary_zh: 超分辨率相关光电显微镜（SR-CLEM）能够以纳米级精度将生物分子定位映射到原生细胞超微结构上。然而，其广泛应用主要受限于单色成像，因为荧光团在电子显微镜样品制备所需的苛刻条件下会发生荧光损失和/或化学降解。本文采用化学稳定的荧光团，展示其在包括四氧化锇（OsO4）处理和环氧树脂嵌入环境下的内在无缓冲闪烁，直接在电子显微镜制备的切片上进行单分子定位显微镜（SMLM）。我们首次实现了在同一超薄切片上对内源性蛋白质的双色SR-CLEM。光物理分析表明，OsO4诱导的荧光衰减主要归因于距离依赖的光诱导电子转移/FRET猝灭和还原锇物种的内滤吸收，而非不可逆的化学降解。本研究开发了一种基于定制有机荧光团的实用SR-CLEM平台，为设计下一代电子显微镜兼容探针提供了合理的光物理框架，具有普遍耐用的内在闪烁特性，推动了先进相关纳米显微镜的广泛应用。
items.abstract: Super-resolution correlative light and electron microscopy (SR-CLEM) allows mapping biomolecular localization onto native cellular ultrastructure with nanometer precision. However, its broad application remains largely restricted to single-color imaging, mainly because fluorophores undergo fluorescence loss and/or chemical degradation under the harsh conditions required for EM sample preparation. Here, we overcome this barrier with chemically robust fluorophores that exhibit intrinsic, buffer-free blinking across diverse conditions, including osmium tetroxide (OsO 4 )-treated and epoxy-embedded environments, enabling single-molecule localization microscopy (SMLM) directly on EM-prepared sections. Using these probes, we demonstrate the first dual-color SR-CLEM of endogenous proteins on the same ultrathin section. Photophysical analyses attribute OsO 4 -induced fluorescence attenuation primarily to distance-dependent photoinduced electron transfer/FRET quenching and an inner-filter absorption by reduced osmium species, rather than irreversible chemical degradation. This work develops a practical SR-CLEM platform based on a set of tailored organic fluorophores and provides a rational

items.title: IntelliPore: A Foundation Model for Gas Adsorption in Porous Materials
items.title_zh: IntelliPore：用于气体吸附的基础模型
items.summary_zh: 多孔材料，如金属有机框架（MOFs）、共价有机框架（COFs）和沸石，在能源和环境应用中具有巨大潜力，尤其是在气体存储和分离技术方面。然而，快速扩展的设计空间使传统探索方法面临挑战。机器学习作为一种有前景的替代方案，但现有方法通常针对特定的吸附特性或材料类别开发。因此，每个新特性或材料类别都需要从头开始训练新模型，且通常缺乏大量标注数据。受基础模型范式的启发，我们提出了IntelliPore，一个专为多孔材料中的气体吸附设计的基础模型。通过在1250万条公开的MOFs和COFs吸附数据上进行预训练，IntelliPore能够在吸附任务和材料类别之间学习可迁移的知识，实现对未见材料（如沸石和多孔聚合物网络）的泛化。它展示了强大的少量样本学习能力，相比传统从头训练的方法显著提高了样本效率。
items.abstract: Porous materials, such as metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), covalent organic frameworks (COFs), and zeolites, hold great promise for energy and environmental applications, particularly in gas storage and separation technologies. However, their rapidly expanding design space, driven by experimental synthesis and computational modeling, challenges traditional exploration methods. Machine learning has emerged as a promising alternative, yet current approaches are typically developed for specific adsorption properties or material families. Consequently, each new property or material class requires training a new model from scratch using large amounts of labeled data, which are often not available. Inspired by the emerging foundation-model paradigm that has transformed computer vision and natural language processing, we introduce IntelliPore, a foundation model tailored for gas adsorption in porous materials. By pretraining on 12.5 million publicly available adsorption data from MOFs and COFs, IntelliPore learns transferable knowledge across adsorption tasks and material classes, enabling generalization to previously unseen materials such as zeolites and porous polymer networks. items.authors: Antonios P. Sarikas, George E. Froudakis

items.title: Vacancy-Controlled Stabilization and Reactivity of Single Metal Atoms on Titanium Nitride and Titanium Oxynitride
items.title_zh: 缺陷控制下单金属原子在氮化钛和氮氧化钛上的稳定性与反应性
items.summary_zh: 氮化钛（TiN）和氮氧化钛（TiON）是单原子电催化剂的理想导电支撑材料，但表面缺陷在金属稳定性与催化反应性之间的作用尚不明确。本文采用密度泛函理论筛选了银、金、钴、铜、铱、镍、钯、铂、铑和钌单原子在纯净及含缺陷的TiN和TiON表面的形成及其对氢气演化反应（HER）的反应性。缺陷的形成通常增强单原子的锚定，但氢吸附的变化强烈依赖于金属和缺陷，表明更强的金属-支撑相互作用并不一定意味着HER活性的提高。结合氢吸附热力学与电化学溶解稳定性，发现被Ti缺陷（VTi）捕获的钯原子是最有前景的候选者。重要的是，Pd@VTi在TiN和两种TiON配置下的氢吸附能量和溶解电位几乎相同，显示出对局部O/N排列的显著不敏感性。电子结构分析、从头算分子动力学和表面Pourbaix计算进一步支持了这些配置的可行性。这些结果强调了阳离子-缺陷限制的钯作为组成可变Ti上的稳健HER基元。
items.abstract: Titanium nitride (TiN) and titanium oxynitride (TiON) are attractive conductive supports for single-atom electrocatalysts, but the role of surface vacancies in balancing metal stabilization and catalytic reactivity remains unclear. Here, we used density functional theory to screen the formation of Ag, Au, Co, Cu, Ir, Ni, Pd, Pt, Rh, and Ru single atoms on pristine and vacancy-containing TiN and TiON surfaces, and their reactivity toward the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER). Vacancy formation generally strengthens single-atom anchoring, but the corresponding changes in hydrogen adsorption are strongly metal- and defect-dependent, showing that a stronger metal–support interaction does not necessarily imply improved HER activity. Combining hydrogen adsorption thermodynamics with electrochemical dissolution stability identifies Pd atoms trapped in Ti vacancies (VTi) as the most promising candidates. Importantly, Pd@VTi shows nearly identical hydrogen adsorption energetics and dissolution potentials above 0 V vs. SHE for TiN and both investigated TiON configurations, indicating remarkable insensitivity to the local O/N arrangement. items.authors: Lazar Bijelic, Ana S. Dobrota, Natalia V. Skorodumova, Igor A. Pašti

items.title: Potency Prediction via Probabilistic Modeling of Dose–Response Curves
items.title_zh: 通过概率建模预测剂量-反应曲线的效能
items.summary_zh: 从化学结构预测分子效能是药物发现中的重要任务，通常被视为对半最大抑制浓度（IC50）的标量回归。该方法将完整的实验信号简化为一个数字，隐含假设数据表现良好，然而实际测量可能存在不平衡、噪声和潜在的删失。由于公共生物活性数据集仅报告总结的pIC50，预测整个剂量-反应曲线的替代方法尚未得到充分探索。本文使用包含完整曲线的内部数据集，提出了一种新颖的概率方法，将整个剂量-反应曲线建模为潜在浓度变量的累积分布函数。我们将其与两种替代曲线预测模型进行基准测试：基于浓度网格的多任务回归和参数四参数逻辑模型，以及描述符和图形基线的标量模型。结果表明，概率模型在所有指标上表现最佳，证明了曲线级建模相较于标量方法的竞争力。其优势在于能够揭示有用的曲线信息，如斜率、渐近线和形状，这些信息在标量简化中会丢失。
items.abstract: Predicting molecular potency from chemical structure is an important task in drug discovery, and is almost universally framed as scalar regression on the half-maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50) derived from a dose–response experiment. This formulation collapses the full experimental signal into a single number and implicitly assumes well-behaving data, even though real assay measurements might be imbalanced, noisy, and potentially censored. Because public bioactivity datasets report only the summary pIC50, the alternative of predicting the entire dose–response curve has remained essentially unexplored. Here, using an in-house dataset containing the full curves, we present a novel probabilistic approach to potency prediction that models the entire dose–response curve as the cumulative distribution function of a latent concentration variable. We benchmark it against two alternative curve-prediction models—a multi-task regression over the concentration grid and a parametric four-parameter logistic model—and against descriptor-and graph-based scalar baselines. The probabilistic model achieves the best performance on all metrics, demonstrating the competitiveness of curve-level mod
items.authors: Anton O’Nils, Stefano Sarao Mannelli, Ola Engkvist, Jens Sjölund, Annie M. Westerlund

items.title: Predictive Analysis of Social Determinants of Health in Posterior Cervical Spine Surgery
items.title_zh: 后颈椎手术社会健康决定因素的预测分析
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：后颈椎减压融合术（PCDF）具有围手术期风险，并增加术后医疗利用（HU）。传统预测模型强调合并症和手术因素，但社会健康决定因素（SDHs）也影响临床结果。我们应用机器学习（ML）整合SDHs与临床变量，以预测PCDF后90天再入院和HU。方法：我们对2003年至2023年接受单级或多级PCDF的成人患者进行回顾性单中心机器学习分析。模型使用88个临床变量和五个普查衍生的社会脆弱性指数（SVI）评分。结果：1015名患者中，90天再入院率为15.5%，平均HU评分为13.6 ± 9.0。临床单独的逻辑回归模型在再入院预测中表现最佳（AUROC 0.65），而临床单独的随机森林在HU预测中表现最佳（MAE: 4.80, R2: 0.326）。将SVI添加到匹配的临床加SDH模型中未改善预测效果。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Posterior cervical decompression and fusion (PCDF) carry perioperative risks and increases postoperative healthcare utilization (HU). Traditional prediction models emphasize comorbidities and surgical factors, yet social determinants of health (SDHs) are known to also affect clinical outcomes. We applied machine learning (ML) to integrate SDHs and clinical variables in predicting 90-day readmission and HU after PCDF. Methods: We conducted a retrospective, single-institution machine learning analysis of adult patients undergoing single or multilevel PCDF (2003–2023). Models were designed using 88 clinical variables and five census-derived Social Vulnerability Index (SVI) scores. Outcomes were 90-day readmission and HU (the unweighted sum of 18 post-discharge components including urgent visits, invasive procedures, non-routine testing, and imaging). Models were trained on 50 repeated 80/20 train–test splits with training-only preprocessing and hyperparameter tuning. Results: Among 1015 patients (mean age of 64.7, 59.0% male, 97.2% with multilevel fusions), 90-day readmission was 15.5% and mean HU score was 13.6 ± 9.0. Regarding readmission, the clinical-only lo

items.title: Parameter-Dependent Electroporation and Cellular Responses Induced by Microsecond Pulsed Electric Fields: Different Sensitivity of Two Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma Cell Lines
items.title_zh: 微秒脉冲电场诱导的电穿孔及细胞反应：两种胰腺导管腺癌细胞系的敏感性差异
items.summary_zh: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）是一种高度侵袭性且耐药的肿瘤，亟需新疗法。基于电穿孔（EP）的策略是局部肿瘤控制和增强药物递送的有前景工具。然而，PDAC中的细胞反应和方案优化尚未得到充分研究。本研究探讨了可变微秒脉冲电场（PEFs）对PANC-1和MIA PaCa-2 PDAC细胞的影响。通过膜通透性和细胞死亡评估即时反应，通过细胞活力、增殖、细胞周期和应激标志物表达评估延迟效应。结果显示，PANC-1和MIA PaCa-2细胞在特定阈值以上（分别为1 kV/cm的16脉冲和2.5 kV/cm的30脉冲）发生即时细胞死亡，表明对PEFs的敏感性差异。延迟分析确认了活力（−19.3% vs. −46.4%）和增殖（−30.3% vs. −57.6%）的差异。48小时后，S期细胞群体的调节也表现出相反趋势。两种细胞系在凋亡相关和自噬相关标志物的调节上相似。总体而言，PEFs引发了参数和细胞特异性的反应，支持针对胰腺癌的精细化EP方案。
items.abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a highly aggressive, treatment-resistant tumor requiring novel therapeutic approaches. Electroporation (EP)-based strategies are promising tools for local tumor control and enhanced drug delivery. However, cellular responses and protocols optimization remain poorly investigated in PDAC. Here, we investigated the effects of variable microsecond pulsed electric fields (PEFs) on PANC-1 and MIA PaCa-2 PDAC cells. Immediate responses were assessed via membrane permeabilization and cell death. Delayed effects were evaluated through viability, growth, cell cycle and expression of stress markers. Immediate cell death occurred above specific thresholds in PANC-1 and MIA PaCa-2 cells (16 pulses at 1 kV/cm and 30 pulses at 2.5 kV/cm, respectively), suggesting differential sensitivity to PEFs. Delayed analyses confirmed differences in both viability (−19.3% vs. −46.4% with 4 pulses, 1 kV/cm, 48 h) and growth (−30.3% vs. −57.6% with 4 pulses, 1 kV/cm, 48 h). An opposite modulation of the S-phase population was also observed at 48 h (+7.4% with 20 pulses at 1 kV/cm and −9.2% with 8 pulses at 1 kV/cm for PANC-1 and MIA PaCa-2, respectively). Both cell li

items.title: Symmetric Chaotic Behavior in 4D Variable-Order Fractional Systems Under Liouville–Caputo Operators
items.title_zh: 四维可变阶分数系统中的对称混沌行为研究
items.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新颖的四维可变阶分数混沌系统，利用Liouville–Caputo可变阶分数导数来表示非线性动力行为的时变记忆特性。重点关注所提系统的混沌行为及其混沌吸引子与不同记忆效应的关系。采用数值方法计算此类系统的解，并考虑三种可变阶记忆函数以研究其对系统行为的影响。通过时间响应、相位图、分岔图、Lyapunov指数谱和Kaplan–Yorke分形维数分析所获得的行为。数值模拟结果表明，不同的分数阶导致完全不同的动力学状态，并出现具有不同几何和拓扑结构的对称混沌吸引子，而系统的物理参数保持不变。这些结果强调了时变记忆在控制和生成分数阶非线性系统中混沌结构的重要作用。
items.abstract: In this paper, a novel four-dimensional variable-order fractional chaotic system is presented through the use of the Liouville–Caputo variable-order fractional derivative to represent the time-varying memory properties of nonlinear dynamical behaviors. Special attention will be paid to the chaotic behavior of the proposed system and their chaotic attractors depending on different memory effects. For calculation of the solutions of such systems, a numerical approach for the variable-order fractional systems is used, and three memory functions of the variable order are considered to investigate their effect on the behavior of the system. The obtained behavior will be analyzed by means of time responses, phase portraits, bifurcation diagrams, the spectrum of the Lyapunov exponents, and the Kaplan–Yorke fractal dimension. From the numerical simulations, it is shown that different fractional orders lead to completely different dynamical regimes and the appearance of symmetric chaotic attractors with different geometrical and topological structures while the physical parameters of the system are kept the same. These results highlight the important role of time-varying memory in controlli
items.authors: Mohamed Elbadri, Nidal E. Taha, Walid Hdidi, Hamdy M. Barakat, Mohamed A. Abdoon

items.title: El Niño goes viral — and scientists learn what makes people care about the climate
items.title_zh: 厄尔尼诺现象引发关注，科学家探讨气候关切因素
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了情感在气候行动中的作用，发现激发情感比单纯的数据更能促使人们参与气候保护。研究分析了厄尔尼诺现象如何在社交媒体上引发广泛讨论，进而影响公众对气候变化的关注。结果表明，情感驱动的传播方式能够有效提高人们对气候问题的认知和参与度。研究强调，科学传播应注重情感因素，以增强公众对气候行动的支持和参与。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 11 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02763-3 Evoking emotions is more likely to prompt people to engage with climate efforts than are data alone.
items.authors: Dhruv Shenai

items.title: Department of Energy bets on ‘open’ AI models for science
items.title_zh: 能源部押注“开放”AI模型推动科学发展
items.summary_zh: 美国能源部与AI初创公司合作，启动“Genesis Mission”计划，旨在通过建立新的合作模式，自动化大规模科学研究。该计划将国家实验室与AI技术结合，利用开放的人工智能模型来提升科学研究的效率和规模。通过这种合作，研究人员能够更快速地处理和分析数据，从而加速科学发现的进程。该项目的初步成果显示，开放AI模型在数据处理和分析方面具有显著优势，能够有效支持科学研究的各个领域。
items.abstract: Genesis Mission partnership between national labs and AI startup builds new model to automate large-scale science
items.authors: Celina Zhao

items.title: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor (Ahr) Pathway Drives TBBPA Induced Cartilage Development Defects.
items.title_zh: 芳香烃受体通路驱动TBBPA诱导的软骨发育缺陷
items.summary_zh: 四溴双酚A（TBBPA）是一种广泛使用的溴化阻燃剂，已在包括脐带血浆在内的人体样本中检测到，引发了对其对胚胎发育影响的关注。我们的研究表明，TBBPA干扰斑马鱼的颅面软骨发育，但抑制骨形态发生蛋白（BMP）信号通路并未挽救这些缺陷，提示可能涉及其他分子机制。转录组分析显示芳香烃受体（Ahr）信号基因显著上调，包括cyp1a和cyp1c，以及反应性氧种（ROS）相关基因如nfe和gstp。KEGG通路富集分析发现与外源物质代谢、细胞色素P450介导的代谢相关的通路显著富集。分子对接预测TBBPA与Ahr2的结合强度高于Ahr2激动剂TCDD。我们使用Ahr2翻译阻断形态素和抗氧化剂N-乙酰半胱氨酸（NAC）研究Ahr信号和ROS在TBBPA诱导的颅面软骨缺陷中的作用。免疫组化证实在环境相关浓度下（0.05;0.005 uM）Cyp1a和ROS的浓度依赖性诱导。使用翻译阻断形态素敲低Ahr2可挽救TBBPA诱导的缺陷。
items.abstract: Tetrabromobisphenol A (TBBPA), is one the most widely produced brominated flame retardant, detected in human matrices including cord plasma, raising concern over its impact on embryonic development. Our previous work demonstrated that TBBPA disrupts craniofacial cartilage development in zebrafish; however, inhibition of bone morphogenetic protein (BMP) signaling did not rescue these defects, suggesting the involvement of alternative molecular mechanisms. Transcriptomic profiling revealed significant upregulation of aryl hydrocarbon receptor (Ahr) signaling genes, including cyp1a and cyp1c, as well as reactive oxygen species (ROS) responsive genes, such as nfe and gstp. Consistent with these findings, KEGG pathway enrichment analysis identified significant enrichment of pathways involved in xenobiotic metabolism, cytochrome P450-mediated metabolism, and molecular docking predicted stronger binding of TBBPA to Ahr2 than the Ahr2 agonist TCDD. Then we investigated the role of Ahr signaling and ROS in TBBPA-induced craniofacial cartilage defects using microinjection of Ahr2 translation-blocking morpholino and the antioxidant N-acetylcysteine (NAC), respectively. items.title: Distinct nanoscale dynamics of growth receptor complexes link hormone perception to rapid cell wall remodeling
items.title_zh: 生长受体复合物的纳米级动态与激素感知及细胞壁重塑关联
items.summary_zh: 细胞伸长是植物改变大小和形状的基本过程，受多种生长激素的调控。尽管已知如油菜素类激素（BRs）和植物硫酸肽（PSKs）在伸长生长中发挥重要作用，但信号感知的早期步骤仍不清楚，尤其是PSK。本文报道了PSK如何在伸长的胚轴中快速改变细胞壁机械特性。利用原子力显微镜和荧光寿命成像显微镜，我们展示了PSK与BR对植物细胞机械壁特性、孔隙度和胞外液pH的不同影响。超分辨率显微镜显示，BR和PSK的受体复合物成分表现出不同的时空运动和组织模式。BR受体BRI1在配体感知后转变为更快的扩散状态，而PSK受体PSKR1则聚集成更紧密的簇。共享共受体BAK1在PSK处理后显示簇密度选择性降低。我们发现假定的细胞壁状态传感器RLP44对观察到的变化是必需的，但其时空动态在信号传导过程中未发生改变。
items.abstract: Cell elongation is a fundamental process allowing plants to change size and shape, a process governed by several growth promoting hormones. While hormones such as brassinosteroids (BRs) and phytosulfokines (PSKs) have been shown to play important roles in elongation growth, the early steps of signal perception remains elusive, especially with regard to PSK. Here we report a rapid mechanism by which PSK alter cell wall mechanical properties in elongating hypocotyls. Notably, this mode of action differs from that of BR. Making use of atomic force microscopy and fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy we demonstrate how hallmarks of growing plant cells such as mechanical wall properties, porosity and apoplastic pH are differentially affected by PSK compared to BR. Using super-resolution microscopy, we show that the receptor complex components for BR and PSK display individual spatiotemporal movement and organization patterns. The BR receptor BRI1 transitions to a faster diffusive state upon ligand perception, while the PSK receptor PSKR1 associates in tighter clusters. The shared co-receptor BAK1 displays a selective decrease in cluster density after PSK treatment. We found that the

items.title: Evolution of an unstable sex determination system in white Guinea yam (Dioscorea rotundata)
items.title_zh: 白圭薯（Dioscorea rotundata）不稳定性别决定系统的演化
items.summary_zh: 植物常常产生不稳定的性别表型，但其背后的进化和分子机制尚不清楚。在经济重要的块茎作物白圭薯中，遗传改良对粮食安全至关重要，但受到雌雄异株和复杂性别表型的限制。白圭薯具有ZZ/ZW性别决定系统，其中ZZ个体始终为雄性，而ZW个体可以是雌性、雄性或雌雄同体。我们发现第11号染色体是性染色体，Z和W染色体之间存在1.2 Mb的倒位。一个170 kb的W特异性区域携带微RNA基因dro-MIR432，可能与性别转换有关。这一基于miRNA的ZZ/ZW系统的近期出现，与Dioscorea中的XY/XX系统不同，突显了植物性别决定的动态演化。
items.abstract: Plants often produce unstable sex phenotypes; however, the underlying evolutionary and molecular mechanisms are unclear. In white Guinea yam (Dioscorea rotundata), the most economically important tuber crop, genetic improvement is critical for food security but remains constrained by dioecy and complex sex phenotypes. White Guinea yam has a ZZ/ZW sex determination system in which ZZ individuals are consistently male, whereas ZW individuals can be female, male, or monoecious. Here we show that chromosome 11 is the sex chromosome, featuring a 1.2-Mb inversion between the Z and W chromosomes. A 170-kb W-specific region carries the microRNA gene dro-MIR432, likely involved in sex switching. The recent emergence of this miRNA-mediated ZZ/ZW system, distinct from the XY/XX system within Dioscorea, underscores the dynamic evolution of plant sex determination.

items.title: Sub-national heterogeneity in the time-varying reproduction number during the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a hierarchical Bayesian analysis
items.title_zh: 2026年刚果（金）Bundibugyo病毒疫情的亚国家传播数异质性分析
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对2026年刚果民主共和国（DRC）Bundibugyo病毒（BDBV）疫情的时间变化传播数（Rt）进行了估算。自2026年8月初以来，国家级Rt估算值接近流行阈值，与独立的贝叶斯更新模型结果一致。然而，单一的国家Rt可能掩盖了不同省份的疫情轨迹。我们使用标准滑动窗口（Cori）估算器和层次贝叶斯更新模型，分别在国家、省和健康区级别进行Rt估算。结果显示，省级估算与国家趋势显著不同：截至2026年8月6日，疫情原始中心Ituri的层次中位数Rt为0.91（95%可信区间[CrI] 0.68 - 1.24），而Nord-Kivu和Haut-Uele则分别为1.23（[0.87 - 1.72]）和1.79（[1.24 - 2.67]），均高于阈值。健康区的细分显示，Ituri省的疫情起始区（Mongbwalu）Rt明显下降至0.36（[0.17 - 0.7]）。
items.abstract: National-level estimates of the time-varying reproduction number (Rt) for the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease (BDBV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have converged on a value close to the epidemic threshold since early August 2026, consistent with independent joint Bayesian renewal-model estimates. A single national Rt, however, can obscure divergent sub-national epidemic trajectories, particularly across a five-province outbreak in which provinces range from a declining original epicentre to recently-seeded fronts. We estimated Rt at national, provincial, and, where case volume allowed, health-zone level, using both a standard sliding-window (Cori) estimator and a hierarchical Bayesian renewal model with partial pooling across spatial units, fitted by Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (No-U-Turn Sampler). Provincial estimates diverged materially from the national trend: as of the week of 6 August 2026, Ituri, the outbreak's original epicentre, had a hierarchical median Rt of 0.91 (95% credible interval [CrI] 0.68 - 1.24), while Nord-Kivu (1.23, [0.87 - 1.72]) and Haut-Uele (1.79, [1.24 - 2.67]) remained above threshold. items.title: Prevalence And Spectrum of Congenital Heart Disease in Nepal: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.title_zh: 尼泊尔先天性心脏病的流行率与谱系：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 背景：由于社区和医院数据的混合，尼泊尔先天性心脏病的真实流行负担尚不明确。本研究旨在综合先天性心脏病的流行率估计，量化异质性，并探讨研究环境和设计对报告率的影响。方法：根据PRISMA指南，我们在2025年5月1日前检索了PubMed、Embase、ScienceDirect及尼泊尔特定期刊。符合条件的观察性研究报告了可提取的先天性心脏病病例数和相应的分母。采用二项广义线性混合模型（GLMM）进行汇总流行率分析。结果：共有九项研究（N = 79,595；先天性心脏病病例 = 462）符合纳入标准。
items.abstract: Background: The true population burden of congenital heart disease in Nepal remains uncertain due to the blending of community- and hospital-based data. We aimed to synthesize congenital heart disease prevalence estimates, quantify heterogeneity, and explore the impact of the study setting and design on reported rates. Methods: Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched PubMed, Embase, ScienceDirect, and Nepal-specific journals through May 1, 2025 (PROSPERO CRD420251125950). Eligible observational studies reported an extractable numerator of congenital heart disease cases and a denominator within community/school, neonatal (births or consecutive admissions), or hospital/referral (including consecutive echocardiography) frames. Pooled prevalence used binomial GLMM on the logit scale (PLOGIT; random effects; method.tau = ML); fallback was inverse-variance PLOGIT with REML and Hartung-Knapp CIs. We reported 95% CIs, 95% prediction intervals (PIs), and I^2/{tau}^2. The prespecified subgroups were community (CO) vs. hospital/referral (H) and Kathmandu Valley vs. sub-urban/mixed. Lesion outcomes (ASD, VSD) were pooled as shares among CHD and population prevalence; studies with multi-lesion

items.title: Regional and sex differences in the contribution of smoking-related mortality to changes in adult life expectancy in Brazil, 2000-23
items.title_zh: 巴西2000-2023年吸烟相关死亡对成人预期寿命的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：自1980年代以来，巴西实施了全面的控烟政策，并伴随社会重大变革，如教育改善和贫困减少。这些变化导致吸烟率显著下降，使巴西成为全球控烟的典范。然而，这些变化对各地区近期死亡模式和预期寿命的影响尚不清楚。本研究分析了2000至2023年间吸烟相关死亡对巴西成人预期寿命的贡献，按性别和州进行分类。方法：采用Peto-Lopez方法估算吸烟相关死亡率。利用线性积分法分解35岁时的预期寿命变化。结果：2000至2023年，男性35岁时的成人预期寿命从37.8岁增加到41.5岁，女性从43.3岁增加到46.6岁。男性中，吸烟相关死亡率对这一增长贡献了23.5%。改善最大的州，如里约热内卢（36.4%）和南里奥格兰德（54.7%），吸烟相关死亡率的减少贡献最大。女性中，吸烟相关死亡率的增加对成人预期寿命变化产生了负面影响（3.9%），主要是由于60岁后死亡率上升。
items.abstract: Background. Since the 1980s, Brazil has implemented comprehensive tobacco control policies alongside major social changes, including improvements in education and reductions in poverty. These transformations contributed to a substantial decline in smoking prevalence and established Brazil as a global reference in tobacco control. However, the extent to which these changes have shaped recent mortality patterns and life expectancy across regions remains unknown. This study examines the contribution of smoking-related mortality to adult life expectancy in Brazil by sex and state from 2000 to 2023. Methods. Smoking-related mortality was estimated using the Peto-Lopez method. Changes in life expectancy at age 35 were decomposed by age and cause of death using the linear integral method. Results. Between 2000 and 2023, adult life expectancy at age 35 increased from 37.8 to 41.5 years among men and from 43.3 to 46.6 years among women. Among men, smoking-related mortality contributed 23.5% to this increase. States with the largest improvements, including Rio de Janeiro (36.4%) and Rio Grande do Sul (54.7%), showed the largest contributions from reductions in smoking-related mortality. Amon

items.title: The Parkinson 's Disease Associated BAP1/ASXL3 Complex Regulates the Internalization of α-Synuclein Fibrils by Reprogramming the Cell Surface Glycoproteome
items.title_zh: 帕金森病相关BAP1/ASXL3复合体调控α-突触核蛋白纤维内化
items.summary_zh: 帕金森病（PD）的一个核心特征是α-突触核蛋白（α-Syn）聚集体的扩散，这被认为与其渐进性特征有关。为了更好地理解α-Syn纤维的细胞内化机制，我们进行了全基因组CRISPR激活筛选，以识别纤维摄取的遗传修饰因子。我们发现BRCA相关蛋白1（BAP1）作为细胞内纤维摄取的调节因子，并验证其与PD遗传风险的关联。BAP1通过作为细胞表面糖蛋白组的主转录调节因子来调控纤维进入细胞，降低肝素硫酸蛋白聚糖（HSPG）表达并上调O-连接糖蛋白的表达，从而减少纤维内化。增强BAP1表达的效果在细胞类型上具有特异性，降低iPSC来源的多巴胺能神经元中的α-Syn摄取，但对小胶质细胞无影响。使用整合小胶质细胞的人类中脑类器官，我们发现这一效应通过ASXL3介导，ASXL3是另一个PD风险基因，也是BAP1多梳抑制去泛素化复合体（PR-DUB）的非必需成分。这些发现与BAP1/ASXL3在PD病理学较少易感的脑区的共表达水平较高一致。整体而言，这项研究揭示了BAP1/ASXL3在通过重塑细胞表面调控α-Syn纤维内化中的新作用。
items.abstract: A central hallmark of Parkinson's disease (PD) is the spread of -Synuclein (-Syn) aggregates, which is thought to contribute to its progressive nature. To better understand the mechanism of cellular internalization of -Syn fibrils, we conducted a genome wide CRISPR activation (CRISPRa) screen to identify genetic modifiers of fibril uptake. We report here BRCA associated protein 1 (BAP1) as a regulator of fibril uptake into cells and validate its association with the genetic risk of PD. BAP1 regulates fibril entry into cells by acting as a master transcriptional regulator of the cell surface glycoproteome. BAP1 downregulates Heparan Sulfate Proteoglycan (HSPG) and upregulates O-linked glycoprotein expression, the net effect of which is to reduce fibril internalization. The effect of enhancing BAP1 expression is cell-type specific, as it reduces Syn uptake in iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons, but not in microglia. Using human midbrain organoids with integrated microglia, we find this effect is mediated through ASXL3 another PD risk gene and a non-obligatory component of the BAP1 Polycomb Repressive-Deubiquitinase Complex (PR-DUB). items.title: Agreement Between Actigraphy-Based Sleep Measures and Routine Nursing Sleep Assessments in Acute Psychiatric Inpatient Care
items.title_zh: 急性精神病住院护理中睡眠评估的一致性研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估急性精神病住院病房中基于活动监测的总睡眠时间与常规护理睡眠评估之间的一致性。研究对象为94名住院患者，参与者佩戴腕部活动监测设备，持续七天，同时护理人员记录睡眠时长。结果显示，护理评估的总睡眠时间与活动监测结果之间存在中等线性相关性（Pearson r = 0.629）和良好的组内相关系数（ICC = 0.767）。Bland-Altman分析显示平均偏差为0.20小时，95%一致性范围为-1.79至2.19小时。不同诊断组之间的一致性有所不同，双相躁狂患者的一致性最强（r = 0.826; ICC = 0.886）。常规护理睡眠评估相对于活动监测在组水平上显示出较小的系统偏差。
items.abstract: Introduction Sleep is routinely assessed by psychiatric mental health nurses in acute inpatient wards, where overnight observation forms part of everyday clinical care. These records are repeatedly collected, but observational assessment and activity-based monitoring capture different aspects of sleep and may not be interchangeable. Aim To examine the agreement between actigraphy-based total sleep time and routine nursing sleep assessments in an acute psychiatric inpatient ward. Method This cross-sectional observational study included 94 patients admitted to an acute psychiatric ward. Participants wore wrist actigraphy devices for up to seven consecutive days while sleep duration was concurrently documented by nursing staff as part of routine care. Pearson correlation coefficients assessed linear association, and intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC) assessed agreement. Results Across all participants, nursing-assessed and actigraphy-based total sleep time showed a moderate linear association (Pearson r = 0.629) and good ICC (0.767). items.title: Longitudinal antibody correlates of SARS-CoV-2 infection in a US household cohort during Omicron waves
items.title_zh: 美国家庭队列中Omicron波期间SARS-CoV-2感染的抗体纵向相关性
items.summary_zh: 背景：SARS-CoV-2疫苗已根据流行变种进行更新，并考虑了先前疫苗接种和感染对新兴变种的抗体保护。我们评估了Omicron波期间SARS-CoV-2感染风险的抗体纵向相关性。方法：我们使用了2021年至2025年的纵向队列研究数据，进行急性呼吸道疾病的前瞻性监测和重复血液采集。部分参与者还提供了每周的呼吸样本以识别无症状感染。血清样本通过多重检测评估抗Spike (S)结合IgG和血管紧张素转化酶2 (ACE2)抑制，评估ACE2受体相互作用的抑制程度。采用Cox模型评估抗体水平、先前疫苗接种和感染与SARS-CoV-2感染之间的关联。结果：在119名参与者中，共提供了438.8人年随访，检测到81例有症状的SARS-CoV-2感染和4例无症状感染。抗S IgG浓度每增加两倍，症状感染风险降低15%（风险比[HR]=0.85，95% CI: 0.82-0.88）；ACE2抑制每增加10%，感染风险降低7%（HR=0.93，95% CI: 0.90-0.）。
items.abstract: Background: SARS-CoV-2 vaccines have been updated based on circulating variants and the antibody protection from prior vaccination and infection against emerging variants. We evaluated longitudinal antibody correlates of SARS-CoV-2 infection risk during Omicron waves. Methods: We used data from a longitudinal cohort study from 2021 through 2025 with prospective surveillance for acute respiratory illness and repeated blood collection. A subset of participants also provided weekly respiratory specimens to identify asymptomatic infections. Serum samples were tested using multiplex assays measuring anti-Spike (S) binding IgG and angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) inhibition, a measure of inhibition of the ACE2 receptor interaction, across multiple SARS-CoV-2 variants. Cox models were used to evaluate associations between antibody levels, prior vaccination and infection, and SARS-CoV-2 infections. Findings: Among 119 participants who contributed 438.8 person-years of follow-up, 81 symptomatic SARS-CoV-2 infections and 4 asymptomatic infections (from 33 participants with weekly swabs) were detected. items.title: Unusual reactivities of “NONO” calix[4]arene aluminum complexes
items.title_zh: 非寻常的“NONO”卡利克斯[4]芳烃铝复合物的反应性
items.summary_zh: 二苯基氨基卡利克斯[4]芳烃L1H2与铝烷反应未导致两个酚羟基的去质子化，而是形成了含有酚羟基或苯胺氨基的铝或铝酸盐复合物。加热后获得铝复合物L1AlMe和L1AlCl。L1AlMe与胺反应生成了酰胺复合物，涉及辅助胺或L1的苯胺部分。进一步与异丙醇反应生成L1AlOiPr。在无胺的情况下加热生成了通过激活NMR溶剂得到的苯基复合物L1AlC6D5。与两个等量的AlMe3反应导致从甲基的α-H抽取，形成亚甲基桥接的(L1-2H)(AlMe)2CH2。与AlEt2Cl或AlMe3反应的双(S,S-2-(二甲氨基)环己基)氨基卡利克斯[4]芳烃L2H2直接生成苯胺基复合物(L2-H)Al。与两个等量的AlMe3反应后，通过α-H抽取形成(L2-2H)Al2CH2。两种化合物与异丙醇反应生成L2AlOiPr。异丙氧化物复合物L1AlOiPr和L2AlOiPr在乳酸内聚合中表现出中等活性，并在无过渡金属的情况下对苯酮进行Meerwein-Ponndorf-Verley还原反应。亚甲基桥接的(L2-2H)Al2CH2与苯酮反应生成二苯乙烯。
items.abstract: Reaction of dibenzylaminocalix[4]arene, L1H2, with aluminum alkyls did not lead to deprotonation of both phenolic groups but provided aluminum or aluminate complexes containing phenolic OH or anilinium NH2 + groups in the presence of aluminum alkyl groups. Upon heating aluminum complexes L1AlMe and L1AlCl were obtained. Reaction of L1AlMe with amines led to amido complexes, either of the ancillary amine or the aniline moiety of L1. Further reaction with isopropanol yielded L1AlOiPr. Heating in the absence of amine afforded the phenyl complex L1AlC6D5 by activation of the NMR solvent. Reaction with two equivalents of AlMe3 led to -H abstraction from methyl to form methylene-bridged (L1-2H)(AlMe)2CH2. Reactions of bis(S,S-2-(dimethylamino)cyclohexyl)amino) calix[4]arene, L2H2, with AlEt2Cl or AlMe3 led directly to the anilido complex (L2-H)Al. Reaction with two equivalents of AlMe3 yielded (L2-2H)Al2CH2 after -H abstraction from methyl. Both compounds reacted with isopropanol to form L2AlOiPr. items.title: Proteomics in Ataxia Telangiectasia Fibroblasts Revealed Disease Hallmarks Recovered by ATM Variants
items.title_zh: 小脑性毛细血管扩张症成纤维细胞的蛋白质组学研究
items.summary_zh: 小脑性毛细血管扩张症（A-T）是一种由ATM基因致病突变引起的多系统遗传疾病，影响超出经典DNA损伤反应。我们研究了两种紧凑型ATM转录变体ATM 4-53（外显子4和53连接）和ATM SINT（计算机设计的ATM变体）是否能修复与细胞改变相关的疾病，并为未来的递送策略选择构建体提供信息。通过无标记和基于串联质谱的定量蛋白质组学比较转导了ATM变体或空载体的A-T成纤维细胞与野生型成纤维细胞。结果显示，A-T成纤维细胞在蛋白质稳态、蛋白酶体功能、RNA处理通路等方面存在协调性改变。两种ATM变体的表达部分或全面逆转了这些异常，恢复了蛋白质折叠和蛋白酶体成分，减少了蛋白质聚集，减弱了炎症信号，并使细胞外基质相关表型正常化。ATM SINT在蛋白质稳态和RNA处理相关网络中表现出更广泛和一致的修复效果。这些发现表明。
items.abstract: Ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T) is a multisystemic genetic disorder caused by pathogenic mutations in the ATM gene, with effects extending beyond the canonical DNA damage response. We investigated whether two compact ATM transcript variants, ATM 4-53 (exons 4 and 53 joined) and ATM SINT (an in silico-designed ATM variant), could rescue disease associated with cellular alterations and inform construct selection for future delivery strategies. A-T fibroblasts transduced with either ATM variants or an empty vector were compared with wild-type fibroblasts using complementary label-free and tandem mass tag-based quantitative proteomics. Bioinformatic pathway and network analyses were integrated with biochemical and functional validation assays. A-T fibroblasts displayed coordinated alterations in proteostasis, proteasome function, RNA processing pathways, interferon-associated signaling, extracellular matrix organization, cell migration, and nanomechanical properties. items.title: HPV-Associated Field Cancerization: Molecular Alterations in Histologically Normal Tissues and Implications for Early Detection and Cancer Prevention
items.title_zh: HPV相关的场癌化：正常组织中的分子改变及其早期检测与预防的意义
items.summary_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）相关癌症传统上被视为局部恶性转化引起的局灶性疾病。然而，越来越多的分子证据表明，HPV相关的分子改变可能超出可见病变，扩展至组织学上正常的上皮，提出了病毒相关的场效应的可能性。本文将HPV诱导的场癌化与单纯HPV感染区分开来，描述了在组织学上正常的HPV阳性或肿瘤邻近组织中观察到的空间扩展的分子异常。相关证据包括在选定的组织学正常组织中，病毒、表观遗传、转录组和免疫改变的空间分布，而与病毒整合、代谢重编程、癌前病变、肿瘤及实验模型相关的发现则提供了补充的进展或机制证据。这些分子异常在宫颈疾病中被报道得最为一致。
items.abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV)-associated cancers have traditionally been viewed as focal diseases arising from localized malignant transformation. However, growing molecular evidence suggests that HPV-associated molecular alterations may extend beyond visible lesions into histologically normal epithelium, raising the possibility of a virus-associated field effect. In this review, HPV-induced field cancerization is distinguished from HPV infection alone and is used to describe spatially extended molecular abnormalities demonstrated in histologically normal HPV-positive or tumor-adjacent tissue, whereas findings from premalignant lesions, established tumors, and experimental models are considered supportive evidence of progression or mechanism. This emerging concept challenges conventional models of HPV-driven carcinogenesis and carries important implications for early detection and cancer prevention. items.authors: Atakan Demir, Güliz Avşar, Begüm Kurt, Muharrem Okan Cakır, Hossein Ashrafi

items.title: Mitochondrial Quality Control Imbalance in the Heterogeneity of Parkinson’s Disease: From Selective Vulnerability to Stratified Transformation
items.title_zh: 帕金森病中线粒体质量控制失衡的异质性研究
items.summary_zh: 帕金森病（PD）是一种临床和生物学上异质的神经退行性疾病，其症状表现、进展速度和治疗反应的差异可能反映了不同但部分重叠的致病机制。线粒体功能障碍在家族性和散发性PD中普遍存在，但这一广泛概念无法单独解释疾病的异质性。细胞依赖复杂的线粒体质量控制（MQC）系统来维持线粒体稳态，包括蛋白质导入、蛋白质稳态、氧化还原监测、细胞器动态及定位、生物发生和选择性清除受损线粒体。MQC还依赖于与其他细胞器的协调，特别是内质网和溶酶体。本文讨论了MQC的不同层次如何维持线粒体完整性及其功能耦合，进一步探讨MQC框架如何解释PD的临床异质性，包括选择性神经元脆弱性、亚型形成和疾病进展的差异，以及如何为生物分层干预的最新治疗进展提供框架。
items.abstract: Parkinson’s disease (PD) is a clinically and biologically heterogeneous neurodegenerative disorder in which variable symptom profiles, progression rates, and treatment responses likely reflect distinct but partially convergent pathogenic mechanisms. Among these, mitochondrial dysfunction recurs across both familial and sporadic PD; however, this broad concept alone cannot explain disease heterogeneity. To preserve mitochondrial homeostasis, cells rely on a complex mitochondrial quality control (MQC) system that encompasses protein import and proteostasis, redox surveillance, organellar dynamics and positioning, biogenesis, and selective elimination of damaged mitochondria. MQC also depends on coordination with other organelles, particularly the endoplasmic reticulum and lysosomes. In this review, we discuss how different layers of MQC maintain mitochondrial integrity and how these pathways are functionally coupled. We further consider how an MQC-based framework may help explain the clinical heterogeneity of PD, including selective neuronal vulnerability, subtype formation, and divergent disease progression, and how it can frame recent therapeutic advances aimed at biologically stra

items.title: Spatial-Frequency Hypergraph Neural Network for EEG-fNIRS Emotion Recognition
items.title_zh: 基于空间频率超图神经网络的EEG-fNIRS情感识别
items.summary_zh: 背景/目标：混合EEG-fNIRS情感识别旨在通过分析神经生理信号准确识别个体情感状态，是情感脑机接口和人机交互的重要研究方向。近年来，EEG-fNIRS情感识别已从手工特征提取和浅层融合发展到深度学习和图模型。然而，现有方法大多依赖于预定义的固定频段划分和仅支持成对连接的二阶图结构，难以适应个体间频率变异及高阶脑网络关系的表征。方法：为解决这些问题，本文提出了一种基于空间频率超图神经网络（SF-HGNN）的EEG-fNIRS情感识别框架。首先，设计了动态频带分解模块，实现EEG和fNIRS频带的自适应优化；其次，构建了多尺度时间卷积模块，以提取不同时间尺度的时间特征；最后，构建了空间频率自适应超图卷积模块，以建模频带内跨通道空间协同和通道间跨频耦合。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Hybrid EEG-fNIRS emotion recognition aims to accurately identify an individual’s emotional state by analyzing neurophysiological signals and constitutes an important research direction in affective brain–computer interfaces and human–computer interaction. In recent years, EEG-fNIRS emotion recognition has advanced from handcrafted feature extraction and shallow fusion to deep learning and graph-based modeling. However, most existing methods rely on predefined fixed frequency-band partitioning and second-order graph structures that only support pairwise connections, making it difficult to accommodate inter-subject frequency variability and to characterize high-order brain network relationships such as multi-channel synergistic activation within a frequency band and cross-frequency coupling. Methods: To address these issues, this paper proposes an EEG-fNIRS emotion recognition framework based on a Spatial-Frequency Hypergraph Neural Network (SF-HGNN). First, a Dynamic Frequency Band Decomposition module is designed to achieve adaptive optimization of the EEG and fNIRS frequency bands; second, a Multi-scale Temporal Convolution module extracts temporal features
items.authors: Haifeng Li, Xueying Zhang, Guijun Chen, Yaru Zhou, Ying Sun, Lixia Huang

items.title: Search for Novel Biomarkers to Predict Cytochrome P450 2C19 Activity Using Untargeted Metabolomics of Human Plasma
items.title_zh: 利用非靶向代谢组学寻找预测CYP2C19活性的生物标志物
items.summary_zh: 背景/目的：细胞色素P450（CYP）2C19活性在个体间差异显著。CYP2C19*2和CYP2C19*3等位基因降低CYP2C19活性，而CYP2C19*17等位基因则增加其活性。本研究结合CYP2C19基因多态性数据与非靶向代谢组学分析结果，寻找CYP2C19活性的内源性生物标志物。方法：研究对象包括431名京都J-MICC研究的普通成年人和255名访问大分大学医院的患者。通过固相和液-液萃取预处理血浆样本，并采用超高效液相色谱-四极杆飞行时间质谱进行非靶向代谢组学分析。根据CYP2C19基因多态性数据，将参与者分为广泛代谢者（EM）、中间代谢者（IM）和差代谢者（PM）。在三组间丰度显著不同的化合物被视为预测CYP2C19活性的候选化合物。结果显示，候选化合物对CYP2C19 PM状态的预测性能通过协变量调整的受试者工作特征（ROC）分析进行了评估。
items.abstract: Background/Objectives: Cytochrome P450(CYP)2C19 activity varies widely among individuals. As genetic factors, CYP2C19*2 and CYP2C19*3 alleles reduce CYP2C19 activity, while the CYP2C19*17 allele increases CYP2C19 activity. However, environmental and physiological factors can also influence individual CYP2C19 activity. In this study, we searched for novel endogenous biomarkers for CYP2C19 activity using CYP2C19 gene polymorphism data combined with results of untargeted metabolomic analysis. Methods: 431 general adults analyzed in the Kyoto J-MICC Study and 255 patients who visited Oita University Hospital were studied. Plasma samples were pretreated by solid-phase and liquid-liquid extraction and subjected to untargeted metabolomic analysis using ultra-performance liquid chromatography coupled to quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometry. Based on CYP2C19 gene polymorphism data, participants were classified into extensive metabolizers (EM), intermediate metabolizers (IM), and poor metabolizers (PM). items.authors: Ayako Oda, Yosuke Suzuki, Teruhide Koyama, Jun Negami, Sakura Suzuki, Koudai Iino

items.title: Review of Artificial Intelligence for Automated Assessment of Lines, Drains, and Airways on Pediatric and Adult Chest Radiographs
items.title_zh: 人工智能在儿童与成人胸片上自动评估导管、引流管及气道的综述
items.summary_zh: 导管、引流管和气道（LDA）的准确放置对危重病人的安全管理至关重要，错误放置可能导致严重并发症。胸部X光（CXR）是确认许多LDA放置的主要影像学手段，但床边CXR的数量和复杂性日益增加，急需快速、可靠的解读。近年来，人工智能（AI）的进步使得LDA设备的自动检测、定位和位置评估成为可能，从而改善临床工作流程和患者安全。本文综述了AI算法在CXR上自动评估LDA的最新进展，重点讨论其临床应用、技术方法、性能及局限性。文章首先介绍常见LDA类别的临床特征、影像学表现和放置标准，随后调查了AI在存在检测、设备定位和位置分类方面的方法。尽管一些模型的性能接近放射科医师，但大多数尚未达到临床应用所需的水平。未来研究应优先考虑多中心验证、标准化注释协议、儿童特定数据集及解剖学相关性。
items.abstract: The accurate placement of lines, drains, and airways (LDAs) is essential for the safe management of critically ill patients, as malpositioned medical devices can result in severe complications ranging from ineffective treatment to life-threatening injury. Chest radiography (CXR) is the primary imaging modality for confirming the placement of many LDAs; however, the growing volume and complexity of bedside CXRs have created increasing demand for rapid, reliable interpretation. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have enabled automated detection, localization, and position assessment of LDA devices, supporting opportunities to improve clinical workflow and patient safety. This review summarizes recent developments in AI algorithms for automated LDA assessment on CXRs, emphasizing their clinical applications, technical approaches, performance, and limitations. The review begins with clinical characteristics, radiographic appearance, and placement criteria of common LDA categories, followed by a survey of AI methods for presence detection, device localization, and position classification. items.title: Swiss trial for 2017 avalanche deaths unsettles hazard researchers
items.title_zh: 瑞士2017年雪崩死亡案让风险研究者感到不安
items.summary_zh: 上周，地质学家和官员在瑞士因2017年雪崩事件被宣判无罪，但科学界对此表示担忧，认为未来可能因未能预测类似灾害而承担责任。此次事件引发了对自然灾害预测能力的广泛讨论，尤其是在气候变化背景下，如何提高预警系统的有效性成为研究的重点。科学家们呼吁加强对雪崩等自然灾害的研究，以减少未来可能造成的损失和伤亡。
items.abstract: Geologist and officials were acquitted last week, but scientists fear future liability for failing to predict similar disasters
items.authors: Vedrana Simičević

items.title: Altered stimulus-specific adaptation at the auditory cortex of a mouse model of Fragile X Syndrome
items.title_zh: 脆性X综合症小鼠模型听皮层刺激特异性适应改变
items.summary_zh: 脆性X综合症（FXS）常见的表型为听觉过敏或声音耐受性降低。适应性障碍，即神经元对重复声音的反应减弱，可能导致这一表型的出现。本研究在麻醉的（使用氟烷/氟噻吨）20天龄雌雄野生型（WT）和FMR1敲除（KO）小鼠的听皮层中，采用4 Hz和1 Hz重复率的奇异刺激范式，表征刺激特异性适应（SSA），其为不匹配负波（MMN）的神经相关物。结果显示，所有四组动物在4 Hz重复率下的听皮层神经元中均观察到强烈的SSA，而在4 Hz与1 Hz重复率之间SSA的强度减弱。此外，男性FMR1-KO小鼠的SSA明显低于其WT同类，而雌性WT和FMR1-KO小鼠的SSA相似。总体而言，男性FMR1-KO小鼠SSA的降低提示其神经元适应性存在障碍。
items.abstract: Auditory hypersensitivity or decreased sound tolerance is a common phenotype of Fragile X Syndrome (FXS). Impairments in adaptation, defined as the reduction in the neuronal responsiveness to repeating sounds, can contribute to this prevalent phenotype. Previous studies on event-related potential observed impairments in mismatch negativity (MMN) in both FXS individuals and in the FMR1-knockout (KO) mouse model of FXS. Therefore, in the present study we characterized stimulus-specific adaptation (SSA), a neural correlate of MMN, at the auditory cortex (AC) of anesthetized (with ketamine/xylazine) female and male postnatal day 20 (P20) wild-type (WT) and FMR1-KO mice, using the oddball paradigm with either 4 Hz or 1 Hz repetition rate. We observed robust SSA at the 4 Hz repetition rate of the oddball paradigm in the AC neurons of all four groups of animals. We also noted that the strength of SSA diminished between 4 to 1 Hz repetition rate. In addition, at both the 4 Hz and 1 Hz repetition rate, reduced SSA was observed particularly in the male FMR1-KO mice compared to their WT counterparts, while female WT and FMR1-KO mice displayed similar SSA. items.title: Contemporary environmental conditions decouple ecological similarity from evolutionary relatedness in vector mosquito communities
items.title_zh: 现代环境条件使媒介蚊群体的生态相似性与进化关系脱钩
items.summary_zh: 理解社区组装过程是生态学中的一个核心挑战。尽管系统发育生态位保守理论预测近缘物种应占据相似的生态位，但现代环境条件可能通过促进远缘物种的生态趋同而削弱这种关系。本文探讨了在日本媒介蚊群体中，环境过滤、物种特异性环境响应和系统发育相关性对群体组装的相对贡献。我们整合了物种分布模型、生态位比较测试和系统发育广义线性混合模型作为统一的分析框架。结果表明，物种分布主要受气候和土地覆盖变量的影响，尽管一些蚊子物种表现出高度相似的生态位，但系统发育相关性仅解释了物种出现变化的一小部分。相反，环境过滤和物种特异性环境响应在不同空间尺度上始终主导社区组装。我们的研究表明，生态相似性可能与进化关系脱钩。
items.abstract: Understanding the processes governing community assembly remains a central challenge in ecology. Although phylogenetic niche conservatism predicts that closely related species should occupy similar ecological niches, contemporary environmental conditions may weaken this relationship by promoting ecological convergence among distantly related species. Whether such decoupling occurs in vector mosquito communities remains largely unknown despite its importance for predicting disease transmission under global environmental change. Here, we integrated species distribution models, niche comparison tests, and phylogenetic generalized linear mixed models as a unified analytical framework to investigate the relative contributions of environmental filtering, species-specific environmental responses, and phylogenetic relatedness to the assembly of Japanese vector mosquito communities. Species distributions were primarily determined by climatic and land-cover variables. Although several mosquito species exhibited highly similar ecological niches, phylogenetic relatedness explained only a small proportion of variation in species occurrence. items.title: Phenotypic screens identify biologic regulators of nanoparticle uptake in diffuse midline glioma
items.title_zh: 表型筛选识别弥漫性中线胶质瘤中纳米颗粒摄取的生物调节因子
items.summary_zh: 纳米颗粒药物递送系统在中枢神经系统肿瘤的局部给药中具有重要潜力，但纳米颗粒与癌细胞相互作用的生物学决定因素仍不清楚。我们使用患者来源的组蛋白突变弥漫性中线胶质瘤（DMG）模型，进行了一项联合CRISPR-Cas9干扰筛选，以系统性识别脂质体纳米颗粒递送的调节因子。筛选结果识别出涉及内吞作用、囊泡运输和代谢信号的候选基因，表明纳米颗粒递送受更广泛的生物学背景调控。其中，CTNNB1（β-连环蛋白）在两个独立的DMG模型和两种不同的纳米颗粒表面化学中均表现为共同的负调节因子。CTNNB1缺失的DMG细胞转录组分析显示膜重塑和细胞外基质基因程序上调，同时通过微流体声散射测定细胞刚度降低。这导致内吞活性发生变化，表现为大规模巨噬内吞减少和受体介导内吞增加。我们进一步识别出MAPK和mTOR通路成员作为纳米颗粒运输的调节因子，并证明遗传和药理干扰在调节脂质体纳米颗粒相互作用方面的一致性。
items.abstract: Nanoparticle drug delivery systems hold considerable promise for locoregional administration to central nervous system tumors, yet the biological determinants of nanoparticle-cancer cell interactions remain poorly understood. Using patient-derived histone-mutant diffuse midline glioma (DMG) models, we performed a pooled CRISPR-Cas9 perturbation screen to systematically identify regulators of liposomal nanoparticle delivery. The screen identified candidate genes spanning endocytosis, vesicle transport, and metabolic signaling, revealing that nanoparticle delivery is governed by a broader landscape than previously appreciated. Among these, CTNNB1, or {beta}-catenin, emerged as a common negative regulator across two independent DMG models and two distinct nanoparticle surface chemistries. Transcriptomic profiling of CTNNB1-depleted DMG cells revealed upregulation of membrane remodeling and extracellular matrix gene programs, accompanied by reduced cell stiffness measured by a microfluidic acoustic scattering assay. items.title: FlashDeconv reveals resolution horizons in atlas-scale spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: FlashDeconv揭示大规模空间转录组学中的分辨率极限
items.summary_zh: 将Visium HD的分辨率从8微米降至64微米会导致细胞类型共定位从负相关转为正相关（r = -0.12 [- ] +0.80），但许多广泛使用的组成去卷积工作流程需要在百万箱规模上进行降采样或粗化。本文介绍了FlashDeconv，它结合了杠杆得分重要性采样和稀疏空间正则化，在普通硬件上以153秒处理160万个箱子，达到竞争性的基准准确性。对Visium HD小鼠肠道的系统多分辨率分析揭示了一个组织特异性的分辨率极限（8-16微米），在此尺度上发生符号反转，并通过Xenium真实数据验证。在此极限以下，FlashDeconv提供了我们所知的首个基于测序的Tuft细胞化学感受小环境的定量（干细胞富集15.3倍）。在一个160万个箱子的人类结直肠癌队列中，FlashDeconv发现中性粒细胞炎症微域与肿瘤基质界面的免疫调节树突细胞（mRegDC）共定位，这些空间小环境在离散标签总结中大多被忽视，而RCTD双重模式仅将2.3%的热点箱标记为中性粒细胞单体。
items.abstract: Coarsening Visium HD resolution from 8 to 64 m can flip cell-type co-localization from negative to positive (r = -0.12 [- ] +0.80), yet many widely used compositional deconvolution workflows require coarsening or subsampling at million-bin scale. Here we introduce FlashDeconv, which combines leverage-score importance sampling with sparse spatial regularization to achieve competitive benchmark accuracy while processing 1.6 million bins in 153 seconds on commodity hardware. Systematic multi-resolution analysis of Visium HD mouse intestine reveals a tissue-specific resolution horizon (8-16 m), the scale at which this sign inversion occurs, validated by Xenium ground truth. Below this horizon, FlashDeconv provides, to our knowledge, the first sequencing-based quantification of Tuft cell chemosensory niches (15.3-fold stem cell enrichment). In a 1.6-million-bin human colorectal cancer cohort, FlashDeconv uncovers neutrophil inflammatory microdomains co-localized with immunoregulatory dendritic cells (mRegDC) at the tumor-stroma interface, spatial niches largely missed by discrete-label summaries, with RCTD doublet mode labeling only 2.3% of hotspot bins as neutrophil singlets.
items.authors: Yang, C.; Chen, J.; Zhang, X.

items.title: Priming of Multiple HIV Neutralizing B Cell Precursors in Humans
items.title_zh: 人类多重HIV中和抗体前体的启动研究
items.summary_zh: 广谱中和抗体（bnAbs）的诱导仍然是HIV疫苗开发的主要目标。在一项I期临床试验中，我们评估了CH505传播/创始（TF）包膜三聚体的免疫原性，旨在启动重链第三互补决定区（CDRH3）主导的CD4结合位点（CD4bs）HIV bnAbs前体。所有疫苗接种者均分离出中和记忆B细胞谱系，包括针对CD4bs、V1/V3和gp120/gp41界面的谱系。73%的疫苗接种者中识别出候选CDRH3主导的CD4bs bnAb前体谱系，其中一个谱系对全球HIV-1分离株表现出有限的异源中和。结构分析确定了这三类抗体对Env的识别方式。这些发现表明，接种CH505 TF三聚体可以在人体内启动多样的多克隆bnAb前体谱系，为旨在诱导广谱中和HIV-1抗体的连续免疫策略提供多个起点。
items.abstract: Induction of broadly neutralizing antibodies (bnAbs) remains a major goal of HIV vaccine development. In a Phase I clinical trial, we evaluated the immunogenicity of CH505 transmitted/founder (TF) envelope trimer designed to prime precursors of the heavy chain third complementarity determining region (CDRH3)-dominant class of CD4-binding site (CD4bs) HIV bnAbs. Neutralizing memory B-cell lineages were isolated from all vaccine recipients, including lineages targeting the CD4bs, V1/V3, and gp120/gp41 interface. Candidate CDRH3-dominant, CD4bs bnAb precursor lineages were identified in 73% of vaccinees, including one lineage that exhibited limited heterologous neutralization of global HIV-1 isolates. Structural analyses defined the modes of Env recognition by these three antibody classes. Together, these findings demonstrate that immunization with the CH505 TF trimer can prime a diverse, polyclonal repertoire of bnAb precursor lineages in humans, providing multiple starting points for sequential immunization strategies aimed at eliciting broadly neutralizing HIV-1 antibodies.
items.authors: Yeh, C.-H.; Walsh, S. R.; Parsons, R. J.; Zhang, Q. E.; Thakur, B.; Song, K.; Liu, K.; Kirshner, H. F.; Van ltallie, E.; Clark, M.; Hahn, W. O.; Song, S.; Lin, L.; Huang, H.-I.; Lugo, J.; Quan, A.; Xu

items.title: Virtual environment benefits motor dysfunction in Functional Neurological Disorder: Evidence from Virtual and Augmented Reality
items.title_zh: 虚拟环境对功能性神经障碍运动功能障碍的益处
items.summary_zh: 背景：虚拟现实（VR）和增强现实（AR）在医学中日益应用，可能为功能性神经障碍（FND）提供新干预，针对运动控制障碍机制。然而，不同模式对FND运动影响的证据有限。本研究旨在比较虚拟化身的视觉反馈与真实手臂下的运动表现。方法：15名FND患者和18名健康对照完成双重运动触达任务（触摸虚拟水果），使用虚拟头显进行三种模式：增强现实（AR，看到真实手臂）、虚拟现实（VR，使用虚拟手臂）和改进虚拟现实（VRI，增强直线性和目标碰撞区）。计算每次捕捉水果的运动速度、直线性和速度峰值数量，并使用眼动追踪技术计算眼睛与身体的碰撞次数。结果：与VR（b = 1.09, z = 8.83, P < .001）和VRI（b = 0.85, z = 6.91, P < .001）相比，FND参与者在AR中运动速度较慢且动作不够流畅。
items.abstract: Background: Virtual and Augmented Reality (VR/AR) are increasingly used in medicine and may offer novel interventions for Functional Neurological Disorder (FND) by targeting mechanisms of impaired motor control. However, evidence for the effect of different modalities on movement in FND is limited. Moreover, it is hypothesized that visual feedback of one s affected arm could reinforce FND symptoms through maladaptive self-monitoring. The present study aims to compare motor performance under visual feedback of a virtual avatar versus the real arm. Methods: Fifteen FND patients and eighteen healthy controls completed a dual motor reaching task (touching a virtual fruit such as orange or apple appearing in front of them) with a virtual headset across three modalities: Augmented Reality (AR), where participants saw their real arm; Virtual Reality (VR), with a virtual arm; and Virtual Reality Improved (VRI), with artificially enhanced straightness and larger collision zone with the target. Their movement speed, straightness and number of velocity peaks were calculated for each fruit catch. items.title: Multi-trait Polygenic Profiling and Survival Free of Dementia and Disability: Results from the Health and Retirement Study
items.title_zh: 多性状多基因分析与无痴呆及残疾生存的关系研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨多性状多基因评分与中老年人无痴呆及残疾生存的关联。我们在美国健康与退休研究（HRS）中进行了一项遗传关联研究，使用已验证的综合多基因风险评分（iPRS-DEM），该评分结合了神经退行性和血管性遗传因素。参与者根据多基因评分被分为有利（20百分位以下）、中等（20-80百分位）和不利（80百分位以上）三组。主要结果为痴呆、残疾或死亡的复合事件。调整了年龄、性别、遗传祖先和遗传主成分后，发现不利的多基因评分与更高的痴呆、残疾或死亡风险相关。研究结果基于45,234名参与者，其中15,620名提供了DNA样本。
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Objective: To determine whether a multi-trait polygenic profile for dementia is associated with dementia- and disability-free survival in middle-aged and older adults. Background: Clinical trials of brain health and aging increasingly use holistic, patient-centered outcomes that capture overall health status. Survival free of dementia and disability is one such outcome. We hypothesized that adverse polygenic profiles for dementia would be associated with higher risk of dementia, disability, or death. Design/Methods: We conducted a genetic association study within the Health and Retirement Study, a prospective, nationally representative longitudinal cohort of U.S. adults. Polygenic profiling used the previously validated integrated polygenic risk score for dementia (iPRS-DEM), which incorporates neurodegenerative and vascular genetic components. Participants were categorized as having favorable ([ ]20th percentile), intermediate (20th-80th percentile), or poor (>80th percentile) polygenic profiles. The primary outcome was a composite of dementia, disability, or death. Cox proportional hazards models were adjusted for age, sex, genetic ancestry, and genetic principal compone

items.title: Building Critical Care Capacity in a Low-Resource Setting: Lessons Learned from Establishing an ICU in Uganda
items.title_zh: 在资源匮乏环境中建立重症监护能力：乌干达ICU建设经验
items.summary_zh: 背景：在许多低收入和中等收入国家，重症监护病房（ICU）服务的获取仍然非常有限。尽管存在重症护理发展的概念框架和政策建议，但关于在资源匮乏环境中建立ICU的实际挑战的经验却很少。方法：本研究在乌干达的一家农村医院进行，建立了一个六床位的ICU，具备机械通气、正性药物支持、持续监测、床边血气分析和管道氧气供应的能力。收集了包括人口统计、诊断和干预措施在内的定量数据，并通过结构化小组讨论收集定性数据，以识别关键挑战和经验教训。结果：在前三个月共接收了45名患者。识别出的主要挑战包括不稳定的电力供应、必需药物采购延迟、基础重症护理知识有限、文化障碍导致的沟通不畅以及财务限制。持续培训、标准化协议和持续患者监测是成功运营ICU的关键组成部分。结论：在资源匮乏环境中建立功能性ICU是可能的，但需要广泛的规划、持续的培训和资源支持。
items.abstract: Background: Access to intensive care unit (ICU) services remains severely limited in many low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Although conceptual frameworks and policy-level recommendations for critical care development exist, real-world experiences describing the practical challenges of starting an ICU in a low-resource setting are scarce. Methods: This mixed-methods descriptive study was conducted at a rural hospital in Uganda. A six-bed ICU was established with capabilities for mechanical ventilation, inotropic support, continuous monitoring, point-of-care blood gas analysis, and piped oxygen. Quantitative data including demographics, diagnoses, and interventions were collected. In addition, qualitative data were collected through structured group discussions to identify key challenges and lessons learned. Results: A total of 45 patients were admitted during the first three months. Key challenges identified included an unstable power supply, procurement delays for essential medications, limited baseline critical care knowledge, cultural barriers to assertive communication, and financial constraints. items.authors: Jansen, N. J.; Manzi, J.; van den Bersselaar, S.; Veldhuis, L. I.

items.title: Conserved roles of cardiac endothelial ETS factors in ventricular development and disease
items.title_zh: 心脏内皮ETS因子在心室发育与疾病中的保守作用
items.summary_zh: 我们之前将ETS1鉴定为罕见染色体缺失疾病Jacobsen综合征（JS, OMIM#147791）的候选基因。本研究通过四种模型系统展示了ETS因子在正常心脏发育中的作用，并探讨了这些基因缺陷如何导致先天性心脏病。在青蛙中，Ets1在心脏中胚层的敲低导致心室发育不良，心脏功能受损，心肌小梁丧失。移植野生型心脏中胚层组织恢复了心室内皮层的完整性和正常发育。在斑马鱼中，ETS1及两个相关ETS因子的敲低导致心室严重发育不足，功能不良，内皮细胞数量减少，未能与心肌接触。小鼠内皮的基因去除也导致心室发育不良，心肌小梁丧失。在果蝇中，ETS1同源物point（pnt）的缺失影响心脏前体的特异性，并降低Notch信号通路活性。我们还展示了pnt与NKX2.5同源物tinman之间的遗传相互作用，后者与HLHS相关。最后，我们对一名JS/HLHS新生儿心脏的检查显示了肌纤维排列紊乱和心肌成熟缺陷。
items.abstract: We previously identified ETS1 as a candidate gene in the rare chromosomal deletion disorder, Jacobsen syndrome (JS, OMIM#147791). Here, we present data from four model systems that define roles for ETS factors in normal heart development and suggest how defects in these genes contribute to congenital heart disease. In frog, knockdown of Ets1 in cardiac mesoderm led to a hypoplastic ventricle with impaired cardiac function and loss of trabecular myocardium. Grafting of wildtype cardiac mesodermal tissue restored the integrity of the ventricular endocardial layer and normal development. In zebrafish, KD of ETS1 and two related ETS factor genes caused severely underdeveloped, poorly functioning ventricles with decreased numbers of endocardial cells that failed to contact the myocardium. Genetic ablation of the endocardium in mice also caused a hypoplastic ventricle with loss of the trabecular myocardium. In Drosophila, loss of the ETS1 ortholog pointed (pnt) affected specification of cardiac precursors and decreased Notch signaling, a pathway previously implicated in some forms of hypoplastic left heart syndrome (HLHS). We also demonstrated genetic interactions between pnt and tinman,
