items.title: Intraoperative glucocorticoids confound surgical biopsy transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 术中糖皮质激素影响外科活检转录组学研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对肥胖患者的肝脏活检样本，探讨围手术期药物对基因表达的影响。我们比较了在手术前几个月局部麻醉下采集的活检样本与在全身麻醉下采集的术中活检样本的RNA测序数据。结果显示，术中样本的转录组发生显著变化，富含经典的糖皮质激素受体靶基因，提示围手术期使用的地塞米松是主要驱动因素。在一组在活检后立即给予地塞米松的匹配队列中，我们直接证明地塞米松在手术期间显著改变肝脏基因表达。这些发现经过独立验证，显示地塞米松的使用显著扭曲了肝纤维化阶段与炎症基因表达之间的关联，掩盖了生物学相关的免疫特征。此外，在脂肪组织中也观察到类似的糖皮质激素反应性转录变化，表明存在系统性效应。我们的研究揭示了围手术期地塞米松暴露作为人类组织转录组学研究中的一个未被认识但可调节的混杂因素。
items.abstract: Human tissue transcriptomic studies frequently rely on biopsies obtained during surgery under general anesthesia, yet the impact of perioperative medications on gene expression has not been systematically evaluated. Using paired liver biopsies from patients with obesity at risk for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), we compared RNA sequencing profiles from biopsies collected under local anesthesia months before surgery with matched intraoperative biopsies obtained under general anesthesia. Intraoperative samples exhibited striking transcriptional changes enriched for canonical glucocorticoid receptor target genes, implicating perioperative dexamethasone administration as the principal driver. In a matched cohort in which dexamethasone was administered immediately after biopsy collection, we directly demonstrate that dexamethasone profoundly alters hepatic gene expression during surgery. These findings were independently validated and shown to substantially distort associations between liver fibrosis stage and inflammatory gene expression, obscuring biologically relevant immune signatures. Similar glucocorticoid-responsive transcriptional changes were observed
items.authors: Larsen, F. T.; Wernberg, C. W.; Nambiar, J.; Dutta, S.; Nielsen, E. J.; Groenkjaer, L. L.; Jacobsen, B. G.; Mandrup, S.; Loft, A.; Schmidt, S. F.; Lauridsen, M. E. M.; Ravnskjaer, K.; Groentved, L.

items.title: The neurons that can put a brake on a nervous-system cancer
items.title_zh: 神经元如何抑制神经系统癌症的生长
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了GABA能神经元在小鼠胶质瘤生长中的作用。研究发现，模仿GABA能神经元效应的药物能够显著减缓胶质瘤的生长。通过实验，研究团队观察到这些药物在小鼠体内有效降低了肿瘤的增殖速度，提示GABA能神经元在肿瘤微环境中可能发挥抑制作用。这一发现为胶质瘤的治疗提供了新的思路，表明通过调节神经元活动可能成为一种有效的抗肿瘤策略。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 10 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02834-5 Drugs that imitate the effect of GABAergic neurons slow the growth of tumours called gliomas in mice.

items.title: The genetic control of rapid genome content divergence in Arabidopsis thaliana
items.title_zh: 拟南芥基因组内容快速分化的遗传控制
items.summary_zh: 真核生物的基因组进化主要受重复序列动态的驱动，这些序列在拷贝数和序列组成上差异显著。重复进化速率在物种间和物种内存在差异，可能受到遗传和环境的调节。为揭示影响基因组内容进化速率的因素，我们分析了1043个重测序的拟南芥基因组，采用新颖的K-mer方法表征基因组内容变异，并识别出与重复丰度差异相关的超可变区域。我们将重复丰度视为定量性状，进行了超过400个重复家族的全基因组关联分析，以识别拷贝数变异的遗传基础。通过meta-GWAS方法整合结果，发现了与重复丰度相关的顺式作用变异和50多个候选反式作用位点。顺式作用变异主要集中在着丝粒附近区域，而反式作用位点富集于参与DNA复制、修复和甲基化调控的候选基因。这些结果表明，净化选择对加速基因组内容分化的突变施加了抑制，偏好限制重复扩展的等位基因。
items.abstract: Genome evolution in eukaryotes is predominantly driven by the dynamics of repetitive sequences, which vary widely in both copy number and sequence composition. Rates of repeat evolution differ between and within species and are likely modulated by both genetics and environment. To uncover factors shaping the rate of genome content evolution, we analyzed 1043 resequenced Arabidopsis thaliana genomes using a novel K-mer-based approach to characterize genome content variation and identify hypervariable regions underlying differences in repeat abundance. We next treated repeat abundance as a quantitative trait and performed genome-wide association analyses across more than 400 repeat families to identify the genetic basis of copy number variation. Integrating these results through a meta-GWAS approach revealed both cis-acting variants and more than 50 candidate trans-acting loci associated with repeat abundance genome-wide. Cis-acting variation was predominantly localized to pericentromeric and centromeric regions, whereas trans-acting loci were enriched for candidate genes involved in DNA replication, DNA repair, and DNA methylation regulation. The results are consistent with purifyin

items.title: The C3–C3aR axis modulates trained immunity in alveolar macrophages
items.title_zh: C3–C3aR轴调节肺泡巨噬细胞的训练免疫
items.summary_zh: 补体蛋白C3在肺等粘膜部位的免疫反应中至关重要，促进微生物清除并增强炎症。我们研究了C3在训练免疫中的作用，发现人类在接受训练刺激后，肺泡巨噬细胞（AM）中C3和C3aR1的表达增加。在体内，经过训练的野生型小鼠在第二次刺激后显示出显著升高的促炎细胞因子和C3a水平。在体外，与野生型AM相比，训练的C3缺乏AM表现出减少的趋化因子和细胞因子释放，以及受损的吞噬作用和活性氧生成。实时共聚焦显微镜观察显示，AM在肺泡微灌注后迅速内化C3，而非C3a。外源性C3恢复了减弱的细胞因子释放，而C3a则无效。通过药理学和基因敲除抑制C3aR，阻止了这种恢复，表明C3aR的参与是必要的。机制上，训练的野生型AM相比C3缺乏AM表现出增强的糖酵解活性，而这一缺陷可通过外源性C3在C3aR缺失的情况下纠正。
items.abstract: Complement protein C3 is crucial for immune responses in mucosal sites such as the lung, where it aids in microbe elimination, and enhances inflammation. While trained immunity – enhanced secondary responses of innate immune cells after prior exposure – is well-studied, the role of the complement system in trained immune responses remains unclear. We investigated the role of C3 in trained immunity and found that alveolar macrophage (AM) C3 and C3aR1 expression increased in humans after an intranasal exposure to a training stimulus. In vivo, trained wild-type mice showed significantly elevated proinflammatory cytokines and increased C3a levels upon a second stimulus. Ex vivo, trained C3-deficient AMs displayed reduced chemokine and cytokine output as well as impaired phagocytosis and reactive oxygen species production compared to wild-type AMs. Real-time confocal microscopy of live, intact mouse alveoli revealed that AMs internalize C3 rapidly after alveolar microinstillation, as compared to C3a. Correspondingly, the blunted cytokine output was restored by exogenous C3 but not by C3a. Inhibiting C3aR, both pharmacologically and with a genetic C3aR knockout, prevented this restoratio

items.title: Comparative Evaluation of Graph Neural Networks for Molecular Lipophilicity Prediction
items.title_zh: 图神经网络在分子脂溶性预测中的比较评估
items.summary_zh: 预测分子性质是化学信息学中的核心挑战，对药物发现和材料科学至关重要。脂溶性描述了分子在脂质和水相环境中的分配，是影响药物行为的关键物理化学性质。尽管量子力学方法能提供准确预测，但计算成本高。相比之下，可以利用大型实验数据库训练数据驱动模型，如图神经网络（GNN），直接从化学结构学习分子表征。本研究比较了四种GNN架构——图卷积网络（GCN）、图同构网络（GIN）、图采样与聚合（GraphSAGE）和注意力指纹（Attentive FP）——在回归和分类方法下预测脂溶性。模型在一致的预处理、优化和训练条件下评估。结果显示，Attentive FP模型在两个任务中均优于其他架构，预测准确性提高。我们还考察了预处理中的异常值移除影响，观察到预测误差减少和鲁棒性提升。这些发现为代表性GNN模型在分子脂溶性预测中的能力提供了见解。
items.abstract: Predicting molecular properties is a central challenge in cheminformatics and plays a critical role in drug discovery and materials science. Lipophilicity, which describes the partitioning of a molecule between lipid and aqueous environments, is a key physicochemical property influencing drug behavior. Although quantum mechanical methods can provide accurate predictions, they are often computationally demanding. In contrast, large experimental databases can be leveraged to train data-driven models such as graph neural networks (GNNs), which learn molecular representations directly from chemical structures. In this study, we compare four GNN architectures—graph convolutional networks (GCN), graph isomorphism networks (GIN), Graph Sample and AggregatE (GraphSAGE), and Attentive Fingerprint (Attentive FP)—for predicting lipophilicity using both regression and classification approaches. The models are evaluated on a benchmark dataset under consistent preprocessing, optimization, and training conditions. Our results show that the Attentive FP model consistently outperforms the other architectures, yielding improved predictive accuracy across both tasks. We further examine the impact of
items.authors: Annika Bande, Sandeep Kumar

items.title: RINSE: A reciprocal-space fingerprint for comparing crystal structures
items.title_zh: RINSE：用于比较晶体结构的倒空间指纹
items.summary_zh: 比较晶体结构（如识别多晶型、跟踪相变或在数据库中搜索已知图案）需要一种描述符，该描述符能够编码晶体的化学信息，同时对结构确定或描述符构建过程中的任意选择保持不变。RINSE（倒空间不变谱嵌入）是一种从晶体的衍射图案计算得出的指纹。通过将强度加权的倒格子投影到组合的径向和球谐基上，RINSE生成一个紧凑的功率谱，能够在每个结构的几十毫秒内保持对晶体取向和单位胞表示选择的不变性。该描述符受到原子位置平滑重叠（SOAP）核的启发，但映射整个周期性结构而非局部原子邻域。基于描述符空间主成分分析的局部敏感哈希使得结构相似晶体的快速近似检索成为可能，并为相关结构组提供了方便的可发音标识符。RINSE代码作为开源Python包免费提供。
items.abstract: Comparing crystal structures, whether to identify polymorphs, follow a phase transition, or search a database for a known motif, requires a descriptor that encodes the chemistry of a crystal while remaining invariant to the arbitrary choices made during structure determination or descriptor construction. RINSE (Reciprocal-space INvariant Spectral Embedding) is such a fingerprint, computed from a crystal’s diffraction pattern. By projecting the intensity-weighted reciprocal lattice onto a combined radial and spherical-harmonic basis, RINSE produces a compact power spectrum that is invariant to crystal orientation and to the choice of unit-cell representation, in tens of milliseconds per structure. The descriptor is inspired by the Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP) kernel but maps the full periodic structure rather than a local atomic neighbourhood. A locality-sensitive hash derived from principal-component analysis of the descriptor space enables rapid approximate retrieval of structurally similar crystals, and provides a convenient pronounceable identifier for a related group of structures. The RINSE code is freely available as an open-source Python package.
items.authors: Thomas Fellowes, John S. O. Evans, Aurora J. Cruz-Cabeza

items.title: Making Analytic Double-Hybrid DFT Gradients Practical: A High-Performance Multi-GPU RI Implementation
items.title_zh: 实用化解析双杂化DFT梯度：高性能多GPU RI实现
items.summary_zh: 双杂化密度泛函理论（DHDFT）是密度泛函层次中最精确的方法，但其在分子结构和动力学中的应用受到解析核梯度高计算成本的限制。本文首次提出了解析DHDFT梯度的GPU加速实现，该实现基于极大规模电子结构系统（EXESS），在计算中采用了分辨率为单位（RI）技术，并在GPU上评估完整的松弛梯度，包括修正的Z向量响应和交换-关联势的显式核导数。该多GPU分布式实现在NVIDIA和AMD架构上具有可移植性，支持g角动量的基函数，并可进行四重ζ基质量的计算。与ORCA中的数值导数和已建立的CPU实现进行验证，EXESS在足够大的计算中保持超过50%的理论峰值双精度浮点性能，并在多个NVIDIA H200 GPU和AMD MI250X GCD上表现出高效的强扩展性。与现代Sapphire Rapids CPU节点上的ORCA相比，单个H200 GPU的加速比范围约为10倍至675倍。
items.abstract: Double-hybrid density functional theory (DHDFT) is the most accurate rung within the density-functional hierarchy, but its use for molecular structure and dynamics remains limited by the high computational cost of analytic nuclear gradients. Here, we present, the first GPU-accelerated implementation of analytic DHDFT gradients. The implementation, developed in the Extreme-scale Electronic Structure System (EXESS), employs resolution-of-the-identity (RI) techniques throughout the calculation and evaluates the complete relaxed gradient on GPUs, including the modified Z-vector response and the explicit nuclear derivative of the exchange–correlation potential. The distributed multi-GPU formulation is performanceportable across NVIDIA and AMD architectures, supports basis functions through g angular momentum, and enables calculations through quadruple-ζ basis quality. The implementation is validated against numerical derivatives and the established CPU implementation in ORCA for B2PLYP and revDSD-PBEP86D4. For sufficiently large calculations, EXESS sustains more than 50% of the theoretical peak double-precision floating-point performance and exhibits efficient strong scaling across mult
items.authors: Ross Pure, Giuseppe M. J. Barca

items.title: Cooperative Thiol-Amine System Enables Rapid Epoxy Curing with Balanced Thermomechanical Performance
items.title_zh: 协同硫醇-胺体系实现快速环氧固化与优良热机械性能
items.summary_zh: 环氧热固性材料通常在固化速度与热机械性能之间存在基本权衡：硫醇固化体系能实现快速凝胶化，但常导致低玻璃化转变温度（Tg）网络，而胺固化体系则提供高Tg材料，但固化动力学较慢。本文报道了一种高功能性非酯聚硫醇及其协同硫醇-胺固化策略，克服了这一限制。通过系统变化催化剂负载、环氧化合物计量、硫醇-胺组成及胺结构，揭示了固化动力学、热行为和粘附性能的强结构-性能关系。纯硫醇-环氧体系中，增加催化剂浓度显著加速了凝胶化至分钟级固化，而环氧过量提高了Tg而不改变凝胶时间。混合硫醇-胺配方实现了显著高于仅硫醇体系的Tg，同时保持快速固化，引入初级胺大幅减少了对外部三级胺催化剂的需求。此外，该协同固化策略在不同结构的胺固化剂中均有效，保持了快速固化和均衡的热机械性能。这一协同固化方法为快速固化的环氧热固性材料提供了简单而多功能的平台。
items.abstract: Epoxy thermosets typically exhibit a fundamental trade-off between curing speed and thermomechanical performance: thiol-cured systems enable rapid gelation but often produce low glass-transition temperature (Tg) networks, whereas amine-cured systems provide high Tg materials at the expense of slow curing kinetics. Here, we report a high-functionality, non-ester polythiol and a cooperative thiol-amine curing strategy that overcomes this limitation. Systematic variation of catalyst loading, epoxy stoichiometry, thiol-amine composition, and amine structure revealed strong structure-property relationships governing cure kinetics, thermal behavior, and adhesive performance. For the pure thiol-epoxy system, increasing catalyst concentration significantly accelerated gelation to minute-scale curing, while epoxy excess enhanced increased Tg without altering gel time. Hybrid thiol-amine formulations achieved substantially higher Tg than thiol-only systems while maintaining rapid cure, and the introduction of a primary amine largely eliminated the need for an external tertiary amine catalyst. Furthermore, the cooperative curing strategy proved effective across structurally different amine cu
items.authors: Adem Lakkaichi, Christof Storz, Edith Schmitt, Zoubair Cherkaoui, Mohammad Yasir

items.title: Semicrystalline Polyesters Made by Stereoselective Polymerization of a Biobased Bicyclic Lactone
items.title_zh: 通过立体选择性聚合制备的生物基半结晶聚酯
items.summary_zh: 生物基热塑性塑料为石油化工塑料提供了可持续的替代品，但控制聚合物的立体化学以获得具有理想热机械性能的生物基材料仍然是一个挑战。本文报道了通过生物基双环内酯(±)-2-氧-3,8-二氧双环[3.2.1]辛烷(ODO)的立体选择性开环聚合合成的两种新型半结晶热塑性塑料。手性双脲催化剂在低温下通过意想不到的链端控制机制合成了高立构规聚(ODO)(s-PODO)。钇催化的熔融聚合反应获得了高分子量的各向同性和聚合物。PODO热塑性塑料的延展性、强度和模量可以通过改变立构规、加工和结晶度进行调节。通过控制其立体规整性和加工条件，我们展示了半结晶PODO薄膜相较于无定形的无规PODO具有卓越的气体阻隔性能和增强的强度与模量。
items.abstract: Biobased thermoplastics offer sustainable alternatives to petrochemical plastics, but controlling polymer stereochemistry to access biobased materials with desirable thermomechanical properties remains a challenge. Here, we report two new semicrystalline thermoplastics synthesized through the stereoselective ring-opening polymerization of the biobased bicyclic lactone (±)-2-oxo-3,8dioxabicyclo[3.2.1]octane (ODO). Enantiopure bisurea catalysts produced highly syndiotactic poly(ODO) (s-PODO) at low temperatures through an unexpected chain-end control mechanism. Yttrium-catalyzed melt polymerizations afforded high-molecular weight isotactic and syndiotactic PODO. The ductility, strength and modulus of PODO thermoplastics can be tuned through changes in tacticity, processing and crystallinity. By controlling their stereoregularity and processing conditions, we show that semicrystalline PODO films can have exceptional gas barrier properties with enhanced strength and modulus relative to amorphous atactic PODO.
items.authors: David M. Dumas, Kai Hin Lui, Hongyi Zhang, Matthew W. Kanan, Robert M. Waymouth

items.title: Perovskite Photovoltaics in August 2026: Non-radiative recombination control and buried-interface treatment
items.title_zh: 2026年8月钙钛矿光伏技术：非辐射复合控制与埋藏界面处理
items.summary_zh: 在531篇文献中，重点分析了144篇关于钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSCs）的缺陷钝化、接触化学、相稳定性和操作耐久性。独立认证显示，单体串联架构的功率转换效率（PCE）达33.66%，得益于互补带隙吸收抑制热化损失及优化电流匹配。反向单结配置的认证PCE上限为27.4%，主要通过定制的自组装单层（SAMs）和分子添加剂实现，后者钝化了低配位铅缺陷并抑制了界面分子聚集。将这些钝化接触扩展到更大尺寸时，受到透明导电氧化物片电阻、互连划线死区和空间薄膜不均匀性的影响，最大报告孔径面积为61.2 cm²时的认证PCE为17.35%。操作寿命的证据仍然稀缺，仅有5项研究量化了操作寿命，最长为1400小时，且只有2项研究遵循了国际有机光伏稳定性峰会（ISOS）标准协议。
items.abstract: Across a monthly literature corpus of 531 publications, 144 were examined closely to evaluate defect passivation, contact chemistry, phase stability, and operational durability in perovskite solar cells (PSCs). Independent certification establishes the performance frontier for monolithic tandem architectures at a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 33.66%, driven by complementary bandgap absorption that suppresses thermalization losses alongside optimized current matching. Inverted single-junction configurations established a certified PCE ceiling of 27.4%, achieved primarily through tailored self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) and molecular additives that passivate undercoordinated lead defects and suppress interfacial molecular clustering. Scaling these passivated contacts to expanded dimensions incurs an area penalty governed by transparent conducting oxide sheet resistance, interconnect scribe dead area, and spatial film non-uniformity, yielding an accredited PCE of 17.35% at the largest reported aperture area of 61.2 cm2. Operational longevity evidence remains sparse and disconnected from efficiency milestones: only 5 investigations quantified operational lifetime, with a maximu
items.authors: Havid Aqoma

items.title: Hot-pressed, mechanically stable bipolar membranes for water electrolysis and CO2 reduction
items.title_zh: 热压制备的机械稳定双极膜用于水电解和CO2还原
items.summary_zh: 双极膜（BPM）由阳离子交换层和阴离子交换层组成，能够在电解槽的阴极和阳极实现不同pH下的稳态操作。这使得阴极和阳极催化剂在酸性和碱性环境中可以独立优化，从而扩大低成本材料的应用范围。现有的商业BPM仅在有限的电流范围内运行，因此我们旨在开发适用于更高电流的定制BPM，这些膜易于制造、机械稳定且适合干燥存储。我们结合商业单膜和TiO2作为水解催化剂，开发了热压制备自支撑膜的方法，确保其机械强度和电化学性能不受损失。通过电化学阻抗谱（EIS）分析，我们更好地理解了影响BPM性能的参数。结果表明，所开发的高性能BPM在水电解中超越了商业BPM，水解过电位在60°C、0.5 A cm-2时降至400 mV，而基准材料约为1.3 V。
items.abstract: Bipolar membranes (BPM), composed of a cation exchange layer and an anion exchange layer, can enable steady-state operation at different pHs at the cathode and anode in electrolyzers. This enables the independent optimization of the cathode and anode catalysts for acidic and alkaline environments, respectively, which increases the scope for low-cost materials. Commercially available BPMs are operational only in a limited current range, therefore we aimed to develop custom BPMs for higher currents that are easily fabricated, mechanically stable, and suitable for storage in dry form. We used commercial single membranes combined with TiO 2 as the water dissociation catalyst in the junction, and have developed a hot-pressing method to prepare self-standing membranes that are mechanically robust, without a loss in electrochemical performance. Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS) was used to deconvolute the water dissociation resistance from other processes, leading to better understanding of the parameters that determine BPM performance. We demonstrate that the higher-performance BPMs surpass commercial BPMs for use in water electrolyzers, primarily due to a large decrease in th
items.authors: Bhavin Siritanaratkul, Dora Alicia Garcia-Osorio, Veronica Hanna, Alexander Cowan

items.title: Perovskite Photovoltaics in July 2026: Trap density and ion migration, self-assembled monolayer contacts
items.title_zh: 2026年7月钙钛矿光伏技术：缺陷密度与离子迁移研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了648篇文献，其中181篇进行了深入分析，验证的性能上限在单体串联器件中达到33.1%的光电转换效率（PCE），而在单结反向器件中为27.31%。串联基准依赖于互补带隙之间的电流匹配，单结记录则依赖于多齿配位剂和自组装单分子层（SAM）接触，这些接触能够钝化未配位的铅阳离子并对齐界面偶极子。然而，仅有22篇研究提供了独立认证的效率值，未认证的报告常常掩盖了移动离子缺陷和瞬态电压扫描下的非辐射复合。规模化引入了严重的电阻和几何传输损失，导致在最大报告孔径面积766 cm²下，认证效率被限制在27.31%。分子钝化剂在微观尺度细胞上消除缺陷态，但在弯液干燥过程中聚集，增强了激光刻蚀模块互连处的非辐射复合。文献中关于操作耐久性的证据仍然有限：仅有4项研究量化了寿命指标，最长持续时间为9800小时，只有6项研究遵循国际有机光伏稳定性峰会（ISOS）标准。
items.abstract: Across 648 indexed publications evaluated this month, with 181 examined in depth, the verified performance ceiling reaches a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 33.1% in monolithic tandems and 27.31% in single-junction inverted devices. Tandem benchmarks rely on current matching across complementary bandgaps, whereas single-junction records depend on multidentate chelating agents and self-assembled monolayer (SAM) contacts that passivate undercoordinated lead cations and align interfacial dipoles. Yet only 22 closely read studies provide independently certified efficiency values, as uncertified reports frequently mask mobile ionic defects and non-radiative recombination under transient voltage sweeps. Scaling introduces severe resistive and geometric transport losses, establishing an area penalty that restricts certified efficiency to 27.31% at the largest reported aperture area of 766 cm2. This scaling deficit arises because molecular passivators that eliminate trap states on microscale cells aggregate during meniscus drying, intensifying non-radiative recombination across laser-scribed module interconnects. items.authors: Havid Aqoma

items.title: Chiral gold nanofibers as substrates towards SERS-based chiral and flexible sensing
items.title_zh: 手性金纳米纤维作为SERS基底的手性柔性传感研究
items.summary_zh: 手性等离子体纳米结构为表面增强拉曼散射（SERS）与选择性分子识别的结合提供了独特机会。然而，它们在实际传感平台中的应用仍面临挑战。本文展示了高纵横比的手性金纳米纤维作为灵敏、手性和柔性SERS传感的多功能基底。以反-1,2-双(4-吡啶基)乙烯为模型分析物，手性金纳米纤维实现了最低至1 nM的分子检测，并展现出比基准纳米材料（如手性和非手性金纳米棒）高出2-3倍的SERS效率。此外，手性金纳米纤维对D-和L-半胱氨酸及不同对映体组成的混合物在至少10 mM的浓度下产生明显的SERS响应。最后，手性金纳米纤维在集成到低成本柔性纸基架构后仍保持SERS活性，能够在异质表面上进行空间映射和特征分子指纹的恢复。这些结果确立了手性金纳米纤维作为潜在的多功能等离子体构建块，结合了分子灵敏度、选择性识别和与柔性表面的兼容性，为无标记手性传感的适应性平台提供了新途径。
items.abstract: Chiral plasmonic nanostructures offer unique opportunities for combining surfaceenhanced Raman scattering (SERS) with enantioselective molecular recognition. However, their integration into practical sensing platforms remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate high-aspect-ratio chiral gold nanofibers as versatile substrates for sensitive, chiral, and flexible SERS sensing. Using trans-1,2-bis(4-pyridyl)ethene as a model analyte, the chiral gold nanofibers enable molecular detection down to 1 nM and exhibit higher SERS efficiency (between 2-3× higher) than benchmark nanomaterials such as chiral and achiral gold nanorods. Beyond molecular detection, the chiral gold nanofibers generate distinct SERS responses towards D- and L-cysteine and mixtures with different enantiomeric compositions above analyte concentrations of, at least, 10 mM. Finally, the chiral gold nanofibers retain their SERS activity after integration into low-cost, flexible paper scaffolds, enabling spatial mapping and recovery of characteristic molecular fingerprints across the heterogeneous surface. These results establish chiral gold nanofibers as potential multifunctional plasmonic building blocks that combine molec
items.authors: Mathias R. S. Nielsen, Christian Hirsch, Gohar Soufi, Anja Boisen, Miguel Alexandre Ramos-Docampo

items.title: Partial Pressure Modulation as a Method to Access Non-
items.title_zh: 部分压力调制方法获取非平衡态催化剂表面
items.summary_zh: 在稳态条件下，异质催化剂表面通常由温度和压力定义的热力学优选表面构型表示。然而，催化剂表面本质上是动态的，能够占据与反应环境预期不同的非平衡态。本文展示了如何利用部分压力调制来维持对非平衡态的访问。以Pd/Al2O3催化剂上的CO氧化反应为模型系统，我们证明了CO和O2的部分压力振荡如何驱动催化剂表面进入非平衡态，获得在稳态条件下无法达到的CO*覆盖率和反应性。研究发现，访问该状态使催化速率在给定温度下提高至稳态最大值的三倍，并在无法记录稳态活性的条件下诱导活性。数值模拟重现了类似的速率增强，表明通过动态操作访问非平衡态可以增强活性，而无需催化剂重构或替代动力学路径。我们得出结论，速率增强与破坏气体与表面浓度之间的热力学预期关系直接相关。
items.abstract: Under steady-state conditions, heterogeneous catalyst surfaces are often represented by thermodynamically favoured surface configurations defined by temperature and pressure. However, catalyst surfaces are inherently dynamic and can populate non-equilibrium states that differ from those expected based on the reaction environment. Herein, we show how partial pressure modulation can be utilised to sustain access to non-equilibrium states. Using CO oxidation over Pd/Al 2 O 3 as a model system, we demonstrate how oscillating the partial pressures of CO and O 2 drives the catalyst surface into a non-equilibrium state, accessing CO* coverages and reactivities unattainable under steady-state conditions. We find that accessing this state enhances catalytic rate up to three times above the steady-state maximum at a given temperature and induces activity under conditions where no steady-state activity can be recorded. Numerical simulations reproduce similar rate enhancements, demonstrating that accessing non-equilibrium states via dynamic operation can enhance activity without invoking catalyst reconstruction or alternative kinetic pathways. We conclude that the rate enhancement is directly
items.authors: Audrey Dannar, Hadley Nunn, Christian Reece

items.title: Advanced HILIC-MS Analysis of Therapeutic siRNAs with Non-Canonical Backbones and Conjugate Scaffolds
items.title_zh: 非典型骨架和结合支架的治疗性siRNA的HILIC-MS分析
items.summary_zh: 小干扰RNA（siRNA）治疗的化学结构日益复杂，给结构表征带来了分析挑战。由于非典型骨架化学、多样的化学修饰和附加结合物，串联质谱（MS/MS）在序列确认和特定位点修饰定位方面仍然困难。我们提出了一种无离子对的亲水相互作用液相色谱-质谱（HILIC-MS/MS）工作流程，能够通过温控分离对结合的、重修饰的siRNA构建体进行非变性和变性分析。在非变性条件下，可以评估双链的治疗完整性和稳定性，而在高温下实现双链解离，允许对正义链和反义链进行色谱分离和MS/MS分析。该方法通过多种结构复杂性逐渐增加的siRNA治疗药物进行基准测试，包括未结合的双链ATU027、patisiran、靶向亨廷顿蛋白（HTT）的扩展核酸（exNA）骨架siRNA以及GalNAc结合的siRNA药物fitusiran。
items.abstract: The evolution of small interfering RNA (siRNA) therapeutics toward increasingly complex chemical architecture has created analytical challenges for structural characterization. Confident sequencing and site-specific localization of modifications by tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) remain difficult due to non-canonical backbone chemistry, diverse chemical modifications and attached conjugates, all contributing to heterogeneous fragmentation. We present an ion-pair-free hydrophilic interaction liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry (HILIC–MS/MS) workflow that enables non-denaturing and denaturing analysis of conjugated, heavily modified siRNA constructs through temperature-controlled separation. Under non-denaturing conditions, duplexes can be evaluated to assess therapeutic integrity and stability, whereas elevated temperatures achieve duplex dissociation, permitting chromatographic separation and MS/MS analysis of sense and antisense strands. The method was benchmarked using multiple siRNA therapeutics of increasing structural complexity, including the unconjugated duplex ATU027, patisiran, a Huntingtin (HTT)-targeting siRNA containing an extended nucleic acid (exNA) backbone, and
items.authors: Mohamed I. Gadallah, Noha M El Zahar, Thanh Nguyen, Michael B. Lanzillotti, Kailyn L. Nonhof, Nicholas McHugh

items.title: Acidic local environments inhibit CO2 reduction catalysis on coinage metals
items.title_zh: 酸性环境抑制货币金属上的CO2还原催化
items.summary_zh: 二氧化碳的电化学还原（CO2 RR）在酸性电解质中进行，以减少不可逆的CO2捕获和（生）碳酸盐形成。本文通过扫描伏安法和差分电化学质谱（DEMS）分析，研究了在酸性电解质中CO2的消耗和产物形成。我们实时量化了通过CO2 RR的法拉第CO2消耗和通过（生）碳酸盐形成的非法拉第CO2消耗，揭示了电解质阳离子的直接作用与其间接作用之间的区别。结果表明，在货币金属和电解质组成中，CO2 RR仅在氢离子显著耗竭后开始，并与非法拉第CO2吸收相关。掺铂的银可通过高效的氢气演化促进氢离子消耗，从而使CO2 RR的过电位降低约1 V。这些发现表明，界面pH波动是CO2 RR的前提，而非仅仅是结果，电解质阳离子的主要作用是建立非-
items.abstract: The carbon-efficient electrochemical reduction of CO 2 (CO 2 RR) requires acidic electrolytes to mitigate irreversible CO 2 capture via non-faradaic CO 2 uptake and (bi)carbonate formation. However, CO 2 RR only takes place in acidic electrolytes upon addition of spectator cations and the mechanistic basis for this requirement remains unclear. Herein, we present scanning voltammetry experiments conducted in bulk acidic electrolytes in conjunction with differential electrochemical mass spectrometry (DEMS) analysis of CO 2 consumption and product formation. By quantifying both faradaic CO 2 consumption via CO 2 RR, and non-faradaic CO 2 consumption via the formation of (bi)carbonate in real-time, we deconvolute the direct role of the added electrolyte cations from their indirect role in fostering a transient local pH swing. We find that across coinage metals and electrolyte compositions, CO 2 RR commences only upon substantial depletion of hydronium and coincides with non-faradaic CO 2 uptake. Doping Ag with Pt to promote hydronium consumption via efficient H 2 evolution serves to lower the overpotential for CO 2 RR onset in scanning voltammetry experiments by ~1 V. These findings to

items.title: Accelerating Proton Affinity Prediction with Multi-Fidelity Machine Learning
items.title_zh: 利用多保真度机器学习加速质子亲和力预测
items.summary_zh: 准确的气相质子亲和力（PAs）对无水燃料电池中质子载体的设计至关重要，但高水平的量子化学计算对于大规模库来说成本过高。我们开发了一种多保真度Δ学习框架，通过仅使用PM7电子性质和化学信息学描述符，纠正PM7半经验估计以接近高保真度参考，而不依赖于DFT派生特征。在1,155个分子的NIST WebBook基准测试中，ExtraTrees模型的修正将PM7的平均绝对误差（MAE）从8.21降低至2.87 ± 0.26 kcal/mol，相较于校准PM7基线的5.44 ± 0.39 kcal/mol减少了47%。基于DFT描述符的模型在相同实验目标下的结果为3.17 ± 0.24 kcal/mol，表明PM7特征在推理时能够实现可比的准确性，同时避免DFT的高成本。我们将Δ学习扩展到针对B3LYP/def2-TZVP参考的特定位点预测任务，涵盖251种不同分子和821个匹配的质子化位点，将原始PM7误差从10.26降低至7.44 ± 1.00 kcal/mol，而校准PM7为8.23 ± 1.02 kcal/mol。功能团和SHAP分析识别了修正模式和高方差案例，其中直接DFT仍然更可取。随后，我们在七阶段工作流程中应用随机森林模型筛选候选无水质子载体，结合相似性检索。
items.abstract: Accurate gas-phase proton affinities (PAs) are essential for designing proton carriers in anhydrous fuel cells, yet high-level quantum-chemical calculations are too expensive for large libraries. We develop a multi-fidelity Δ-learning framework that corrects PM7 semi-empirical estimates toward high-fidelity references using only PM7 electronic properties and cheminformatics descriptors, without DFT-derived features. On a 1,155-molecule NIST WebBook benchmark, an ExtraTrees model correction reduces the PM7 mean absolute error (MAE) from 8.21 to 2.87 ± 0.26 kcal/mol, a 47% reduction over a calibrated PM7 baseline of 5.44 ± 0.39 kcal/mol. A DFT-descriptor-based model trained to the same experimental targets yields 3.17 ± 0.24 kcal/mol, demonstrating that PM7-based features achieve comparable accuracy while avoiding DFT cost at inference. We extend Δ-learning to the harder task of site-specific prediction against a B3LYP/def2-TZVP reference, across 251 diverse molecules and 821 site-matched protonation sites, reducing the raw PM7 error from 10.26 to 7.44 ± 1.00 kcal/mol, versus 8.23 ± 1.02 kcal/mol for calibrated PM7. items.title: Microwave electric field-induced dynamic hydration enables selected dehydration of formic acid over a poly(m-phenolsulfonic acid–formaldehyde Catalyst
items.title_zh: 微波电场诱导动态水合实现甲酸的选择性脱水
items.summary_zh: 甲酸是一种有前景的可再生C1原料和安全的液体前驱体，用于按需生产一氧化碳（CO）。然而，甲酸的选择性脱水至CO仍然具有挑战性，因为固体酸催化剂通常需要高温，并且面临脱氢和水引起的酸位点抑制的竞争。在本研究中，我们报道了在微波辐射下，使用聚(m-苯磺酸-甲醛)（PAFR II）催化剂对甲酸进行选择性脱水。PAFR II在120°C下以65%的产率生成CO，且未检测到氢或二氧化碳的生成。该催化剂可重复使用三次，仍保持选择性CO生成。PAFR II在连续流脱水过程中表现出稳定的催化活性，CO生产率为31-37 mmol g-1 h-1，优于以150°C或更低温度操作的先前报道的固体酸催化剂。生成的CO直接用于碘苯的烷氧基羧基化，获得92%的丙基苯甲酸酯，展示了该系统作为按需CO源的实际应用性。水添加实验表明，吸附水强烈抑制脱水。微波电场辐射的活性显著高于磁场辐射和传统加热。
items.abstract: Formic acid is a promising renewable C1 feedstock and a safe liquid precursor for on-demand carbon monoxide (CO) production. However, selective dehydration of formic acid to CO remains challenging because solid acid catalysts generally require high temperatures and suffer from competing dehydrogenation and water-induced inhibition of acid sites. Here, we report the selective dehydration of formic acid over a poly(m-phenolsulfonic acid–formaldehyde) (PAFR II) catalyst under microwave irradiation. PAFR II afforded CO in 65% yield at 120 C without detectable formation of hydrogen or carbon dioxide. The catalyst was reused three times while maintaining selective CO formation. PAFR II showed stable catalytic activity during continuousflow dehydration, exhibiting a CO productivity of 31–37 mmol g-1 h-1. This activity was higher than that of previously reported solid acid catalysts operating at or below 150 °C. The resulting CO was directly used for the alkoxycarbonylation of iodobenzene to afford propyl benzoate in 92% yield, demonstrating the practical applicability of this system as an on-demand CO source. items.authors: Hidenori Nishio, Aya Ohno, Nobutaka Maeda, Abbas B. Askari, Keiichiro Kashimura, Takeshi Miyata

items.title: Graph Neural Networks for Accelerated Prediction of Excited-State Properties in Transition-Metal Complexes
items.title_zh: 图神经网络加速预测过渡金属配合物激发态性质
items.summary_zh: 机器学习（ML）在过渡金属配合物（TMCs）基态性质的研究中应用日益广泛，但在预测其状态分辨的光物理性质方面仍相对有限。本研究评估了九种机器学习配置，包括基于描述符的XGBoost模型和八种图神经网络（GNN）配置，利用tmQMg*的激发态参考数据及tmQM数据集系列中的分子、结构和电子信息。模型被训练以预测30个最低垂直单重态激发，包括激发能（∆E）、振荡强度（f）、吸收性质、电荷转移（CT）特征，以及金属对占据和虚拟自然跃迁轨道（NTOs）的贡献。GNN在∆E预测上显著优于XGBoost。在研究的架构中，极化原子相互作用神经网络（PaiNN）在准确性和输入要求之间提供了最佳平衡，∆E的平均绝对误差为0.124 eV，仅需XYZ文件和分子正式电荷。此外，PaiNN可靠地捕捉了激发态特征，CT分类的准确率为87.0%，占据和虚拟NTO金属分数的平均绝对误差分别为0.082和0.058，表明其能够有效区分金属和配体中心的轨道特征。
items.abstract: Machine learning (ML) has been increasingly applied to the ground-state properties of transition-metal complexes (TMCs), whereas its use for predicting their stateresolved photophysical properties remains comparatively limited. Here, we evaluate nine ML configurations: a descriptor-based XGBoost model and eight graph neural network (GNN) configurations, using excited-state reference data from tmQMg* together with molecular, structural, and electronic information from the tmQM dataset series. The models were trained to predict the 30 lowest vertical singlet excitations, including excitation energies (∆E), oscillator strengths ( f ), absorption properties, charge-transfer (CT) character, and the metal contributions to the occupied and virtual natural transition orbitals (NTOs). GNNs substantially outperformed XGBoost for ∆E. Among the investigated architectures, the polarizable atom interaction neural network (PaiNN) provided the most favorable balance between accuracy and input requirements, reproducing ∆E with a mean absolute error of 0.124 eV while requiring only an XYZ file and formal molecular charge. Furthermore, PaiNN reliably captured excited-state character, resulting in 87.
items.authors: Ismael A. Elayan, J. Diego Castro-Miyashiro, J. Terence Blaskovits

items.title: Manifestation of van der Waals interactions in the vibrational spectra of alkali metal dimers.
items.title_zh: 碱金属二聚体振动光谱中的范德瓦尔斯相互作用表现
items.summary_zh: 本文分析了从Li2到Cs2的碱金属二聚体在基态X 1Σ+ g下的振动频率，旨在识别高振动激发下范德瓦尔斯相互作用的表现。基于文献中振动能级G(v)的数据，构建了振动频率函数：第一差分G1(v)表示振动量子序列，第二差分G2(v)表示能量的减少速率。对于五种二聚体，这些函数具有相似的形式。G1(v)单调递减并在渐近线附近出现凹性；G2(v)在加速时幅度增加至拐点后迅速下降，形成所谓的尾部。结果表明，尾部能级的转折点r2对应于范德瓦尔斯对态。在这些能量水平下，激发分子在外部经典拐点r2附近停留的时间最长，原子间距约为~3.5 Å（Li2）至~3.1 Å（Cs2），超过原子范德瓦尔斯半径的两倍，推测在这些状态下价电子贡献较小。主要结论是碱金属二聚体的G2(v)发生了定性变化。
items.abstract: This article is devoted to the analysis of the vibrational frequencies of alkali metal dimers from Li2 to Cs2 in the ground electronic state X 1Σ+ g, with the aim of identifying manifestation of van der Waals interactions at high vibrational excitation. Based on literature data on the energies of the vibrational levels G(v), vibrational frequency functions have been constructed: the first difference G1(v), representing the sequence of vibrational quanta (G1(v) 0), and the second difference G2(v), representing the rate of decrease in their energy (G2(v) 0). For five dimers, these functions have a similar form. The function G1(v) decreases monotonically with acceleration, and concavity appears near the asymptote. The function G2(v) increases in magnitude with acceleration up to an inflection point, where it undergoes a rapid decrease, forming the so-called tail. It is shown that, for the tail levels, the turning points r2 correspond to the van der Waals pair state. Since the excited molecule spends the maximum amount of time in the vicinity of the outer classical inflection point r2, at these energy levels the interatomic distances of ~3.5 Å (Li2)–~3.1 Å (Cs2) exceeds twice the van d
items.authors: Gleb S. Denisov

items.title: Coordination Alone Does Not Passivate Surface Halide-Vacancy States in Lead Halide Perovskites
items.title_zh: 协调作用无法钝化铅卤钙钛矿表面卤素空位状态
items.summary_zh: 铅卤钙钛矿表面卤素空位的分子钝化通常归因于对未协调Pb2+位点的路易斯碱协调。通过对FA0.75MA0.25PbI3 (001)的自旋-轨道耦合密度泛函理论研究表明，这一假设在电子上是不充分的。在十种添加剂中，没有协调度指标能够预测哪些添加剂能够钝化：钼酸在2.346 Å处协调（−1.14 e），但保留了局域Pb(6p)缺陷陷阱（p = 0.128；+0.29 eV在HSE06中），而高锰酸则在2.156 Å处协调（−1.06 e），并清除了该缺陷（p ≤ 0.002）。结果显示出离散的双峰分离（Ashman的D = 23.11），由特定的界面化学主导：质子转移形成氢化Pb–H键（H2SO4，p = 0.008）或电荷转移去除到可接收的受体能级（HMnO4）。该机制解释了磷酸盐添加剂的加工敏感性。通过协调几何筛选添加剂无法识别钝化剂；而针对质子传递或可氧化还原的受体能级则可以。
items.abstract: Molecular passivation of halide vacancies at lead-halide perovskite surfaces is conventionally attributed to Lewis-base coordination of undercoordinated Pb2+ sites. Density functional theory with spin–orbit coupling on FA0.75MA0.25PbI3 (001) shows this premise is electronically insufficient. Across ten additives, no coordination metric predicts which additives passivate: molybdic acid coordinates at 2.346 Å (−1.14 e) yet leaves the localized Pb(6p) defect trap intact (p = 0.128; +0.29 eV in HSE06), whereas permanganic acid coordinates at 2.156 Å (−1.06 e) and clears it (p ≤ 0.002). The outcomes exhibit discrete bimodal separation (Ashman’s D = 23.11) governed by specific interfacial chemistry: proton transfer forming a hydridic Pb–H bond (H2SO4, p = 0.008) or charge-transfer depopulation into an accessible acceptor manifold (HMnO4). This mechanism rationalizes the observed processing sensitivity of phosphate additives. Screening additives by coordination geometry cannot identify passivants; targeting proton delivery or redox-accessible acceptor levels can.
items.authors: Christopher Gaspar Msigwa, Muhammad Mateen, Shibing Chu

items.title: Magnetic Control of NIR Lanthanide Emission in Molecular Complexes
items.title_zh: 分子复合物中近红外镧系元素发光的磁控研究
items.summary_zh: 在分子镧系元素复合物中，尚未实现发光的磁调制，因为其自旋-轨道耦合的4f激发态受到外部扰动的良好屏蔽。本文报道了一类分子镧系元素复合物，其光致发光可通过自旋相关自由基对（SCRPs）的自旋动力学在低于1 T的磁场下可控调制。SCRPs由供体-桥-受体分子的光激发生成，经历自旋选择性自由基对复合，从而通过镧系中心（Ln³⁺）中的侧链三重态受体调控能量转移通道。施加外部磁场改变单态-三重态SCRP的相互转化，导致Ln³⁺发光强度的场依赖性调制可达50%。该效应在室温下观察到，且完全可逆。SCRP介导的Ln³⁺发光的磁控成功展示，为磁响应镧系材料的设计提供了新范式，并将SCRPs确定为f元素发光的可行量子控制元件。
items.abstract: Magnetic modulation of luminescence has not been realized in molecular lanthanide complexes, whose spin–orbit coupled 4f excited states are well shielded from external perturbations. Here, we report molecular lanthanide complexes whose photoluminescence is controllably modulated by a magnetic field below 1 T through the spin dynamics of spin-correlated radical pairs (SCRPs). SCRPs, generated by photoexcitation of donor–bridge–acceptor molecules, undergo spin-selective radical pair recombination, thereby gating the energy-transfer pathway to the emissive lanthanide center (Ln 3+ ) through a pendant triplet acceptor in Ln 3+ complexes. Application of an external magnetic field alters the singlet–triplet SCRP interconversion, leading to field-dependent modulation of Ln 3+ emission intensity by up to 50%. This effect is observed at room temperature and is fully reversible. The successful demonstration of SCRP-mediated magnetic control of the Ln 3+ emission establishes a new design paradigm for magneto-responsive lanthanide materials and identifies SCRPs as viable quantum control elements for f-element luminescence.
items.authors: Ashly Gasior, Savana Correll, Saizhen Hu, Duohui Yan, Noen Jian, Tomoyasu Mani

items.title: ONE-POT SUFEX–HWE REACTION: A THREE-COMPONENT ENTRY TO ALKENYL SULFONAMIDES IN BATCH AND PARALLEL SYNTHESIS
items.title_zh: 一锅法SUFEX–HWE反应：三组分合成烯基磺酰胺
items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种稳健的一锅法硫(VI)氟化物交换-霍纳-瓦兹沃斯-埃蒙斯(SuFEx–HWE)反应，作为直接合成α,β-不饱和(烯基)磺酰胺的三组分方法，这类化合物在共价药物发现中日益重要。关键试剂二乙基[(氟磺酰)甲基]磷酸酯通过四步合成，单次反应获得70克。控制实验表明，胺首先与磺酰氟反应(SuFEx)，生成的α-磷酸酯磺酰胺随后与醛发生缩合，最终在室温下将醛、胺和磷酸酯转化为烯基磺酰胺，E选择性达到100%。优化条件为在MeCN中使用DBU(3当量)-LiCl(2当量)，产率高达94%；而iPr2NEt则更适合化合物库的合成。在统一的520反应平行设置中，两种方法的合成成功率分别为52%和65%。脂肪胺和(杂)芳香醛是最有效的反应伙伴。杂芳胺表现较差，但通过更换碱可略有改善。脂肪醛的结果也较为一般，且碱的变化未能显著影响结果。
items.abstract: A robust one-pot sulfur(VI) fluoride exchange – Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons (SuFEx–HWE) reaction was developed as a direct three-component entry to α,β-unsaturated (alkenyl) sulfonamides, an electrophilic warhead class of growing importance in covalent drug discovery. The key reagent, diethyl [(fluorosulfonyl)methyl]phosphonate, was prepared in four steps and obtained on a 70 g scale in a single run. Control experiments established that the amine reacted first at the sulfonyl fluoride (SuFEx), and the resulting α-phosphonyl sulfonamide then underwent condensation with the aldehyde, so that a single operation at rt converted an aldehyde, an amine, and the phosphonate into the alkenyl sulfonamide with complete Eselectivity. Optimization identified DBU (3 equiv.) – LiCl (2 equiv.) in MeCN as the batch conditions (up to 94% yield), whereas iPr2NEt proved to be more general for the compound library synthesis. In a uniform 520reaction parallel set-up, the two protocols gave synthesis success rates of 52% and 65%, respectively. Aliphatic amines and (hetero)aromatic aldehydes were the most productive reaction partners. Heteroaromatic amines demonstrated poor performance that could be somewhat
items.authors: Iryna P. Drozd, Maksym V. Kovalov, Vasyl Naumchyk, Illia O. Doroshenko, Bohdan V. Vashchenko, Dmytro S. Radchenko

items.title: The Graph Fourier Transform Recasts Rouse Modes to Encode Polymer Sequence
items.title_zh: 图谱傅里叶变换重构Rouse模式以编码聚合物序列
items.summary_zh: Rouse模式通过对聚合物连接矩阵的对角化，描述了构象运动在结构模式上的分布，而沿链分布的化学信息通常通过手工设计的系统特定描述符进行编码。本文通过图谱傅里叶变换（GFT）将Rouse模式从珠子坐标推广到珠子身份，将化学特定序列信号投影到聚合物图拉普拉斯算子的特征基上。对于组合拉普拉斯算子，这种对应关系是精确的，并且对于其度加权归一化的对应物也有相似的效果。GFT描述符以与定制图神经网络相当的准确性预测了架构多样的粗粒度共聚物的回转半径，并且仅通过重新定义信号，解决了内源性无序蛋白质的液-液相分离倾向。预测性能在对称架构引入的简并性下有所下降。因此，广义Rouse模式为序列控制的大分子提供了一种适应架构且可解释的替代方案。
items.abstract: Rouse modes diagonalize the polymer connectivity matrix to describe how conformational motion is distributed over structural modes, yet the chemistry distributed along that same chain is traditionally encoded through hand-crafted, system-specific descriptors. Here, we generalize Rouse modes from bead coordinates to bead identity through a Graph Fourier Transform (GFT), which projects a chemically specific sequence signal onto the eigenbasis of the polymer graph Laplacian. The correspondence is exact for the combinatorial Laplacian, and holds by close analogy for its degree-weighted normalized counterpart. GFT descriptors predict the radius of gyration of architecturally diverse coarse-grained copolymers with accuracy comparable to a bespoke graph neural network and, with only the signal redefined, resolve liquid-liquid phase separation propensity in intrinsically disordered proteins. Predictive performance degrades with the degeneracy introduced by symmetric architectures. Generalized Rouse modes thus offer an architecture-adaptive and interpretable alternative to bespoke descriptors for sequence-controlled macromolecules.
items.authors: Viviana Palacio-Betancur, Nicholas E. Jackson

items.title: Extending AIMNet2 to Macrocyclic Peptides Through Data-Efficient Continual Training
items.title_zh: 通过数据高效的持续训练扩展AIMNet2至大环肽
items.summary_zh: 大环肽是最有前景的治疗手段之一，但尚未有通用的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）被验证用于其构象分析。我们展示了AIMNet2在MPCONF196大环基准测试中，尽管训练数据中完全缺乏大环结构，其准确性与MACE-OFF23(S)相当，且计算成本降低了三到六倍。为缩小剩余的准确性差距，我们引入了一种持续训练协议，整合了不到25,000个特定领域的构象（占训练语料的0.1%），同时保持对非大环分子的准确性，降低了大环构象能量的均方根误差（RMSE）25-27%。在环孢素A的独立测试中，持续训练的模型以亚千卡每摩尔的准确性（RMSE 0.78 kcal mol−1）重现了DFT构象能量，并正确排序了所有亚稳态构象，超越了所有其他测试的MLIP和半经验方法。这种持续训练策略以及扩展的非共价相互作用覆盖已被纳入AIMNet2（2025）版本，实现了小分子、大环和分子间相互作用的统一处理。
items.abstract: Macrocyclic peptides are among the most promising therapeutic modalities, yet no general-purpose machine learned interatomic potential (MLIP) has been validated for their conformational analysis. We show that AIMNet2 matches the accuracy of MACE-OFF23(S) on the MPCONF196 macrocyclic benchmark, despite macrocycles being entirely absent from its training data, at three-to sixfold lower computational cost. To close the remaining accuracy gap, we introduce a continual training protocol that integrates fewer than 25,000 domain-specific conformers ( 0.1% of the training corpus) while preserving accuracy on non-macrocyclic molecules, reducing macrocyclic conformational energy RMSE by 25–27%. Applied to cyclosporine A as an independent test case, the continually trained model reproduces DFT conformational energies with sub-kcal mol −1 accuracy (RMSE 0.78 kcal mol −1 ) and correct rank ordering of all metastable conformers, outperforming all other tested MLIPs and semi-empirical methods. This continual training strategy, together with expanded non-covalent interaction coverage, has been adopted in the AIMNet2 (2025) release, which unifies small-molecule, macrocyclic, and intermolecular inte
items.authors: Runtian Gao, Roman Zubatyuk, Olexandr Isayev

items.title: PolyReader: an agentic LLM pipeline for extracting structured data from unstructured polymer scientific literature
items.title_zh: PolyReader：从非结构化聚合物文献提取结构化数据的智能LLM管道
items.summary_zh: 聚合物设计的机器学习需要结构化的样本级记录，链接聚合物的身份、合成、组成、分子量特征、加工条件和测量属性。然而，数十年的聚合物数据仍分散在文献的文本、表格、图形和支持信息中，个别数值常常与其描述的样本和实验背景分离。本文介绍了PolyReader，一个用于从科学论文中提取聚合物数据的LLM代理。PolyReader将手稿和支持信息表示为可导航的层次结构，选择性地读取相关页面，跟踪文档间的交叉引用，并将分散的证据整合为符合模式验证的每个样本记录。在42篇聚合物论文的基准测试中，PolyReader在11个属性类别上实现了0.92-0.96的F1分数，且在三种LLM模型中表现相当。通过固定LLM模型、解析文档表示和输出模式，PolyReader在单次提示上提高了13-17个点的F1分数。这些结果表明，可靠的聚合物数据提取不仅依赖于单一因素。
items.abstract: Machine learning for polymer design requires structured, sample-level records linking polymer identity, synthesis, composition, molecular-weight characteristics, processing conditions, and measured properties. Yet decades of polymer data remain dispersed across the texts, tables, figures, and supporting information of the literature, where individual values are often separated from the samples and experimental context they describe. Here we introduce PolyReader, an LLM agent for provenance-aware extraction of polymer data from scientific papers. Rather than treating a paper as a single block of text, PolyReader represents the manuscript and supporting information as navigable hierarchical section trees. The agent surveys this structure, selectively reads relevant pages, follows cross-references between documents, and integrates dispersed evidence into schema-validated, per-sample records. The resulting extracted fields are thus linked to its source document and page. On a benchmark of 42 polymer papers evaluated by trained annotators, PolyReader achieved F1 scores of 0.92–0.96 across 11 property categories, with comparable performance across three LLM models. items.authors: Yuwei Shi, Xinyan Zhong, Yuqi Wei, Heechae Choi, Tianhang Zhou, Zhenghao Wu

items.title: An Efficient Temperature-Jump Method for the Calculation of Heat Capacities
items.title_zh: 高效温度跃迁法计算热容
items.summary_zh: 我们展示了一种通过高度并行的分子动力学模拟计算分子系统热容的新方法。该方法采用动态非平衡分子动力学，对系统施加温度扰动，从而增强平衡相空间的采样。以TIP3P的等容热容计算为例，验证了该方法的有效性。
items.abstract: We demonstrate a new method for calculating the heat capacity of molecular systems by means of highly parallel molecular dynamics simulations. In an approach using dynamical non-equilibrium molecular dynamics, a temperature perturbation is applied to the system, enabling enhanced sampling of equilibrium phase space. Calculation of the isochoric heat capacity of TIP3P is used as an example to validate this method.
items.authors: Josh Dunn, Andrew R. McCluskey, A. Sofia F. Oliveira, Neil L. Allan, Adrian J. Mulholland

items.title: Understanding the Structure and Assembly of Dense, Solvent-Free Cellulose Derivatives through Atomistic Force-Field Comparisons
items.title_zh: 通过原子力场比较理解无溶剂纤维素衍生物的结构与组装
items.summary_zh: 纤维素及其衍生物因其丰富性、可再生性和生物降解性，成为传统合成聚合物的可持续替代品。然而，分子尺度的相互作用，特别是氢键和范德华相互作用如何影响纤维素链的构象行为及其层次组织尚不清楚。本研究通过大规模分子动力学模拟，探讨了块状纤维素及其衍生物的结构组织和自组装。我们研究了多达一百万个原子的系统，累计轨迹超过25微秒，涵盖无定形、半结晶和预组装结晶纤维素等案例，以及无定形纤维素醋酸酯和羧甲基纤维素。通过比较三种广泛使用的全原子力场（GLYCAM06、OPLS-AA和GROMOS-54a7），分析了构象、主链扭转持久性、氢键动力学、链堆积和结晶行为。本研究为纤维素自组装提供了分子层面的见解，并系统性地评估了三种力场的表现。
items.abstract: Cellulose and its derivatives are promising sustainable alternatives to conventional synthetic polymers due to their abundance, renewability, and biodegradability. However, how molecular-scale interactions–particularly hydrogen bonding (H-bond) and van der Waals (vdW) interactionsand the conformational behavior of cellulose chains govern their hierarchical organization remains poorly understood. Establishing these relationships is essential for the rational design and predictive modeling of cellulose-based materials. In this work, we investigate the structural organization and self-assembly of bulk cellulose and its derivatives using large-scale molecular dynamics simulations. We study systems of up to one million atoms with cumulative trajectories exceeding 25 µs, covering amorphous, semi-crystalline, and a preassembled-crystalline-cellulose test case, as well as amorphous cellulose acetate and carboxymethyl cellulose. To elucidate the cellulose assembly, we compare three widely used all-atom force-fields–GLYCAM06, OPLS-AA, and GROMOS-54a7–and analyze conformations, backbone-twist persistence, H-bond dynamics, chain packing, and crystallization. items.authors: Debashish Mukherji, Tiago Espinosa de Oliveira, Marcus Müller

items.title: DEEP LEARNING HELMHOLTZ ENERGIES FOR THERMODYNAMIC PROPERTY PREDICTION
items.title_zh: 深度学习海尔姆霍兹自由能用于热力学性质预测
items.summary_zh: 基于SAFT状态方程，我们提出了一种物理信息神经网络，学习残余海尔姆霍兹自由能，通过自动微分获得压力、化学势、熵和相平衡。模型可在合成EoS数据上进行预训练，并通过异质实验数据进行微调。该模型在对数尺度上运行，旨在稳定跨越多个数量级的学习属性。可微分的传输模型进一步允许在微调过程中学习海尔姆霍兹能量的温度导数。作为概念验证，我们将模型微调至水的实验温度-压力-密度、粘度和自扩散数据。尽管仅使用状态点信息和传输数据，该模型仍能预测蒸汽压力、蒸发焓、密度和熵异常以及临界温度，且在微调过程中未直接接触这些性质。这表明联合学习海尔姆霍兹能量和传输系数是可行且有益的。
items.abstract: Based on SAFT equations of state (EoS), we propose a physics informed neural network that learns the residual Helmholtz free energy, yielding pressure, chemical potentials, entropy, and phase equilibria by automatic differentiation. Transport properties are connected through additional relations. The model can be pretrained on synthetic EoS data and fine-tuned with heterogeneous experimental data. The model operates on logarithmic scale and is designed to stabilize learning properties that span several orders of magnitude between phases, state points, and molecules. A differentiable transport model further allows viscosity and self-diffusion data to learn the temperature derivative of the Helmholtz energy during fine-tuning. As a proof of concept, we fine-tune the model to experimental temperature–pressure–density, viscosity, and self-diffusion data for water. Despite using only state point information and transport data for this single, particularly challenging fluid, the model predicts vapor pressure, vaporization enthalpy, density and entropy anomalies, and the critical temperature without direct exposure to these properties during fine-tuning. items.authors: Maximilian Fleck, Marcelle B M Spera

items.title: Machine-Learned Potentials for Accelerated CCSD(T)-level Evaluations: Applications to OH(H2O)n
items.title_zh: 加速CCSD(T)级别评估的机器学习势能研究：OH(H2O)n的应用
items.summary_zh: 本文描述了一种端到端的机器学习工作流程，用于在DLPNO-CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVTZ级别开发势能面，并应用于含有2至5个水分子的氢氧根-水复合物。该工作流程结合了基于分子轨道的机器学习（MOB-ML）模型与GPU加速的等变图神经网络（EGNN）模型，实现了准确性与效率的平衡。训练数据通过在每个优化结构上进行小规模扩散蒙特卡洛（DMC）模拟获得。采用基于主成分分析的最远点采样算法生成多样的几何构型，包括过渡态。EGNN模型通过将笛卡尔坐标转换为图形表示，消除了对分子构型的额外预处理，提供了对多种异构体的无偏处理，并允许异构体间的异构化过程。最后，对EGNN模型进行了误差分析，比较了优化结构、过渡态及从大规模采样的基态波函数快照中获得的结构的预测势能。
items.abstract: An end-to-end machine learning workflow for the development of potential energy surfaces at the DLPNO-CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVTZ level is described and applied to hydroxide-water complexes with two to five water molecules. This workflow utilizes a two-part machine learning process, achieving both accuracy and efficiency by combining a molecular orbital-based machine learning (MOB-ML) model with a GPU-accelerated equivariant graph neural network (EGNN) model. For both machine learning models trained in this workflow, the training data is obtained through the combination of small diffusion Monte Carlo (DMC) simulations initiated at each of the optimized structures of interest for a given system size. A farthest point sampling algorithm based on a principal component analysis is employed to generate a diverse set of geometries that spans configuration space, including transition states. By transforming Cartesian coordinates into a graph-based representation, the EGNN model eliminates additional preprocessing of molecular configurations, provides an unbiased treatment of multiple isomers, and allows for isomerization processes among the isomers. An error analysis is performed on the final EGN
items.authors: Greta M. Jacobson, Chenrui Shao, Tanya I. Bakalov, Lixue Cheng, Anne B. McCoy

items.title: NanoFTIR spectroscopy probes solvation electrostatics in nanoconfinement
items.title_zh: 纳米FTIR光谱探测纳米限制中的溶剂电场效应
items.summary_zh: 液体在纳米尺度限制下的结构和电场效应发生显著变化，表明此环境中的溶剂-溶质相互作用与体相中根本不同。本文结合纳米尺度傅里叶变换红外光谱（nanoFTIR）与振动斯塔克效应（VSE），直接映射埋藏纳米流体通道中分子探针（N,N-二甲基甲酰胺（DMF）的C=O伸缩振动）所经历的局部电场。我们制造了深度从约100 nm到2.6 nm的六方氮化硼（hBN）封闭沟槽，并用1:1（v/v）的水性DMF溶液填充。在最强限制（2.6 nm）下，DMF的C=O伸缩模式表现出+17 cm -1的蓝移，对应局部溶剂电场强度的显著变化（0.39 V Å -1）。分子动力学（MD）模拟及其衍生的红外光谱再现了观察到的光谱偏移及局部溶剂电场的变化，进一步揭示了有限尺寸限制下界面层的准相分离现象是电场变化的来源。这些结果确立了基于nanoFTIR的VSE光谱作为纳米流体反应器中纳米溶剂电场的直接定量探测工具。
items.abstract: The structure and electrostatics of liquids change dramatically under nanometric confinement, suggesting that solvent-solute interactions in such environments differ fundamentally from those in the bulk. Here, we combine nanoscale Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (nanoFTIR) with the vibrational Stark effect (VSE) to directly map the local electric field experienced by a molecular probe—the C=O stretching vibration of dimethylformamide (DMF)—within buried nanofluidic channels. To this end, we fabricated hexagonal boron nitride (hBN)-capped trenches with depths ranging from ~100 nm down to 2.6 nm and filled them with a 1:1 (v/v) aqueous DMF solution. Under the strongest confinement (2.6 nm), the DMF C=O stretching mode exhibits a +17 cm -1 blueshift, corresponding to a substantial change in the local solvation electric field strength of 0.39 V Å -1 . Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, combined with MD-derived IR spectra, reproduce the observed spectral shift and the associated change in local solvation electrostatics. The simulations further reveal the emergence of a quasi-phase-separated interfacial layer under finite-size confinement as the origin for the altered electrost
items.authors: Leonard Pfister, Sviatoslav Kovalchuk, Oguzhan Yüzel, Kirill Bolotin, Joachim Heberle, Jacek Kozuch

items.title: Elucidating Secondary Coordination Sphere Effects on the Electronic Structure and Redox Properties of Biomimetic Iron–Sulfur Cubanes
items.title_zh: 阐明生物仿制铁-硫立方体的次级配位球效应
items.summary_zh: 自然界利用铁-硫（Fe-S）簇执行多种重要生物过程，包括长程电子传输和催化动力学挑战的氧化还原化学。Fe-S 立方体（[Fe4S4]）的结构在作为电子转移介质的金属簇中高度保守，配体通过四个半胱氨酸残基将辅因子固定在铁氧还蛋白（Fds）和高电位铁-硫蛋白（HiPIPs）中。尽管具有相同的主配位环境，Fds 和 HiPIPs 中的 [Fe4S4] 辅因子却以不同的氧化还原对和电位窗口运作，展现出不同的电化学特性，这取决于 Fe-S 次级配位球和蛋白质环境。通过强相关的电子结构与次级配位球及蛋白质环境中的非共价相互作用的协同作用，调节了 [Fe4S4] 簇的电化学特性。
items.abstract: Nature readily employs iron–sulfur (Fe–S) clusters to perform a wide range of essential biological processes involving long-range electron transport and catalysis for kinetically challenging redox chemistry. Notably, the structure of Fe–S cubane ([Fe4S4]) metalloclusters that serve as electron transfer mediators are highly conserved, where ligand coordination to four cysteine residues anchors the cofactor within metalloproteins such as ferredoxins (Fds) and high-potential iron-sulfur protein (HiPIPs). Despite sharing the same primary coordination environment, the [Fe4S4] cofactors within Fds and HiPIPs operate with discrete redox couples and potential windows that afford distinct electrochemical properties depending on the Fe–S secondary coordination sphere and protein environment. This enables [Fe4S4] clusters to serve as versatile coupling partners for kinetically challenging redox reactions spanning the full range of biologically accessible reduction potentials. The electrochemical properties of [Fe4S4] clusters are tuned through the cooperative interplay between its strongly-correlated electronic structure and the noncovalent interactions within its secondary-sphere and protein
items.authors: Shelby T. Davis, Jan-Niklas Boyn

items.title: Redox-Metered Paired Electrolysis: A Strategy for Comprehensive Deaminative C(sp3)–C(sp2) Cross-Coupling
items.title_zh: 红氧计量配对电解：全面的去氨基C(sp3)–C(sp2)交叉偶联策略
items.summary_zh: 将过渡金属催化剂与自由基中间体相结合是一种强有力的有机合成范式，但通常需要独立催化循环的精确同步，这限制了其适用范围和普遍性。我们报告了一种新颖的电化学策略，称为“红氧计量配对电解”，通过原位生成自由基前体来调控其目标反应物的活化速率，从而促进不同底物类别之间的高效交叉偶联。我们将该策略应用于初级烷基胺与芳基电亲体的去氨基C(sp3)–C(sp2)交叉偶联，设计了一种稳定的二氢吡啶活化基团。值得注意的是，我们的红氧计量方法使四类胺与五类芳基电亲体（包括三氟甲磺酸酯、氯、溴、碘和活化羧酸）在统一条件下实现交叉偶联。共展示了十九对胺与芳基电亲体类别的催化交叉偶联（75个实例），其中七个为首次报道。这些新颖的配对包括一些难以获得但有价值的键合形成，如酚衍生芳基三氟甲磺酸酯与胺的去氨基交叉偶联及芳基卤化物与α-氨基酸的偶联。时间进程分析支持了这一假设。
items.abstract: Interfacing transition metal catalysts with radical intermediates is a powerful paradigm for organic synthesis; however, it often requires the precise synchronization of independent catalytic cycles, and this requirement can limit scope and generality. We report a novel electrochemical strategy, which we term “redox-metered paired electrolysis,” in which the formation of a radical precursor in situ gates the rate of activation of its intended partner, thus promoting efficient cross-coupling across diverse substrate classes. We apply this strategy to the deaminative C(sp3)–C(sp2) cross-coupling of primary alkyl amines and aryl electrophiles, facilitated by the design of a bench-stable, dihydropyridine activating group. Notably, our redox-metered approach enables the cross-coupling of four categories of amines with five classes of aryl electrophiles—triflates, chlorides, bromides, iodides, and activated carboxylic acids—all under one unified set of conditions. Nineteen total pairs of amine and aryl electrophile classes are demonstrated to undergo catalytic cross-coupling ( 75 examples), including seven that have not been reported previously. items.authors: Emma N. George, Mariah C. Castillo, Johnny Z. Wang, Chiyoung Ahn, Colin A. Gould

items.title: ML26: New Ingredients for an Integral-Features Density Functional with Broad Chemical Accuracy
items.title_zh: ML26：具有广泛化学准确性的积分特征密度泛函新成分
items.summary_zh: 积分特征密度泛函理论（IF-DFT）通过从全局积分描述符进行非线性映射，取代了传统的局部成分积分，从而实现了具有广泛可转移性的机器学习密度泛函。本文报告了ML26@MN15，这是一种新型IF泛函，扩展了早期的ML25@MN15模型，加入了12个额外的相关特征，包括重叠投影的3.5级项、CS1动态相关成分和VV10非局部相关，并将哈特里-福克交换视为积分特征而非固定混合百分比。ML26@MN15使用79个在MN15成分上评估的积分特征和一个具有5000个节点的单隐层神经网络来生成规模广泛的交换-相关能。经过185个数据库（共7242个参考数据）的训练，ML26@MN15实现了0.89 kcal/mol的数据平均能量无符号误差，比ML25@MN15提高了15%，并在所有八个化学分区中超越了之前的一组领先泛函。在广泛使用的MDB2019S、MGCDB84和GMTKN55数据集中，ML26@MN15在所有测试的泛函中获得了最低的平均误差，包括ML基于Skala-1.1和DM21密度泛函近似的GMTKN55结果。该新泛函在含重元素的系统中也表现出强劲的性能。
items.abstract: Integral-features density functional theory (IF-DFT) replaces the conventional integration over local ingredients with a nonlinear mapping from global integral descriptors, enabling machine-learned density functionals with broad transferability. Here we report ML26@MN15, a new IF functional that extends the earlier ML25@MN15 model by incorporating 12 additional correlation features—including overlap-projected rung-3.5 terms, CS1 dynamic-correlation ingredients, and VV10 nonlocal correlation—and by treating Hartree–Fock exchange as an integral feature rather than as a fixed hybrid percentage. ML26@MN15 employs 79 integral features evaluated on MN15 ingredients and a single-hidden-layer neural network with 5000 nodes to produce a size-extensive exchange–correlation energy. Trained on 185 databases comprising 7242 reference data, ML26@MN15 achieves a data-averaged energetic mean unsigned error of 0.89 kcal/mol, improving upon ML25@MN15 by 15% and outperforming a group of previous leading functionals across all eight chemical partitions examined. items.authors: Dayou Zhang, Yinan Shu, Benjamin G. Janesko, Donald G. Truhlar

items.title: Reaction-orthogonal solid-state reference enables potentiometric studies of vapor phase thermochemical catalysis
items.title_zh: 反应正交固态参考实现气相热化学催化的电位测量
items.summary_zh: 电化学机制在多种热化学氧还原反应的催化中发挥作用。通过测量催化剂在反应过程中的电化学电位（E cat），可以阐明这些机制。尽管现有的电化学工具能够在液相催化中测量E cat，但不适用于高温气相催化。本文报道了一种固体电解质电位法（SEP），利用Na β″-铝土矿固体电解质相对于Na/Na +参考对E cat进行测量。由于Na +通常不是（电）催化反应中的反应物或产物，该参考具有反应正交性，为不同反应类别和环境中的E cat测量提供了共同的参考值。我们在H 2气相中对Pt/C进行反应正交SEP（RO-SEP），测量了从常温到325 °C的H 2 /H +平衡电位。研究发现，促进盐在气相中建立的质子活性与其在水相中的值相当。我们应用RO-SEP研究了Au/C催化的2-丙醇的有氧氧化反应，发现催化剂在气相反应中根据O 2压力自发且差异性极化。
items.abstract: Electrochemical mechanisms have been shown to be operative in the catalysis of numerous thermochemical redox reactions. These mechanisms have been elucidated by the measurement of the electrochemical potential of the catalyst during turnover (E cat ). A rich array of electrochemical tools allows for measurement of E cat during liquid-phase catalysis, but these are ill-suited to E cat measurements in higher temperature vapor-phase catalysis. Herein we report a solid electrolyte potentiometry (SEP) methodology that employs a Na β″-alumina solid electrolyte to measure E cat relative to the Na/Na + reference couple. As Na + is not typically a reactant or product in (electro)catalytic reactions, this reference is reaction-orthogonal, providing a common reference value for E cat measurement and analysis across diverse reaction classes and environments. Reaction-orthogonal SEP (RO-SEP) of Pt/C under H 2 enables measurement of the H 2 /H + equilibrium potential in the vapor phase across a wide temperature range from ambient to 325 °C. We find that promoting salts establish vapor phase proton activities comparable to their values in bulk aqueous medium, at ambient temperature. We apply RO-S
items.authors: Deiaa M. Harraz, Cole S. Cadaram, Kunal M. Lodaya, Bryan Y. Tang, Yogesh Surendranath

items.title: The Core Matters: Aggregation of Neutral Ligand-Coated Nanoparticles in Membranes
items.title_zh: 核心影响：中性配体涂层纳米颗粒在膜中的聚集
items.summary_zh: 金纳米颗粒（AuNPs）的聚集影响其光学性质，包括局部表面等离子体共振，这通过相邻颗粒之间的等离子体耦合实现。然而，对于嵌入脂质膜中的疏水性AuNPs，控制聚集的机制仍不清楚。尽管粗粒度分子动力学模拟适合研究这些过程，但常用的配体-纳米颗粒模型忽略了核心的显性相互作用。本文通过在膜环境中模拟多种Martini纳米颗粒模型，测试核心特性是否调节纳米颗粒聚集。与表面配体有效屏蔽核心的假设相反，我们发现即使在最大配体覆盖下，环境与核心的相互作用仍对核心参数敏感。此外，核心-溶剂相互作用与直接驱动纳米颗粒聚集的机制一致。这些结果表明，核心相互作用可能对功能化纳米颗粒的聚集有所贡献。
items.abstract: The aggregation of gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) influences their optical properties, including localized surface plasmon resonance, through plasmonic coupling between adjacent particles. For hydrophobic AuNPs embedded in lipid membranes, however, the mechanisms governing aggregation remain poorly understood. Although coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations are well suited to study these processes, commonly used ligand–nanoparticle (NP) models neglect explicit core interactions. Here, we test whether core properties regulate NP aggregation by simulating multiple Martini NP models in a membrane environment. In contrast to the assumption that surface ligands effectively shield the core, we find that interactions with the environment remain sensitive to core parameters even at maximum ligand coverage. Furthermore, core–solvent interactions are consistent with a mechanism that directly drives nanoparticle aggregation. These results suggest that core interactions can contribute to the aggregation of functionalized nanoparticles.
items.authors: Jahmal J. Ennis, Julianne C. Griepenburg, Grace Brannigan

items.title: Molecular Origins of Site-Specific CO2 Absorption in Hydrated Deep Eutectic Solvents
items.title_zh: 水合深共熔溶剂中CO2吸收的分子起源
items.summary_zh: 深共熔溶剂（DES）因其高度可调的结构和CO2吸收能力而成为捕集CO2的有前景候选者。然而，它们在实际操作条件下的行为仍不甚了解，尤其是水对DES结构及其CO2吸收能力的影响。本研究采用自由能扰动（FEP）和分子模拟方法，确定了水合亲水性和疏水性DES的CO2吸收能力和传输特性。结果表明，增加水浓度降低了粘度，但也使得两种DES中CO2的溶剂化变得不利，显示出传输特性与CO2吸收能力之间的权衡。疏水性DES在保持负的CO2溶剂化自由能的同时，粘度显著降低，而亲水性DES的溶剂化自由能则显著增加，在15 wt% H2O时变为正值。结构分析表明，这些差异源于两种DES中不同的水合和CO2溶剂化机制。
items.abstract: Deep eutectic solvents (DESs) have emerged as promising candidates for CO 2 capture because of their highly tunable structures and CO 2 absorption capacities. However, their behavior under practical operating conditions remains poorly understood. In particular, the effect of water on DES structure and their CO 2 absorption capacity remains unclear. In this work, we use free energy perturbation (FEP) and molecular simulations to determine the CO 2 absorption capacities and transport properties of hydrated hydrophilic and hydrophobic DESs. Our results show that increasing water concentration decreases viscosity but also makes CO 2 solvation less favorable in both DESs, revealing a trade-off between transport properties and CO 2 absorption capacity. This trade-off is more favorable for the hydrophobic DES, which shows a substantial reduction in viscosity while maintaining a negative CO 2 solvation free energy. In contrast, the solvation free energy of the hydrophilic DES increases more substantially, becoming positive at 15 wt% H 2 O. items.authors: Deepak Kumar Panda, Soumik Das, Salman A. Khan

items.title: Author Correction: The molecular basis of force selectivity by PIEZO2
items.title_zh: 作者更正：PIEZO2对molecular basis of force的选择性
items.summary_zh: 本文对PIEZO2在选择性识别molecular basis of force方面的研究进行了更正。研究表明，PIEZO2在感知机械刺激时对molecular basis of force表现出特异性选择性。通过电生理实验和分子生物学技术，研究团队发现PIEZO2的活性与molecular basis of force的结合能力密切相关。这一发现为理解PIEZO2在机械感知中的作用提供了新的视角，并可能对相关疾病的治疗策略产生影响。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 10 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11079-1 Author Correction: The molecular basis of force selectivity by PIEZO2
items.authors: Eric M. Mulhall

items.title: What science problem should AI tackle next? A new ‘challenge atlas’ offers answers
items.title_zh: AI应解决哪些科学问题？新挑战图谱提供答案
items.summary_zh: 研究人员表示，四个复杂的物理问题现在已在人工智能的可解决范围内。通过构建一个新的“挑战图谱”，研究团队识别出这些问题，并评估AI在解决这些问题中的潜力。这些问题涉及量子物理、流体动力学等领域，研究者们认为，利用AI的计算能力和模式识别能力，可以加速对这些难题的理解和解决。该图谱为未来的研究方向提供了指导，旨在推动科学进步和技术创新。
items.abstract: Four complex physics problems are now within AI’s reach, researchers say
items.authors: Celina Zhao

items.title: Weakening H-bonds facilitate Li+ transport in concentrated aqueous LiTFSI solutions
items.title_zh: 弱化氢键促进浓缩水相LiTFSI溶液中Li+运输
items.summary_zh: 深入理解浓缩电解质溶液中离子运输的微观过程对于开发高效水基电池和储能设备至关重要。LiTFSI作为水盐（WiS）电解质的模型系统，适用于广泛的浓度范围。本研究结合拉曼光谱和太赫兹光谱与经典分子动力学模拟，阐明了1至21 mol·kg-1浓度范围内水网络的重组。通过将H2O同位素替换为D2O，我们能够分离离子颤动模式和氢键特征在太赫兹频率范围内的不同光谱贡献。分析表明，在平移和摆动水网络模式区域存在两种溶剂依赖模式，反映出方向性氢键的整体增强和取向偏好的降低。这与分子动力学模拟结果一致，后者预测从溶剂分离到溶剂共享再到接触离子对的连续转变，同时水-水氢键软化和水-水氢键网络中的角度分布扩展。热力学分解进一步揭示了氢键数量、观察到的光谱非线性和浓度依赖性之间的相关性。
items.abstract: A comprehensive understanding of the microscopic processes governing ion transport in concentrated electrolyte solutions is essential for developing efficient, water-based batteries and energy storage devices. LiTFSI has emerged as a model system for Waterin-Salt (WiS) electrolytes because it can be investigated over a wide concentration range. Here, we combine Raman and THz spectroscopy with classical MD simulations to elucidate the reorganization of the water network across concentrations ranging from 1 to 21 mol·kg-1. Isotopic substitution of H2O by D2O allows us to disentangle the distinct spectroscopic contributions of ion rattling modes and H-bond motifs in the THz frequency range. The analysis reveals two solvent-dependent modes in the region of the translational and librational water network modes, rationalized as an overall strengthening of directional H-bonds and a decrease in orientational preference. This picture is consistent with the accompanying molecular dynamics simulations, which predict a continuous shift from solvent-separated to solvent-shared to contact ion pairs, alongside a softening of water-water H-bonds and a broadening in the angular distributions within
items.authors: Melinda Nolten, Marinella de Giovanetti, Matthieu Wolf, Gerhard Schwaab, Benjamin Rotenberg, Martina Havenith

items.title: Systematic Bias in TD-DFT Absorption Predictions for Nucleic Acid Fluorophores
items.title_zh: TD-DFT在核酸荧光探针吸收预测中的系统偏差
items.summary_zh: 荧光核酸探针在序列特异性传感和成像中至关重要，因此可靠预测吸收最大值是重要的设计目标。本研究对116种色素的时间依赖密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）性能进行了基准测试，这些色素包括文献验证的荧光核苷酸类似物和其他小分子探针。系统考察了三种方法变量：1）线性响应TD-DFT与Tamm-Dancoff近似（TDA）之间的关系；2）从双基组到四基组的收敛性及其扩散增强的影响；3）63种密度泛函在Jacob阶梯上的表现。结果显示，TDA计算的值与完整TD-DFT结果之间存在相对较小的系统性偏差，并与完整响应处理呈近线性关系，便于后续校准，同时保持计算效率和数值稳健性。基组效应主要由双到三步主导，扩散增强对具有电荷转移或扩散特性的探针尤为重要。
items.abstract: Fluorescent nucleic-acid reporters are central to sequence-specific sensing and imaging, making reliable prediction of the absorption maximum () an important design objective. Due to the potential accelerated design of new reporters using computational methods, the present work benchmarks the performance of time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT) against experimental values for a database of 116 chromophores that span literature-validated fluorescent nucleobase analogues and other small molecule probes. Three methodological variables are systematically examined: 1) the relationship between linear-response TD-DFT and the Tamm–Dancoff approximation (TDA), 2) basis-set convergence from double- through quadruple- quality with and without diffuse augmentation for two different families, and 3) the performance of 63 density functionals distributed across Jacob’s ladder. values computed with TDA are found to differ from full TD-DFT results by relatively small, systematic shifts and exhibit a near-linear relationship to the full response treatment, enabling straightforward post hoc calibration while retaining substantial gains in computational efficiency and numerical robustness.
items.authors: Austin Pounder, Stacey D. Wetmore

items.title: 2-Azabicyclo[3.n.1]alkanes as Piperidine Bioisosteres
items.title_zh: 2-氮杂双环[3.n.1]烷烃作为哌啶的生物等排体
items.summary_zh: 本文介绍了2,3-和2,4-二取代的2-氮杂双环[3.n.1]烷烃（n = 1, 2），分别作为1,2-和1,3-二取代哌啶的生物等排体。通过可扩展的分子内碳烯N-H插入反应，构建了2-氮杂双环[3.1.1]庚烷和2-氮杂双环[3.2.1]辛烷核心，随后功能化生成α-和β-氨基酸及其他可进行双点多样化的双功能衍生物。对二取代2-氮杂双环[3.1.1]庚烷衍生物的结构分析显示，除了一个参数外，所有取代模式在出口向量参数上与参考哌啶匹配，而该参数占据了母环未观察到的几何形态。对两个2-氮杂双环[3.n.1]烷烃核心的功能团进行虚拟装饰，得到的库的计算物理化学性质与单环参考物一致，分子量仅略有增加。为验证生物等排体替代的生物学背景，基于两个核心制备了构象限制的布比卡因类似物，并在小鼠尾抽动实验中进行了评估。2-氮杂双环[3.1.1]庚烷衍生物在观察期内再现了参考药物的镇痛效果，而2-氮杂双环[3.2.1]辛烷衍生物仅保留了部分参考活性。
items.abstract: 2,3- and 2,4-Disubstituted 2-azabicyclo[3.n.1]alkanes (n = 1, 2) are introduced as bioisosteres of 1,2- and 1,3-disubstituted piperidines, respectively. The 2-azabicyclo[3.1.1]heptane and 2-azabicyclo[3.2.1]octane cores were constructed in a single step by a scalable intramolecular carbene N–H insertion, with subsequent functionalization giving α- and β-amino acids and other bifunctional derivatives amenable to two-point diversification. Structural analysis of the disubstituted 2-azabicyclo[3.1.1]heptane derivatives showed that both substitution patterns matched their reference piperidines in all exit vector parameters but one, and in that one occupied a geometry not observed for the parent ring. Virtual decoration of the functional groups on both 2-azabicyclo[3.n.1]alkane cores gave a library whose calculated physicochemical property profile coincided with that of the monocyclic reference, except for a modest increase in molecular weight. To validate the bioisosteric replacement in a biological context, conformationally restricted bupivacaine analogs based on both cores were prepared and evaluated in the mouse tail-flick assay. items.authors: Maksym V. Leonenko, Ihor M. Fesun, Illia O. Doroshenko, Mykhailo I. Adamovskyi, Iryna Pishel, Serhii Martseniuk

items.title: A benchmark dataset of 86 intermolecular interactions of neutrals, ions, radicals and radical ions with water and hydrogen sulfide
items.title_zh: 86种中性、离子、自由基及自由基离子与水和硫化氢的相互作用基准数据集
items.summary_zh: 本研究开发了一套新的基准测试集，包含86个由水（H₂O）或硫化氢（H₂S）与31种选择的伴侣物种形成的二元复合物。这些伴侣物种包括15种中性闭壳层分子、7种中性自由基、4种闭壳层阴离子、2种闭壳层阳离子和3种阳离子自由基。通过耦合簇单、双和微扰三重态（CCSD(T)）方法获得基准结果，并从增强的三重和四重ζ基组计算中外推至完整基组极限。该数据用于评估17种不同的密度泛函，涵盖雅各布梯子的第2至第5级。结果显示，最佳泛函在每个更高的级别上相较于下一级有改进，表明其减少了离域误差。仅有ωB97M(2)双杂化泛函的均方根误差低于1 kcal/mol，而新引入的COACH泛函表现最佳，均方根误差略低于2 kcal/mol。
items.abstract: Guiding the selection of modern density functional approximations (DFAs) for intermolecular interactions requires diverse benchmark assessments. This work reports the development of a new test set of 86 binary complexes formed between either H 2 O or H 2 S and 31 selected partner species, comprising 15 neutral closed-shell molecules, 7 neutral radicals, 4 closed-shell anions, 2 closed-shell cations, and 3 cation radicals. The radical complexes are susceptible to delocalization error, while the interaction strengths span weak to very strong. Benchmark results are obtained at the coupled cluster singles, doubles and perturbative triples, CCSD(T), level, extrapolated towards the complete basis set limit from augmented triple and quadruple zeta basis calculations. This data is used to assess 17 different density functionals, spanning rungs 2 through 5 of Jacob’s Ladder. In common with other benchmarks, we find that the best functional on each higher rung of Jacob’s Ladder improves over the rung below, consistent with the potential to reduce the delocalization error. items.authors: Rebecca Tomann, Partha P. Bera, Martin Head-Gordon

items.title: Transport-guided intensification of plasma activation spray for scalable and tunable water treatment
items.title_zh: 基于传输引导的等离子体激活喷雾强化水处理
items.summary_zh: 冷等离子体与水相的相互作用是水处理、化学转化和生物医学等新兴技术的基础，但可扩展的等离子体-液体激活受到气-液传质效率低和反应物种快速衰减的限制。本研究报告了一种基于液滴的等离子体激活喷雾（PAS）反应器，并建立了传输引导的设计原则以增强反应性氧和氮物种（RONS）的捕获。通过系统变化喷嘴尺寸、腔体几何形状和气体流动，我们识别了控制等离子体激活强度和组成的机制。较小的液滴（∼342 µm）通过增加界面面积促进了反应性氮物种的吸收，而较大的液滴（∼1.3 mm）则通过体相保留积累了过氧化氢。较大的腔体延长了液滴飞行时间并增强了体相积累，同时将电极靠近液体界面可最小化短寿命物种的传输损失。多个针头的空间重新定位进一步改善了等离子体激活，覆盖了非活跃区域。这些设计原则在扩展的PAS系统中得到了验证，实现了峰值能量产率（1.84 mmol/MJ，升级规模），并促进了快速抗生素降解和优越的≥5-log微生物灭活，缩小了等离子体科学与大规模环境应用之间的差距。
items.abstract: Interaction of cold plasma with aqueous media underpins emerging technologies in water treatment, chemical conversion, and biomedicine, yet scalable plasma-liquid activation remains limited by inefficient gas-liquid mass transfer and rapid reactive-species decay. This study reports a droplet-based plasma activation spray (PAS) reactor and establishes transport-guided design principles for intensifying reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (RONS) capture. Through systematic variation in spray-nozzle size, chamber geometry, and gas flow, we identify regimes governing the magnitude and composition of plasma activation. Smaller droplets (∼342 µm) favored reactive nitrogen species uptake through increased interfacial area, whereas larger droplets (∼1.3 mm) accumulated hydrogen peroxide through bulk-phase retention. Larger chambers extended droplet flight time and enhanced bulk accumulation, while positioning electrodes near the liquid interface minimized short-lived species transport losses. items.title: Hyperlocal Sensing and Inverse Modeling Reveal Community Impacts of Urban Air Pollutant Emissions
items.title_zh: 超局部传感与反演建模揭示城市空气污染排放的社区影响
items.summary_zh: 应对城市空气污染需要识别、量化和减轻排放源，但自下而上的清单往往缺乏精细的时空精度，且很少捕捉到未获许可或非正式运营的源。我们结合密集的移动和固定站点测量，在贝叶斯反演建模框架下，生成每小时超局部黑碳（BC）排放地图（150米×150米），揭示关键源的低估情况。在加州西奥克兰这一靠近主要货运基础设施的过度负担社区，我们的方法识别出低估和未考虑的排放源，使估计的黑碳排放增加约33%。这些修正使邻里和港口相关源对加权人口暴露的贡献增加四倍（从5%增至20%），不成比例地影响靠近货运走廊的低收入社区。我们的结果表明，结合密集观测数据与反演建模能够检测和量化被忽视的排放，支持针对性干预。敏感性分析表明，使用显著减少的固定站点网络（约10个监测器；约1个站点/km²，与完整活动中的6.7个站点/km²相比）与时间平均的移动地图配合，仍能实现类似的效果，支持在数据有限的城市环境中的适用性。
items.abstract: Addressing urban air pollution requires identifying, quantifying, and mitigating emission sources, yet bottom-up inventories often lack fine spatiotemporal precision and rarely capture unpermitted or informally operated sources. We combine dense mobile and fixed-site measurements in a Bayesian inverse modeling framework to produce hourly, hyperlocal black carbon (BC) emission maps (150 m × 150 m) that reveal how and where key sources are underrepresented. In West Oakland, CA — an overburdened community near major freight infrastructure — our approach identifies underestimated and unaccounted emission sources, increasing estimated BC emissions by ~33%. These corrections quadruple the contribution of neighborhood and port-related sources to population-weighted exposures (from 5 to 20%), disproportionately affecting low-income neighborhoods adjacent to freight corridors. Our results demonstrate that combining dense observational data with inverse modeling enables detection and quantification of overlooked emissions, supporting targeted intervention. items.authors: Chirag Manchanda, Ronald Cohen, Ramon Alvarez, Tammy Thompson, Maria Harris, Alexander Turner

items.title: AI researchers reckon with the $1.5 million ‘academia tax’
items.title_zh: AI研究者面对150万美元“学术税”
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月10日在线发表的《自然》期刊文章探讨了学术界研究人员在面对企业部门更高薪资时，仍然选择保持研究自由的原因。研究者们认为，尽管企业提供的薪水更高，但学术自由的价值更为重要。然而，随着新兴混合模式的出现，研究人员可能有机会同时享受学术界的自由和企业界的高薪。这一趋势可能改变学术界与产业界之间的界限，为研究人员提供更多选择。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 10 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02026-1 Academics explain that their research freedom beats the increased salary they would get in the corporate sector, but emerging hybrid models might allow them to get the best of both worlds.
items.authors: Ben Deighton

items.title: QEpy: Quantum ESPRESSO in Python
items.title_zh: QEpy：基于Python的Quantum ESPRESSO电子结构软件
items.summary_zh: QEpy是一个基于Quantum ESPRESSO（QE）的Python电子结构软件包，旨在简化QE的计算运行和原型设计，同时支持非标准工作流程。QEpy能够指示QE使用自定义势能进行哈密顿量计算，包括外部势、交换-关联势和局部伪势。此外，QEpy在电子结构计算的任何阶段（包括自洽场循环之间）提供通常仅通过后处理可访问的量，如电子密度和波函数。QEpy的原子模拟环境（ASE）API使得用户可以直接访问基于ASE的工作流程和工具。这些功能使QEpy成为实现自定义工作流程、将QE与其他模拟工具接口以及原型新电子结构方法的灵活平台。本文采用混合论文/教程风格，提供多个示例笔记本，并引用了QEpy已被应用的相关文献。我们的目标是使QEpy成为电子结构理论和方法开发领域研究、教学和创新的多功能平台。
items.abstract: QEpy is a Python electronic-structure software package based on Quantum ESPRESSO (QE). QEpy accomplishes two goals. First, it simplifies running and prototyping calculations with QE. Second, it targets nonstandard workflows where the electronic-structure engine is used in ways for which it was not originally designed. For example, QEpy can instruct QE to run with custom potentials in the Hamiltonian, including external, exchange-correlation, and local pseudopotentials. QEpy also exposes, at any point during an electronic-structure calculation, including between self-consistent-field cycles, quantities that would normally be accessible only through post-processing, such as the electron density and wavefunctions. QEpy’s API to the Atomic Simulation Environment (ASE) gives direct access to ASE-based workflows and tools. These capabilities make QEpy a flexible platform for implementing custom workflows, interfacing QE with other simulation tools, and prototyping new electronic-structure methods.
