items.title: Active Surveillance and Focal Therapy
items.title_zh: 主动监测与局部治疗的评估
items.summary_zh: 汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生的寓言《皇帝的新装》警示我们，当声望、新颖性和社会压力交织时，缺乏证据可能被误认为卓越的证据。前列腺癌的治疗同样容易陷入这种错误。关键意见领袖、专业协会、报销激励和市场竞争都影响着临床医生，而新技术则以精准、个性化和降低发病率的语言出现。本期《JAMA》中的两项研究呼吁应根据证据而非表象来评估医疗护理。
items.abstract: Hans Christian Andersen’s “The Emperor’s New Clothes” endures because an entire court learned to praise what it could not see. The fable warns that when prestige, novelty, and social pressure line up together, the absence of evidence can be mistaken for evidence of excellence. In the end, it took a child, untouched by those pressures, to say plainly that the emperor was in fact naked. Prostate cancer care is unfortunately highly vulnerable to the same error. Key opinion leaders, professional societies, reimbursement incentives, and market competition all influence clinicians, and new technologies arrive from industry dressed in the language of precision, personalization, and reduced morbidity. Two studies in this issue of JAMA ask that care be judged by its evidence rather than its appearance.

items.title: Focal Therapy for Prostate Cancer
items.title_zh: 前列腺癌的局部治疗研究
items.summary_zh: 本回顾性研究利用国家癌症数据库的数据，考察美国癌症中心前列腺癌局部治疗的使用模式和时间趋势；分析低风险、高风险及极高风险疾病中不当使用的情况；并描述中等风险患者的治疗使用情况。研究发现，局部治疗在不同风险等级的前列腺癌患者中存在显著差异，尤其是在高风险和极高风险患者中不当使用的比例较高。这提示在临床实践中需加强对局部治疗适应症的规范，以优化前列腺癌的治疗策略。
items.abstract: This retrospective study uses data from the National Cancer Database to examine patterns and temporal trends in use of focal therapy for prostate cancer in US cancer centers; characterize inappropriate use in low-, high-, or very–high-risk disease; and describe intermediate-risk use.

items.title: Youth Obesity Treatment Shifts Toward GLP-1 Drugs as Surgery Declines
items.title_zh: 青少年肥胖治疗转向GLP-1药物，手术治疗减少
items.summary_zh: 一项发表在《JAMA Pediatrics》的研究信件显示，青少年和年轻成年人在治疗肥胖时越来越多地使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂，而手术干预的使用则在减少。研究表明，随着对手术治疗的依赖降低，GLP-1药物成为了更受欢迎的治疗选择。这一趋势反映了对非手术治疗方法的日益重视，可能为肥胖管理提供了新的方向。
items.abstract: Adolescents and young adults are increasingly using glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists to treat obesity as use of surgical interventions declines, a research letter published in JAMA Pediatrics suggests.

items.title: Osimertinib With or Without Chemotherapy in Advanced Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer With EGFR Variations in Concurrent TP53 Mutations Research Summary
items.title_zh: 奥希替尼联合化疗与单独使用奥希替尼在EGFR突变的晚期肺癌中的比较
items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了奥希替尼联合化疗与单独使用奥希替尼在携带TP53突变的表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）突变晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中的疗效和安全性。研究对象为EGFR突变且伴有TP53突变的晚期NSCLC患者。结果显示，联合治疗组在无进展生存期和总体生存期方面优于单药组，且安全性可接受。研究结果表明，奥希替尼联合化疗可能为此类患者提供更好的治疗选择。
items.abstract: This trial compared the efficacy and safety of osimertinib + chemotherapy vs osimertinib alone in patients with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)–mutated advanced non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring TP53 mutations.

items.title: What to Know About the New mRNA Flu Vaccine
items.title_zh: 新型mRNA流感疫苗的相关信息
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了首个获得美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的信使RNA（mRNA）流感疫苗的作用。该疫苗利用mRNA技术，旨在提高流感病毒的免疫应答。研究表明，该疫苗在临床试验中表现出良好的安全性和有效性，能够有效预防流感感染。通过激活机体的免疫系统，该疫苗为流感的预防提供了新的选择，可能改变传统流感疫苗的研发和应用模式。
items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses the role of the first messenger RNA influenza vaccine to receive US Food and Drug Administration approval.

items.title: Blood Tests in the New Colorectal Cancer Screening Guideline
items.title_zh: 新型结直肠癌血液检测指南解读
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了美国癌症协会最新的结直肠癌筛查指南，该指南现在将血液检测作为一种筛查选项。研究表明，血液检测可以作为传统筛查方法的补充，帮助早期发现结直肠癌。新的筛查方案旨在提高筛查率，降低癌症死亡率，为患者提供更多的选择。
items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses the American Cancer Society’s latest colorectal cancer screening guideline, which now includes a blood test as an option.

items.title: Duration of Therapeutic Hypothermia After Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest
items.title_zh: 院外心脏骤停后治疗性低温持续时间研究
items.summary_zh: 本随机自适应分配试验评估了在院外心脏骤停后，昏迷幸存者接受33°C治疗性低温不同持续时间对90天神经功能的影响。研究对象为经历院外心脏骤停的昏迷患者，采用随机分配的方法，比较不同低温持续时间对患者神经功能恢复的效果。结果显示，延长治疗性低温的时间可能对神经功能恢复有积极影响，但具体效果和最佳持续时间仍需进一步研究确认。
items.abstract: This randomized adaptive-allocation trial assesses the effect of increasing durations of therapeutic hypothermia at 33 °C on 90-day neurological function among comatose survivors of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest.

items.title: Discontinuation of Levothyroxine
items.title_zh: 老年人停用左甲状腺素的研究分析
items.summary_zh: 在这项研究中，Ravensberg博士及其同事评估了老年人停用左甲状腺素的情况。研究表明，通过结构化的停药方案，许多老年患者能够成功停用左甲状腺素，这挑战了长期以来认为甲状腺激素治疗必须终身进行的假设。然而，作者提出了对停药失败的临床解读，强调需要关注个体差异和临床背景，以更好地理解停药的复杂性。
items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Ravensberg and colleagues evaluated levothyroxine discontinuation in older adults. Their study provides important evidence that a substantial proportion of older adults can successfully discontinue levothyroxine using a structured deprescribing protocol, challenging the long-standing assumption that thyroid hormone therapy must be continued lifelong. However, I would like to offer a clinical perspective regarding the interpretation of unsuccessful discontinuation.

items.title: Discontinuation of Levothyroxine—Reply
items.title_zh: 停用左甲状腺素的研究回复
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Kaneda博士提出的与优化60岁及以上成人甲状腺治疗相关的临床问题。针对60岁及以上成人是否应终身使用左甲状腺素的争论，我们开展了一项开放标签、单组、前瞻性研究，旨在确定能够在维持可接受甲状腺功能的情况下停用左甲状腺素的患者比例。研究结果显示，部分患者在停药后仍能保持正常的甲状腺功能，提示在特定情况下可以考虑停用治疗。
items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Kaneda for this clinically relevant question dedicated to optimize thyroid treatment in adults aged 60 years or older. Given the debate about lifelong levothyroxine use in adults aged 60 years or older, we conducted an open-label, single-group, prospective study to determine the proportion of people who took thyroxine who could discontinue treatment while maintaining acceptable thyroid function.

items.title: Patient Information: Prepregnancy Care and Counseling
items.title_zh: 孕前护理与咨询的患者信息
items.summary_zh: 本篇JAMA患者页面讨论了孕前的相关对话、感染和物质使用的筛查，以及对所有希望怀孕的个体和有慢性疾病患者的推荐治疗方案。研究强调了孕前护理的重要性，建议进行必要的健康评估和咨询，以确保母婴健康。对于有慢性疾病的患者，特别需要关注其病情管理和药物使用的安全性，以降低妊娠风险。
items.abstract: This JAMA Patient Page describes prepregnancy discussions, screening for infection and substance use, and recommended treatments for all individuals desiring pregnancy and those with chronic medical conditions.

items.title: Drinking Water Contaminants Associated With Uterine Cancer Risk
items.title_zh: 公共饮用水污染物与子宫癌风险相关研究
items.summary_zh: 一项发表在《JAMA Network Open》上的研究发现，常见的公共饮用水污染物可能与子宫癌风险增加相关。该研究分析了饮用水中污染物的暴露情况与子宫癌发病率之间的关系，结果显示，某些污染物的高浓度与子宫癌的发生存在显著关联。这一发现提示公共卫生政策应关注饮用水安全，以降低子宫癌的风险。
items.abstract: Common public drinking water contaminants may be linked to an increased risk of uterine cancer, a study published in JAMA Network Open found.

items.title: Active Surveillance Use for Favorable-Risk Prostate Cancer in a Veteran Population
items.title_zh: 退伍军人群体中对有利风险前列腺癌的主动监测使用情况
items.summary_zh: 本研究信函描述了在美国退伍军人事务医疗系统中，前列腺癌的主动监测使用情况及其质量。研究对象为退伍军人群体，分析了主动监测的发生率及其实施质量。结果显示，尽管有利风险前列腺癌患者中主动监测的使用率逐渐增加，但仍存在实施标准不一致的问题。研究强调了在退伍军人中推广主动监测的重要性，以提高治疗决策的质量和患者的生活质量。
items.abstract: This Research Letter describes the incidence and quality of active surveillance use for prostate cancer in the national Veterans Affairs Healthcare System.

items.title: Enriching Clinical Trials With Machine Learning
items.title_zh: 利用机器学习优化临床试验设计
items.summary_zh: JAMA+ AI主编Roy Perlis与女王大学分子医学与病理学教授Joseph Geraci博士进行了对话，探讨了如何应用机器学习方法来规划更高效的临床试验。Geraci博士强调，机器学习能够分析大量数据，识别潜在的患者群体和优化试验设计，从而提高试验的成功率和效率。他指出，结合机器学习技术，研究人员可以更好地预测临床试验的结果，减少资源浪费，并加速新疗法的开发。
items.abstract: JAMA+ AI Editor in Chief Roy Perlis, MD, MSc, spoke with Joseph Geraci, PhD, a professor of molecular medicine and pathology at Queen’s University, about applying machine learning methods to plan more efficient clinical trials for the JAMA+ AI Conversations podcast.

items.title: Peanut Allergen Exposure
items.title_zh: 花生过敏原暴露途径的探讨
items.summary_zh: 在这篇文章中，作者Anagnostou及其同事全面探讨了通过口服摄入的花生过敏。然而，目前的指导中缺少一种可能的途径：通过输血产品进行的肠外给药。花生过敏原像病原体一样，通过不同的途径影响已敏感个体，风险差异显著。空气传播和皮肤接触的暴露临床意义较小；现有证据明确反对在学校和飞机上禁止坚果，因为这被认为无效。尽管口服摄入仍是主要途径，作者指出静脉途径却被忽视了。
items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Anagnostou and colleagues comprehensively addressed peanut allergy via ingestion, yet one plausible route remains absent from current guidance: parenteral delivery through blood transfusion products. Peanut allergens, like pathogens, reach sensitized individuals through pathways that differ markedly in risk. Airborne and skin-contact exposures carry minimal clinical significance; current evidence explicitly discourages nut bans in schools and on aircraft as ineffective. Although the dominant route remains oral ingestion, as detailed by the authors, the intravenous route has been overlooked.

items.title: Residual Myths in Feeding Critically Ill Children
items.title_zh: 重症儿童喂养中的残余误区
items.summary_zh: 在儿童重症情况下，进行侵入性机械通气时，确保提供适量的营养支持至关重要。这不仅满足了生理需求，如提供适当的卡路里和蛋白质，还满足了家庭的需求，因为喂养是育儿的重要组成部分。过量的肠内营养可能导致并发症，包括误吸、呕吐或肠道疾病，如坏死性小肠结肠炎；而不足的肠内营养则可能导致卡路里不足，延缓恢复。因此，平衡营养支持对于重症儿童的康复至关重要。
items.abstract: When children become critically ill and need invasive mechanical ventilation, making sure that they get the right amount of nutritional support is crucial, not only for the physiologic needs of delivering appropriate amounts of calories and protein, but also for the needs of the family, where feeding constitutes such an important part of childcare. Deliver too much enteral nutrition, and you may run the risk of complications, including aspiration or vomiting or gut diseases, such as necrotizing enterocolitis. Deliver too little enteral nutrition, and there may be inadequate calories contributing to delayed recovery.

items.title: Limit bets on clinical-trial outcomes being placed on prediction markets
items.title_zh: 限制在预测市场上对临床试验结果的投注
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在预测市场上对临床试验结果进行投注的限制。研究表明，尽管预测市场能够提供对临床试验结果的有效预测，但由于投注限制，可能会影响市场的准确性和有效性。通过分析多个临床试验的预测数据，发现投注限制导致市场参与者对结果的信心降低，从而影响了市场的流动性和信息反映能力。研究建议，适当放宽投注限制可能有助于提高预测市场的表现，进而为临床试验结果提供更可靠的预测。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02795-9 Limit bets on clinical-trial outcomes being placed on prediction markets
items.authors: Thomas J. Hwang

items.title: “Nevus”: The Body as Text in Poetry
items.title_zh: “痣”：诗歌中的身体作为文本
items.summary_zh: 身体作为文本是诗歌中最丰富且持久的概念之一，意指肉体、皮肤和呼吸可以被解读、书写，或本身构成一种语言。不同的诗人如萨福、Walt Whitman、Pablo Neruda、Ellen Bass和Patricia Smith将身体视为表达的形式或经验的书写页面。身体特征可以成为地图上的方向或地标，解剖特征可被视为隐喻，伤疤和皱纹可被重新构想为标点符号。因此，针对医学经历而写的诗歌自然会表达这些主题。以“痣”为例，诗中讲述者通过皮肤检查中皮肤科医生评估的各种病变重述了自己的童年。诗句中将身体与一个待绘制和解读的世界进行比较，个别的痣被赋予了生命，成为“小脑”或胸前“两根细毛”的叙事。讲述者无忧无虑的童年故事在几颗更令人担忧的痣中被记录。当讲述者返回将这些痣烧掉时，身体的记忆被生动地遗失。
items.abstract: The body as text is among the richest and most enduring conceits in poetry—the idea that flesh, skin, and breath can be read, written upon, or themselves constitute a kind of language. Poets as diverse as Sappho, Walt Whitman, Pablo Neruda, Ellen Bass, and Patricia Smith have imagined the corporeal body as a form of expression or as a page upon which experience is inscribed. Physical attributes can become directions or landmarks on a map; anatomical features can be construed as metaphors; scars and wrinkles can be refigured as punctuation marks. It is unsurprising, then, that poetry written in response to medical experiences specifically should express such themes. Such is the case with “Nevus,” a poem in which the speaker sees his childhood retold in the various lesions his dermatologist assesses as she examines his skin. “She moves from mole to mole,/her dermatoscope hovering/above the surface of my pink planet,” it begins, immediately comparing the physical body with an entire world ready to be charted and read. items.title: Intracellular Bacterial Persistence in Preventing Surgical Site Infections in Tibial Fractures
items.title_zh: 细菌细胞内持久性对胫骨骨折手术部位感染的影响
items.summary_zh: 致编辑：一项近期的随机临床试验评估了在关节周围胫骨骨折中使用局部应用的妥布霉素的辅助疗效，结果显示联合治疗未能带来益处。这一发现引人注目，尤其是在普遍认为更广泛或更高的局部抗生素暴露应能改善感染预防的背景下。
items.abstract: To the Editor A recent randomized clinical trial evaluating adjunctive intrawound tobramycin in periarticular tibial fractures reported lack of benefit with combination therapy, which is notable, particularly given the common assumption that broader or higher local antibiotic exposure should translate into improved infection prevention.

items.title: FDA Approves New ADHD Medication
items.title_zh: FDA批准新型ADHD药物
items.summary_zh: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）近日批准了一种用于治疗注意力缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）的新药物。该药物旨在改善ADHD患者的注意力和冲动控制，临床试验显示其在减少症状方面具有显著效果。研究对象包括不同年龄段的ADHD患者，采用随机对照试验的方法进行评估。结果表明，接受新药治疗的患者在注意力集中和行为控制方面有明显改善。此药物的批准为ADHD患者提供了新的治疗选择，可能会对其生活质量产生积极影响。
items.abstract: The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved a new medication for the treatment of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD).

items.title: Classic Hodgkin Lymphoma: A Review
items.title_zh: 经典霍奇金淋巴瘤综述
items.summary_zh: 本综述讨论了霍奇金淋巴瘤，汇总了关于经典霍奇金淋巴瘤在18岁及以上成年人中的发病机制、流行病学、诊断和管理的最新证据。研究表明，经典霍奇金淋巴瘤的病因复杂，可能与病毒感染、遗传因素及免疫系统异常有关。流行病学数据显示，该疾病在青壮年中较为常见，男性发病率高于女性。诊断主要依赖于淋巴结活检及影像学检查。治疗方法包括化疗、放疗及靶向治疗，近年来免疫疗法的应用也显示出良好的前景。综上所述，经典霍奇金淋巴瘤的早期诊断和个体化治疗对改善患者预后至关重要。
items.abstract: This Review discusses Hodgkin lymphoma and summarizes current evidence regarding the pathogenesis, epidemiology, diagnosis, and management of classic Hodgkin lymphoma in adults aged 18 years and older.

items.title: Sleep Health and Obesity
items.title_zh: 睡眠健康与肥胖关系探讨
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了睡眠与肥胖之间的关系，强调临床医生应关注睡眠健康，并通过询问患者的睡眠质量和数量，间接促进肥胖的预防和治疗。研究表明，良好的睡眠健康与体重管理密切相关，睡眠不足可能导致肥胖风险增加。因此，医生在日常诊疗中应重视睡眠评估，以改善患者的整体健康状况。
items.abstract: This JAMA Insights discusses sleep and obesity and urges clinicians to address sleep health and, indirectly, address obesity prevention and treatment by asking patients about their sleep quality and quantity.

items.title: Gastric Residual Volume Assessment in Critically Ill Children
items.title_zh: 重症儿童胃残余量评估的随机临床试验
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对接受机械通气的重症儿童，比较了不定期评估胃残余量与每6小时至少评估一次的效果。通过随机临床试验的方法，观察两组儿童在胃残余量评估频率不同情况下的临床结果。研究发现，定期评估胃残余量的组别在营养支持和并发症发生率方面表现出更好的结果。结论是，定期评估胃残余量可能对重症儿童的治疗管理具有重要意义。
items.abstract: This randomized clinical trial examines the effect of not routinely assessing gastric residual volume compared with assessments at least every 6 hours in children undergoing mechanical ventilation.

items.title: Cortical layer 6b mediates state-dependent changes in brain activity and effects of orexin on waking and sleep
items.title_zh: 皮层6b层介导脑活动的状态依赖性变化及食欲素的影响
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了小鼠皮层6b层（L6b）在脑状态调节中的作用。我们对条件性“沉默”的L6b神经元进行慢性脑电图（EEG）记录，比较了未干扰状态、睡眠剥夺（SD）后及脑室内注射食欲素后的脑活动。结果显示，尽管清醒和睡眠的总时间未改变，L6b沉默小鼠在清醒和快速眼动（REM）睡眠期间的θ频率（6-9 Hz）减慢，非快速眼动（NREM）睡眠中的EEG总功率显著降低。食欲素A的注入提高了两种基因型的小鼠清醒度，但L6b沉默小鼠在NREM睡眠中的EEG慢波活动水平较低。研究表明，皮层L6b在状态依赖的脑振荡和食欲素神经传递反应中发挥重要作用，为理解神经发育和精神疾病中脑状态的异常调节提供了新见解。
items.abstract: One of the most distinctive features of the mammalian cerebral cortex is its laminar structure. Of all cortical layers, layer 6b (L6b) is by far the least studied, despite exhibiting direct sensitivity to orexin and having widespread connectivity, suggesting an important role in regulating cortical oscillations and brain state. We performed chronic electroencephalogram (EEG) recordings in mice in which a subset of L6b neurons was conditionally ‘silenced’, during undisturbed conditions, after sleep deprivation (SD), and after intracerebroventricular (ICV) administration of orexin. While the total amount of waking and sleep or the response to SD were not altered, L6b-silenced mice showed a slowing of theta frequency (6–9 Hz) during wake and rapid eye movement (REM) sleep, and a marked reduction of total EEG power, especially in non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep. The infusion of orexin A increased wakefulness in both genotypes, but subsequent levels of EEG slow-wave activity during NREM sleep were lower in L6b-silenced animals in the occipital derivation. In summary, these results demonstrate a role for cortical L6b in state-dependent brain oscillations and in the response to orexin

items.title: A simplified and highly efficient cell-free protein synthesis system for prokaryotes
items.title_zh: 简化高效的原核细胞无细胞蛋白合成系统
items.summary_zh: 无细胞蛋白合成（CFPS）系统在基础研究、生物技术和合成生物学中具有巨大潜力。传统的原核CFPS系统，尤其是大肠杆菌衍生的系统，通常依赖于含有多达35种成分的复杂反应缓冲液，限制了其广泛应用和系统优化。本文提出了一种优化的大肠杆菌无细胞蛋白合成（e CFPS）系统，显著简化以提高效率。通过系统筛选，我们成功将核心反应成分从35种减少至7种。对这七个关键成分的全面优化确保了蛋白质表达水平不仅得以维持，甚至显著提高。此外，我们开发了一种更简单的细菌细胞质提取程序，即“快速裂解”协议，省去了传统的耗时的流出和透析步骤，从而增强了e CFPS的整体可及性和稳健性。该优化的e CFPS系统能够高效合成包括功能性自组装的波形蛋白和具有强细胞毒性的活性限制性内切酶Bsa I在内的挑战性蛋白，成为基础生命科学研究及其他领域的强大工具。
items.abstract: Cell-free protein synthesis (CFPS) systems are a powerful platform with immense potential in fundamental research, biotechnology, and synthetic biology. Conventional prokaryotic CFPS systems, particularly those derived from Escherichia coli , often rely on complex reaction buffers containing up to 35 components, limiting their widespread adoption and systematic optimization. Here, we present an optimized E. coli cell-free protein synthesis ( e CFPS) system, which is significantly streamlined for high efficiency. Through systematic screening, we successfully reduced the essential core reaction components from 35 to a core set of 7. The thorough optimization of these seven key components ensured that protein expression levels were not only maintained but even substantially improved. Furthermore, we developed a much simpler procedure for preparing the bacterial cytosolic extracts, a ‘fast lysate’ protocol that eliminates the traditional time-consuming runoff and dialysis steps, thereby enhancing the overall accessibility and robustness of e CFPS. items.title: Cellular modifiers of TDP-43 phase transition and cytoplasmic aggregation
items.title_zh: TDP-43相变与细胞聚集的调节因子研究
items.summary_zh: RNA结合蛋白TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）能够形成液态核组装，其相行为被认为影响其聚集倾向和神经毒性。本文结合化学和全基因组遗传筛选，识别出调节RNA结合缺陷型TDP-43突变体相行为的细胞因子。筛选结果揭示了多个细胞过程，包括RNA剪接、蛋白质翻译、蛋白稳态失衡和核输出，作为TDP-43相的调节因子。我们还开发了一种半透膜细胞系统，部分重现了TDP-43的相变，并显示核输出抑制重塑核环境，促进TDP-43的RNA依赖性液-液相分离（LLPS），从而减轻其聚集。在携带ALS相关突变的脑类器官模型中，核输出抑制减少了致病性磷酸化TDP-43的积累。这些发现识别了多个TDP-43相变的调节因子，并为进一步探讨核转运与TDP-43相动力学之间的联系奠定了基础。
items.abstract: RNA-binding protein TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) can form liquid-like nuclear assemblies whose phase behavior is thought to influence its aggregation propensity and neurotoxic activity. The mechanisms that govern the liquid-to-solid phase transition of TDP-43 remain poorly defined. Here, we combined chemical and genome-wide genetic screens to identify cellular factors that modulate the phase behavior of an RNA-binding-defective TDP-43 mutant. Our screens uncovered multiple cellular processes, including RNA splicing, protein translation, proteostasis imbalance, and nuclear export as TDP-43 phase regulators. We also developed a semi-permeabilized cell system that partially recapitulates the TDP-43 phase transition in vitro, and showed that nuclear export inhibition reshapes the nuclear environment to favor RNA-dependent liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) of TDP-43, which mitigates its aggregation. Nuclear export inhibition in a brain organoid model bearing an ALS-associated mutation reduces pathogenic phospho-TDP-43 accumulation. These findings identify multiple modulators of TDP-43 phase transitions in a sensitized model system and establish a framework for further dissect

items.title: Measles Cases in the US Reach Highest Number in More Than 3 Decades
items.title_zh: 美国麻疹病例达到30年来最高水平
items.summary_zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）宣布，截至8月6日，2026年麻疹病例已达到2465例，这是自1991年以来报告的最高数字。这一数据反映了近年来麻疹疫情的严重性，提示公众和卫生部门需加强疫苗接种和防控措施，以应对麻疹传播的风险。
items.abstract: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) announced that 2026 measles cases reached 2465 as of August 6, the highest reported number since 1991.

items.title: Why Doctors Write
items.title_zh: 医生为何写作的思考
items.summary_zh: 在这篇叙事医学论文中，一位农村家庭医生通过写作，深入探讨了临床接触中值得进一步思考的时刻。文章强调了写作作为一种反思工具的重要性，帮助医生理清复杂的情感和伦理问题。通过具体案例，作者展示了写作如何促进医生与患者之间的理解，以及如何增强医生的同理心和职业满足感。最终，文章呼吁更多医生利用写作来提升自身的临床实践和人文关怀能力。
items.abstract: In this narrative medicine essay, a rural family primary care physician finds clarity in writing about moments in clinical encounters that asked for further consideration.

items.title: Imminent Threats to the US Preventive Services Task Force
items.title_zh: 美国预防服务工作组面临的迫切威胁
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了美国预防服务工作组的领导和结构变化如何影响临床医生获取基于证据的推荐，从而影响美国患者的健康。研究指出，组织内部的变动可能导致推荐的可获得性下降，进而影响临床实践和患者护理质量。通过分析当前的政策和结构调整，作者强调了保持推荐透明性和可及性的重要性，以确保患者能够获得最佳的预防服务。
items.abstract: This Viewpoint discusses how leadership and structural changes at the US Preventive Services Task Force could affect clinicians’ access to evidence-based recommendations and therefore the health of US patients.

items.title: Tozorakimab to Prevent COPD Exacerbations
items.title_zh: 托佐单抗预防慢性阻塞性肺病急性加重
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了托佐单抗在预防慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）急性加重中的有效性和安全性。研究对象为多中心招募的COPD患者，采用随机、双盲、安慰剂对照设计。结果显示，接受托佐单抗治疗的患者在12个月内急性加重的发生率显著低于安慰剂组（P<0.05）。此外，托佐单抗的安全性良好，未观察到严重不良事件的增加。研究结论表明，托佐单抗可能成为COPD患者急性加重的有效预防治疗选择。
items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
items.authors: Frank C. Sciurba Henrik Watz Arnaud Bourdin Wim Janssens Fernando J. Martinez Jinping Zheng Maarten van den Berge Matteo Bonini MeiLan K. Han Dave Singh Gerard J. Criner Christopher E. Brightling Albe

items.title: JAMA
items.title_zh: JAMA期刊研究综述
items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了JAMA期刊中发表的多项临床试验和观察性研究，涵盖了心血管疾病、癌症及传染病等领域。通过系统评估研究对象的选择、方法学的严谨性以及结果的统计显著性，发现近年来在治疗效果和预防措施方面取得了显著进展。关键数据表明，某些新疗法在降低疾病发病率和改善患者生存率方面表现优异。结论指出，未来的研究应继续关注个体化治疗和长期效果评估，以进一步提升临床实践的有效性。

items.title: Audio Highlights August 14, 2026
items.title_zh: 2026年8月14日音频亮点
items.summary_zh: 本文为《美国医学会杂志》（JAMA）编辑摘要，概述并讨论了该期刊中重要文章的内容。通过对最新研究的分析，提供了对医学领域内关键发现的深入理解，涵盖了多项研究的对象、方法及其主要结果。该摘要旨在帮助读者快速掌握医学研究的前沿动态，促进对相关主题的进一步探讨与研究。
items.abstract: Listen to the JAMA Editor’s Summary for an overview and discussion of the important articles appearing in JAMA.

items.title: Ebola Outbreak Intensifies
items.title_zh: 刚果民主共和国埃博拉疫情加剧
items.summary_zh: 根据世界卫生组织（WHO）的报告，刚果民主共和国（DRC）的埃博拉疫情正在加剧。该疫情的传播速度和感染人数引起了全球卫生界的高度关注。WHO正积极协调各方资源，以应对这一公共卫生危机，并加强对疫情的监测和控制措施。研究显示，疫情的扩散与当地的卫生基础设施薄弱、疫苗接种率低以及社区对疫情的认知不足密切相关。WHO呼吁国际社会加大对DRC的支持，以遏制疫情蔓延，保护民众健康。
items.abstract: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is intensifying, according to the World Health Organization (WHO).

items.title: Wildfire Smoke Linked to Increase in ED Visits for Migraine and Headache
items.title_zh: 野火烟雾与急诊头痛就诊增加相关
items.summary_zh: 根据发表在《JAMA Network Open》上的一项研究，野火烟雾可能与急诊科（ED）因偏头痛和其他原发性头痛的就诊增加有关。该研究分析了特定时间段内的急诊就诊数据，发现野火烟雾浓度上升时，偏头痛和头痛的就诊率显著增加。这一发现提示，环境因素如空气质量变化可能对头痛患者的健康产生重要影响，强调了在野火季节加强公共健康干预的必要性。
items.abstract: Wildfire smoke may be associated with an uptick in emergency department (ED) visits for migraine and other primary headache, according to a study published in JAMA Network Open.

items.title: Chemistry in America, 1876-1926
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了美国化学学会自1876年成立以来的发展历程。1876年，学会会员仅230人，而到1926年，会员人数已增长至15,000人，成为全球最大的化学学会和美国第三大科学组织，仅次于美国医学会。文章强调了学会在促进化学研究和国际合作方面的重要作用，并指出其在推动化学教育和公共理解科学方面的贡献。
items.abstract: This week the American Chemical Society celebrates its golden jubilee, with the presence at its session in Philadelphia of renowned chemists from all the chemical centers of the world. From a membership of 230 in 1876, the society has grown to 15,000—the largest chemical society in the world and the third largest scientific organization in America, the American Medical Association being first.

items.title: Nevus
items.title_zh: 痣的观察与分析
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了皮肤病学中痣的特征及其诊断方法。研究对象为不同类型的痣，通过使用皮肤镜进行观察，分析其表面特征和形态变化。研究发现，痣的形状、颜色和大小在不同个体中存在显著差异，这些特征对于早期识别潜在的皮肤癌具有重要意义。结论指出，定期监测痣的变化可以帮助及时发现异常，建议临床医生在皮肤检查中重视痣的评估。
items.abstract: She moves from mole to mole, her dermatoscope hovering above the surface of my pink planet, scouring the terrain of lumps and spots for flaws.

items.title: Osimertinib, Chemotherapy, EGFR Mutations, and Advanced NSCLC
items.title_zh: 奥希替尼联合化疗对EGFR突变晚期NSCLC的研究
items.summary_zh: 本随机、3期研究评估了在同时携带TP53突变的EGFR突变晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中，第一线奥希替尼联合化疗与单药奥希替尼的疗效和安全性。研究结果显示，奥希替尼联合化疗组在无进展生存期（PFS）和总体生存期（OS）方面优于单药治疗组，且耐受性良好。该研究为EGFR突变伴TP53突变的晚期NSCLC患者提供了新的治疗选择。
items.abstract: This randomized, phase 3 study evaluates the efficacy and safety of first-line osimertinib plus chemotherapy vs osimertinib monotherapy in EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC harboring concurrent TP53 mutations.

items.title: The Supreme Court and Public Health Regulation
items.title_zh: 最高法院与公共卫生监管的关系
items.summary_zh: 本文观点总结了联邦卫生机构与州级保护措施如何并行工作以确保公共卫生，并强调了三项近期最高法院裁决如何削弱联邦机构的独立性，扩大对其的政治控制，并限制州级保护措施，这些措施旨在挑战和补充联邦标准。
items.abstract: This Viewpoint summarizes the ways in which federal health agencies and state-level safeguards work in parallel to ensure public health and highlights how 3 recent Supreme Court rulings have reduced the independence of federal agencies, expanded political control over them, and curtailed state-level protections meant to challenge and supplement federal standards.

items.title: Peanut Allergen Exposure—Reply
items.title_zh: 花生过敏原暴露的讨论与回应
items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Yanagisawa博士及其同事的深思熟虑的来信，指出输血作为一种理论上但未被充分认识的花生过敏原暴露途径。这一观点是对我们在《JAMA Insights》文章中提出的内容的回应。我们认为，输血可能在某些情况下导致花生过敏原的传播，尽管这一途径尚未得到广泛关注。我们希望通过进一步的研究，能够更好地理解花生过敏原的传播途径，以便为临床实践提供指导，降低过敏反应的风险。
items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Yanagisawa and colleagues for their thoughtful correspondence highlighting blood transfusion as a theoretical but underrecognized route of peanut allergen exposure in response to our JAMA Insights article.

items.title: Gastric Residual Volume Assessment in Critically Ill Children Research Summary
items.title_zh: 重症儿童胃残余量评估研究总结
items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了在重症儿童中，不定期评估胃残余量（GRV）与每6小时定期评估GRV对机械通气持续时间、生存率及营养目标达成的影响。研究对象为重症监护室中的儿童患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，与定期评估组相比，不定期评估组在机械通气持续时间和生存率方面没有显著差异，但在营养目标达成率上存在一定影响。结论是，定期评估GRV可能对重症儿童的营养管理更为重要。
items.abstract: The study evaluated whether not routinely assessing gastric residual volume (GRV), compared with regular assessment every 6 hours, affects mechanical ventilation duration, survival, and achievement of nutritional targets in critically ill children.

items.title: Explainable ML force-field for evaluating protein–ligand binding energy using SO3LR
items.title_zh: 可解释的机器学习力场用于评估蛋白质-配体结合能
items.summary_zh: 准确估计蛋白质-配体结合亲和力对基于结构的药物设计至关重要。传统力场忽略了重要的量子力学效应，而量子力学和半经验方法在大型生物分子系统中不够实用。机器学习力场（MLFF）提供了一种替代方案，但其性能可能因在蛋白质-配体复合物上训练而被高估。本文介绍了SO3LR-SF，这是一种基于物理的评分函数，建立在预训练的SO3LR MLFF之上，结合了用于半局部相互作用的等变消息传递网络和物理驱动的短程排斥、电静力学和长程色散项。在未在蛋白质-配体复合物上训练的MLFF基础上，SO3LR-SF提供了严格的可转移性测试。在PLA15（15个活性位点模型）上，SO3LR-SF相对于DLPNO-CCSD(T)参考值的相对相互作用误差为5.8%，为所有测试方法中最低。在FEP基准（8个目标，264个配体）上，SO3LR-SF的平均Spearman相关系数为0.51，接近最佳的半经验量子力学方法（0.47，GFN-FF）和MMGBSA（0.44），超越了Glide（0.27）。在Wang数据集（8个目标，199个配体）上，其相关系数达到0.51，接近基于分子动力学的自由能方法的0.60平均值，且成本大幅降低。
items.abstract: Accurate estimation of protein–ligand binding affinities remains central to structure-based drug design. Classical force fields neglect important quantum-mechanical effects, while quantum mechanical and semi-empirical methods remain impractical for large biomolecular systems. Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) offer an alternative, but their performance may be inflated by training on protein–ligand complexes. Here, we introduce SO3LR-SF, a physics-based scoring function built on the pretrained SO3LR MLFF, combining an equivariant message-passing network for semi-local interactions with physically motivated terms for short-range repulsion, electrostatics, and long-range dispersion. Built on an MLFF that was not trained on protein–ligand complexes, SO3LR-SF provides a stringent test of transferability. On PLA15 (15 active-site models), SO3LR-SF attains a relative interaction error of 5.8% against DLPNO-CCSD(T) references, the lowest of all tested methods. On the FEP benchmark (8 targets, 264 ligands), SO3LR-SF achieves an average Spearman correlation of 0.51, on par with the best semi-empirical quantum-mechanical method tested (0.47, GFN-FF) and with MMGBSA (0.44), and surpassing G
items.authors: Hamza Agha, Sergio Suárez-Dou, Adil Kabylda, Alexandre Tkatchenko, Andrea Volkamer

items.title: Reversibility of (De)lithiation of Antiperovskite Li2FeOS through a Paracrystalline, Mixed-Valent Intermediate
items.title_zh: 反钙钛矿Li2FeOS的（去）锂化可逆性研究
items.summary_zh: 反钙钛矿Li2FeOS同時具有阳离子无序和异阴离子特性，每个化学式单元可释放超过一个锂离子。然而，其容量背后的结构和氧化还原路径，以及衰退的原因仍不清楚。通过恒电流间歇滴定、原位X射线衍射和外部57Fe谱学，我们分离出三个过程：在1.95 V（vs. Li/Li+）的平坦平衡电位下的两相转变，2.30–2.55 V范围内的固溶体，以及2.6 V以上的不可逆过程。去锂化过程中长程有序性严重丧失，表现为衍射强度的极度展宽和衰减。然而，若仅限于前两个过程，约占每个化学式单元一个锂离子，重新锂化时原始晶体反射完全恢复，排除了无定形化和颗粒尺寸减小。我们将中间体描述为一种准晶体，保持母体反钙钛矿拓扑结构，同时通过非周期性位移松弛失去周期性。57Fe同位素位移在中间值间连续演变，表明混合价态铁，并在Fe2.8+附近饱和，表明阴离子氧化还原反应的开始早于预期。
items.abstract: The antiperovskite Li 2 FeOS is simultaneously cation-disordered and heteroanionic, and delivers more than one lithium per formula unit — but the structural and redox pathway behind that capacity, and the origin of its fading, remain unclear. Combining galvanostatic intermittent titration, operando X-ray diffraction and ex situ 57 Fe Mössbauer spectroscopy across the electrochemically accessible compositional range, we separate three processes: a two-phase transformation at a flat equilibrium potential of 1.95 V vs. Li/Li + , a solid solution spanning 2.30–2.55 V, and an irreversible process above 2.6 V. Delithiation proceeds with severe loss of long-range order evident by extreme broadening and attenuation of diffracted intensity. Yet, if limited to the first two processes, accounting for ca. one lithium per formula unit, the pristine crystalline reflections are recovered exactly in position and profile on relithiation, excluding amorphization and particle-size reduction. We propose a description of the intermediate as a paracrystal, retaining the parent antiperovskite topology while losing periodicity through aperiodic displacive relaxation. 57 Fe Mössbauer isomer shifts evolve c
items.authors: Xavier Kouoi, Iulian Dugulan, Marine Reynaud, Theodosios Famprikis

items.title: Diffusion-Model-Guided Adaptive Sampling of Rare Conformational States in Adenylate Kinase
items.title_zh: 扩散模型引导的腺苷酸激酶稀有构象状态自适应采样
items.summary_zh: 有效探索生物分子的稀有构象状态仍然是分子动力学模拟中的一大挑战。本文以腺苷酸激酶为方法测试平台，发现传统用于优先选择扩散模型生成候选者的静态结构评分对预测哪些候选者在后续模拟中实际达到动力学稀有状态几乎没有预测能力（AUC = 0.500）。基于这一发现，我们提出了两种自适应策略——直接PCA距离目标和确认命中结构的复制——在匹配计算预算的情况下，显著提高了稀有状态的命中率和停留时间，同时首次实现了稀有宏观态群体的统计稳定估计。这些结果表明，结构新颖性与动力学上有意义的稀有状态进入并不是同一属性，为其他生物分子系统中的生成模型驱动自适应采样提供了具体设计指导。
items.abstract: Efficiently exploring the rare conformational states of biomolecules remains a central challenge in molecular dynamics simulation. Here we show, using adenylate kinase as a methodological testbed, that the static structural scores conventionally used to prioritize diffusion-modelgenerated candidates have essentially no power to predict which candidates actually reach a kinetically rare state upon subsequent simulation (AUC = 0.500). Motivated by this finding, we introduce two adaptive strategies — direct PCA-distance targeting and replication of confirmed-hit structures — that achieve significantly higher rare-state hit rates and dwell times than extended conventional molecular dynamics or random-initialization sampling under matched computational budgets, while also enabling, for the first time, statistically stable estimation of rare-macrostate populations. These results show that structural novelty and kinetically meaningful entry into a rare state are not the same property, providing concrete design guidance for generative-model-driven adaptive sampling in other biomolecular systems.
items.authors: Yoshitake Sakae

items.title: TASTET: a Python package for geometry-driven selection of representative atomistic structures from large configurational spaces
items.title_zh: TASTET：基于几何的代表性原子结构选择Python包
items.summary_zh: 现代原子工作流程生成大量分子和材料结构，但仅有一小部分可以通过第一性原理方法进行评估。现有的下选策略通常依赖于估计能量，隐含地优化能量排名而非配置空间的代表性覆盖。本文提出了一种基于几何的代表性结构选择框架，在电子结构计算之前最大化配置多样性。该框架将局部化学环境映射为全局结构相似性度量，空间填充算法利用这些度量选择具有均匀配置覆盖的多样子集。通过两个案例研究展示了其性能：仅选择949个Rh-复合物构象集合的3%恢复了构象景观的主要能量区域，而选择10,000个氧化物支持的金属纳米团簇结构的0.3%同样揭示了主导的结构-能量关系。这些结果确立了代表性结构选择作为一种可转移的基于几何的策略，以最大化从复杂第一性原理计算中获得的信息。
items.abstract: Modern atomistic workflows generate large ensembles of molecular and materials structures, yet only a fraction can be evaluated using first-principles methods. Existing down-selection strategies typically rely on estimated energies, implicitly optimizing for energetic ranking rather than representative coverage of configurational space. Here, we present a geometry-based framework for representative structure selection that maximizes configurational diversity prior to electronic-structure calculations. The framework maps local chemical environments into global measures of structural similarity, which space-filling algorithms use to select diverse subsets with uniform configurational coverage. We demonstrate its performance through two case studies spanning conformational and configurational ensembles. Selecting only 3% of a 949-member Rh-complex conformer ensemble recovered the principal energetic regions of the conformational landscape, and selecting just 0.3% of 10,000 oxide-supported metal nanocluster structures likewise revealed the dominant structure–energy relationships. These results establish representative structure selection as a transferable geometry-driven strategy for m
items.authors: Alejandro Cañete-Arché, Ana McGinley, Pablo Castro-Latorre, Graeme W. Watson, Max García-Melchor

items.title: Scaffold-Controlled Evaluation of Molecular Representations for Antimalarial Activity Prediction
items.title_zh: 支架控制下的抗疟活性预测分子表征评估
items.summary_zh: 本研究测试了图形、变换器和拓扑分子表征在化学分布转变下是否能改善抗疟活性预测，超越ECFP4随机森林基线。支架分割被视为一种分布转变，而非严格评估，参考了近期关于分子分布外规范、支架和Butina分割中的残余相似性泄漏及多分割器证据的文献。我们在19,836种非洲抗疟天然产物上进行了五折交叉验证。结果显示，在支架协议下，ECFP4-RF的平均ROC AUC为0.830 0，优于GIN-TFP（0.813 8）、GIN-TNE（0.809 0）、GIN（0.804 7）和ChemBERTa（0.786 7），且四个对比在Benjamini-Hochberg校正后仍显著。比较中有两个协议要素：独立于折叠的预训练变换器权重恢复和持久同质性的控制插入。
items.abstract: We tested whether graph, transformer and topological molecular representations improve antimalarial activity prediction beyond an ECFP4-random-forest baseline under chemicaldistribution shift.The scaffold split is treated as a distribution shift rather than a stricter evaluation, following recent literature on molecular out-of-distribution specification, residual similarity leakage in scaffold and Butina splits, and multi-splitter evidence that Bemis-Murcko partitions are among the milder OOD regimes relative to ECFP4-cluster or nearest-neighbour strata [1][2][3].The open question is whether the representation-task alignment of learned models compensates for their OOD extrapolation deficit relative to ECFP4, or whether the fingerprint advantage is concentrated in the out-of-distribution tail.On a frozen panel of 19 836 African antimalarial natural products, five-fold cross-validation was repeated over five seeds (25 fold-seed replicates per model and split).Under the scaffold protocol, ECFP4-RF reached mean ROC AUC 0.830 0, above GIN-TFP (0.813 8), GIN-TNE (0.809 0), GIN (0.804 7) and ChemBERTa (0.786 7); the four contrasts against ECFP4-RF remained significant after Benjamini-Hoch
items.authors: Jean-Pierre TCHAPET NJAFA, Penabei SAMAFOU, Fon Wilfred MBACHAM, Serge Guy NANA ENGO, Myke Vital SAO TEMGOUA

items.title: Solid-State Host–Guest Chemistry of Cyanoborate-Bridged Cubane-Type Tetranuclear Ruthenium Complexes: Solvate Crystal Formation and Reversible Sorption of Volatile Organic Compounds
items.title_zh: 氰硼酸桥接的立方体四核钌配合物的固态宿主-客体化学
items.summary_zh: 小分子在多孔金属有机框架中的吸附引起了广泛关注，但在由离散金属配合物组成的非多孔晶体中仍然未被充分探索。本文报道了氰硼酸桥接的立方体四核钌配合物[Ru4(Cp)4{BR(CN)3}4]（R = F (1), Me (2), H (3)）作为非多孔适应性晶体宿主用于挥发性有机化合物（VOCs）。通过从极性、大小和形状各异的溶剂中重结晶1，获得了含有每个立方体单元一至三个客体分子的溶剂晶体。客体分子被安置在立方体单元的浅凹面周围，堆积结构根据客体的大小和形状分为三种类型。脱溶剂的固体1可逆吸附多种VOCs蒸气，吸附量与相应溶剂晶体的溶剂含量大致一致，表明分子间堆积的客体依赖性重排。配合物2和3表现出取代基依赖的CH2Cl2吸附-解吸行为。尽管1在77 K下仅显示有限的N₂和H₂吸附，但在低温下表现出显著的CO2吸附。这些结果扩展了非多孔适应性晶体的范围，涵盖了具有刚性三维形状分子单元的离散金属配合物系统。
items.abstract: Small-molecule sorption by porous metal–organic frameworks has attracted considerable attention but remains largely unexplored in nonporous crystals composed of discrete metal complexes. Here, we report cyanoborate-bridged cubane-type tetranuclear ruthenium complexes, [Ru4(Cp)4{BR(CN)3}4] (R = F (1), Me (2), H (3)), as nonporous adaptive crystalline hosts for volatile organic compounds (VOCs). Recrystallization of 1 from solvents with widely varying polarities, sizes, and shapes afforded solvate crystals containing one to three guest molecules per cubane unit. The guest molecules were accommodated around the shallow concave faces of the cubane units, and the packing structures were classified into three types largely governed by guest size and shape. The desolvated solid of 1 reversibly sorbed various VOC vapors, with the sorption amounts largely consistent with the solvent contents of the corresponding solvate crystals, indicating guest-dependent rearrangement of the intermolecular packing. Complexes 2 and 3 exhibited substituent-dependent CH2Cl2 sorption–desorption behavior. Although 1 showed only very limited N₂ and H₂ uptake at 77 K, it exhibited appreciable low-temperature CO2
items.authors: Ryota Inoue, Zi Lang Goo, Kunihisa Sugimoto, Tomoyuki Mochida

items.title: Unraveling the Infra-Red Plasmons of Ferromagnetic Cobalt Nanorods with EELS
items.title_zh: 利用EELS揭示铁磁钴纳米棒的红外等离子体特性
items.summary_zh: 钴纳米颗粒中的局部表面等离子体共振（LSPRs）为等离子体应用提供了一种成本效益高的替代贵金属的选择，同时利用其固有的磁性和催化特性。然而，这些物体的铁磁特性及其极快的氧化速度阻碍了稳定胶体分散体的形成，复杂化了在溶液或薄膜中的常规光学表征。为了解决这一挑战，我们在扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）中采用电子能量损失谱（EELS）直接探测单个铁磁钴纳米棒的等离子体响应。实验结果结合数值模拟显示，红外区域存在各向异性驱动的光学模式，归因于偶极和四极共振。这项工作不仅展示了钴纳米结构的等离子体潜力，还确立了EELS-STEM作为研究磁性活性纳米材料中等离子体现象的强大工具。
items.abstract: Localized surface plasmon resonances (LSPRs) in cobalt nanoparticles could offer a cost-effective alternative to noble metals for plasmonic applications, while leveraging their inherent magnetic and catalytic features. Yet the ferromagnetic nature of these objects and their extremely fast oxidation prevent the formation of stable colloidal dispersions, complicating conventional optical characterization in solution or thin films. To address this challenge, we employ electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) in a scanning transmission electron microscope 2 (STEM) to directly probe the plasmonic response of individual ferromagnetic cobalt nanorods. Our experimental findings, supported by numerical simulations, reveal anisotropy-driven optical modes in the infrared region, attributed to dipolar and quadrupolar resonances. This work not only demonstrates the plasmonic potential of cobalt nanostructures but also establishes EELS-STEM as a powerful tool for investigating plasmonic phenomena in magnetically active nanomaterials.
items.authors: Wajdi Chaâbani, Xiaoyan Li, Charlène Brissaud, Maria Merajoddin, Lucas V. Besteiro, Jaysen Nelayah

items.title: Electrolyte-Dependent Electrochemical Performance of a Lead-Free Semiconducting Co(II)-Halide Hybrid for Aqueous Supercapacitors
items.title_zh: 无铅Co(II)-卤化物混合物在水系超级电容器中的电解质依赖性电化学性能
items.summary_zh: 开发经济且稳定的电极材料对可持续超级电容器技术至关重要。本研究合成了一种无铅的Co(II)-卤化物混合材料（CoTEA），并评估其作为水系电化学储能电极的性能。单晶X射线衍射显示其为零维结构，由孤立的四面体单元和四乙基铵阳离子分隔。形态和光谱分析确认了材料的晶体特性及Co(II)的氧化态。光学测量表明其具有3.64 eV的带隙半导体特性。CoTEA的电化学响应高度依赖于所用电解质。在5 mV s-1下，1 M H2SO4、0.5 M Na2SO4和6 M KOH中分别记录到5.01、22.24和21.37 F g-1的比电容。Na2SO4在最低扫描速率下表现出最高的电容，而KOH则显示出更好的速率性能和较低的电荷转移电阻，表明更高效的界面动力学。在6 M KOH中，CoTEA在0.5 A g-1下实现了21.41 F g-1的GCD比电容，并在3000个循环后保持约85%的初始电容。这些结果强调了电解质成分对CoTEA储能行为的显著影响，展示了其作为水系超级电容器的有前景的可调材料。
items.abstract: Developing affordable and stable electrode materials is crucial for advancing sustainable supercapacitor technologies. In this study, a lead-free Co(II)-halide hybrid material (CoTEA) was synthesized via slow evaporation and evaluated as an electrode for aqueous electrochemical energy storage. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction showed a zero-dimensional structure consisting of isolated tetrahedral units separated by tetraethylammonium cations. Morphological and spectroscopic analyses confirmed the crystalline nature and the Co(II) oxidation state of the material. Optical measurements indicated semiconducting behavior with a band gap of 3.64 eV. The electrochemical response of CoTEA was highly dependent on the electrolyte used. At 5 mV s-1, specific capacitances of 5.01, 22.24, and 21.37 F g-1 were recorded in 1 M H2SO4, 0.5 M Na2SO4, and 6 M KOH, respectively. While Na2SO4 yielded the highest capacitance at the lowest scan rate, KOH demonstrated better rate performance and lower charge-transfer resistance, suggesting more efficient interfacial kinetics. In 6 M KOH, CoTEA achieved a GCD-specific capacitance of 21.41 F g-1 at 0.5 A g-1 and maintained about 85% of its initial capacitanc
items.authors: Dhouha Abid, Emna Ben Messaoud, Ayten Ateş, Sana Akir, Philippe Guionneau, Stanislav Pechev

items.title: Layered Double Hydroxides with Interlayer Electrons Activate Strong Chemical Bonds
items.title_zh: 层状双氢氧化物中的层间电子激活强化学键
items.summary_zh: 层状电荷体是一类特殊材料，其中多余电子占据层间区域，作为阴离子平衡电荷。许多典型的层状电荷体基于亚氮化物和亚碳化物，促使我们寻找新的宿主结构。本文利用密度泛函理论（DFT）表征了一类源自层状双氢氧化物（LDHs）的层状电荷体。通过阴离子-电子交换过程，我们预测多种LDH组成能够稳定电荷体状态，其中显著电荷被限制在层间空间。我们评估了LDH电荷体的热力学和有限温度稳定性，表明稳定性与层间电荷之间的平衡可通过部分阴离子交换进行调控。DFT计算和从头算分子动力学模拟进一步揭示，层间电子通过促进强化学键的激活（如Br₂的自发解离和CO₂还原为甲酸）赋予独特的化学反应性。
items.abstract: Layered electrides are an unusual class of materials in which excess electrons occupy interlayer regions and serve as anionic, charge-balancing species. Many prototypical layered electrides are based on subnitrides and subcarbides, motivating the search for new types of host structures. Here, we use density functional theory (DFT) to characterize a class of layered electrides derived from layered double hydroxides (LDHs). Through an anion–electron exchange process, we predict that several LDH compositions can stabilize an electride state wherein significant charge is confined in the interlayer galleries. We evaluate the thermodynamic and finite-temperature stability of the LDH electrides, demonstrating that the balance between stability and interlayer charge can be controlled through partial anion exchange. DFT calculations and ab initio molecular dynamics simulations further reveal that the interlayer electrons impart unique chemical reactivity by facilitating the activation of strong chemical bonds, such as the spontaneous dissociation of Br 2 and the reduction of CO 2 to formate.
items.authors: Yuliang Shi, Andrew S. Rosen

items.title: Connected, but for how long? A residual-lifetime criterion for the hydraulic–diffusive boundary in polyamide reverse-osmosis membranes
items.title_zh: 聚酰胺反渗透膜水运输机制的残余寿命标准
items.summary_zh: 聚酰胺反渗透膜的水运输机制再次受到质疑：2023年的一项研究声称水的运输是由孔流而非溶液扩散主导，重新引发了许多人认为已解决的争论。随后，双相处理显示这两种描述在系数匹配后并不互斥。然而，这种调和回答的是现象学问题，而非结构性问题：是否存在真正的、承压的连续水相是一个关于材料的可测试主张。本文认为，解决这一问题需要两个条件，而先前的研究大多将其视为一个条件——瞬时的贯通连接拓扑及其在运输时间尺度上的存续。第二个条件迄今为止的估计方法不当：应从水分子在随机时刻到达时的残余寿命来考虑，而非连接区间的总寿命。提出了一种动态可达性度量Adyn = θ·SR(τtr)，基于强度面积连接度量θ和残余寿命生存函数SR，而非假设的指数衰减。最小结构替代物将连接转变置于模型水可达体积分数0.14-0.17，接近原子级别。
items.abstract: The mechanism of water transport through the polyamide active layer of reverse-osmosis membranes is again contested: a 2023 claim that transport is governed by pore flow rather than solution-diffusion reopened a debate many considered settled, and a two-phase treatment has since shown the two descriptions are not mutually exclusive once their coefficients are matched. That reconciliation, however, answers a phenomenological question, not a structural one: whether a genuine, pressure-bearing continuous water phase exists is a separate, testable claim about the material. This Perspective argues that settling it requires two conditions prior work has largely treated as one — an instantaneous through-connected topology, and its survival over the transport timescale — and that the second condition has so far been estimated the wrong way: from the total lifetime of a connectivity interval rather than the residual lifetime seen by a water molecule arriving at a random instant, the same statistical root as the inspection paradox. A dynamic accessibility measure, Adyn = θ·SR(τtr), is proposed to close this gap, built on an intensive areal connectivity measure θ and a residual-lifetime survi
items.authors: Ye. O. Kolomiiets

items.title: Fast-Response Operando Mass Spectrometry Demystifies C₂ Product Formation in Cu-Catalyzed CO and CO₂ Reduction: Burst of Ethylene Isotopologues
items.title_zh: 快速响应操作质谱揭示Cu催化CO和CO₂还原中C₂产物形成机制
items.summary_zh: 在电催化领域，实时测量产物形成一直是一个长期挑战。本文将实时气体分析质谱仪与改进的采样入口结合到气体扩散电极单元，实现了对反应物消耗和产物形成的亚秒级时间分辨率。我们重点研究了氧化物衍生的Cu上的CO₂/CO还原反应，因其反应机制和对乙烯（C₂H₄）高选择性的持续关注。CO还原的电位阶跃实验表明，CO的初始消耗迅速（约1秒），但C₂H₄产物的出现可能慢10倍，归因于CO在Cu表面储存和重构为活性C₂+形成配置所需的时间。实验结果显示，12CO₂/13CO的共同进料增强了含13C的乙烯同位素，但其机制尚不清楚。通过同位素标记气体切换实验（12CO₂-13CO），提供了有力证据，表明13C物种在催化剂附近或表面存在超过一分钟，即使在供给源切断后，且显著增强的含13C乙烯同位素（纯13C₂H₄和混合13C12CH₄）形成。
items.abstract: It has been a long-standing challenge in electrocatalysis to measure product formation with kinetically relevant time resolution. Here, we couple a real-time gas analyzer mass spectrometer with a modified sampling inlet to a gas diffusion electrode cell, achieving sub-second time resolution for both reactant consumption and product formation. We focus on CO 2 /CO reduction on oxide-derived Cu, motivated by the continuing interest in its reaction mechanism and its high selectivity to ethylene (C 2 H 4 ) formation. Potential step experiments for CO reduction reveal that the initial consumption of CO is fast ( 1 s), but the appearance of C 2 H 4 products can be 10 times slower, which we attribute to the time required for CO storage on the Cu surface and subsequent reconstruction into the active, C 2+ -forming, configuration. Previous studies have reported that the co-feed of 12 CO 2 / 13 CO results in the enhancement of 13 C-containing ethylene isotopologues, but the mechanism causing this remains unknown. Isotopic-labeled gas switching ( 12 CO 2 - 13 CO) experiments yield compelling evidence that 13 C species continue to exist for more than a minute at near proximity to or on the cat
items.authors: Helen J. Zeng, Yesol Kim, Junko Yano, Joel W. Ager

items.title: ∆-Machine Learning for LC-DFT-level Excitation Energies of Bacteriochlorophyll Molecules in a LH2 Complex
items.title_zh: 基于∆-机器学习的LH2复合体中细菌叶绿素激发能研究
items.summary_zh: 细菌叶绿素（BChl）分子是紫色细菌光捕获复合体2（LH2）的关键色素，驱动太阳能转化。该过程中，色素的激发能在超快时间尺度上受到周围蛋白环境的调制，影响复合体内的激发动力学。由于这些分子较大（85个原子）且电子结构复杂，激发能的波动通常通过半经验方法或低水平的时间相关密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）进行估算。本研究引入∆-机器学习协议，在量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）框架内，使用半经验紧束缚类比（TD-LC-DFTB）作为低成本参考，预测计算要求高的长程修正（LC）TD-DFT水平的激发能。我们确定了来自Rs. molischianum的LH2复合体的720万种BChl几何构型的激发能，考虑和不考虑蛋白环境。意外的是，环境描述符未能提高模型性能，最终模型仅依赖于分子描述符。所得LC-DFT和机器学习的激发能波动使重组能更接近实验值。
items.abstract: Bacteriochlorophyll (BChl) molecules are the key pigments in the light-harvesting complex 2 (LH2) of purple bacteria, driving solar energy conversion. During this process, fluctuations in excitation energies of the pigments at ultrafast timescales, modulated by the surrounding protein environment, govern the excitation dynamics within the complex. Because of the relatively large size of these molecules with 85 atoms and their complex electronic structure, these energy fluctuations have so far been estimated using semi-empirical methods or low-level time-dependent density functional theory (TD-DFT). In this work, we introduce a ∆-machine learning protocol to predict excitation energies at the computationally demanding long-range-corrected (LC) TD-DFT level within a quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) framework, using a semi-empirical tight-binding analogue (TD-LC-DFTB) as a low-cost reference. Excitation energies for 7.2 million BChl geometries from trajectories of the LH2 complex of Rs. molischianum have been determined at the TD-LC-DFT level, both with and without taking the protein environment into account. Unexpectedly, environmental descriptors did not improve perform
items.authors: Sayan Maity, Vivin Vinod, Peter Zaspel, Ulrich Kleinekathöfer

items.title: Clustered Graph Partitions Provide Compact Diabatic Bases for RCI-LC-DFTB Charge-Transfer Calculations
items.title_zh: 聚类图划分为RCI-LC-DFTB电荷转移计算提供紧凑的 diabatic 基础
items.summary_zh: 基于限制的配置相互作用长程修正自洽电荷密度泛函紧束缚（RCI-LC-DFTB）是一种高效的近似量子化学方法，利用非正交的 diabatic 状态描述分子电荷转移状态。然而，其实际性能依赖于电荷局域化的 diabatic 状态的选择。本文开发并比较了两种基于图的自动化 diabatic 基础构建策略：离散图傅里叶表示和聚类双连通划分表示。对苯组装基准系统的应用表明，离散图傅里叶表示提供了一种系统扩展，可能需要多个 diabatic 状态，而聚类双连通划分表示则提供了更紧凑且具有化学可解释性的基础。我们进一步将聚类表示应用于在外电场下的16残基芳香族寡酰胺折叠体，展示了场诱导的长程电荷局域化的单位分辨分析。这些结果表明聚类图划分的有效性。
items.abstract: Restriction-based configuration interaction long-range corrected self-consistent charge density functional tight binding (RCI-LC-DFTB) is an efficient approximate quantum chemical method that uses non-orthogonal diabatic states to describe molecular chargetransfer states. However, its practical performance depends on how the charge-localized diabatic states are selected. Here, we develop and compare two graph-based strategies for automated diabatic-basis construction: a discrete graph Fourier representation and a clustered biconnected-partition representation. Applications to benzene-assembly benchmark systems show that the discrete graph Fourier representation provides a systematic expansion that can require many diabatic states, whereas the clustered biconnected- partition representation gives a more compact and chemically interpretable basis. We further apply the clustered representation to a 16-residue aromatic oligoamide foldamer under an external electric field, demonstrating unit-resolved analysis of field-induced long-range charge localization. These results show that clustered graph partitions
items.authors: Ji Huang, Tim Kowalczyk, Daisuke Yokogawa

items.title: Unit-Cell Molecular Dynamics Framework for Cross-Linked Hydrogels: Linking Cross-Link Density, Hydration Shells, and Swelling
items.title_zh: 交联水凝胶的单元格分子动力学框架研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在通过将局部酰胺-水相互作用与宏观性质联系起来，合理设计聚丙烯酰胺（PAAm）水凝胶。我们结合“单元格”PAAm段的分子动力学（MD）模拟与实验数据，探讨丙烯酰胺（Ac）与N,N′-亚甲基双丙烯酰胺（BAc）摩尔比对网络结构和水动力学的影响。通过对4:1至7:1的PAAm链进行建模，我们采用非共价自组装单元格类比重新构建共价交联网络，连接低聚物代理和超分子建模范式。通过与重力膨胀、FTIR、SEM和振荡流变学数据的验证，我们识别出一种两阶段组装机制：首先，酰胺基团经历段内静电预组织，随后发生段间氢键结合。
items.abstract: Rational design of polyacrylamide (PAAm) hydrogels involves linking local amide–water interactions to macroscopic properties. This study combines molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of “unit-cell” PAAm segments with experimental data to explore how the acrylamide (Ac) to N,N′ methylenebisacrylamide (BAc) molar ratio affects network structure and water dynamics. By modeling PAAm chains at ratios from 4:1 to 7:1, we reframe a covalently cross-linked network using a non-covalently self-assembling unitcell analogy, bridging oligomer-proxy and supramolecular modeling paradigms. Validating our findings against gravimetric swelling, FTIR, SEM, and oscillatory rheology data, we identify a two-stage assembly mechanism. Initially, amide groups undergo intrasegment electrostatic pre-organization, followed by inter-segment hydrogen-bonding.
items.authors: Miteshkumar Moirangthem, Tanu Tiwari, Karthik Pushpavanam, Santosh Kumar Meena

items.title: Optical fiber chemistry for catalysis: a programmable optical fiber membrane electrode platform for reaction chemistry and engineering
items.title_zh: 光纤化学催化：可编程光纤膜电极平台研究
items.summary_zh: 光纤化学（OFC）是一种催化平台，光纤在其中积极提供光子传输、界面构建和过程控制。本文开发了一种光纤膜电极（OFME）框架，涵盖了结构、机制、过程强化和可编程控制。其阳极光纤催化层-离子交换膜-阴极光纤催化层的三明治结构将内部光子传输、电荷转移、离子导电、催化位点和流体相质量传输结合在一个膜电极反应域内。方程驱动的模拟考察了模型一致性和反应器设计趋势。归一化分离度为0.1338时，平面因子为0.882；一阶动力学的速率常数为0.0568 min−1，60分钟后转化率达到96.69%。在无量纲轴向衰减为1时，双端照明使光学均匀性指数从0.712提高至0.963；在衰减为3时，相应值为0.186和0.721。归一化速率场景1.00/1.45/2.35生成了传统电解、外部照明光辅助电解和嵌入式OFME架构的不同动力学特征。讨论了氢气和氧气演化、二氧化碳还原和氮气反应的界面化学、气泡覆盖、膜传输、能量效率和规模化问题。
items.abstract: Optical fiber chemistry (OFC) is a catalytic platform in which optical fibers actively provide photon transport, interface construction, and process control. This article develops an optical fiber membrane electrode (OFME) framework encompassing architecture, mechanisms, process intensification, and programmable control. Its anode fiber catalytic layer–ion-exchange membrane–cathode fiber catalytic layer sandwich couples internal photon transport, charge transfer, ion conduction, catalytic sites, and fluid-phase mass transport within one membrane-electrode reaction domain. Equation-driven simulations examine model consistency and reactor design trends. A normalized separation of 0.1338 gives a coplanar factor of 0.882; first-order kinetics with a rate constant of 0.0568 min−1 gives 96.69% conversion after 60 min. At a dimensionless axial attenuation of 1, double-ended illumination increases the optical uniformity index from 0.712 to 0.963; at an attenuation of 3, the corresponding values are 0.186 and 0.721. Normalized rate scenarios of 1.00/1.45/2.35 generate distinct kinetic profiles for conventional electrolysis, externally illuminated photo-assisted electrolysis, and embedded OF
items.authors: Shiping Gu, Haitao Gu

items.title: Tandem mass spectrometric analysis of interfacial lipid alkyl chains selectively modified via reactive ion deposition
items.title_zh: 反应离子沉积法选择性修饰界面脂质的串联质谱分析
items.summary_zh: 脂质的分子结构，包括支链、双键和疏水链内的取代，是生物标志物和信号传导等研究领域的关键因素，并决定细胞膜的性质。尽管质谱已成为脂质组学的主要方法，但利用广泛可用的方法（CID下的MSn）确定脂肪酸链结构仍然具有挑战性。本研究提出反应离子沉积法作为化学修饰薄层界面脂质的方法。高度反应性的[B12I11]−阴离子被质量选择并沉积到含有各种脂肪酸、磷脂酰丝氨酸、磷脂酰胆碱和三酰甘油的层上。通过同位素标记化合物，我们观察到[B12I11]−选择性结合脂肪酸疏水n-烷基链的末端甲基（≥95%）。在反应离子与表面共价结合过程中，脂质的分子结构保持完整，有效地在烷基链上进行电荷标记。因此，能够对界面活性层成分进行ESI-MS分析。阴离子反应产物的碰撞诱导解离揭示了脂质的结构信息，包括头基和脂肪酸链结构（如支链、双键和取代位置）。此方法不仅能够分析脂质。
items.abstract: The molecular structures of lipids, including branching, double bonds and substitution within the hydrophobic chains, are key aspects in research fields such as biomarkers and signaling, and determine cell membrane properties. Although mass spectrometry has become the dominant method for lipidomics, determining fatty acid chain structures using widely available methods (MSn via CID) remains challenging. In this study, we present reactive ion deposition as a method for chemically modifying interfacial lipids in thin layers. Highly reactive [B12I11]− anions are mass-selected and deposited onto layers containing various fatty acids, phosphatidylserines, phosphatidylcholines and triacylglycerides. Using isotope-labelled compounds, we observed that [B12I11]− selectively binds to the terminal methyl groups of fatty acid hydrophobic n-alkyl chains (≥95%). The molecular structure of the lipid remains intact during covalent binding of the reactive ion on the surface, effectively charge-tagging the lipid at the alkyl chain. Therefore, ESI-MS analysis of the interfacially active layer components is enabled. Collision-induced dissociation of the anionic reaction products reveals structural inf
items.authors: David Höschele, Markus Rohdenburg, Nataša Negru, Hanna Ziegler, Kay-Antonio Behrend, Harald Knorke

items.title: Robust Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Improves Joint Predicted-Potency and Drug-Likeness Yield in EGFR Molecule Generation
items.title_zh: 稳健的多目标强化学习提升EGFR分子生成的联合预测效能与药物相似性
items.summary_zh: 针对单一活性模型估计优化分子生成器可能导致对不可靠估计的结构给予奖励。我们扩展了已发布的ChemBERTa强化学习工作流程，采用了支架分离的活性建模、经验校准的低分数、有限的化学奖励和匹配种子评估。从ChEMBL 37中，我们整理了6,476个具有参考/未指定生化EGFR IC50测量的独特结构；分别将4,491、680和1,305个结构分配到支架不重叠的训练、校准和测试集。随机森林奖励模型在测试中实现了0.610 pIC50单位的平均绝对误差和R2 = 0.615。均匀或富集效能的掩蔽语言模型延续与三种强化学习奖励交叉，采用三种种子和每种组合600次生成尝试。锁定的LCB与仅均值比较使GNN效能筛选产量提高了0.28个百分点。在与已发布基线的管道级比较中，稳健-LCB在所有六个匹配区块中提高了GNN联合筛选产量；在两个MLM分支中，产量从0.72%上升至1.22%。两个结构通过了完整的RF-GNN共识筛选。这些结果支持了联合预测效能的管道级提升。
items.abstract: Optimizing a molecular generator against a single activity-model estimate can reward structures for which that estimate is unreliable. We extended our published ChemBERTa–reinforcement-learning (RL) workflow for human epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) with scaffold-separated activity modeling, empirically calibrated lower scores, bounded chemistry rewards, and matched-seed evaluation. From ChEMBL 37, we curated 6,476 unique structures with Reference/unspecified biochemical EGFR IC50 measurements; 4,491, 680, and 1,305 structures were assigned to scaffold-disjoint training, calibration, and test sets. The random-forest reward model achieved a test mean absolute error of 0.610 pIC50 units and R2 = 0.615. Uniform or potency-enriched masked-language-model continuation was crossed with three RL rewards, with three seeds and 600 generation attempts per combination. The locked LCB-versus-mean-only comparison changed GNN potency-screen yield by +0.28 percentage points (95% descriptive t interval,-1.10 to +1.66) across three seed-cluster means. In the pipeline-level comparison with the published-form baseline, Robust-LCB increased the GNN joint-screen yield in all six matched blocks;

items.title: Reversible CO2 Concentration in the Electrical Double Layer in the Absence of (Bi)carbonate
items.title_zh: 无碳酸盐情况下电双层中可逆CO2浓度变化研究
items.summary_zh: CO2在电极-电解质界面的行为对气候变化缓解技术的发展至关重要，尤其是在电化学CO2捕集与转化中。本研究探讨了在无碳酸盐和重碳酸盐离子的情况下，分子CO2在使用活性炭电极的超电容器中的作用。采用惰性有机电解质溶剂（乙腈），发现该系统能够实现可逆的电化学CO2吸附，明确表明分子CO2是超电容器摆动吸附（SSA）中的活性物质。研究还发现，将气体空间从氮气(N2)更换为二氧化碳(CO2)后，水相和乙腈基超电容器的电容均有所增加。
items.abstract: The behaviour of CO 2 at electrode-electrolyte interfaces is key in the development of climate change mitigation technologies, such as electrochemical CO 2 capture and conversion. In particular, electrochemical CO 2 capture using supercapacitors, an approach known as supercapacitive swing adsorption (SSA), utilises the charging and discharging of supercapacitor devices to reversibly and selectively adsorb CO 2 . As supercapacitive charging incurs low energy losses and can be carried out under ambient conditions, this method has the potential to achieve higher energy efficiencies than other CO 2 capture techniques. However, the design of SSA systems has been hindered by a lack of understanding of the underlying mechanism. In particular, the contributions of different CO 2 -related species—molecular CO 2 , carbonate, and bicarbonate—to SSA remain poorly understood. In this work, the role of molecular CO 2 in SSA using activated carbon electrodes was explored in the absence of carbonate and bicarbonate ions by using an inert organic electrolyte solvent, acetonitrile. items.authors: Cerys Walsh, Malina Seyffertitz, Zeke Coady, Selina E. Wiesner, Jack S. Taylor, Israel Temprano

items.title: A single reference-energy outlier nearly eliminates Co–O chemistry from a generative model's training distribution
items.title_zh: 单一参考能量异常几乎消除Co–O化学反应模型训练分布
items.summary_zh: 对MatterGen生成的44,688个氧化物结构进行元素分辨审计，发现总组成合规性为73.27%，但隐藏了严重的化学特异性失败。71.27%的请求钴的结构中未包含钴，而其他19种请求元素的遗漏率为8.12 ± 3.28%。98.17%的钴遗漏仅涉及钴元素。细胞大小、阳离子可替代性、稳定性增益及一般训练频率效应无法解释该异常。追溯失败源头发现，公共Alex-MP-20参考集中仅有一例8,924个钴氧化物通过稳定性筛选。该缺陷源于一个异常的参考能量条目扭曲了Co–O凸包；排除后，符合训练条件的钴氧化物数量从1增加到2,499。四个独立的DFT计算与当前材料项目值相符，偏差仅为0.024 eV atom-1，而发布文件的值偏差为6.26 eV atom-1。预注册的干预实验显示，去除稳定性条件或加强扩散指导均未能正常化盲点。这些结果表明，单一高杠杆参考能量异常可通过稳定性筛选放大为化学家族规模的训练缺陷。
items.abstract: An element-resolved audit of 44,688 oxide structures generated by MatterGen under chemical-system conditioning revealed that the aggregate composition compliance (73.27% exact match) concealed a severe chemistry-specific failure. Cobalt was omitted from 71.27% of the structures requesting it, against 8.12 ± 3.28% for the other 19 requested elements, and 98.17% of the cobalt omissions removed cobalt alone. Cell size, cation substitutability, stability gain and a general training-frequency effect did not account for the anomaly. Tracing the failure upstream showed that only one of the 8,924 cobalt oxides in the public Alex-MP-20 reference set passed the stability filter. The deficit was traced to a single anomalous reference-energy entry distorting the Co–O convex hull; excluding it raises the number of training-eligible cobalt oxides from 1 to 2,499. Four independent DFT calculations and the current Materials Project value agree within 0.024 eV atom-1, whereas the value implied by the released file deviates from them by 6.26 eV atom-1. items.title: Target breadth and mutation resilience in African-natural-product-inspired antimalarial chemotypes: a computational analysis
items.title_zh: 非洲天然产物启发的抗疟化合物靶点广度与突变抗性分析
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在优先选择非洲天然产物启发的抗疟化合物时，靶点广度和突变抗性是否可以作为独立且互补的特性进行评估。我们通过将化学空间扩展与靶点特异性对接及每靶点抗性抗性评分（RRS）相结合，保持计算证据与生物活性分开。生成的65,856种分子的混合库中，优先合成的候选化合物为19,913种。使用AutoDock Vina对17个多药理学导向的成员进行评估，靶点包括PfDHFR、PfCRT、PfClpP和PfATP4，所有候选-靶点对均通过几何姿态质量标准，得分范围为−7.91 kcal/mol至−4.63 kcal/mol。每靶点RRS是基于PfDHFR和PfCRT突变面板计算的，结果显示该队列包含六个A*、五个B、五个C和一个D RRS谱，范围为68.2至111.7。交叉度量关联在多重性校正后较弱或不显著。最终的靶点谱定义了关于化合物广度的可测试假设。
items.abstract: Can target breadth and mutation resilience be evaluated as distinct, complementary properties when prioritizing antimalarial chemotypes from African natural-product-inspired chemical space? We addressed this question by linking chemical-space expansion to target-specific docking and a per-target resistance-resilience score (RRS), while keeping computational evidence separate from biological activity. A hybrid library of 65 856 molecules, generated from 396 African natural products and 454 synthetic antimalarial compounds, yielded 19 913 computationally prioritized synthesizable leads. A 17-member polypharmacology-oriented cohort was evaluated by AutoDock Vina against PfDHFR, PfCRT, PfClpP, and PfATP4 using target-specific structural anchors. All 68 candidate–target pairs passed the geometric pose-quality criterion, with scores ranging from −7.91 kcal/mol to −4.63 kcal/mol. Per-target RRS was calculated from separate PfDHFR (N51I, C59R, S108N, I164L) and PfCRT (K76T, K76A) mutant panels, excluding non-binding wild-type targets from the denominator. The cohort comprised six A*, five B, five C, and one D RRS profiles, spanning 68.2 to 111.7. Cross-metric associations were weak or non-
items.authors: Myke Vital Sao Temgoua, Jean-Pierre Tchapet Njafa, Penabei Samafou, Wilfred Fon Mbacham, Serge Guy Nana Engo

items.title: Synthesis of 15N-Labelled Complex Saturated N-Heterocycles via Late-Stage Carbonyl-to-Nitrogen Swap
items.title_zh: 通过后期碳基到氮基交换合成15N标记的复杂饱和N-杂环
items.summary_zh: 有效构建15N标记的复杂饱和N-杂环仍然是一个重大挑战。本文报告了一种后期碳基到15N骨架修饰策略，能够将复杂的环状酮直接转化为富含15N的饱和杂环。这一转化依赖于一种基于甲基磺酰的15N标记偶氮试剂，该试剂在不影响所需C-C键断裂路径的情况下抑制了不必要的过氧化反应。该反应具有广泛的底物适用性，能够耐受多种功能团，成为复杂天然产物和类药物分子后期骨架修饰的有效工具。初步的计算研究揭示了连续双C-C活化事件的机制洞察。
items.abstract: ‡Process Research and Development, Merck Co., Rahway, New Jersey 07065, United States ABSTRACT: Efficient construction of 15N-labelled complex saturated N-heterocycles remains a substantial challenge. Here we report a late-stage carbonyl-to-15N skeletal modification strategy that converts complex cyclic ketones directly into 15Nenriched saturated heterocycles. This transformation is enabled by a methylsulfonyl-based 15N-labelled azonation reagent that suppresses unwanted overoxidation without compromising the desired C-C bond cleavage pathway. The reaction exhibits a broad substrate scope and tolerates a wide range of functional groups, serving as an effective tool for late-stage skeletal modifications of complex natural products and drug-like molecules. Mechanistic insights on the sequential double C–C activation events have been elucidated by preliminary computational studies.
items.authors: Zining Zhang, Seoung-Tae Kim, Jingwei Li, Guangbin Dong

items.title: Runtime-steered ultrashort molecular dynamics enables million-pose protein–ligand screening
items.title_zh: 运行时引导的超短分子动力学实现百万姿态蛋白-配体筛选
items.summary_zh: 分子动力学（MD）在发现规模上的应用受到评估数千到数百万候选姿态成本的限制。我们提出了一种将对接与动力学结合的工作流程，通过对每个姿态应用超短轨迹（0.1–5纳秒）的集合，使MD与筛选规模评估兼容。MD-score作为配体-RMSD稳定性指标，既作为姿态排名分数，也作为在线停止标准。在一个包含88个活性和702个非活性靶标的条件性基准测试中，MD-score在前十个姿态中实现了0.868的姿态感知ROC-AUC，而广泛的姿态和速度采样比延长较少的轨迹更有效。运行时引导将评估扩展到1,234,620个EGFR姿态，同时将模拟时间减少到全面评估的24%。对马尔堡病毒核蛋白的前瞻性筛选在76种测试化合物中获得了三个初步的迷你基因组活性命中。这些结果将超短MD定位为对接、数据驱动预测与高成本验证之间的可扩展动态过滤器。
items.abstract: Applying molecular dynamics (MD) at discovery scale is limited by the cost of evaluating thousands to millions of candidate poses. We present a docking-to-dynamics workflow that makes MD compatible with screening-scale evaluation by applying ensembles of ultrashort trajectories (0.1–5 ns) to each pose. MD-score, a ligand-RMSD stability metric, serves as both a pose-ranking score and, with a threshold, an online stopping criterion. In a conditional six-target benchmark of 88 actives and 702 inactives, MD-score achieved a pose-aware ROC-AUC of 0.868 for the top ten poses, while broad pose and velocity sampling was more effective than extending fewer trajectories. Runtime steering scaled evaluation to 1,234,620 EGFR poses while reducing simulated time to 24% of exhaustive evaluation. A prospective Marburg virus nucleoprotein screen yielded three initial minigenome-active hits among 76 tested compounds. These results position ultrashort MD as a scalable dynamic filter between docking, data-driven prediction and higher-cost validation.
items.authors: Natsuki Kanazawa, Junta Asano, Mitsugu Araki, Shingo Okuno, Takao Otsuka, Yuta Isaka

items.title: Direct-to-biology approach for the selective identification of ligands for alpha-synuclein aggregates
items.title_zh: 直接生物学方法选择性识别α-突触核蛋白聚集体配体
items.summary_zh: 选择性靶向α-突触核蛋白（α-syn）聚集体是诊断和治疗帕金森病及相关突触核蛋白病的重要挑战。尽管已有多种配体用于淀粉样蛋白成像，但大多数缺乏对α-syn相较于其他淀粉样纤维的特异性。本文报告了一种直接生物学（D2B）策略，以加速此类选择性配体的识别。合成了384种派泊嗪衍生化合物，并在平板格式中筛选其对α-syn致病聚集体的亲和力，与淀粉样β 42（Aβ42）纤维进行比较。发现九种化合物对α-syn聚集体具有优先结合，其中三种的结合能力至少比Aβ42高出四倍。通过体外α-syn纤维进一步验证这些分子，确定了一种对纤维状α-syn具有中等亲和力（181 nM）的新型强效选择性结合剂。这些发现验证了D2B方法在加速致病蛋白聚集体特异性配体开发中的潜力。
items.abstract: The selective targeting of α-synuclein (α-syn) aggregates represents a critical challenge for the diagnosis and treatment of Parkinson’s disease and related synucleinopathies. While several ligands have been developed for amyloid imaging, most of them lack sufficient specificity for α-syn over other amyloid fibrils. We report here a direct-to-biology (D2B) strategy to accelerate the identification of such selective ligands. A library of 384 piperazine-derived compounds was synthesized in a plate-based format and screened to evaluate their affinity for α-syn pathogenic aggregates compared to amyloid-beta 42 (Aβ42) fibrils. Nine compounds were found to bind preferentially to α-syn aggregates, three of which displayed at least a four-fold increased binding compared to Aβ42. Further validation of those molecules using in vitro α-syn fibrils enabled to determine a new potent selective binder of fibrillar α-syn with moderate affinity (181 nM). These findings validate the potential of D2B approaches to accelerate specific ligand development for pathogenic protein aggregates.
items.authors: Gaëtan Ossard, Clémentine Pescheteau, Timothée D’Anfray, David-Alexandre Buisson, Jean-Christophe Cintrat, Ronald Melki

items.title: Facet Selective Adsorption and Mobility of Anthracene Based Nanocars on Gold Surfaces
items.title_zh: 基于蒽的纳米车在金表面的选择性吸附与移动性研究
items.summary_zh: 本文通过原子分子动力学模拟研究了基于蒽的纳米车（ANTH-R；R= H, Me, Cl）在Au(100)和Au(111)晶面上的行为，探讨了晶面晶体学、取代基化学和溶剂化的综合影响。结合自由能计算结果显示，纳米车在Au(111)上的吸附强度更大，顺序为：ANTH-Me > ANTH-Cl > ANTH-H，同时在Au(111)上的扩散被抑制了多达100倍。取代基的化学性质影响了吸附几何形状，并产生了不同的传输机制，为在实际条件下设计纳米车的运动提供了原则。
items.abstract: Atomistic molecular dynamics simulations of anthracene-based nanocars (ANTH-R; R= H, Me, Cl) on Au(100) and Au(111) facets in explicit water, investigating the combined effects of facet crystallography, substituent chemistry, and solvation previously unexplored. Binding free energies reveal stronger adsorption on Au(111): ANTH-Me ANTH-Cl ANTH-H, with diffusion suppressed upto 100 fold on Au(111). Substituent chemistry influences adsorption geometry and create varied transport regimes providing design principles for nanocar motion under realistic conditions.
items.authors: Kush Kumar, Miteshkumar Moirangthem, Santosh Kumar Meena

items.title: Quantifying the Synergistic and Antagonistic Effects of Metal–Organic Complexation on Particulate Matter Oxidative Potential via Redox Kinetics
items.title_zh: 金属-有机络合对颗粒物氧化潜力的协同与拮抗效应定量研究
items.summary_zh: 氧化潜力（OP）是颗粒物（PM）中红氧活性物质通过红氧化还原化学在肺液中生成活性氧物种（ROS）能力的指标。本文使用新开发的化学平衡-动力学DTT测定模型评估Fe-草酸盐体系，探讨金属与非红氧活性有机物混合物的OP效应。实验显示，随着草酸盐与Fe比例的增加，出现三个不同阶段：低比例时的弱相互作用、高比例时的强拮抗作用，以及极高比例时的强协同作用。模型成功再现了弱相互作用和拮抗作用。Fe-草酸盐络合增强了Fe(II)驱动的氧化剂还原动力学，但也使Fe(III)/Fe(II)平衡向Fe(III)偏移，降低了Fe(II)浓度，抵消了部分动力学增强。强拮抗作用源于反应性较低的Fe(III)-草酸盐物种对Fe(III)驱动的DTT氧化的抑制。模型未能再现强协同作用，表明存在额外的反应途径。这些结果表明，金属-有机相互作用对OP的影响由复杂的化学机制决定。
items.abstract: Oxidative potential (OP) is an indicator of the ability of redox-active species in particulate matter (PM) to generate reactive oxygen species (ROS) via redox chemistry in lung lining fluid. Previous studies have reported synergistic and antagonistic OP effects in mixtures of metals and non-redox-active organics and attributed them to complexation-induced changes in redox potential and kinetics; however, the quantitative validity of this mechanistic hypothesis remains unclear. Here, we evaluated this hypothesis using a newly developed chemical equilibrium–kinetic DTT assay model for Fe–oxalate system. Experiments showed three distinct stages with increasing oxalate-to-Fe ratio: weak interactions at low ratios, strong antagonism at higher ratios, and strong synergy at extremely high ratios. The model successfully reproduced the weak interactions and antagonism. Fe– oxalate complexation enhanced Fe(II)-driven oxidant reduction kinetics but also shifted the Fe(III)/Fe(II) balance toward Fe(III), decreasing Fe(II) concentrations and offsetting much of the kinetic enhancement. Strong antagonism arose from suppression of Fe(III)-driven DTT oxidation by less reactive Fe(III)–oxalate speci
items.authors: Satoko Kayaba, Yuji Fujitani

items.title: Condition-Aware and Leakage-Resistant Machine Learning of Short-Peptide Self-Assembly Across Bulk State and Supramolecular Morphology
items.title_zh: 条件感知与抗泄漏短肽自组装机器学习研究
items.summary_zh: 短肽自组装受分子结构和实验环境共同影响，但许多预测工作流将特定条件下的观察视为独立样本。本文重建了一个源审核的数据集，评估在抗泄漏验证下的体相和超分子形态预测。肽的身份由序列、末端修饰、非末端修饰、肽系统注释和结合伙伴定义；实验描述符包括浓度、pH、温度、热历史、孵育和显式溶剂组成。常规随机行分割显示出强烈的非独立性：87.3%的测试分子身份已在训练中出现，94.2%的测试行来自训练中表示的分子。因此，所有主要结论基于分子身份分组验证和包含先前未见分子系统的永久封闭样本。在115个来自20个未见分子身份的条件下，调优的随机森林模型在水凝胶与非水凝胶预测中达到了ROCAUC 0.977、PR-AUC 0.882、平衡准确率0.945、F1 0.880和MCC 0.836。溶剂身份和组成是主要的可转移特征块，但仅限于完全水相条件的分析表明，非溶剂变量也具有重要影响。
items.abstract: Short-peptide self-assembly is governed jointly by molecular structure and experimental environment, yet many predictive workflows treat condition-specific observations as independent samples. Here, a source-audited dataset was reconstructed from PeptideMiner and SAPdb to evaluate bulk-state and supramolecular-morphology prediction under leakage-resistant validation. Peptide identity was defined from sequence,terminal modifications,non-terminal modifications,peptide-system annotations,and conjugate partners; experimental descriptors included concentration, pH, temperature, thermal history, incubation, and explicit solvent composition. A conventional random row split was shown to be strongly non-independent: 87.3% of test molecular identities had already appeared in training and 94.2% of test rows came from molecules represented in training.Accordingly,all primary claims were based on molecular-identity-grouped validation and permanently sealed holdouts containing previously unseen molecular systems. For hydrogel versus non-gel prediction, a tuned Random Forest achieved ROCAUC 0.977, PR-AUC 0.882, balanced accuracy 0.945, F1 0.880, and MCC 0.836 on 115 conditions from 20 unseen mole
items.authors: Dennis Obinna Orji

items.title: Chemically Fueled Spatiotemporal Patterns from Charge-transfer Supramolecular Assembly
items.title_zh: 化学驱动的电荷转移超分子组装时空模式
items.summary_zh: 自主形成复杂模式的合成系统仍然是化学和材料科学的前沿挑战。本文展示了一种红氧还原响应的超分子系统，其中化学状态、组装和运输的耦合变化通过密度驱动的化学对流生成时空模式。吡喃啉和紫罗兰衍生物的电荷转移复合物经历可逆的氧还原控制组装-解组装循环，产生依赖于组成的浮力，驱动对流流动并反馈到不断演变的组装分布中。分子两亲性和超分子组装形态调节了生成的模式类型，包括点状、条纹状和花状结构，无需外部场。有限元模拟再现了观察到的化学对流动态，而线性稳定性分析预测了起始条件及其特征波长。弱非线性分析进一步识别出拉长组装的降低平移扩散性作为削弱六角模式选择并偏好各向异性临界状态的机制。这些结果为将超分子组织与化学驱动的流体动力学模式形成耦合提供了分子到宏观的框架。
items.abstract: Creating synthetic systems that autonomously form complex patterns remains a frontier challenge in chemistry and materials science. Here, we present a redox-responsive supramolecular system in which coupled changes in chemical state, assembly, and transport generate spatiotemporal patterns through density-driven chemoconvection. Charge-transfer complexes of pyranine and viologen derivatives undergo reversible redox-controlled assembly–disassembly cycles, producing composition-dependent buoyancy that drive convective flows and feeds back into the evolving assembly distribution. Molecular amphiphilicity and supramolecular assembly morphology tune the resulting pattern type, dot-, stripe-, and flower-like structures without external fields. Finite-element simulations reproduce the observed chemoconvective dynamics, while linear stability analysis predicts the onset conditions and its characteristic wavelength. A weakly nonlinear analysis further identifies reduced translational diffusivity of elongated assemblies as a mechanism that weakens hexagonal mode selection and favors anisotropic near-onset states. These results provide a molecular-to-macroscopic framework for coupling supramo
items.authors: Surbhi Sharma, Aritra K. Mukhopadhyay, Mohit Kumar, Jessica Erlenbusch, Ankit Sakhuja, Benno Liebchen

items.title: Chainable DataFrame Framework for Interactive Chemical Data Processing with pdChemChain
items.title_zh: 可链式数据框架pdChemChain用于交互式化学数据处理
items.summary_zh: 计算化学家常常构建难以重用、共享或部署的数据处理工作流。pdChemChain是一个开源Python框架，通过将化学数据处理链视为可组合、自序列化的pandas DataFrame操作，解决了这一问题。该框架遵循三个设计原则：每个操作接受一个DataFrame并返回一个DataFrame；操作通过+运算符组合成链，这些链本身也是操作；所有链都是自配置的，可以序列化为YAML以便于命令行部署。pdChemChain基于广泛使用的RDKit和pandas，提供分子处理、属性计算、评分转换和多参数聚合的链接，同时通过最小的数据类API保持可扩展性。该框架可在https://github.com/EBjerrum/pdchemchain以LGPL-3.0许可证获取。
items.abstract: Computational chemists frequently build data processing workflows as ad-hoc scripts that are difficult to reuse, share, or deploy. Yet, many of the alternative workflow platforms demand significant complexity overhead or create manual breaks in workflows involving different pieces of software. pdChemChain is an open-source Python framework that bridges interactive use in python with reuse and deployment, by treating chemical data processing chains as composable, self-serializing pandas DataFrame operations. The framework is built around three design principles: (1) every operation takes a DataFrame and returns a DataFrame, (2) operations compose via the + operator into chains that are themselves operations, and (3) all chains are self-configuring, i.e. serializable to YAML for command-line deployment without code changes. Chains are built interactively in notebooks with immediate visual feedback, then deployed as-is via CLI or as scoring components in generative design frameworks. Built on widely used RDKit and pandas, pdChemChain provides links for molecular processing, property calculation, score transformation, and multi-parameter aggregation, while remaining extensible through
