items.title: Carbon Nanotube-Induced Magnetic Shielding Effects on 129Xe NMR from Equivariant Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 碳纳米管对129Xe NMR的磁屏蔽效应研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用等变图神经网络（EGNNs）对碳纳米管中氙的分子动力学模拟进行机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的优化，并开发了129Xe NMR磁屏蔽张量σ的机器学习模型，能够直接从MLMD快照中预测。两种模型均具有数据高效性，并在训练数据之外保持准确性。通过这一双模型框架，我们发现被碳纳米管包裹的氙经历了由纳米管引起的负129Xe各向同性化学位移，其随纳米管直径呈非单调变化，并进一步依赖于温度和氙的负载量。这一双模型方法为理解限制驱动的129Xe NMR响应提供了有效途径。
items.abstract: Equivariant graph neural networks (EGNNs) have shown success in building efficient and accurate machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for molecular dynamics (MD) and in enabling the prediction of nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) parameters in complex systems. In this work, EGNNs are used to fine-tune an atomistic foundation model, which serves as an MLIP for large-scale molecular dynamics simulations of xenon in carbon nanotubes. In addition, EGNNs are employed to develop a machine learning model for the 129 Xe NMR magnetic shielding tensor, σ , enabling its direct prediction from MLMD snapshots. Both models are data-efficient and remain accurate well beyond their training data. Using this dual-model framework, we show that xenon encapsulated in carbon nanotubes experiences a nanotube-induced, negative 129 Xe isotropic chemical shift that varies non-monotonically with nanotube diameter and depends further on temperature and Xe loading, establishing this dual-model approach as an efficient route to interpreting confinement-driven 129 Xe NMR response.
items.authors: Ouail Zakary, Tiia Jacklin, Perttu Lantto

items.title: Operando Investigation of the Lithiation Mechanism in CsPbCl3 Perovskite
items.title_zh: CsPbCl3钙钛矿锂化机制的原位研究
items.summary_zh: 金属卤化物钙钛矿为锂离子电池组件提供了结构响应平台，但结构转变与电化学功能之间的相互作用尚不明确。本文以全无机CsPbCl3钙钛矿为模型系统，研究其锂化机制，揭示与人工固态电解质界面相关的电化学驱动相重构。通过原位X射线衍射结合电化学阻抗谱，发现锂化过程通过多步路径进行，起始于不可逆的钙钛矿分解，形成金属Pb和混合Cs–Li–Cl相。首次循环中的可逆合金化反应导致Li–Pb金属间化合物（如LiPb和Li8Pb3）的出现。衍射特征的演变与阻抗响应的显著变化相关，显示出从动力学受限的转化到更易于的电荷转移和扩散过程的过渡。值得注意的是，去锂化时未观察到钙钛矿框架的重构，确认了转化-合金化机制是主要的电荷储存途径。Cs–Li–Cl相的原位形成与电荷转移和扩散相关电阻的显著变化相吻合。
items.abstract: Metal halide perovskites offer a structurally responsive platform for lithium-ion battery components, however the interplay between structural transformation and electrochemical functionality remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the lithiation mechanism in all-inorganic CsPbCl3 perovskite as a model system for resolving electrochemically driven phase reconstruction relevant to artificial solid electrolyte interphase concepts. Operando X-ray diffraction combined with electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, reveals that lithiation proceeds via a multistep pathway initiated by irreversible perovskite decomposition, resulting in formation of metallic Pb and mixed Cs–Li–Cl phases. Subsequently, reversible alloying reactions during the first cycle leads to the emergence of Li–Pb intermetallic compounds including LiPb and Li8Pb3. The evolution of diffraction features correlates with pronounced changes in the impedance response, revealing a transition from kinetically hindered conversion to more facile charge-transfer and diffusion-associated processes during alloying. Notably, no reconstruction of the perovskite framework is observed upon delithiation, confirming a conversion–a
items.authors: Aleksandra Ossowska, Maciej Siekierski, M. Saski, Andrzej Ostrowski, Jacek Kowalczyk, J. Lewiński

items.title: Automated Symbolic Derivation Enables Scalable Ensemble DFT for Strongly Correlated Molecules and Materials
items.title_zh: 自动符号推导实现强关联分子和材料的可扩展集成DFT
items.summary_zh: 强电子关联主导了键断裂、多自由基和激发态的化学，但准确描述这些现象需要计算成本随系统规模急剧增加的方法。我们提出了一种可扩展的集成密度泛函理论（eDFT）方法，能够在标准Kohn-Sham DFT成本下，对具有现实规模的分子系统进行强关联的准确处理。该方法通过自动推导工作方程和数据驱动加速方案，实现了与活跃空间大小线性缩放，同时保持多构型的准确性。应用于标准Kohn-Sham DFT方法无法处理的系统，如多重键解离、开壳层多自由基和最近合成的磁量子材料，该框架能够重现实验磁隙和近乎精确的波函数基准，使用的活跃空间可达到十个电子和十个轨道，从而消除了强关联物质常规模拟的长期障碍。
items.abstract: Strong electron correlation governs the chemistry of bond breaking, polyradicals, and excited states, yet accurately describing it requires computational methods whose cost increases steeply with system size. We present a scalable ensemble density functional theory (eDFT) methodology that extends accurate treatment of strong correlation to molecular systems of realistic size at standard Kohn-Sham DFT cost. Automated derivation of the method’s working equations and a data-driven acceleration scheme enable linear scaling with active-space size while retaining multiconfigurational accuracy. Applied to systems inaccessible to standard Kohn-Sham DFT methods, such as multiple bond dissociation, open-shell polyradicals, and a recently synthesized magnetic quantum material, the framework reproduces experimental magnetic gaps and near-exact wavefunction benchmarks using active spaces up to ten electrons in ten orbitals, thus removing a long-standing barrier to routine simulation of strongly correlated matter.
items.authors: Konstantin Komarov, Michael Filatov(Gulak), Seung Kyu Min

items.title: Coupling Insoluble Pteroic Acid Using Quaternary Ammonium Salts: Synthesis of a Peptide Bearing a Folic Acid Moiety
items.title_zh: 四级铵盐耦合不溶性对氨酸的研究
items.summary_zh: 本文报道了一种独特的不溶性对氨酸耦合方法。四烷基铵氢氧化物有效地促进了对氨酸的溶解、与胺的高效耦合以及简便的后处理过程，从而合成了叶酸结合肽。通过对多种氨基酸的耦合研究，验证了该方法的普遍性和多样性，表明其适用于合成多种叶酸和对氨酸结合物。
items.abstract: Herein, I report a unique coupling method for insoluble pteroic acid. Tetraalkylammonium hydroxide effectively enabled solubilization, efficient coupling with an amine, and an easy workup process to produce folate-conjugated peptides. The generality and versatility were confirmed through coupling studies of several amino acids, demonstrating its applicability to the synthesis of various folate and pteroate conjugates.
items.authors: Yuya Asahina

items.title: Molarium: Agent-Generated Adaptive Software for Molecular Design
items.title_zh: Molarium：用于分子设计的自适应软件
items.summary_zh: 商业药物发现软件传统上将界面、科学模型和专业知识整合在一起，以便通过界面运行模型并将输出转化为设计决策。大型语言模型、编码代理和工具使用代理开始打破这一模式。界面、分析、工作流程逻辑及大量科学软件可以越来越多地根据特定科学家、项目和问题的需求生成，而代理可以自动化曾经需要专业用户的复杂工作流程。这一转变重新定义了计算药物发现中的竞争优势。更直观的界面和更快的执行并不能解决模型不准确或扩大适用范围。随着基础工具的日益可及和灵活，战略差异化将从对特定软件包的熟悉转向更优越的预测算法、更具普适性的模型、专有实验数据、积累的发现智能以及人类判断力，以框定正确的问题并评估答案。Molarium（网址：https://molarium.org）提供了这一转变在分子设计软件背景下的案例研究。
items.abstract: Commercial drug discovery software has traditionally bundled three sources of value: the interface, the scientific models, and the specialized expertise required to run the models through the interface, thereby translating outputs into design decisions. Large language models, coding agents, and tool-using agents are beginning to unbundle this paradigm. Interfaces, analyses, workflow logic, and substantial portions of scientific software can increasingly be generated to meet the needs of a particular scientist, project, and question, while agents can automate sophisticated workflows that once required specialist users. This shift repositions where competitive advantage is created in computational drug discovery. More intuitive interfaces and faster execution alone do not fix model inaccuracies or broaden the applicability domain. As the underlying tooling becomes increasingly accessible and fluid, strategic differentiation will shift away from familiarity with a particular software package and toward superior preditive algorithms, more generalizable models, proprietary experimental data, accumulated discovery intelligence, and the human discernment needed to frame the right question
items.authors: Rafal Wiewiora, Woody Sherman

items.title: Operando Cross-Sectional Nanoscale Imaging of Na Anode Formation in Zero-Excess Solid-State Batteries: Coupled Phase–Stress Evolution and X-ray Beam Effects
items.title_zh: 零过量固态电池中钠阳极形成的纳米级成像研究
items.summary_zh: 零过量固态钠电池在充电过程中沉积钠，这对阳极及其界面的机械稳定性提出了严峻挑战。本研究利用定制的原位电池，通过150纳米直径的X射线纳米衍射，解析了Na-Pb模型系统中相形成和机械应力的时空演变。原位相图显示，Na、Pb/NaPb3和NaPb/Na9Pb4相在沉积过程中空间共存，这与液态电解质Na-Pb系统中主要顺序路径的报道相悖。平面应力的时间演变揭示固态电解质内的压缩状态逐渐增强，集中在界面附近，与钠填充陶瓷电解质中的残余孔隙一致，导致局部应力集中和树枝晶生长及失效。意外的是，与无束参考电池的比较表明，X射线照射显著抑制钠沉积，表现为电化学响应的变化和钠及合金形成的显著减少。未照射位置的相形成抑制进一步表明，束引起的扰动超出了照射区域，区别于液态电解质系统中主要局部化的效应。
items.abstract: Zero-excess solid-state sodium batteries plate Na during charging, which places severe demands on the mechanical stability of the evolving anode and its interfaces. This work resolves the spatiotemporal evolution of phase formation and mechanical stresses across buried interfaces in a Na-Pb model system using a custom-built operando cell for cross-sectional X-ray nanodiffraction with a beam of 150 nm in diameter. The operando phase maps reveal that Na, Pb/NaPb3, and NaPb/Na9Pb4 phases coexist spatially during plating, contradicting the predominantly sequential pathway reported for liquid-electrolyte Na-Pb systems. The temporal evolution of the deviatoric in-plane stress reveals an increasingly compressive state within the solid-state electrolyte, concentrated near the interface and consistent with Na filling residual pores within the ceramic electrolyte, thereby creating local stress concentrations associated with dendritic growth and failure. Unexpectedly, comparison with beam-free reference cells reveals that X-ray exposure measurably suppresses Na plating, evidenced by an altered electrochemical response and substantially reduced Na and alloy formation. items.authors: Henrik Rotvær Bratlie, Verena Reisecker, François Lienard, Juraj Todt, Steven T. Boles, Tobias M. Huber

items.title: Reliable Structure-Processing-Performance Learning in Organic Photovoltaics: Chemical Generalization, Processing-Aware Prediction and Uncertainty under Domain Shift
items.title_zh: 有机光伏中的可靠结构-加工-性能学习研究
items.summary_zh: 有机光伏（OPVs）的机器学习模型在随机训练-测试分割下表现良好，但这种评估可能高估了潜在的泛化能力。本文构建了两个互补的OPV基准，以区分插值与化学外推：一个包含21,590个实验报告设备的干净OPV-DB队列和一个包含994种独特物理加工条件的加工丰富的Wen-Zhang-Ma队列。比较了随机、出版物保留、供体-受体对保留等验证方式，以及仅结构、仅加工和结合结构-加工的表示。在OPV-DB上，Extra Trees的性能在随机验证下为R² = 0.813，但在供体保留下降至R² = 0.362。在加工丰富的基准中，添加加工信息在随机验证下减少了19.5%的平均绝对误差（MAE），但在化学分组验证下仅减少了1.0-2.4%。这一效果与材料系统的熟悉度密切相关。
items.abstract: Machine-learning models for organic photovoltaics (OPVs) can achieve strong performance under random train-test splits, but such evaluation may overstate prospective generalization when literaturederived datasets contain repeated publications and material systems. Here, two complementary OPV benchmarks were constructed to separate interpolation from chemical extrapolation: a provenanceclean OPV-DB cohort containing 21,590 experimentally reported devices and a processing-rich Wen-Zhang-Ma cohort containing 994 unique physical processing conditions. Random, publication-heldout, donor-acceptor (D:A)-pair-held-out, acceptor-held-out, and donor-held-out validation regimes were compared, together with structure-only, processing-only, and combined structure-processing representations. Extra Trees performance on OPV-DB declined from R2 = 0.813 under random validation to R2 = 0.362 under donor holdout. In the processing-rich benchmark, adding processing information reduced MAE by 19.5% under random validation but by only 1.0-2.4% under chemically grouped validation. items.authors: DENNIS OBINNA ORJI

items.title: A Zero-Shot Single-Point Chemical Language Model Mimics Medicinal Chemist Reasoning for Molecular Optimization and STING Inhibitor Development in Alzheimer’s Disease
items.title_zh: 零样本单点化学语言模型模拟药物化学家分子优化推理
items.summary_zh: 药物开发依赖于药物化学家识别有效的局部结构修饰，以提高药物的效力、选择性和可开发性，同时保留先导骨架的有利特征。本文介绍了单点化学语言模型（SpCLM），这是一个零样本分子优化框架，旨在计算上模拟这一迭代药物化学范式。SpCLM基于Transformer架构，执行受控的单点分子修饰，生成集中且可化学解释的类比空间，而非大型无约束的分子库。该策略有效探索结构-活性关系，同时保持与实验可处理的先导化合物的紧密结构关系。在多个蛋白靶点和分子优化任务中，SpCLM生成的紧凑库通常仅包含几百个分子，但从未在模型训练中包含的测试集中恢复了60%-80%的实验验证活性化合物。生成的分子与实验观察到的结构-活性关系高度一致，包括结合亲和力和功能活性的变化，表明该模型能够再现有效的化学推理。
items.abstract: Drug development relies heavily on the ability of medicinal chemists to identify productive, localized structural modifications that improve potency, selectivity, and developability while preserving favorable features of a lead scaffold. Here, we introduce the Single-Point Chemical Language Model (SpCLM), a zero-shot molecular optimization framework designed to computationally emulate this iterative medicinal chemistry paradigm. Built on a Transformer architecture, SpCLM performs controlled single-point molecular modifications encompassing common medicinal chemistry operations and generates focused, chemically interpretable analog spaces rather than large, unconstrained molecular libraries. This strategy enables efficient exploration of structure–activity relationships while maintaining close structural relationships to experimentally tractable lead compounds. Across multiple protein targets and molecular optimization tasks, SpCLM generated compact libraries typically comprising only a few hundred molecules, yet recovered 60%–80% of experimentally validated active compounds from held-out test sets that were not included during model training. items.title: Novel green K-based Metal-Organic Framework with high proton conductivity
items.title_zh: 新型绿色钾基金属有机框架的高质子导电性
items.summary_zh: 尽管金属有机框架（MOFs）在质子导电应用中受到越来越多的关注，但基于单价阳离子的MOFs仍然相对未被充分研究，主要是由于这些体系通常较弱的配位相互作用。本研究报告了一种新型钾基萘四羧酸盐框架GR-MOF-28，该框架在室温下的温和水相条件下合成。GR-MOF-28的结构由K2O10双八面体通过四羧酸盐配体和配位水分子相互连接，形成沿晶体通道的受限氢键网络。在高相对湿度条件下，该材料的质子导电性可达4.3·10^-2 S·cm^-1，位列迄今为止报道的钾基MOFs中表现最优者之一。结合电化学阻抗谱和分子模拟结果支持通过受限氢键网络的水介导Grotthuss型质子传输机制。此外，GR-MOF-28可与导电聚合物基体结合，且不损失质子传输特性。这些结果突显了未被充分探索的钾基配位框架作为质导电材料的潜力。
items.abstract: Despite growing interest in metal-organic frameworks (MOFs for protonconductivity applications, monovalent-cation-based MOFs remain comparatively underexplored due to the weaker coordination interactions typically associated with these systems. In this work, we report GR-MOF-28, a novel potassium-based naphthalene tetracarboxylate framework synthesized under mild aqueous conditions at room temperature. Structurally, GR-MOF-28 consists of K2O10 dioctahedra interconnected through tetracarboxylate ligands and coordinated water molecules, generating a confined hydrogen-bond network along the crystallographic channels. The material exhibits proton conductivity values up to 4.3·10-2 S·cm-1 under high relative humidity conditions, placing it among the highest-performing K-based MOFs reported to date. Combined electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and molecular simulations support a water-mediated Grotthusstype proton transport mechanism through the confined hydrogen-bond network. In addition, GR-MOF-28 can be incorporated into a conductive polymer matrix without loss of proton transport properties. These results highlight the potential of underexplored K-based coordination frameworks as

items.title: Dynamic vacancy redistribution shifts Pd nanoparticle coalescence from orientation-gated to defect-enabled on reduced CeO2(110)
items.title_zh: 动态空位重分布改变Pd纳米颗粒的合并机制
items.summary_zh: 烧结会使支持催化剂失活，但支持缺陷如何与晶体结构传输各向异性耦合以影响纳米颗粒合并仍不清楚。本研究开发了一种三元Ce–O–Pd机器学习原子间势（Ce–O–Pd MLIP），并通过密度泛函理论（DFT）计算和从头算分子动力学（AIMD）验证。大规模深势分子动力学（DPMD）模拟揭示了Pd 62 /Pd 287纳米颗粒对在CeO 2–x (110)上的早期粗化，发现方向选择性合并：沿[11̅0]对的合并概率高于沿[001]对。CI-NEB计算识别出互补的传输各向异性，Pd原子扩散沿[11̅0]更有利，氧空位迁移沿[001]更有利，促进了颗粒间区域的动态缺陷重分布。统计轨迹分析表明，增加颗粒间氧空位比例从10%到30%提高了合并概率，加速了桥接和颈部成核。时间分辨指标进一步显示，低配位桥接-Pd中间体在颗粒完全合并前出现。这些结果表明缺陷与传输耦合是微观机制。
items.abstract: Sintering deactivates supported catalysts, yet how mobile support defects couple to crystallographic transport anisotropy during nanoparticle coalescence remains poorly understood. Here, we develop a ternary Ce–O–Pd machine-learning interatomic potential (Ce–O–Pd MLIP) by fine-tuning a pre-trained large atomic model and validate it against density functional theory (DFT) calculations and ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD). Large-scale deep potential molecular dynamics (DPMD) simulations resolve early-stage coarsening of Pd 62 /Pd 287 nanoparticle pairs on CeO 2–x (110) and reveal direction-selective coalescence: [11̅0]-aligned pairs exhibit higher probabilities and shorter onset times than [001]-aligned pairs. CI-NEB calculations identify complementary transport anisotropies, with Pd adatom diffusion favored along [11̅0] and oxygen-vacancy migration favored along [001], enabling dynamic defect redistribution within the interparticle region. Statistical trajectory analysis shows that increasing the interparticle oxygen-vacancy fraction from 10% to 30% raises coalescence probability and accelerates bridge and neck nucleation, including along the kinetically less favorable [001] alig
items.authors: Shulin Wang, Jilun Song, Liang Cao

items.title: Design and computational evaluation of reversible covalent cathepsin S inhibitors using molecular docking, ADMET, molecular dynamics, MM/PBSA, and density functional theory
items.title_zh: 可逆共价半胱天冬酶S抑制剂的设计与计算评估
items.summary_zh: 半胱天冬酶S（CatS）在细胞外条件下仍保持显著的蛋白水解活性，与肿瘤进展、慢性炎症、自身免疫疾病及心血管疾病相关，因此成为选择性共价抑制剂的理想靶点。本研究合理设计并评估了100种α-氰基丙烯酰胺衍生物，首先通过刚性分子对接筛选候选化合物，随后进行药代动力学研究和初步的25 ns分子动力学（MD）模拟以评估稳定性。基于结果，化合物F7和F48进行了密度泛函理论（DFT）计算、共价和非共价诱导适配对接，随后进行了100 ns的MD模拟。通过均方根偏差（RMSD）、均方根波动（RMSF）、氢键分析、自由能景观分析、每残基能量分解及分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积（MM/PBSA）计算进一步检查了复合物的稳定性和结合行为。研究中F7表现出比F48更有利的行为，保持了稳定的结合模式和与关键活性位点残基的持久相互作用。
items.abstract: Cathepsin S (CatS) is unique among lysosomal cathepsins in retaining significant proteolytic activity under extracellular conditions. Its extracellular activity has been implicated in tumour progression, chronic inflammation, autoimmune disorders, and cardiovascular diseases, making CatS an attractive target for the development of selective covalent inhibitors . In the present study, a series of 100 α-cyanoacrylamide derivatives was rationally designed and evaluated using computational approaches. The compounds were first assessed by rigid molecular docking. Top candidates were selected for pharmacokinetics study and initial 25 ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulations for further stability evaluation. Based on these results, Compounds F7 and F48 were subjected to density functional theory (DFT) calculations, covalent and non-covalent induced fit docking, followed by 100 ns MD simulations. Complex stability and binding behaviour were further examined using root mean square deviation (RMSD), root mean square fluctuation (RMSF), hydrogen-bond analysis, free-energy landscape analysis, per-residue energy decomposition, and molecular mechanics Poisson-Boltzman surface area (MM/PBSA) calcul
items.authors: Yousif Sajjad Hasan

items.title: Accelerated characterization of active natural extracts with single-step microfractionation coupled to mass spectrometry and bioassays
items.title_zh: 单步微分馏结合质谱与生物测定的活性天然提取物加速表征
items.summary_zh: 微分馏是一种用于发现和表征复杂提取物中生物活性天然产物的有效替代方法，但其在全结构表征选定成分时面临规模化困难。此外，微分馏数据与代谢组学数据的整合仍然复杂且繁琐。为解决这些限制，我们开发了一种单步微分馏方法，能够在96孔深孔板中提供94个分馏，结合生物学和计算代谢组学数据，操作在毫克级别。该分馏方法与单四极杆质谱分析仪相结合，通过我们开发的开源图形界面实现与高分辨率代谢组学输出的整合。我们将该方法应用于七种植物（如Macleaya microcarpa、Macleaya cordata等）的提取物表征，获得了高重复性的色谱结果，共进行了151次连续注射，注入量不超过10 mg。
items.abstract: Microfractionation is a prominent alternative for the discovery and characterization of bioactive natural products in complex extracts (e.g., plant, fungal, or microbial); however, the method faces limitations as it requires arduous scale-up for full structural characterization of selected constituents. Furthermore, the integration of microfractionation data with metabolomic data is still a complex and tedious process. To circumvent current limitations, we developed a single-step (i.e., no gram-scale isolation or orthogonal chromatographic steps) microfractionation method that delivers 94 fractions in a 96-deep-well plate, combining biological and computational metabolomic readouts at the milligram scale. Fractionation is coupled to a single-quadrupole mass analyzer, which enables integration with high-resolution metabolomic outputs through an open-source graphical interface we developed. To illustrate the method’s performance, we applied it to characterize extracts from seven plant species — Macleaya microcarpa , Macleaya cordata , Ruta corsica, Thymus camphoratus, Helleborus foetidus, Hypericum hookerianum, and Hypericum olympicum — spanning different extract complexities and bio
items.authors: Joshua Smith, Erik Bouchal, Zdeněk Knejzlík, Martin Dracinsky, Tito Damiani, Roman Bushuiev

items.title: Strongly bound excitons limit the photocatalytic efficiency of carbon nitride by hindering free charge carrier generation
items.title_zh: 强束缚激子限制碳氮化合物的光催化效率
items.summary_zh: 本研究为聚合物碳氮化合物（PCN）光催化剂在太阳能-化学能转化效率不足的原因提供了电荷和激子动力学基础。通过温度依赖的稳态和瞬态光致发光（PL）光谱，探测了PCN中激发态的辐射衰减。此外，进行了时间分辨微波导电性（TRMC）实验，以揭示自由电荷载流子的动力学和传输。分析结果显示，激发态局限于PCN的七氮烯单元，结合能为54 meV，约为298 K下热能的两倍。TRMC实验表明，激子解离后生成的自由电荷载流子的产率（j）和总迁移率（Sµ）值约为10^-4 cm²/Vs，典型于低介电常数导电聚合物，但与已知高效自由载流子生成和高迁移率的有机金属卤化物钙钛矿相比低五个数量级。这一比较揭示了激发态通过复合的显著失活，这是PCN的主要瓶颈。
items.abstract: This work provides a charge and exciton dynamics basis to rationalize inadequate solar-tochemical energy conversion efficiency in polymeric carbon nitride (PCN) photocatalyst.The radiative decay of excited states in PCN is probed using temperature-dependent (340 to 20 K) steady-state and transient photoluminescence (PL) spectroscopy.In addition, time-resolved microwave conductance (TRMC) experiments are performed to reveal the dynamics and transport of free charge carriers.Collective analyses from these spectroscopy tools and comparing the decay dynamics in the presence of Pt cocatalysts reveal the following conclusions: The excited state is localized within the heptazine units of PCN with a binding energy of 54 meV that is two times higher than thermal energy at 298 K. items.authors: Simon Joyson Galbao, Tom J Savenije, Dharmapura H. K. Murthy

items.title: A computed thermoelectric feature database for 50,992 GNoME materials
items.title_zh: 50,992种GNoME材料的计算热电特征数据库
items.summary_zh: 本文展示了一个包含50,992种新型热力学合理晶体材料的计算特征数据库，这些材料来自Google DeepMind的材料探索图网络（GNoME）数据库，并经过热电相关性筛选（非金属、有限带隙、能量高于材料项目凸包≤0.05 eV/原子）。我们为每种材料提供了组成和晶体学描述；CHGNet通用势能学、每个原子的磁矩以及64维学习的晶体嵌入；完整的谐波热传导层（弹性张量、德拜温度、声速和Cahill/Clarke最小导电性界限）；以及一个非谐层（来自CHGNet状态方程的Grüneisen参数和Slack模型的晶格热导率）。CHGNet形成能以0.036 eV/原子的平均绝对误差重现了基础的DFT值（Pearson r = 0.999），两个独立计算的体模量的中位差为5.3%（r = 0.992）。这是首次发布完整的晶格热电特征数据库。
items.abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials now make it feasible to compute rich physical property sets for very large libraries of hypothetical crystals, but such feature sets are rarely released in analysis-ready form, and thermal-transport descriptors — central to thermoelectric performance — are especially scarce. Here we present a computed feature database for 50,992 novel, thermodynamically plausible crystalline materials drawn from Google DeepMind's Graph Networks for Materials Exploration (GNoME) database and filtered for thermoelectric relevance (non-metallic, finite band gap, energy above the Materials Project convex hull ≤ 0.05 eV/atom). For every material we provide composition and crystallographic descriptors; CHGNet universal- potential energetics, per-site magnetic moments, and a 64-dimensional learned crystal embedding; a full harmonic thermal-transport layer (elastic tensor, Debye temperature, sound velocities, and Cahill/Clarke minimum-conductivity bounds); and an anharmonic layer (Grüneisen parameter from a CHGNet equation-of-state, and a Slack-model lattice thermal conductivity). items.authors: Akshay Deshpande

items.title: Reliable Structure-Processing-Performance Learning in Organic Photovoltaics: Chemical Generalization, Processing-Aware Prediction and Uncertainty under Domain Shift
items.title_zh: 有机光伏中的可靠结构-加工-性能学习研究
items.summary_zh: 有机光伏（OPVs）的机器学习模型在随机训练-测试分割下表现良好，但这种评估可能高估了潜在的泛化能力。本文构建了两个互补的OPV基准，以区分插值与化学外推：一个包含21,590个实验报告设备的干净OPV-DB队列和一个包含994种独特物理加工条件的加工丰富的Wen-Zhang-Ma队列。比较了随机、出版物保留、供体-受体对保留等验证方式，以及仅结构、仅加工和结合结构-加工的表示。在OPV-DB上，Extra Trees的性能在随机验证下为R² = 0.813，但在供体保留下降至R² = 0.362。在加工丰富的基准中，添加加工信息在随机验证下减少了19.5%的平均绝对误差（MAE），但在化学分组验证下仅减少了1.0-2.4%。这一效果与材料系统的熟悉度密切相关。
items.abstract: Machine-learning models for organic photovoltaics (OPVs) can achieve strong performance under random train-test splits, but such evaluation may overstate prospective generalization when literaturederived datasets contain repeated publications and material systems. Here, two complementary OPV benchmarks were constructed to separate interpolation from chemical extrapolation: a provenanceclean OPV-DB cohort containing 21,590 experimentally reported devices and a processing-rich Wen-Zhang-Ma cohort containing 994 unique physical processing conditions. Random, publication-heldout, donor-acceptor (D:A)-pair-held-out, acceptor-held-out, and donor-held-out validation regimes were compared, together with structure-only, processing-only, and combined structure-processing representations. Extra Trees performance on OPV-DB declined from R2 = 0.813 under random validation to R2 = 0.362 under donor holdout. In the processing-rich benchmark, adding processing information reduced MAE by 19.5% under random validation but by only 1.0-2.4% under chemically grouped validation. items.authors: DENNIS OBINNA ORJI

items.title: Hidden Hypoxanthine Neighborhoods in β-Guanine
items.title_zh: β-鸟嘌呤中的隐性次黄嘌呤邻域研究
items.summary_zh: 生物源鸟嘌呤晶体能够在保持β-鸟嘌呤晶格的同时，显著掺入次黄嘌呤（Hpx），但晶格是否能区分掺杂物的身份和局部邻域尚未解决。本文采用周期性密度泛函理论（DFT）、基于位点的簇交叉检查、对称完全对偶枚举和GIPAW 13C计算，将这两种掺入水平与可实验测试的可观测量联系起来。在干燥的6.25%固定单元模型中，N7H-Hpx的电子能量比N9H-Hpx低21.78 kcal mol⁻¹；三种簇处理保持了17.40–18.25 kcal mol⁻¹的能量偏好。纯晶体校准排除嵌入Hpx的共振，预测N7H和N9H的C5位移分别为115.98 ppm和127.94 ppm，N7H-Hpx位于实验报告的115–116 ppm区域。在12.5%替代时，120个位点对减少为13个对称独特轨道。十五个代表性轨道经过放松，校正后的轨道均值跨度为2.407 kcal mol⁻¹，最低的相邻平面轨道保持此最小值。
items.abstract: Biogenic guanine crystals can incorporate substantial hypoxanthine (Hpx) while retaining the βguanine lattice, but whether the lattice discriminates both dopant identity and local neighborhood remains unresolved. Here, periodic DFT, site-anchored cluster cross-checks, symmetry-complete pair enumeration, and GIPAW 13C calculations connect these two levels of incorporation to experimentally testable observables. In a dry 6.25% fixed-cell model, N7H-Hpx is 21.78 kcal mol ¹ lower in electronic energy than N9H-Hpx; three cluster treatments preserve a 17.40–18.25 ⁻¹ lower in electronic energy than N9H-Hpx; three cluster treatments preserve a 17.40–18.25 kcal mol ¹ preference. A pure-crystal calibration excluding the embedded-Hpx resonance ⁻¹ lower in electronic energy than N9H-Hpx; three cluster treatments preserve a 17.40–18.25 predicts C5 shifts of 115.98 ppm for N7H and 127.94 ppm for N9H, placing N7H-Hpx in the experimentally reported 115–116 ppm region. At 12.5% substitution, 120 site pairs reduce to 13 symmetry-distinct orbits. items.title: On Coupled Cluster Theory and Beyond
items.title_zh: 耦合簇理论及其发展概述
items.summary_zh: 耦合簇（CC）理论是分子电子结构理论的“金标准”，但其发展历程从哈特里-福克理论的变分起源、指数假设及其图示工具，到现代作为代数多样体上的多项式方程系统的重新表述，以及其多参考态推广和作为量子电路的新兴形式，鲜有完整的叙述。本文从电子薛定谔方程出发，推导出哈特里-福克理论、二次量子化和威克定理；通过相似变换哈密顿量构建耦合簇单体和双体（CCSD）方程，并展示这些方程如何作为截断特征值问题在推广的Grassmannian上重新出现，计算得到的CC度数控制解的数量。接着，我们发展了微扰三体修正CCSD(T)、激发、离子化和电子附加态的线性响应运动方程（EOM-CC）框架，以及支持多参考态耦合簇理论的有效哈密顿量形式和著名的入侵态问题，最后介绍了恢复变分性质的单位耦合簇（UCC）假设。
items.abstract: Coupled cluster (CC) theory is the “gold standard” of molecular electronic structure theory, yet the full arc of the subject—from its variational origins in Hartree–Fock theory, through the exponential ansatz and its diagrammatic machinery, to its modern reformulation as a system of polynomial equations on an algebraic variety, its multireference generalizations, and its emerging reincarnation as a quantum circuit—is rarely presented as a single connected narrative. This review builds that narrative completely from first principles and carries it through to today’s research frontier. Starting from the electronic Schrödinger equation, we derive Hartree–Fock theory, second quantization, and Wick’s theorem; construct the coupled cluster singles-and-doubles (CCSD) equations via the similarity-transformed Hamiltonian; and show how these same equations reappear, verbatim, as a truncated eigenvalue problem on a projective variety generalizing the Grassmannian, with a computable CC degree controlling the number of solutions. We then develop the perturbative triples correction CCSD(T), the linear-response equationof-motion (EOM-CC) framework for excited, ionized, and electron-attached state
items.authors: Mohsen Doust Mohammadi

items.title: From Black Box to Dialogue: An MCP Server for Tanabe–Sugano Diagrams as a Reference Case for Conversational Scientific Tools
items.title_zh: 从黑箱到对话：基于MCP服务器的Tanabe–Sugano图示例研究
items.summary_zh: 过渡金属配合物的d–d电子光谱解释是无机化学中的常规实践，但其背后的模型操作却出乎意料地复杂。传统的解释工具需要专业软件和高性能计算，且即使是教科书中的标准工具也需要练习才能掌握。Tanabe–Sugano（TS）图是发展直觉的最有效方法，且同样的配体场框架是更高级光谱分析的基础。本文介绍了TanabeSugano，一个开源Python求解器，专用于d2–d8 TS图。该求解器作为模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器实现，允许语言模型客户端作为交互前端操作求解器。用户通过自然语言提示可以计算能级、探索和比较构型、拟合测量的吸收带以提取晶体场强度（Dq）和Racah B，并通过nephelauxetic比率解释B作为金属-配体共价性的指示。该求解器在本地运行，无需编译或高性能计算。
items.abstract: Interpreting the d–d electronic spectra of transition-metal complexes is a routine practice in inorganic chemistry, yet the underlying models behind such interpretations are unexpectedly challenging to operate. Rigorous treatments demand specialized software, expert parameterization, and often high-performance computing, while even the standard textbook tool for first-pass intuition takes practice to read. The Tanabe–Sugano (TS) diagram remains the most efficient method for developing that intuition, and the same ligand-field framework is foundational for more advanced spectroscopic analyses. Here we present TanabeSugano, an open-source Python solver for d2–d8 TS diagrams. It is implemented as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, letting a language-model client act as an interactive front end that operates the solver rather than merely describing it. Through natural-language prompts, users can compute term energies, explore and compare configurations, fit measured absorption bands to extract the crystal-field strength (Dq) and Racah B, and interpret B as an indicator of metal–ligand covalency via the nephelauxetic ratio. The solver runs locally, without compilation or high-perfor

items.title: Physical Metallurgy of Lithium and Sodium and its Role in Electrochemical Stability of Solid-State Battery Anodes
items.title_zh: 锂和钠的物理冶金及其在固态电池负极中的电化学稳定性作用
items.summary_zh: 固态电池（SSBs）中的碱金属负极在循环过程中会发生机械变形，因此理解其物理冶金至关重要。本研究探讨了锂和钠的微观结构与塑性变形之间的关系。通过变形加工控制晶粒尺寸，并开发了蚀刻方法以揭示晶界、亚晶界和位错结构。两种金属均表现出随着晶粒尺寸减小而增强的Hall-Petch效应。锂的蠕变速率在亚晶粒尺寸以上与晶粒尺寸无关，但在小晶粒尺寸下，扩散蠕变主导，速率增加。锂表现出氧化物弥散强化行为。在亚晶粒尺寸以下，强度增加而蠕变速率降低，原因是位错匮乏。通过在压力下剥离不同厚度锂箔的固态电化学电池测试验证了长度尺度效应。总体而言，本研究为碱金属变形提供了物理冶金框架，并为先进固态电池的设计原则提供了指导。
items.abstract: Alkali metal negative electrodes in solid-state batteries (SSBs) undergo mechanical deformation during cycling, for which an understanding of their physical metallurgy is critical. Here, we study the link between microstructure and plastic deformation in lithium and sodium. Grain size is controlled through deformation processing, and etching methods are developed to reveal grain boundaries, subgrain boundaries, and dislocation structures. Hall-Petch strengthening with decreasing grain size occurs in both metals. Creep rate in lithium is grain-size-independent above the subgrain size, but increases at small grain sizes where diffusional creep dominates. Oxide dispersion-strengthened behavior is observed in Li. At length scales below the subgrain size, strength increases and creep rates decrease due to dislocation starvation. Solid-state electrochemical cell tests in which lithium of differing foil thickness is stripped under pressure validates length-scale effects. Overall, this work provides a physical metallurgy framework for alkali metal deformation and offers design principles for advanced SSBs.
items.authors: Chiung-Yuan Lo, Vijay D. Veeraraghavan, Cole D. Fincher, Callum J. Campbell, QianQian Yan, David Mitlin

items.title: Put patients at the centre of medical AI governance
items.title_zh: 将患者置于医疗人工智能治理中心
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在医疗人工智能（AI）治理中将患者置于核心的重要性。研究指出，患者的参与能够提升AI系统的透明度和信任度，从而改善医疗决策。通过分析现有的医疗AI应用案例，作者提出了多种方法以增强患者在AI治理中的声音，包括建立患者咨询委员会和开展公众教育活动。研究表明，患者的反馈不仅能优化AI算法，还能确保其符合伦理标准。结论强调，只有将患者纳入治理框架，才能实现医疗AI的可持续发展和社会接受度。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02796-8 Put patients at the centre of medical AI governance
items.authors: Yuan Shen

items.title: Nepal disaster is a wake-up call to take compound climate risks seriously
items.title_zh: 尼泊尔灾难警示我们重视复合气候风险
items.summary_zh: 2026年尼泊尔发生的灾难事件凸显了复合气候风险的严重性。研究表明，气候变化导致的极端天气事件与地质灾害的相互作用，使得灾害影响加剧。通过分析历史数据和气候模型，研究发现复合风险的发生频率和强度正在上升，尤其是在发展中国家。结论强调，全球应加强对复合气候风险的监测与应对措施，以减少未来灾害的损失和影响。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02794-w Nepal disaster is a wake-up call to take compound climate risks seriously
items.authors: Ramit Debnath

items.title: BetaII-spectrin gaps and patches emerge from the patterned assembly of the actin/spectrin membrane skeleton in human motor neuron axons
items.title_zh: 人类运动神经元轴突中βII-谱蛋白的间隙与斑块形成研究
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了人类运动神经元（MNs）轴突中与膜相关的周期性骨架（MPS）的βII-谱蛋白的空间分布及其组装模式。我们利用共聚焦和超分辨成像技术，发现中轴部分存在明显的间隙与斑块模式，βII-谱蛋白的间隙与含有有序MPS的斑块交替出现。该模式可被激酶抑制剂staurosporine急性诱导，而药理学抑制肌动蛋白聚合则阻止斑块形成，表明MPS组装需要肌动蛋白的成核。我们的数据支持一种模型，即谱蛋白的纳入导致邻近区域的耗竭，从而产生长距离的间隙与斑块模式。
items.abstract: The actin/spectrin membrane-associated periodic skeleton (MPS) is a cytoskeletal structure that supports axonal integrity and function. Lower spinal motor neurons (MNs) are characterized by exceptionally long axons and are particularly susceptible to degeneration in a wide range of hereditary neuromuscular disorders, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Using confocal and super-resolution imaging, we characterized the spatial distribution of βII-spectrin and the assembly pattern of the MPS in human MN axons derived from induced pluripotent stem cells. We discovered a striking gap-and-patch pattern in the medial axon, where sharply demarcated βII-spectrin gaps alternate with patches containing a well-organized MPS. The pattern is acutely induced by the kinase inhibitor staurosporine and pharmacological inhibition of actin polymerization prevents patch formation, indicating a requirement for actin nucleation in MPS assembly. Our data supports a model in which spectrin incorporation into nascent MPS patches depletes neighboring regions, producing long-range gaps-and-patches patterns.

items.title: Semiclassical initial value representation in curvilinear coordinates
items.title_zh: 曲线坐标系中的半经典初值表示法
items.summary_zh: 本文系统地将最初定义在欧几里得空间上的半经典传播子扩展到一般曲线坐标系。该方法能够在曲线坐标中实时演化核波包，无需事先构建全局势能面或复杂的动能算符，并通过坐标约束隔离出物理上重要的自由度，从而实现维度降低。通过在冗余坐标空间中传播动力学，避免了曲线系统固有的坐标奇点，确保数值计算的稳健性。此外，通过修改传播子的相干态基，适当考虑了每个坐标的拓扑特性，如周期性和边界条件。我们将此方法应用于传统法难以描述的分子运动，包括氢气和甲烷的纯旋转、氢气的转动-振动动力学以及丁烷的大幅度扭转运动，成功再现了参考本征能量及相应光谱的特征。
items.abstract: A semiclassical propagator originally defined on Euclidean space is systematically extended to general curvilinear coordinate systems. This method time-evolves nuclear wave packets on the fly in curvilinear coordinates, without prior construction of global potential energy surfaces or complicated kinetic energy operators, and enables dimensionality reduction by isolating the physically essential degrees of freedom through coordinate constraints. By propagating the dynamics in a redundant coordinate space, the coordinate singularities inherent to curvilinear systems are circumvented in a numerically robust manner. In addition, the topology of each coordinate—such as its periodicity and boundary conditions—is properly taken into account by modifying the coherent state basis of the propagator. We applied this approach to molecular motions that are difficult to describe in conventional normal coordinates—pure rotation of hydrogen and methane, ro-vibrational dynamics of hydrogen, and large-amplitude torsional motion of butane—and reproduced reference eigenenergies and the characteristic features of the corresponding spectra.
items.authors: Masaya Tsumura, Yuki Kurashige

items.title: Artificial Intelligence for a Circular Solvent Economy: An Environmental Decision-Support Architecture for Sustainable Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
items.title_zh: 人工智能助力循环溶剂经济：可持续制药制造的环境决策支持架构
items.summary_zh: 工业脱碳需要整合数字化策略，将人工智能（AI）、循环经济原则和生命周期思维结合，以提高制造过程的环境可持续性。制药制造特别依赖溶剂，使用有机溶剂显著增加了材料消耗、能源需求、温室气体排放和危险废物产生。尽管绿色化学、溶剂替代、生命周期评估（LCA）和数字制造已推动可持续过程设计，但其在统一环境决策支持架构中的整合仍显不足。本文提出了“循环溶剂经济的人工智能”（AICSE）框架，连接AI辅助预测、数字过程模拟、循环溶剂管理和生命周期可持续性评估。该框架在LCA导向的评估结构中保留了过程物质强度（PMI）、循环过程物质强度（cPMI）、全球变暖潜力（GWP）和累积能源需求（CED）作为互补的可持续性指标。通过文献基础的舍曲林活性药物成分（API）制造过程作为示例，展示了该框架的应用。
items.abstract: Industrial decarbonization requires integrated digital strategies that combine artificial intelligence (AI), circular economy principles, and life-cycle thinking to improve the environmental sustainability of manufacturing processes. Pharmaceutical manufacturing is particularly solvent-intensive, with organic solvents contributing substantially to material consumption, energy demand, greenhouse gas emissions, and hazardous waste generation. Although green chemistry, solvent substitution, life-cycle assessment (LCA), and digital manufacturing have advanced sustainable process design, their integration into a unified environmental decision-support architecture remains insufficiently developed. This communication presents an Artificial Intelligence for Circular Solvent Economy (AICSE) framework that connects AI-assisted prediction, digital process simulation, circular solvent management, and life-cycle sustainability assessment within a structured environmental decision-support architecture. The framework retains Process Mass Intensity (PMI), Circular Process Mass Intensity (cPMI), Global Warming Potential (GWP), and Cumulative Energy Demand (CED) as complementary sustainability indic
items.authors: ISAK RAJJAK SHAIKH

items.title: Observation-Guided Computation: Sequential Reobservation for Robust Chromatographic Peak Detection
items.title_zh: 观察引导计算：顺序重观察以增强色谱峰检测的稳健性
items.summary_zh: 色谱峰检测是数据处理链中的基础步骤，但几乎所有经典检测器都以信号幅度为单位定义决策变量，这些变量会随基线漂移、注入量和检测器增益而变化，并且在未改变的轨迹上进行单次决策。我们将检测重新构思为观察的计算组织变化，分为三个层次。第一层——观察引导计算（OGC）是一个顺序计算框架，围绕我们相关工作中建立的观察偏差（OD）度量构建。OGC并未引入新的峰标准或重新定义OD，而是将OD嵌入到观察-检测-重构-平坦化-重观察的循环中，以便在每次检测到结构后更新观察条件。在工作窗口内，轨迹被归一化为无量纲的观察空间，通过OD与单一无量纲阈值进行评分，所有最终边界重新锚定在原始信号上。OGC故意独立于任何特定候选生成器，可以由任何峰值查找器组合而成，六个异构引擎均收敛到共同的性能平台。
items.abstract: Chromatographic peak detection is the bottom-most step of the data-processing chain, yet almost every classical detector defines its decision variables in units of signal amplitude, so those variables co-vary with baseline drift, injection amount, and detector gain, and a single-pass decision is made once against an unchanged trace. We reframe detection not as a better criterion but as a change in the computational organization of observation, and we do so in three ordered layers. Layer 1 — Observation-Guided Computation (OGC) is a sequential computational framework — an analytical data-interpretation principle rather than a new peak detector — built around the Observation Deviation (OD) measure established in our companion work13. OGC does not introduce another peak criterion or redefine OD; it embeds OD as an observation measure into an observe–detect–reconstruct–flatten–reobserve loop, so the observation condition is updated after each detected structure. Within a working window the trace is normalized to a unitless observation space, scored by OD against a single dimensionless threshold, and all final boundaries are re-anchored on the raw signal. OGC is deliberately independent
items.authors: Zhang Zhi Xi, Chua Chun Kiang, Hua-Jun Zhang

items.title: High-Throughput Experimentation Enables the C6-Functionalisation of 1H-Indazol-3-Amines as Antitubercular Agents
items.title_zh: 高通量实验促进1H-吲唑-3-胺的C6功能化作为抗结核药物
items.summary_zh: 针对结核分枝杆菌硫氧还蛋白还原酶（TrxR）的新型抗结核药物开发受到基于苯异噻唑的抑制剂合成困难的阻碍。本研究确定了6-取代的1H-吲唑-3-胺作为一种生物等效骨架，提供了可比的结合模式和更好的合成可及性。为了解决C6位点衍生化缺乏既定协议的问题，我们进行了984个单独反应的高通量实验（HTE）活动。通过平行筛选，系统性地绘制了铃木-宫浦和布赫瓦尔德-哈特维希交叉偶联的反应条件空间，确定了一组普遍适用的条件。对所得到的化合物库进行生化评估，验证了生物等效设计，获得了几种对结核分枝杆菌TrxR具有增强抑制活性的衍生物，包括一种微摩尔抑制剂。获得了五种衍生物的共晶结构。本研究为探索1H-吲唑-3-胺骨架建立了合成基础，并展示了高通量实验如何成功应对基于片段的药物发现中的合成挑战。
items.abstract: The development of novel antitubercular drugs targeting mycobacterial thioredoxin reductase (TrxR) has previously been hampered by the synthetic intractability of promising benzisothiazole-based inhibitors. Here, we identify 6-substituted 1H-indazol-3-amine as a bioisosteric scaffold that offers a comparable binding mode and improved synthetic accessibility. To address the lack of established protocols for the derivatisation of this scaffold at the C6 Position, we carried out a high-throughput experimentation (HTE) campaign with 984 individual reactions. Through parallel screening, the reaction condition space for Suzuki-Miyaura and Buchwald-Hartwig cross-couplings was systematically mapped, identifying a set of generally applicable conditions. Biochemical evaluation of the resulting library validated the bioisosteric design, yielding several derivatives with enhanced inhibitory activity against mycobacterial TrxR, including a micromolar inhibitor. Co-crystal structures of five derivatives could be obtained. This study establishes a synthetic foundation for exploring the 1H-indazol-3-amine scaffold and demonstrates how HTE can successfully address synthetic challenges in fragment-b
items.authors: Philipp Janssen, Fabrice Becker, Vesa Krasniqi, Sophia Gethmann, Anna Junker, Oliver Koch

items.title: Engineering Receptor-Mediated Cell-Surface Mobility with Phage-Inspired DNA Tetrapods
items.title_zh: 利用噬菌体启发的DNA四足体调控受体介导的细胞表面移动性
items.summary_zh: 本研究以噬菌体为灵感，开发了针对细菌受体的DNA四足体，探讨其在细胞表面移动中的应用。通过调节配体亲和力、价态和间隔长度，我们实现了在活细菌细胞上类似噬菌体的侧向移动。此外，该平台可扩展至哺乳动物系统，四足体结构同样调控侧向运动和细胞结合，从而实现选择性癌细胞识别和改善反义寡核苷酸的摄取。这些发现表明，受体介导的移动性是一种可编程特性，可用于增强细胞靶向和载荷递送。
items.abstract: Viruses have long inspired the development of multiligand display systems that engage cell-surface receptors through strong multivalent interactions. However, considerably less attention has been devoted to recapitulating the early stages of infection, during which weak, reversible interactions promote receptor-mediated mobility across cell membranes. Bacteriophages provide a striking example of this behavior, using transient receptor interactions to move across bacterial surfaces in search of favorable binding sites. Inspired by this mechanism, we developed DNA tetrapods targeting bacterial receptors exploited by phages during adsorption and demonstrate that phage-like lateral mobility on living bacterial cells can be achieved by tuning ligand affinity, valency, and spacer length. Furthermore, this platform can be extended to mammalian systems, where the tetrapod architecture similarly governs lateral motion and cell association, enabling selective cancer-cell recognition and improved antisense oligonucleotide uptake. Together, these findings demonstrate receptor-mediated mobility as a programmable property that could be harnessed to enhance cellular targeting and cargo delivery.
items.authors: Gal Raviv, Ilan Edelstein, Tali Dadosh, Inna Goliand, Ziv Porat, Alla H. Falkovich

items.title: A simple demonstration of the importance of purity in nanotechnology with the example of rapid syntheses of gold nanoparticles in water
items.title_zh: 纳米技术中纯度重要性的简单示范：水中金纳米粒子的快速合成
items.summary_zh: 本文描述了纯度及杂质在纳米技术中重要性的简单直观示范。通过在室温下将NaBH4加入HAuCl4水溶液中，能够在几秒钟内获得稳定的胶体金纳米粒子，无需其他化学品。通过调整所用水的导电性（例如使用高纯度水、自来水或两者的混合物），可以轻松调节纳米粒子的大小和稳定性。纳米粒子的大小可通过获得的胶体颜色和/或紫外-可见光谱法进行评估。该本科水平的示范适合广泛受众，仅需非常简单的设备，能够有效展示控制条件在纳米技术中的重要性，提高对杂质影响的认识，并展示如何利用负面结果将缺点转化为优势。此外，所提概念和实验方法与其他教学活动良好结合，为将纳米技术与化学科学教育中的其他重要主题建立坚实基础。
items.abstract: A simple and visual demonstration of the importance of purity and the impact of impurities in nanotechnology is described. Stable colloidal gold nanoparticles are simply obtained at room temperature in seconds, adding NaBH4 to HAuCl4 in water without the need for other chemicals. By adjusting the conductivity of the water used, for example by using high purity water, tap water or mixtures of the two in different ratios, the size and stability of the nanoparticles is easily tuned. Size control is easily assessed by the color of the colloids obtained and/or by UV-vis spectroscopy. This undergraduate level demonstration suitable for a wide audience requires only very simple equipment and can be broadly implemented to illustrate the importance of controlled conditions in nanotechnology, raise awareness on the impact of impurities, but also show how to leverage on negative results to turn a drawback into a benefit. Additionally, the concept and the experimental approach proposed integrate well in other pedagogical activities and are a solid foundation to link nanotechnology to other important topics in the education of the chemical sciences.
items.authors: Javier Eiroa Soto, Jonathan Quinson

items.title: China’s fast-track clinical trials are in the spotlight after child deaths
items.title_zh: 儿童死亡事件后，中国快速临床试验引发关注
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月8日，Nature在线发表了一项研究，探讨了中国政府新政策在创新与安全之间的平衡。该政策旨在加快临床试验的审批流程，以促进新药和治疗方法的开发。然而，近期发生的儿童死亡事件引发了公众对快速试验的安全性和伦理性的担忧。研究指出，尽管快速审批能够加速医疗创新，但必须加强对试验过程的监管，以确保参与者的安全和权益。政府正在考虑进一步的措施，以提高透明度和公众信任。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02407-6 A new government policy seeks to balance innovation and safety.
items.authors: Xiaoying You

items.title: Two children died from gene therapies in China: where the field goes next
items.title_zh: 两名儿童因基因疗法在中国死亡：未来发展方向何在
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月8日，《自然》在线发表的文章指出，中国的基因疗法研究面临严峻挑战，因两名儿童因治疗而死亡引发广泛关注。文章强调，未来应加强法律法规，以确保类似事件能够迅速向公众披露。然而，这一事件对中国在基因研究领域的声誉造成了风险，可能影响公众对基因疗法的信任和接受度。研究者呼吁在推进基因疗法的同时，必须加强伦理审查和安全性评估，以防止悲剧重演。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02497-2 Strengthened laws should help to ensure future deaths are quickly disclosed to the public, but China’s reputation for such research is at risk.
items.authors: Rachel Fieldhouse

items.title: Why this neuroscientist is taking the plunge into science advocacy
items.title_zh: 神经科学家为何投身科学倡导工作
items.summary_zh: 随着资金削减重塑美国研究环境，神经科学家斯特凡诺·卡塔尔迪（Stefano Cataldi）开始转向政策和倡导工作，以捍卫科学。他认为，科学研究的未来依赖于有效的政策支持和公众理解，因此他积极参与科学政策的制定和科学传播活动。卡塔尔迪的努力旨在提高科学研究的可持续性，并确保科学家在政策讨论中拥有发言权。他的工作强调了科学与社会之间的联系，呼吁更多的科学家参与到科学倡导中，以应对当前的挑战。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02457-w As funding cuts reshape the US research landscape, Stefano Cataldi is turning towards policy and advocacy work to defend science.
items.authors: Alissa de Chassey

items.title: Primordial cardiomyocytes orchestrate myocardial morphogenesis and vascularization but are dispensable for regeneration
items.title_zh: 原始心肌细胞在心脏形态发生中的作用及其再生的非必需性
items.summary_zh: 脊椎动物心脏由异质心肌细胞（CM）群体组成，但不同CM亚群在心脏发育和修复中的作用尚不明确。本研究通过对成年斑马鱼心脏进行单细胞RNA测序分析，识别出一种独特的CM亚群，标记为phlda2，主要与厌氧代谢相关，且不同于富含氧化磷酸化基因的成熟CM。我们证明phlda2+细胞构成了位于致密肌和小梁肌之间的原始CM区间。发育过程中基因去除phlda2+ CM严重干扰了心脏形态发生，导致心肌小梁和致密化缺陷以及冠状血管化受损。令人惊讶的是，尽管在发育中发挥重要作用，去除phlda2+ CM并未影响心室切除后的心肌恢复和再血管化。我们发现这可能是由于原始CM自身的有限再生能力，因为它们在外科切除或基因去除后未能再生。我们的研究表明，原始CM在心脏形态发生中起组织者作用，但对再生并非必需，揭示了脊椎动物心脏发育与再生程序之间的根本差异。
items.abstract: The vertebrate heart is composed of heterogeneous cardiomyocyte (CM) populations; however, the roles of distinct CM subpopulations in heart development and repair remain poorly defined. Here, using single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of adult zebrafish heart, we identified a unique CM subpopulation marked by the expression of phlda2 , which is associated with anaerobic metabolism and different from mature CMs, which are enriched for oxidative phosphorylation genes. We demonstrated that phlda2 + cells constituted a primordial CM compartment localized between compact and trabecular muscles. Genetic ablation of phlda2 + CMs during development severely disrupted heart morphogenesis, leading to defective myocardial trabeculation and compaction, and impaired coronary vascularization. Surprisingly, despite their essential roles in development, the depletion of phlda2 + CMs didn’t impair myocardial restoration and revascularization following ventricular resection. We found that this was probably due to the limited regenerative capacity of the primordial CMs themselves, as they failed to regenerate after either surgical amputation or genetic ablation. items.title: Centrosome migration and apical membrane formation during epithelial polarization in MDCK cysts
items.title_zh: MDCK囊泡上皮极性化过程中的中心体迁移与顶膜形成
items.summary_zh: 上皮细胞的极性化对其正常功能至关重要。早期特征包括极性分子的运输和富集以形成顶膜（AM）或细胞间连接，以及中心体的顶端定位。然而，极性分子、AM形成和中心体定位之间的依赖关系仍不清楚。在Matrigel中培养的单个上皮细胞的极性化通常与细胞分裂相关。在有丝分裂退出期间，中心体移动到未来的AM位置，这引发了它们在极性化中的作用的疑问。我们在Matrigel培养的细胞中扰动中心体和极性调节因子，并通过悬浮培养操控极性方向，以研究极性特征之间的关系。结果显示，中心体微管可能不是中心体定位或AM形成的必要条件，但其缺失会降低AM形成的效率。极性调节因子Par3影响中心体定位，而非AM组分的运输。在悬浮培养中，中心体向与AM形成相反的方向迁移。我们的研究定义了多个极性特征之间的层次关系，并表明基于中心体的极性在上皮细胞中并非普遍存在，为上皮极性化机制提供了新见解。
items.abstract: Polarization is crucial for the proper functioning of epithelial cells. Early hallmarks include the trafficking and enrichment of polarity molecules to form the apical membrane (AM) or cell–cell junctions, and the apical positioning of the centrosome. However, the dependencies among polarity molecules, AM formation, and centrosome positioning remain poorly understood. When cultured in Matrigel, de novo polarization of a single epithelial cell is often coupled with cytokinesis. During mitotic exit, centrosomes move to the future AM site, raising questions about their role in polarization. We perturbed centrosomes and polarity regulators in Matrigel-cultured cells and manipulated polarity direction using suspension culture to examine the relationships among polarization features. Surprisingly, centrosomal microtubules may not be necessary for centrosome positioning or AM formation, but their absence reduces the efficiency of AM formation. The polarity regulator Par3, rather than AM component trafficking, influences centrosome positioning. In suspension culture, centrosomes migrate in the direction opposite to AM formation. items.title: Non-Isobaric Is Not Enough: Gap-Merge Safety for Unambiguous Peptide Readout
items.title_zh: 非等质量氨基酸不足：肽段读出中的缺口合并安全性
items.summary_zh: 在使用肽序列传递信息时，选择一组非等质量氨基酸是确保明确读出的标准方法。然而，我们证明这并不足够。由于串联质谱通过连续片段质量差异读取残基，单个缺失的b/y离子会将两个相邻残基合并为一个观察到的缺口；如果该合并缺口与单个残基质量重叠，解码器将不会记录缺失，而是发出一个自信但错误的残基。非等质量性无法防止这种情况，因为碰撞的量是总和而非单个残基。我们将缺口合并安全性形式化为可判定的谓词，并在Lean 4中提供了机器检查的有效性证明，全面描述了蛋白质字母表的碰撞结构：除了Leu/Ile等质量和Gln/Lys近等质量外，存在两个总和缺口碰撞，Gly + Gly = Asn和Gly + Ala = Gln，使甘氨酸的成本不成比例地高。在模拟中，满足缺口合并安全性的字母表在0到0.4的每个片段缺失率下产生零静默错误，而仅通过非等质量性选择的字母表则产生1.0%到6.9%的错误；每个失败都变成可检测的缺失，而非静默替代。
items.abstract: Selecting a set of non-isobaric amino acids is the standard way to guarantee unambiguous readout when peptide sequences are used to carry information. We show it is insufficient. Because tandem MS reads residues as differences between consecutive fragment masses, a single missing b/y ion merges two adjacent residues into one observed gap; if that merged gap aliases a single residue mass, the decoder does not register a dropout but emits one confident, wrong residue. Non-isobaricity cannot prevent this, because the colliding quantity is a sum rather than a residue. We formalize the missing condition—gap-merge safety, |m(a) +m(b)−m(c)| τ for all a, b, c in the alphabet—as a decidable predicate with a machine-checked soundness proof in Lean 4, and characterize the collision structure of the proteinogenic alphabet exhaustively: beyond the Leu/Ile isobar and the Gln/Lys near-isobar, exactly two summed-gap collisions exist, Gly + Gly = Asn and Gly + Ala = Gln, making glycine disproportionately expensive. In simulation, alphabets satisfying gap-merge safety produce zero silent errors at every fragment dropout rate from 0 to 0.4, where alphabets chosen by non-isobaricity alone produce 1.0%

items.title: Trophic Transfer–Driven Predator Risk from Diatomite Nanoparticles Is Mitigated by a dsRNA Safety Switch
items.title_zh: 二氧化硅纳米颗粒的捕食者风险及其dsRNA安全开关的缓解作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究使用捕食者-猎物微观生态模型（木虱和小麦赤小蜂），探讨了二氧化硅纳米颗粒（DNP）对捕食者的影响。结果表明，捕食者主要通过摄食DNP暴露的猎物而受到影响，捕食者的死亡率随着猎物预处理剂量的增加而增加，且在营养转移下的死亡率高于共存暴露，确认了食物网转移是导致捕食者死亡的主要途径。为减轻非目标效应并保持害虫控制，我们开发了一种负载双链RNA（dsRNA）的DNP配方（dsRNA@DNP）。dsRNA@DNP在对小麦赤小蜂的致死性保持不变的同时，显著降低了捕食者在营养暴露下的死亡率。释放实验表明，dsRNA在低离子强度和测试pH条件下主要与DNP结合，但在高离子强度下显著释放，符合可逆静电结合的特性。基因表达分析显示捕食者的Chc表达减少，而猎物未见明显变化。这些发现表明营养转移是二氧化硅纳米颗粒非目标效应的重要途径，并展示了一种设计安全策略。
items.abstract: Diatomaceous earth is widely used in pest management and other industrial applications; however, non-target ecological risks remain poorly resolved. Using a predator–prey microcosm model (Xylocoris flavipes and Tribolium castaneum), we show that diatomite nanoparticles (DNP) impact the predator primarily via trophic transfer after predators consume DNP-exposed prey. Predator mortality increased with prey pretreatment dose and was higher under trophic transfer than co-occurrence exposure, identifying food-web transfer as the dominant pathway driving predator mortality. To mitigate non-target effects while preserving pest control, we developed a double-stranded RNA (dsRNA)-loaded DNP formulation via APTES silanization and electrostatic adsorption (dsRNA@DNP). dsRNA@DNP maintained lethality against T. castaneum while significantly reducing predator mortality during trophic exposure. Release assays showed that dsRNA remained largely associated with DNP across low-ionic-strength and tested pH conditions but was substantially released under high ionic strength, consistent with reversible electrostatic association. items.authors: Zihan Shen, Kangxu Wang

items.title: Software Tool for Automated Kinetic Tracking in Mass Spectrometry Data
items.title_zh: 质谱数据自动化动力学追踪软件工具
items.summary_zh: 时间分辨质谱产生的大量数据集难以组织和筛选动力学趋势。我们提出了一款开源软件工具，旨在对大量mzML测量中的时间依赖性变化进行探索性筛选和可视化。该软件的主要目的是突出和排名随时间发生显著变化的信号，而非自动化化合物识别。软件简化了时间顺序文件组织、重复数据聚合和趋势排名。为了展示其实用性，该工具用于监测苯胺与1-碘丁烷的反应。软件不仅正确识别了预期的单丁基和双丁基苯胺衍生物，还揭示了意外存在的苯胺二聚体（m/z 183和185）和三聚体（m/z 274）及其相应的丁基化产物。自动排名完美捕捉了连续反应特征，显示了单丁基中间体的初步积累及其后转化为双丁基衍生物。若无这种无偏筛选，这些二聚体和三聚体路径可能会被轻易忽视。最终，该工具显著减少了手动数据处理，同时直接引导研究人员关注最具化学兴趣的变化。
items.abstract: Time-resolved mass spectrometry produces large datasets that are challenging to organize and screen for kinetic trends. We present an open-source software tool designed for the exploratory screening and visualization of time-dependent variations in extensive series of mzML measurements. Rather than focusing on automated compound identification, the software's main purpose is to highlight and rank the signals that undergo the most significant changes over time. The software streamlines chronological file organization, replicate aggregation, and trend ranking. To demonstrate its utility, the tool was used to monitor the reaction between aniline and 1-iodobutane. Crucially, the software not only correctly identified the expected mono- and dibutyl derivatives of aniline, but it also revealed the unexpected presence of aniline dimers (m/z 183 and 185), and trimer (m/z 274), and their corresponding butylated products. The automated ranking perfectly captured the consecutive reaction profiles, showing the initial accumulation of monobutyl intermediates and their subsequent consumption into dibutyl derivatives. items.title: Superhydrophobic-Like Complete Rebound of Impacting Water Droplets on a Smooth Oleic- Acid-Coated Phenyl-Silica Surface
items.title_zh: 超疏水表面水滴撞击后完全反弹现象研究
items.summary_zh: 我们研究了在涂有约1微米厚油酸液体层的光滑苯硅氧烷表面上，水滴撞击引起的反弹现象。通过5000帧每秒的高速成像，观察到在Weber数（𝑊𝑒）为0.69至3.99的条件下，水滴完全反弹，而在𝑊𝑒为6.03和7.14时则出现部分反弹和卫星滴落。在近零冲击的参考条件下，未观察到水滴起飞。反弹峰值代理（𝑒apex）非单调变化，达到0.72 ± 0.02，明显停留时间为16-21毫秒，与𝑊𝑒无系统依赖，接近惯性-毛细时间尺度。这些运动学特征与光滑固体和液体界面的反弹机制相似。讨论了气体膜动力学和油酸层的响应作为机制假设，但未直接解决气体膜连续性或润滑剂重分布。结果表明，在光滑、无纹理的油酸涂层界面上，水的快速冲击引起的排水现象，并为未来在重复水冲击下润滑剂保持的测试提供了动机。
items.abstract: We report impact-induced water-droplet rebound on a nanoscopically smooth phenyl-silica surface bearing an oleic-acid liquid layer with a nominal cast-equivalent thickness of ≈1 µm, retained on the substrate through interactions previously attributed to COOH–π association. High-speed imaging (5000 fps) of 10 µL water droplets resolves complete rebound at all sampled conditions from Weber number (𝑊𝑒) = 0.69 to 3.99 and partial rebound with satellite ejection at 𝑊𝑒 = 6.03 and 7.14; a near-zero-impact reference showed no liftoff during the recorded interval. The apex-based rebound proxy (𝑒apex) varied nonmonotonically, reaching 0.72 ± 0.02, whereas the apparent residence time of 16–21 ms showed no systematic dependence on 𝑊𝑒 and remained close to the inertial-capillary timescale. These kinematics are comparable to rebound regimes reported for smooth solids and liquid interfaces. Entrained-gas-film dynamics and the response of the oleic-acid layer are discussed as mechanistic hypotheses, while neither gas-film continuity nor lubricant redistribution was directly resolved. items.authors: Dai Watanabe, Keita Niikura, Youfeng Yue, Kengo Manabe

items.title: A simple visual tool to illustrate the relationship between transcript and protein specificity in human organs
items.title_zh: 一种简单的可视化工具展示人类器官转录本与蛋白特异性关系
items.summary_zh: 目前，几乎所有人类组织都有大量高深度定量蛋白组学信息。然而，缺乏简单的工具来可视化蛋白在人体中的分布。生物学家通常使用提供RNA转录本读数的网络门户作为蛋白数据的代理，但转录本计数与蛋白浓度之间的相关性较低。为了解决这一问题，本文构建了一个轻量级HTML页面，能够轻松可视化大量蛋白组学数据，包含29种健康人类组织的深度分析。通过叠加从转录组数据预测的器官特异性蛋白，能够快速判断哪些转录本测量可以预测蛋白特异性。这种简单的蛋白组学数据表示方法具有重要价值。
items.abstract: Today a large amount of high depth quantitative proteomic information exists for nearly every human tissue. Despite this wealth of information simple tools for visualizing protein distribution in the human body are somehow lacking. Due to the challenges in accessing protein measurements directly biologists commonly use accessible web portals which provide RNA transcript read counts, which end up being used as a proxy for protein data. This is unfortunate because it is well established that the correlation between transcript counts and protein concentration in mammalian material is low. This is, however, a relatively vague concept that is difficult to both envision and to explain in the context of the central dogma. One way to rectify this problem would be by making protein quantification data as simple and accessible as RNA read count data. To illustrate how a large amount of proteomic data can be easily visualized, I have constructed an example lightweight HTML page that is small enough to be attached to email even when containing deep proteomic analysis of 29 healthy human tissues. items.authors: Benjamin C. Orsburn

items.title: Argon Coordination to the 3d Transition-Metal Monohalides: A Systematic Study of σ-Acceptor Accessibility in Ar–MX (M = Sc–Cu; X = F, Cl, Br)
items.title_zh: 氩气与3d过渡金属单卤化物的配位研究
items.summary_zh: 氩气通常被认为是化学惰性，但已证实其与多种晚期过渡金属配合。本文系统研究了3d过渡金属单氟化物MF（M = Sc–Cu）中氩气的配位，并扩展至相应的氯化物和溴化物。通过密度泛函理论、人口分析、能量分解和多参考计算，发现MF系列中氩气结合倾向呈现明显且非单调变化。氩气结合特征为氩3pσ向金属中心σ受体的混合4s和3dz2轨道的捐赠。在主要为单参考的体系中，裸MF的金属4s人口可作为该受体可达性的简单描述：低4s占据通常与氩气配位相关，而高4s占据则与解离相关。单参考计算显示MnF和FeF在低自旋DFT表面上具有短程氩气结合的极小值，尽管这些解是SCF不稳定的，需要多参考确认。氯化物和溴化物的趋势大体保持一致，但受到M–X框架的额外调制。Sc卤化物标志着简单4s描述的多参考极限。
items.abstract: Argon is generally regarded as chemically inert, yet direct Ar–metal coordination has been established for several late transition-metal complexes. Here, we systematically investigate Ar coordination across the 3d transition-metal monofluorides, MF (M = Sc–Cu), and subsequently extend the analysis to the corresponding chlorides and bromides. Density functional theory, population analysis, energy decomposition, and multireference calculations reveal a pronounced and nonmonotonic variation in Ar-binding propensity across the MF series. Ar binding is characterized by Ar 3pσ donation into a metal-centered σ-acceptor manifold of mixed 4s and 3dz2 character. In predominantly single-reference systems, the metal 4s population of bare MF provides a simple descriptor of the accessibility of this manifold: low 4s occupation is generally associated with Ar coordination, whereas high 4s occupation is associated with dissociation. Consistent with this picture, single-reference calculations give shortrange Ar-bound minima for MnF and FeF on lower-spin DFT surfaces with reduced 4s occupation, although these solutions are SCF-unstable and require multireference confirmation. items.authors: Akane Yano, Ryuto Kambara, Lihao Qu, Takuro Tsutsumi, Yuriko Ono, Tetsuya Taketsugu

items.title: A glass-box foundation model for density functional theory
items.title_zh: 用于密度泛函理论的玻璃盒基础模型
items.summary_zh: 机器学习的交换-关联泛函在准确性上超越传统形式，但目前为止往往牺牲了解释性以换取灵活性。本文介绍了DL-xDH26，这是一个用于密度泛函开发的玻璃盒基础模型，具有独立的交换和关联专家塔、相对于物理基础的可解释增强因子和偏移参数，以及精确的一阶齐次性。该模型仅基于相对能量进行训练，能够恢复原子交换和关联能量及其量子壳结构，生成平滑、尺寸一致的解离曲线，无需色散修正，并在GMTKN55和MGCDB84基准测试中实现了低于1 kcal/mol的误差。轻量级微调进一步专门化该模型以适应环化反应、扭曲有机几何和有机金属反应能量，同时保持其广泛的准确性。
items.abstract: Machine-learned exchange–correlation functionals promise accuracy beyond traditional forms, yet so far they trade interpretability for flexibility. Here we introduce DL-xDH26, a glass-box foundation model for density functional development on the fifth rung of Jacob’s ladder, with separate exchange and correlation expert towers, interpretable enhancement-factor and shift parameters relative to a physical base, and exact degree-one homogeneity. Trained exclusively on relative energies, it recovers atomic exchange and correlation energies and their quantum shell structure, and produces smooth, size-consistent dissociation curves without dispersion corrections, while reaching errors below 1 kcal/mol on the GMTKN55 and MGCDB84 benchmark suites. Lightweight fine-tuning then specializes the same backbone to cyclization reactions, distorted organic geometries, and organometallic reaction energetics while retaining its broad accuracy.
items.authors: Sheng Bi, Shiqi Liu, Igor Ying Zhang, Xin Xu

items.title: Interpretable Machine Learning Disentangles Pore Confinement Across Multiple Zr-MOF CO2 Capture Targets
items.title_zh: 可解释机器学习揭示多种Zr-MOF CO2捕集目标的孔隙限制
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了基于锆的金属有机框架（Zr-MOFs）中的孔隙限制，通常用笼-窗口比（ΓCW）来描述，即最大腔体直径与孔限制直径（Df）的比值。然而，ΓCW是否仅携带Df的信息尚不明确。我们使用结构分组的机器学习和SHAP解释方法，对239种含锆MOF在与真空摆动吸附相关的两种压力下进行了CO2吸附、吸附热（HoA）和CO2/N2选择性的建模，测试R²值达到0.77–0.88。尽管ΓCW与所有三个目标呈正相关，但控制Df后，这些关联减弱并反转，而反向分析则使Df的关联基本保持不变，基于差异的公式未产生显著关联。Df在三个目标中发挥了不同的作用，表明明显的限制效应主要反映了限制孔径，而非相对的笼-窗口结构。
items.abstract: Pore confinement in zirconium-based metal–organic frameworks (Zr-MOFs) is often described using the cage–window ratio (ΓCW), the largest cavity diameter divided by the pore-limiting diameter (Df), yet whether this composite coordinate carries information beyond Df alone remains unclear. We modeled CO2 uptake, heat of adsorption (HoA), and CO2/N2 selectivity for 239 Zr-containing MOFs at two pressures relevant to vacuum-swing adsorption using structure-grouped machine learning with SHAP interpretation, reaching test R2 values of 0.77–0.88. Although ΓCW correlated positively with all three targets, controlling for Df weakened these associations and reversed their sign, while the reciprocal analysis left the Df associations largely unchanged and a difference-based formulation produced no significant association. Df played different roles across the three targets, indicating that the apparent confinement effect mainly reflects the limiting aperture rather than relative cage–window architecture.
items.authors: Leyli Vali, Seyed Majid Hashemianzadeh

items.title: Aqueous-rich flow intensification for enzymatic transesterification of rose geranium oil in a coiled flow inverter microreactor
items.title_zh: 水相富集流动强化玫瑰天竺葵油的酶催化转酯化
items.summary_zh: 酶辅助将粗花油转化为高价值香料酯的过程受到传统批量反应器的传质限制和生产率低的制约。本文选择了含有香叶醇、香茅醇等多种挥发成分的玫瑰天竺葵油，研究了从粗花油中进行连续酶催化转酯化的过程。采用假单胞菌荧光脂肪酶（PFL），在不需事先分离成分的情况下，选择性地转酯化了香叶醇和香茅醇。使用卷曲流动反转微反应器（CFI）开发了一种过程强化策略。在水相与有机相比例为9:1的水相富集双相流动中，提供了2319 m²/m³的特定界面面积，使得香叶醇的表观体积传质系数（kLa）提高了约5倍，香茅醇提高了7倍。在60°C、5分钟的停留时间下，CFI在0.2 M的玫瑰天竺葵油中实现了99%的香叶醇和93%的香茅醇转化，而在1.4 M时分别保持了91%和71%的转化率。将停留时间增加到7分钟，1.4 M下香茅醇的转化率提高至95%。在1.4 M时，2 mL的CFI提供了约572 g/day的香叶酯生产率。
items.abstract: Enzyme-assisted valorisation of crude floral oils into high-value fragrance esters is constrained by mass-transfer limitations and limited productivity in conventional batch reactors. Rose geranium oil, a naturally complex and terpene-rich multicomponent feedstock containing geraniol, citronellol and numerous other volatile constituents, was selected to investigate continuous enzymatic transesterification directly from a crude floral oil. Using Pseudomonas fluorescens lipase (PFL), geraniol and citronellol were selectively transesterified within the multicomponent oil, without prior isolation of these constituents. A process-intensified strategy was developed using a coiled flow inverter (CFI) microreactor. Aqueous-rich biphasic slug flow at an aqueous-to-organic ratio of 9:1, providing a specific interfacial area of 2319 m 2 m -3 , increased the apparent volumetric mass-transfer coefficient (kLa) by approximately 5-fold for geraniol and 7-fold for citronellol relative to batch operation. At 60 °C and a residence time of 5 min, the CFI achieved 99 % geraniol and 93 % citronellol conversion at 0.2 M rose geranium oil, while maintaining 91 % and 71 % conversion, respectively, at 1.4
items.authors: Alisa S Wikaputri, Shyam Rana, Rhea Satpute, Derek J Irvine, Robert A Stockman, Volker Hessel

items.title: Slap restricts oncogenic Src-family kinase signaling to maintain colonic epithelial homeostasis
items.title_zh: SLAP限制致癌Src家族激酶信号以维持结肠上皮稳态
items.summary_zh: Src家族激酶（SFKs）调控结肠上皮细胞（CECs）的增殖，但其活性抑制机制尚不明确。我们发现Src样适配蛋白（SLAP）作为受体酪氨酸激酶信号的负调节因子，是结肠中SFK活性的关键抑制因子。使用villin-CreERT2模型进行的Slap缺失实验显示，Slap的持续和诱导性缺失增加了CECs的增殖，并加速了在氮杂环戊烯/右旋糖酐硫酸盐模型中的肿瘤发生。Slap缺失还增强了正常和肿瘤来源的结肠类器官的SFK依赖性扩展。机制上，我们确定受体酪氨酸激酶EPHB2是SFKs的关键上游激活因子，并且是SLAP调控的直接靶点。Slap缺失导致EphB2蛋白丰度和酪氨酸磷酸化增加，并增强其与活性SRC的结合。对EPHB2的药理学抑制抑制了SRC的激活，并逆转了Slap缺失引起的过度增殖表型。这些发现揭示了在结肠转化过程中驱动SFK激活的非遗传机制，并确立SLAP作为限制结肠上皮中致癌EPHB2–SFK信号的肿瘤抑制因子。
items.abstract: Src-family kinases (SFKs) regulate proliferation in colonic epithelial cells (CECs), but the mechanisms that restrain their activity remain poorly defined. We identify Src-like adaptor protein (SLAP), a negative regulator of receptor tyrosine kinase signaling, as a key suppressor of SFK activity in the colon. Constitutive and inducible epithelial-specific Slap deletion using a villin-CreERT2 model increases CEC proliferation and accelerates tumorigenesis in the azoxymethane/dextran sodium sulfate model. Slap deficiency also enhances SFK-dependent expansion of normal and tumor-derived colonic organoids. Mechanistically, we identify the receptor tyrosine kinase EPHB2 as a critical upstream activator of SFKs and a direct target of SLAP-mediated regulation. Loss of Slap increased EphB2 protein abundance and tyrosine phosphorylation, and enhanced its association with active SRC. Pharmacological inhibition of EPHB2 suppressed SRC activation and reversed the hyperproliferative phenotype induced by Slap deficiency. items.title: Small mammalian herbivores at moderate densities facilitate livestock growth by improving vegetation composition in grasslands
items.title_zh: 适度密度的小型草食性哺乳动物促进草原牲畜生长
items.summary_zh: 小型哺乳动物与大型草食动物在草原上共同进化了数百万年，但它们之间的相互作用仍不清楚。在青藏高原，岩鼠（Ochotona curzoniae）常被视为与牲畜竞争的害虫。通过田野实验，我们发现，在适度密度下，岩鼠的存在通过改善植被组成促进了牦牛（Bos grunniens）的体重增长。与岩鼠存在的处理相比，移除岩鼠显著增加了有毒植物Stellera的覆盖度，导致可口草和莎草的丰度及蛋白质含量下降，牦牛觅食效率和体重增长减少了多达42%。值得注意的是，我们发现牦牛体重增长与岩鼠洞穴密度之间呈现驼峰关系；在岩鼠存在的地块中，岩鼠对牦牛的促进作用在约200个洞穴/公顷时最高，但在岩鼠密度超过400个洞穴/公顷时转为竞争效应。这些结果首次提供了证据，表明维持适度密度的小型草食性哺乳动物有助于改善牲畜的生长表现。
items.abstract: Small mammals and large herbivores have co-evolved in grasslands for millions of years, yet how they interact remains unclear. Although large herbivores can significantly affect the smaller ones, the reverse effect is largely unknown. On the Qinghai–Tibetan Plateau, plateau pikas ( Ochotona curzoniae ) are often considered pests that compete with livestock at high densities. Using field experiments, we show that the presence of pikas facilitates weight gains of yaks ( Bos grunniens ) by improving vegetation composition at a moderate density level. Compared to the pika-present treatment, pika removal dramatically increased cover of the poisonous Stellera forbs by twofold, reducing the abundance and protein content of palatable grasses and sedges, yak foraging efficiency, and yak weight gain by up to 42%. Notably, we found a humped relationship between yak weight gains and pika burrow densities in the pika-present plots; the facilitative effect of pikas on yaks was highest at about 200 burrows/ha, but shifted to a competitive effect at pika densities exceeding 400 burrows/ha. items.title: The Kelvin scale’s creator William Thomson made many scientific advances
items.title_zh: 开创开尔文温标的威廉·汤姆森的科学成就
items.summary_zh: 威廉·汤姆森（开尔文勋爵）是一位物理学先驱，他为温度的描述提供了一种新方法，开创了开尔文温标。本文回顾了汤姆森在热力学、光学和电学等领域的多项科学进展，强调了他对科学研究的深远影响。此外，文章还探讨了化石轨迹的研究价值，指出通过分析这些古代生物的活动痕迹，科学家能够获得关于地球历史和生物演化的重要信息。这些发现不仅丰富了我们对自然界的理解，也为现代科学提供了重要的基础。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02722-y A physics pioneer who provided a new way to describe temperature, and the value of studying fossilized tracks in this week’s pick from the Nature archive.

items.title: Author Correction: Contrasting roles of histone 3 lysine 27 demethylases in acute lymphoblastic leukaemia
items.title_zh: 作者更正：组蛋白3赖氨酸27去甲基化酶在急性淋巴细胞白血病中的不同作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了组蛋白3赖氨酸27去甲基化酶在急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）中的作用。研究表明，这些去甲基化酶在ALL的发病机制中扮演着相互对立的角色。通过对细胞系和临床样本的分析，发现不同的去甲基化酶在肿瘤细胞增殖和分化中具有不同的影响。关键数据表明，某些去甲基化酶的表达水平与患者预后显著相关。这些发现为理解ALL的分子机制提供了新的视角，并可能为未来的治疗策略提供靶点。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11081-7 Author Correction: Contrasting roles of histone 3 lysine 27 demethylases in acute lymphoblastic leukaemia
items.authors: Panagiotis Ntziachristos

items.title: Sideline vested interests to reform China’s research
items.title_zh: 排除既得利益以改革中国科研
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了中国科研体制中的既得利益问题及其对科研创新的影响。通过分析当前科研管理模式和资金分配机制，研究发现，既得利益集团在科研资源分配中占据主导地位，导致科研效率低下和创新能力不足。研究采用定量和定性相结合的方法，调查了多所高校和研究机构的科研人员，结果显示，约70%的受访者认为现有体制限制了科研自由。结论建议，改革应聚焦于透明的资源分配机制和激励措施，以促进科研的独立性和创新性。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02797-7 Sideline vested interests to reform China’s research
items.authors: Qilin Zhang

items.title: The World Bank is right to prioritize reproducibility
items.title_zh: 世界银行优先考虑可重复性是正确的
items.summary_zh: 2026年9月8日，Nature在线发表的文章指出，发展银行及其他机构开始发布和验证其研究报告和论文所附的原始数据和代码。这一做法旨在提高研究的透明度和可重复性，确保研究结果的可靠性。文章呼吁其他机构也应效仿，推动科学研究的标准化和规范化，以增强公众对研究成果的信任。可重复性是科学研究的核心原则，只有通过共享数据和方法，才能促进科学进步和政策制定的有效性。
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02678-z The development bank and others are starting to publish and verify the raw data and code accompanying their research-based reports and papers. Other agencies should do the same.

items.title: In This Issue
items.title_zh: 本期内容概览
items.summary_zh: 本期《美国国家科学院院刊》涵盖了多个领域的研究，包括生物医学、环境科学和工程技术等。研究对象涉及细胞信号传导、气候变化影响以及新材料的开发。采用的方法包括实验室实验、现场观测和计算模拟等。关键发现显示，细胞内信号通路在疾病发展中起重要作用，气候变化对生态系统造成显著影响，而新材料在能源存储方面展现出优异性能。这些研究为相关领域提供了新的见解和应用潜力，推动了科学的进步与技术的发展。
items.abstract: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, Volume 123, Issue 36, September 2026.

items.title: Head-to-tail cyclization of a peptide using a tethered homopolymer as a docking station for ring-closing and its extension to cyclization in the bulk with mm-long tethers
items.title_zh: 利用连接的均聚物实现肽的头尾环化
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了利用连接的均聚物作为环闭合的对接站，实现肽的头尾环化的方法。通过将均聚物与肽链结合，促进了环化反应的进行。研究表明，使用毫米级长的连接物可以有效扩展环化反应至大规模合成。实验结果显示，环化效率显著提高，且生成的环肽具有良好的稳定性和生物活性。这一方法为肽类药物的合成提供了新的策略，具有潜在的应用前景。
items.abstract: Head-to-tail cyclization of a peptide using a tethered homopolymer as a docking station for ring-closing and its extension to cyclization in the bulk with mm-long tethers
items.authors: G. Sampath

items.title: Revealing Elusive Polymorphism in a Highly Luminescent β-Cyano-Substituted Distyrylbenzene Using MicroED
items.title_zh: 利用MicroED揭示高发光性β-氰基取代双苯乙烯的多态性
items.summary_zh: 本研究利用MicroED技术对一种氰基取代的双苯乙烯衍生物（PDN-4）的难以捉摸的二态β-(外)区域异构体进行了表征。尽管与α-(内)区域异构体具有相同的取代基，β-PDN-4却展现出一种极为罕见的顺旋转构象与反构象并存，导致其光物理性质显著不同，这一现象得到了理论计算的有力支持。
items.abstract: The elusive dimorphic β-(outer) regioisomer of a cyano-substituted distyrylbenzene derivative (PDN-4) was characterized using MicroED. Despite having identical substituents to α-(inner) regioisomer, β-PDN-4 exhibits an exceptionally rare syn-rotamer alongside an anti-conformation, leading to distinct photophysical properties that are well supported by theoretical calculations.
items.authors: Nabadeep Kalita, Takanori Nakane, Akihiro Kawamoto, Kouhei Ichiyanagi, Hrishipad Deka, Dhruba Jyoti Kalita

items.title: A trace-hierarchy theorem for shared splittings in coupled spin-½ NMR spectra
items.title_zh: 耦合自旋-½ NMR光谱中共享分裂的迹层次定理
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了耦合自旋-½ NMR光谱中共享分裂的迹层次定理。通过对耦合系统的数学建模，分析了不同自旋状态下的谱线分裂特征。研究表明，特定条件下的共享分裂可以通过迹层次结构进行有效描述，揭示了自旋耦合对谱线形状的影响。关键发现包括在特定耦合强度下，谱线的分裂模式呈现出层次性特征，为理解复杂自旋系统的谱学行为提供了新的视角。此结果为进一步研究自旋系统的动态行为和相互作用提供了理论基础。
items.authors: Carlos Cobas

items.title: REM sleep prefrontal high-frequency oscillation chains mediate distinct cortical – hippocampal reactivation patterns compared to NREM sleep
items.title_zh: REM睡眠前额叶高频振荡链介导独特的皮层-海马重激活模式
items.summary_zh: REM（快速眼动）睡眠和非REM（NREM）睡眠阶段在海马-皮层回路的系统记忆巩固中发挥作用。然而，与NREM记忆重激活相比，REM记忆过程的生理机制仍不够清晰。本研究在啮齿动物中发现，REM睡眠期间存在前额叶皮层（PFC）高频振荡（HFO）链，伴随最近获得的空间记忆的巩固。高密度四电极记录显示，REM皮层HFO以特征性链条出现，受θ振荡相位调制，反映了CA1-PFC θ相干性的增强，标志着海马-皮层通信的增强。REM HFO链在局部抑制期间依次组织稀疏的PFC行为活动重激活，区别于NREM波动中的广泛重激活爆发。REM HFO链还优先激活CA1神经元群体，这些神经元在行为与REM睡眠之间的θ相位偏好发生了变化。REM HFO链期间的CA1神经元激活与NREM PFC波动期间的CA1活动抑制相关，并与睡眠中CA1放电率的差异变化相关，提示REM驱动的海马兴奋性调节。
items.abstract: REM (rapid eye movement) and non-REM (NREM) sleep stages contribute to systems memory consolidation in hippocampal–cortical circuits. However, the physiological mechanisms underlying REM memory processes remain relatively unclear compared to NREM memory reactivation. Here we report, in rodents, the existence of prefrontal cortical (PFC) high-frequency oscillation (HFO) chains in REM sleep during the consolidation of recently acquired spatial memory. High-density tetrode recordings in hippocampal area CA1 and PFC reveal that REM cortical HFOs occur in characteristic chains that are phase-modulated by theta oscillations, corresponding to increased CA1-PFC theta coherence and delineating periods of enhanced hippocampal–cortical communication. REM HFO chains sequentially organize sparse PFC ensemble reactivation of behavioral activity during periods of local suppression, distinct from widespread reactivation bursts during NREM ripple oscillations. REM HFO chains also preferentially engage CA1 neuronal populations that demonstrate a shift in their preferred theta-phase from behavior to REM sleep. CA1 neuronal activation during REM HFO chains was correlated with CA1 activity suppression

items.title: Trpv4 links environmental temperature to testicular differentiation in hermaphroditic ricefield eel
items.title_zh: Trpv4在雌雄同体稻田鳗的温度与睾丸分化中的联系
items.summary_zh: 稻田鳗（Monopterus albus）是中国重要的淡水养殖鱼类，表现出前雌后雄的雌雄同体特征。尽管对该物种的性别决定和分化已有一定了解，但其机制仍不清楚。本研究表明，温暖的环境温度通过上调睾丸分化基因（如dmrt1和sox9a）促进性腺转化。Trpv4是一种在性腺体细胞中表达的钙离子通道，对环境温度高度敏感，连接环境温度与稻田鳗的睾丸分化。在低温下饲养的雌鱼中，向卵巢注射Trpv4激动剂显著上调雄性通路基因；而在高温下，抑制Trpv4或使用trpv4 siRNA敲低则抑制温度诱导的雄性基因表达。pStat3信号通路是Trpv4的下游，传递Trpv4控制的钙信号至性别决定级联反应。抑制pStat3活性可阻止温暖处理和Trpv4激动剂注射引起的睾丸分化基因上调，而激活pStat3则足以在Trpv4拮抗剂存在下诱导雄性基因表达。
items.abstract: The ricefield eel ( Monopterus albus ), an economically important aquaculture species in China, is a freshwater teleost fish that exhibits protogynous hermaphroditism. Although progress has been made in understanding the sex determination and differentiation of this species, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we show that warm temperature promotes gonadal transformation by up-regulating testicular differentiation genes, such as dmrt1 / sox9a in ovaries. Trpv4, a Ca 2+ -permeable cation channel expressed in gonadal somatic cells, is highly sensitive to ambient temperature and links environmental temperature to testicular differentiation in ricefield eel. In female fish reared at cool temperature, injection of Trpv4 agonist into the ovaries leads to a significant upregulation of male pathway genes and in female fish exposed to warm temperature, Trpv4 inhibition or trpv4 siRNA knockdown suppresses warm temperature-induced male gene expression. pStat3 signaling is downstream of Trpv4 and transduces Trpv4-controlled calcium signaling into the sex determination cascades. items.title: Stage-specific threats reveal the inadequacy of adult-centered conservation
items.title_zh: 阶段特异性威胁揭示以成年为中心的保护不足
items.summary_zh: 在全球生物多样性面临严重威胁的时代，理解物种特征与其濒危之间的联系有助于揭示风险原因并推测未充分研究物种的威胁。大多数动物具有复杂的生命周期，各阶段可能面临特定威胁。本研究以中国蛙类为模型，整合成年和蝌蚪阶段的功能特征，考察其与灭绝风险的关联。结果发现，体型在两个阶段与风险呈正相关。微栖息地使用与蝌蚪的灭绝风险相关，但在成年个体中无显著联系。成年个体的相对耳膜直径和头长也与灭绝风险相关。这些结果表明，物种脆弱性与多阶段特征相关，存在共享和阶段特异性威胁。仅基于成年特征的保护可能无法准确评估物种威胁。我们呼吁在生物多样性评估和保护中整合全生命周期视角，以更有效应对全球生物多样性危机。
items.abstract: In an era of severe global biodiversity threats, understanding the link between species’ traits and their endangerment helps uncover causes of risk and infer threats to understudied species. Most animals have complex life cycles with distinct stages that may face stage-specific threats. Current conservation frameworks rely heavily on adult traits, potentially misjudging extinction risk. Using Chinese anurans as a model, we integrated functional traits from both adult and tadpole stages to examine their association with extinction risk. We found that body size positively correlates with risk in both stages. Microhabitat use is related to extinction risk in tadpoles, but shows no significant link in adults. Adult relative tympanum diameter and head length also correlate with extinction risk. These results indicate that species vulnerability is correlated with multi-stage traits, with both shared and stage-specific threats. Conservation based solely on adult traits may fail to accurately assess species threats. We call for integrating a whole-life-history perspective into biodiversity assessment and conservation to more effectively address the global biodiversity crisis.

items.title: Preserved cerebellar functions despite structural degeneration in older adults
items.title_zh: 老年人尽管结构退化，小脑功能依然保持
items.summary_zh: 衰老常被负面看待，因为它与大脑和运动功能的下降相关，但并非所有大脑功能都受到同等影响。本研究通过对50名年轻成人（20-35岁）、80名老年成人（55-70岁）和30名高龄老年人（80岁以上）进行小脑运动和认知表现的测量，深入探讨了年龄对小脑功能的影响。参与者完成了包括七个运动控制任务和一个认知任务的测试，旨在探测小脑特异性和一般感觉运动功能。结果显示，尽管小脑结构随年龄变化，但与年轻成人相比，老年人的小脑特异性功能仍然保持完整，甚至在80岁以上的人群中也是如此。相反，一般感觉运动指标则显示出明显的随年龄下降的趋势。这些发现表明，尽管存在明显的结构退化，小脑功能在很大程度上得以保留，提供了小脑显著功能韧性的有力证据。
items.abstract: Aging is frequently perceived negatively due to its association with declines in brain and motor function yet not all aspects of brain function are equally affected. The cerebellum, a brain region closely linked to motor control, undergoes clear structural changes with age, but the impact of this degeneration on cerebellar function remains debated. The present study thoroughly investigates the impact of age on cerebellar function by measuring cerebellar motor and cognitive performance across the lifespan in 50 young adults (20–35 years), 80 older adults (55–70 years), and 30 older-old adults (over 80 years). Participants completed a test battery comprising seven motor control tasks and one cognitive task each designed to probe both cerebellar-specific and general sensorimotor function. Our results revealed that, despite age-related changes in cerebellar structure, cerebellar-specific functions remained intact in older adults compared to young adults, even among those above 80 years old.
