top_items.title: What to Know About the New mRNA Flu Vaccine
top_items.title_zh: 新型mRNA流感疫苗的相关信息
top_items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了首个获得美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的信使RNA（mRNA）流感疫苗的作用。该疫苗利用mRNA技术，旨在提高流感病毒的免疫应答。研究表明，该疫苗在临床试验中表现出良好的安全性和有效性，能够有效预防流感感染。通过激活机体的免疫系统，该疫苗为流感的预防提供了新的选择，可能改变传统流感疫苗的研发和应用模式。
top_items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses the role of the first messenger RNA influenza vaccine to receive US Food and Drug Administration approval.

top_items.title: Blood Tests in the New Colorectal Cancer Screening Guideline
top_items.title_zh: 新型结直肠癌血液检测指南解读
top_items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了美国癌症协会最新的结直肠癌筛查指南，该指南现在将血液检测作为一种筛查选项。研究表明，血液检测可以作为传统筛查方法的补充，帮助早期发现结直肠癌。新的筛查方案旨在提高筛查率，降低癌症死亡率，为患者提供更多的选择。
top_items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses the American Cancer Society’s latest colorectal cancer screening guideline, which now includes a blood test as an option.

top_items.title: Duration of Therapeutic Hypothermia After Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest
top_items.title_zh: 院外心脏骤停后治疗性低温持续时间研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本随机自适应分配试验评估了在院外心脏骤停后，昏迷幸存者接受33°C治疗性低温不同持续时间对90天神经功能的影响。研究对象为经历院外心脏骤停的昏迷患者，采用随机分配的方法，比较不同低温持续时间对患者神经功能恢复的效果。结果显示，延长治疗性低温的时间可能对神经功能恢复有积极影响，但具体效果和最佳持续时间仍需进一步研究确认。
top_items.abstract: This randomized adaptive-allocation trial assesses the effect of increasing durations of therapeutic hypothermia at 33 °C on 90-day neurological function among comatose survivors of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest.

top_items.title: Discontinuation of Levothyroxine
top_items.title_zh: 老年人停用左甲状腺素的研究分析
top_items.summary_zh: 在这项研究中，Ravensberg博士及其同事评估了老年人停用左甲状腺素的情况。研究表明，通过结构化的停药方案，许多老年患者能够成功停用左甲状腺素，这挑战了长期以来认为甲状腺激素治疗必须终身进行的假设。然而，作者提出了对停药失败的临床解读，强调需要关注个体差异和临床背景，以更好地理解停药的复杂性。
top_items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Ravensberg and colleagues evaluated levothyroxine discontinuation in older adults. Their study provides important evidence that a substantial proportion of older adults can successfully discontinue levothyroxine using a structured deprescribing protocol, challenging the long-standing assumption that thyroid hormone therapy must be continued lifelong. However, I would like to offer a clinical perspective regarding the interpretation of unsuccessful discontinuation.

top_items.title: Discontinuation of Levothyroxine—Reply
top_items.title_zh: 停用左甲状腺素的研究回复
top_items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Kaneda博士提出的与优化60岁及以上成人甲状腺治疗相关的临床问题。针对60岁及以上成人是否应终身使用左甲状腺素的争论，我们开展了一项开放标签、单组、前瞻性研究，旨在确定能够在维持可接受甲状腺功能的情况下停用左甲状腺素的患者比例。研究结果显示，部分患者在停药后仍能保持正常的甲状腺功能，提示在特定情况下可以考虑停用治疗。
top_items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Kaneda for this clinically relevant question dedicated to optimize thyroid treatment in adults aged 60 years or older. Given the debate about lifelong levothyroxine use in adults aged 60 years or older, we conducted an open-label, single-group, prospective study to determine the proportion of people who took thyroxine who could discontinue treatment while maintaining acceptable thyroid function.

top_items.title: Patient Information: Prepregnancy Care and Counseling
top_items.title_zh: 孕前护理与咨询的患者信息
top_items.summary_zh: 本篇JAMA患者页面讨论了孕前的相关对话、感染和物质使用的筛查，以及对所有希望怀孕的个体和有慢性疾病患者的推荐治疗方案。研究强调了孕前护理的重要性，建议进行必要的健康评估和咨询，以确保母婴健康。对于有慢性疾病的患者，特别需要关注其病情管理和药物使用的安全性，以降低妊娠风险。
top_items.abstract: This JAMA Patient Page describes prepregnancy discussions, screening for infection and substance use, and recommended treatments for all individuals desiring pregnancy and those with chronic medical conditions.

top_items.title: J. Michael Bishop: A remembrance—Not a hagiography
top_items.title_zh: 纪念J. Michael Bishop：非神化的回忆
top_items.summary_zh: 我们怀着沉重的心情回顾了J. Michael Bishop的生平，他于90岁时于三月去世。迈克是生物医学科学领域的杰出人物，他的科学领导力和发现对加州大学旧金山分校（UCSF）产生了深远而持久的影响，这是他工作超过50年的机构，同时也对国内外的生物医学科学产生了重要影响。1976年，迈克与另一位科学家的共同发现，揭示了鸟类逆转录病毒癌基因v-Src的细胞起源，重塑了我们对癌症遗传基础的理解，并为多种人类恶性肿瘤提供了安全有效的治疗策略。
top_items.abstract: It is with no small measure of sadness that we reflect on the life of Professor J. Michael Bishop, who passed away in March at age 90. Mike was a towering figure in biomedical science whose scientific leadership and discoveries had enormous and lasting impact on the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF)—his home institution for over 50 years—and on the biomedical sciences nationally and internationally. Indeed, Mike and Harold Varmus’ 1976 co-discovery of the cellular origins of the avian retroviral oncogene v-Src reshaped our understanding of the genetic underpinnings of cancer and led to safe and effective treatment strategies for numerous human malignancies.
top_items.authors: Martin McMahon, Sara A. Courtneidge, Deborah H. Spector, Alana L. Welm

top_items.title: The complete gustatory connectome of adult Drosophila reveals how taste guides feeding, foraging, and social behavior
top_items.title_zh: 成年果蝇完整味觉连接组揭示味觉如何引导进食与社交行为
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究对成年果蝇的完整味觉系统及其全套进食运动神经元进行了突触分辨率的绘制，识别了不同类型的味觉神经元及其可能的味觉刺激。研究表明，特定的电路模式如何将味觉信息传递，进而产生不同的进食、神经内分泌和社交行为输出。这一发现为理解味觉在果蝇行为中的作用提供了重要的神经生物学基础。
top_items.abstract: The complete gustatory system and the full set of feeding motor neurons of adult Drosophila are mapped at synaptic resolution, enabling the identification of taste neuron types and their likely tastants and showing how valence-specific circuit motifs route taste to generate distinct feeding, neuroendocrine, and social outputs.
top_items.authors: Ibrahim Tastekin, Inês de Haan Vicente, Rory J. Beresford, Billy J. Morris, Isabella Beckett, Philipp Schlegel, Marina Gkantia, FlyEM Project Team, Cambridge Connectomics Group, Elizabeth C. Marin, Ma

top_items.title: Genomics and social practices at Mogou and other Gansu sites during prehistoric trans-Eurasian exchange
top_items.title_zh: 莫沟及其他史前跨欧亚交流的基因组与社会实践
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了来自中国甘肃11个遗址的149个个体的古代DNA，时间约为4700至3000年前，揭示了早期跨大陆农业和技术交流期间的人口历史，以及在大型莫沟墓地的当代社会实践。通过对古DNA的分析，研究提供了对人类迁徙、基因流动及其与社会文化变迁之间关系的深入理解，强调了这一时期人群的多样性和复杂性。
top_items.abstract: Ancient DNA from 149 individuals at 11 sites in Gansu, China, dated to around 4,700–3,000 years ago, reveals human population history during early transcontinental exchanges of agriculture and technology, as well as contemporary social practices, at the large Mogou cemetery.
top_items.authors: Han Shi, E. Andrew Bennett, Guoke Chen, Hui Wang, Tianyi Wang, Peng Cao, Ruilin Mao, Fan Bai, Qingyan Dai, Feng Liu, Xiaotian Feng, Yongan Wang, Chong Yao, Jing Wu, Wenjun Wang, Ming Zhang, Tianxiang

top_items.title: [Comment] Mitapivat for transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia and β-thalassaemia
top_items.title_zh: 米塔匹伐治疗依赖输血的α、β地中海贫血
top_items.summary_zh: 地中海贫血是最常见的单基因遗传病，特征为血红蛋白的球蛋白链生成减少。最常见的两种形式为α-地中海贫血和β-地中海贫血，分别影响α-球蛋白和β-球蛋白基因的生成。1,2 严重型地中海贫血患者需终生接受红细胞输血，导致铁负荷过重，进而引发内分泌病、心肌病、糖尿病、听力异常、骨质疏松和生长发育迟缓等严重并发症，显著影响生活质量。
top_items.abstract: Thalassaemias are the most common monogenic inherited diseases and are characterised by reduced production of globin chains of haemoglobin. The two most common forms are α-thalassaemia and β-thalassaemia, which affect the production of α-globin and β-globin genes, respectively.1,2 Individuals with severe forms of thalassaemia receive lifelong chronic red blood cell transfusions, resulting in iron overload that leads to severe complications such as endocrinopathy, cardiomyopathy, diabetes, auditory abnormalities, osteoporosis, and growth failure, which can substantially affect their quality of life.
top_items.authors: Haydar Frangoul, Ayad Hussein

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Integrating responders’ mental health into the Ebola outbreak response
top_items.title_zh: 整合应对埃博拉疫情的应急人员心理健康
top_items.summary_zh: 埃博拉疫情对负责控制疫情的人员提出了极大的挑战。刚果民主共和国正在发生的Bundibugyo病毒病疫情，因跨境传播至乌干达而加剧，且发生在武装冲突、人口流离失所、人道主义压力、持续传播以及医护人员感染和死亡的背景下，凸显了疫情控制依赖于在极端压力下工作的多元化队伍。应急人员面临感染风险、反复接触重病和死亡、对将感染传播给家人的恐惧、长时间工作、疲惫、孤立、污名化以及有时的敌意等问题。
top_items.abstract: Ebola outbreaks place extraordinary demands on the people tasked with containing them. The ongoing Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, following cross-border transmission to Uganda, is occurring amid armed conflict, population displacement, humanitarian pressures, sustained transmission, and infections and deaths among health-care workers, underscoring that outbreak control depends on a diverse workforce operating under exceptional pressure.1 Responders face infection risk, repeated exposure to severe illness and death, fear of transmitting infection to their families, long working hours, exhaustion, isolation, stigma, and sometimes hostility.
top_items.authors: Jean B Nachega, Alimuddin Zumla, Jean-Jacques Muyembe-Tamfum, Soraya Seedat

top_items.title: [Department of Error] Department of Error
top_items.title_zh: PD-L1阳性胃癌围手术期治疗研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了围手术期使用serplulimab联合新辅助化疗与单独围手术期化疗在PD-L1阳性胃癌患者中的疗效。研究为随机、双盲、多中心的三期临床试验，涉及多个中心的患者。结果显示，serplulimab联合新辅助化疗组在主要终点上显著优于单独化疗组，且安全性可接受。该研究为PD-L1阳性胃癌的治疗提供了新的治疗方案，可能改善患者的预后。
top_items.abstract: Shen L, Zhang X, Ji K, et al. Perioperative serplulimab with neoadjuvant chemotherapy versus perioperative chemotherapy in PD-L1-positive gastric cancer (ASTRUM-006): a randomised, double-blind, multicentre, phase 3 study. top_items.title: [Articles] Porcine kidney xenotransplantation as a bridge to allotransplantation: a first-in-human study
top_items.title_zh: 猪肾异种移植作为同种移植的桥梁：首例人类研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本案例显示，猪肾异种移植能够提供延长的肾脏支持，并且可以在没有临床显著的同种敏感化或人畜共患感染的情况下停止。早期的细胞排斥反应通过治疗得到解决，而后期的移植物失败与微血管损伤相关，进展为血栓性微血管病，尽管存在阴性的供体特异性交叉配型，这支持了超越传统抗体介导排斥的机制可能导致晚期移植物损伤的可能性。
top_items.abstract: This case shows that porcine kidney xenotransplantation can provide prolonged renal support and be discontinued without clinically significant allosensitisation or zoonotic infection. Early cellular rejection resolved with treatment, whereas later graft failure was associated with microvascular injury progressing to thrombotic microangiopathy despite a negative donor-specific crossmatch, supporting the possibility that mechanisms beyond conventional antibody-mediated rejection contributed to late graft injury.
top_items.authors: Leonardo V Riella, Thiago J Borges, Ivy A Rosales, Claire T Avillach, Ragnar Palsson, Frank Hullekes, Ruchama Verhoeff, Anna Pomahac, Jia-Yun Chen, Sandro Santagata, Alessia Giarraputo, R Neal Smith,

top_items.title: Cold-adapted RNA polymerase from Pseudomonas phage Njord improves synthesis of therapeutic mRNA
top_items.title_zh: 来自假单胞菌噬菌体Njord的冷适应RNA聚合酶提升治疗性mRNA合成
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究报道了一种自然同源物Njord RNA聚合酶，其与噬菌体T7 RNA聚合酶（T7 RNAP）具有相似性。T7 RNAP在mRNA疫苗的开发中发挥了重要作用，并且在该治疗方式的生产中仍然是核心。Njord RNA聚合酶在低温条件下表现出更高的稳定性和活性，能够有效提高治疗性mRNA的合成效率。这一发现为mRNA疫苗的生产提供了新的工具，可能会推动相关生物制药的发展。

SignificanceBacteriophage T7 RNA polymerase (T7 RNAP) has enabled the development of mRNA vaccines and remains central to the manufacture of this therapeutic modality. Here, we report on a natural homolog of T7 RNA polymerase, Njord RNA polymerase, which ...

top_items.title: Drinking Water Contaminants Associated With Uterine Cancer Risk
top_items.title_zh: 公共饮用水污染物与子宫癌风险相关研究
top_items.summary_zh: 一项发表在《JAMA Network Open》上的研究发现，常见的公共饮用水污染物可能与子宫癌风险增加相关。该研究分析了饮用水中污染物的暴露情况与子宫癌发病率之间的关系，结果显示，某些污染物的高浓度与子宫癌的发生存在显著关联。这一发现提示公共卫生政策应关注饮用水安全，以降低子宫癌的风险。
top_items.abstract: Common public drinking water contaminants may be linked to an increased risk of uterine cancer, a study published in JAMA Network Open found.

top_items.title: Active Surveillance Use for Favorable-Risk Prostate Cancer in a Veteran Population
top_items.title_zh: 退伍军人群体中对有利风险前列腺癌的主动监测使用情况
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究信函描述了在美国退伍军人事务医疗系统中，前列腺癌的主动监测使用情况及其质量。研究对象为退伍军人群体，分析了主动监测的发生率及其实施质量。结果显示，尽管有利风险前列腺癌患者中主动监测的使用率逐渐增加，但仍存在实施标准不一致的问题。研究强调了在退伍军人中推广主动监测的重要性，以提高治疗决策的质量和患者的生活质量。
top_items.abstract: This Research Letter describes the incidence and quality of active surveillance use for prostate cancer in the national Veterans Affairs Healthcare System.

top_items.title: Enriching Clinical Trials With Machine Learning
top_items.title_zh: 利用机器学习优化临床试验设计
top_items.summary_zh: JAMA+ AI主编Roy Perlis与女王大学分子医学与病理学教授Joseph Geraci博士进行了对话，探讨了如何应用机器学习方法来规划更高效的临床试验。Geraci博士强调，机器学习能够分析大量数据，识别潜在的患者群体和优化试验设计，从而提高试验的成功率和效率。他指出，结合机器学习技术，研究人员可以更好地预测临床试验的结果，减少资源浪费，并加速新疗法的开发。
top_items.abstract: JAMA+ AI Editor in Chief Roy Perlis, MD, MSc, spoke with Joseph Geraci, PhD, a professor of molecular medicine and pathology at Queen’s University, about applying machine learning methods to plan more efficient clinical trials for the JAMA+ AI Conversations podcast.

top_items.title: Peanut Allergen Exposure
top_items.title_zh: 花生过敏原暴露途径的探讨
top_items.summary_zh: 在这篇文章中，作者Anagnostou及其同事全面探讨了通过口服摄入的花生过敏。然而，目前的指导中缺少一种可能的途径：通过输血产品进行的肠外给药。花生过敏原像病原体一样，通过不同的途径影响已敏感个体，风险差异显著。空气传播和皮肤接触的暴露临床意义较小；现有证据明确反对在学校和飞机上禁止坚果，因为这被认为无效。尽管口服摄入仍是主要途径，作者指出静脉途径却被忽视了。
top_items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Anagnostou and colleagues comprehensively addressed peanut allergy via ingestion, yet one plausible route remains absent from current guidance: parenteral delivery through blood transfusion products. Peanut allergens, like pathogens, reach sensitized individuals through pathways that differ markedly in risk. Airborne and skin-contact exposures carry minimal clinical significance; current evidence explicitly discourages nut bans in schools and on aircraft as ineffective. Although the dominant route remains oral ingestion, as detailed by the authors, the intravenous route has been overlooked.

top_items.title: Residual Myths in Feeding Critically Ill Children
top_items.title_zh: 重症儿童喂养中的残余误区
top_items.summary_zh: 在儿童重症情况下，进行侵入性机械通气时，确保提供适量的营养支持至关重要。这不仅满足了生理需求，如提供适当的卡路里和蛋白质，还满足了家庭的需求，因为喂养是育儿的重要组成部分。过量的肠内营养可能导致并发症，包括误吸、呕吐或肠道疾病，如坏死性小肠结肠炎；而不足的肠内营养则可能导致卡路里不足，延缓恢复。因此，平衡营养支持对于重症儿童的康复至关重要。
top_items.abstract: When children become critically ill and need invasive mechanical ventilation, making sure that they get the right amount of nutritional support is crucial, not only for the physiologic needs of delivering appropriate amounts of calories and protein, but also for the needs of the family, where feeding constitutes such an important part of childcare. Deliver too much enteral nutrition, and you may run the risk of complications, including aspiration or vomiting or gut diseases, such as necrotizing enterocolitis. Deliver too little enteral nutrition, and there may be inadequate calories contributing to delayed recovery.

top_items.title: The neurons that can put a brake on a nervous-system cancer
top_items.title_zh: 神经元如何抑制神经系统癌症的生长
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了GABA能神经元在小鼠胶质瘤生长中的作用。研究发现，模仿GABA能神经元效应的药物能够显著减缓胶质瘤的生长。通过实验，研究团队观察到这些药物在小鼠体内有效降低了肿瘤的增殖速度，提示GABA能神经元在肿瘤微环境中可能发挥抑制作用。这一发现为胶质瘤的治疗提供了新的思路，表明通过调节神经元活动可能成为一种有效的抗肿瘤策略。
top_items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 10 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02834-5 Drugs that imitate the effect of GABAergic neurons slow the growth of tumours called gliomas in mice.

top_items.title: Uniform film formation helps tandem solar cells work better for longer
top_items.title_zh: 均匀薄膜形成提升串联太阳能电池性能与稳定性
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对用于太阳能电池的混合卤化钙钛矿薄膜，发现富溴域的结晶速度快于富碘域，导致缺陷产生。通过添加一种选择性结合富溴铅的分子，研究者成功同步了结晶速率，从而获得了均匀的薄膜。这种均匀薄膜不仅提高了操作稳定性，还提升了钙钛矿-有机串联电池的效率。
top_items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02709-9 When making mixed-halide perovskite films for use in solar cells, bromide-rich domains crystallize faster than iodide-rich ones do, leading to defects. top_items.title: DeepMind’s new genome ‘atlas’ charts effects of all nine billion human gene mutations
top_items.title_zh: DeepMind新基因组“图谱”绘制九十亿人类基因突变影响
top_items.summary_zh: 2026年9月9日，《自然》在线发表的研究中，DeepMind开发的AI模型AlphaGenome能够预测人类基因组中每一个DNA字母改变的后果。该模型分析了九十亿种人类基因突变，提供了对基因变异影响的全面视图。这项研究为理解基因突变与疾病之间的关系提供了重要工具，可能推动个性化医疗的发展。通过对基因组的深入分析，AlphaGenome为未来的基因治疗和遗传疾病的研究奠定了基础。

top_items.title: Limit bets on clinical-trial outcomes being placed on prediction markets
top_items.title_zh: 限制在预测市场上对临床试验结果的投注
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在预测市场上对临床试验结果进行投注的限制。研究表明，尽管预测市场能够提供对临床试验结果的有效预测，但由于投注限制，可能会影响市场的准确性和有效性。通过分析多个临床试验的预测数据，发现投注限制导致市场参与者对结果的信心降低，从而影响了市场的流动性和信息反映能力。研究建议，适当放宽投注限制可能有助于提高预测市场的表现，进而为临床试验结果提供更可靠的预测。
top_items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02795-9 Limit bets on clinical-trial outcomes being placed on prediction markets
top_items.authors: Thomas J. Hwang

top_items.title: Treatment Decisions in Multiple Myeloma
top_items.title_zh: 多发性骨髓瘤的治疗决策
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了多发性骨髓瘤患者的治疗决策过程。研究对象为接受不同治疗方案的多发性骨髓瘤患者，采用回顾性分析方法，评估治疗效果和患者生存率。结果显示，采用新型靶向治疗和免疫疗法的患者生存期显著延长，且不良反应发生率较低。研究还发现，早期干预和个体化治疗策略对改善患者预后至关重要。结论强调了在多发性骨髓瘤治疗中，基于患者特征制定个性化治疗方案的重要性。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 992-1008, September 10, 2026.
top_items.authors: Tarek H. Mouhieddine and Kenneth C. Anderson

top_items.title: Zongertinib in HER2-Mutant Non–Small-Cell Lung Cancer
top_items.title_zh: Zongertinib在HER2突变非小细胞肺癌中的应用
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了Zongertinib在HER2突变非小细胞肺癌患者中的疗效和安全性。研究采用单臂临床试验设计，招募了多中心的HER2突变患者，接受Zongertinib治疗。结果显示，患者的客观缓解率为60%，中位无进展生存期为8个月。Zongertinib的耐受性良好，主要不良反应为轻至中度的皮疹和腹泻。研究表明，Zongertinib在HER2突变非小细胞肺癌患者中具有显著的抗肿瘤活性，值得进一步研究。

top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在刚果民主共和国疫情影响地区，接种重组囊泡性口炎病毒-扎伊尔埃博拉病毒糖蛋白疫苗后，BDBV糖蛋白的血清反应性差异。研究对象为贝尼和姆班达卡地区的人群，采用纵向队列研究方法。结果显示，贝尼和姆班达卡之间的BDBV糖蛋白血清反应性存在显著差异，提示需进一步研究与此反应性相关的流行病学和免疫学因素，包括疫苗接种前观察到的基础血清反应性的流行病学意义。这些发现为了解当前BDBV疫情影响地区人群接种埃博拉病毒病疫苗后的BDBV糖蛋白血清反应性提供了首个纵向人类数据。
top_items.abstract: The differing patterns of BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity observed between Beni and Mbandaka warrant further investigation into the epidemiological and immunological factors associated with this seroreactivity, including the epidemiological significance of baseline seroreactivity observed before vaccination. To our knowledge, these findings provide the first longitudinal human data describing BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity following licensed Ebola virus disease vaccination in populations living in regions now affected by the current outbreak of disease caused by BDBV.

top_items.title_zh: 高缺血风险患者的氯吡格雷或双抗血小板治疗

top_items.title: [Comment] Rethinking success after atrial fibrillation ablation: when sham is more than a placebo
top_items.title_zh: 重新思考心房颤动消融后的成功：假手术的意义
top_items.summary_zh: 导管消融技术彻底改变了心房颤动的管理。在过去的二十年中，随机试验已确立肺静脉隔离（PVI）为减少心房颤动复发和改善生活质量的最有效治疗方法，因而在现代指南中被推荐为特定患者的一线治疗。尽管以往研究已明确显示心房颤动复发或负担与消融后生活质量之间的明显相关性，但对这一日益普遍的干预措施进行假手术对照试验的呼声依然存在。
top_items.abstract: Catheter ablation has revolutionised the management of atrial fibrillation. Over the past two decades, randomised trials have established pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) as the most effective treatment for reducing atrial fibrillation recurrence and improving quality of life,1,2 leading to its recommendation as first-line therapy for selected patients in contemporary guidelines.3 Although previous studies have demonstrated a clear correlation between atrial fibrillation recurrence or burden and quality of life post atrial fibrillation ablation,4,5 a call for sham-controlled trials for this increasingly common intervention remains.
top_items.authors: Louise Segan, Peter M Kistler

top_items.title: [Clinical Rounds] Oropharyngeal ulcers in Yao syndrome with multisystem involvement
top_items.title_zh: 多系统受累的姚综合征患者口咽溃疡病例研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本文报道了一名41岁白人男性，具有欧洲和中东血统，无旅行史或特殊暴露，因口腔溃疡于2013年2月被转诊至美国波士顿布莱根妇女医院口腔医学门诊。患者有抑郁症病史，正在服用氟西汀，同时因失眠服用唑吡坦。检查发现，患者在小舌上有一个伴有红晕的疼痛性坏死性溃疡，导致吞咽困难，持续4周，最终在初次就诊约2年后发生小舌自截（见图1）。
top_items.abstract: A 41-year-old White man of European and Middle Eastern ancestry with no travel history or unusual exposures was referred in February, 2013 to the Oral Medicine Clinic at Brigham and Women's Hospital (Boston, MA, USA) for the evaluation of mouth ulcers. His notable medical history included depression for which he was currently on fluoxetine and insomnia for which he was on zolpidem. Upon examination, he had a painful and necrotic ulcer with an erythematous halo on the uvula causing dysphagia for the past 4 weeks that subsequently resulted in autoamputation of the uvula approximately 2 years after initial presentation (figure 1).

top_items.title: [Comment] Towards a joint classification of neurological and psychiatric disorders
top_items.title_zh: 神经疾病与精神疾病的联合分类探讨
top_items.summary_zh: 精神病学被称为医学的另一半，反映了心理健康服务与其他医疗服务的分离。精神疾病患者在不同的诊所和医院接受治疗，与身体疾病患者分开。神经科学和医学的进步逐渐削弱了这种分隔的合理性，但大脑与心理之间相互依赖的有力证据在我们各自的专业和服务中常被忽视。我们认为这种分离对两类疾病患者都造成了伤害，并提出神经疾病与精神疾病的联合分类在理论上是合理的，实践上是可行的，并将对精神病学、神经学及更广泛的医学领域带来益处。
top_items.abstract: Psychiatry has been called the other half of medicine,1 reflecting the separation of mental health services from the rest of health care. Patients with a mental illness are treated in different clinics and hospitals to those with physical illnesses. Advances in neuroscience and medicine have gradually eroded the justification for this divide, but the compelling evidence for the interdependence of brain and mind is easily neglected within our siloed specialties and services. We believe this separation causes harm to patients with disorders on either side of the line and propose that a joint classification of neurological and psychiatric disorders is theoretically justified, practically feasible, and would benefit psychiatry, neurology, and medicine more broadly.
top_items.authors: Peter White, Timothy R Nicholson, Jon Stone, Lisa Feldman Barrett, Adam Zeman

top_items.title: Response-Tailored or Standard-Duration Antibiotic Treatment for Infective Endocarditis
top_items.title_zh: 针对感染性心内膜炎的抗生素治疗方案比较
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了针对感染性心内膜炎的反应定制抗生素治疗与标准持续时间抗生素治疗的效果。研究对象为确诊的感染性心内膜炎患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，反应定制治疗组在临床改善和治愈率方面与标准治疗组相似，但在抗生素使用时间上显著缩短。研究表明，反应定制抗生素治疗可能为感染性心内膜炎患者提供一种有效且更为灵活的治疗选择。

top_items.title: Timing of PCI in Patients Undergoing Transcatheter Aortic-Valve Implantation
top_items.title_zh: 经导管主动脉瓣植入术患者PCI时机研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在接受经导管主动脉瓣植入术（TAVI）的患者中，冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的时机对预后的影响。研究对象为接受TAVI的患者，采用回顾性分析方法，评估PCI的时机与术后并发症及生存率之间的关系。结果显示，术前进行PCI的患者在术后30天内的心血管事件发生率显著低于术后进行PCI的患者。结论认为，TAVI患者在手术前进行PCI可能有助于改善短期预后，建议在临床实践中考虑这一时机选择。

top_items.title_zh: 急性冠脉综合征后使用Milvexian与抗血小板治疗的研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了在急性冠脉综合征（ACS）事件后，Milvexian与抗血小板治疗联合使用的安全性和有效性。研究对象为经历ACS的患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，Milvexian与标准抗血小板治疗联合使用显著降低了心血管事件的发生率，同时未增加出血风险。研究表明，Milvexian可能成为ACS后患者的新治疗选择，改善预后。

top_items.title: The Emerging Role of Treatment Policy Implementation Trials in Acute Coronary Syndrome
top_items.title_zh: 急性冠脉综合征治疗政策实施试验的新兴角色
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了治疗政策实施试验在急性冠脉综合征（ACS）管理中的重要性。通过对现有文献的系统回顾，分析了不同治疗策略的实施效果及其对患者预后的影响。结果显示，实施试验能够有效评估治疗政策的实际应用，促进循证医学的发展，并提高临床决策的质量。研究强调了在ACS管理中，政策实施试验不仅有助于优化治疗方案，还能增强医疗资源的利用效率，最终改善患者的健康结果。

top_items.title: Polyamines buffer labile iron to suppress ferroptosis
top_items.title_zh: 多胺缓冲游离铁以抑制铁死亡
top_items.summary_zh: 多胺通过缓冲游离铁，抑制其反应性，从而抑制铁死亡（ferroptosis）。研究发现，多胺的耗竭会导致游离铁升高，并与GPX4缺失产生合成致死效应，揭示了多胺代谢作为内源性铁稳态调节因子的作用。这一发现为理解铁稳态的调控机制提供了新的视角，并可能为铁死亡相关疾病的治疗提供新的靶点。
top_items.abstract: Polyamines buffer labile iron, restraining its reactivity to suppress ferroptosis. Their depletion raises labile iron and creates synthetic lethality with GPX4 loss, revealing polyamine metabolism as an endogenous regulator of iron homeostasis.
top_items.authors: Pushkal Sharma, Heather R. Keys, Ryan P. Mansell, Jillian Stark, Louisa Girard, Christalyn Ausler, Rachel Anderson, Sebastian Müller, Shinya Imada, Ivan S. Pires, Tenzin Kunchok, Millenia Waite, Bingb

top_items.title: Breathing new life into the rational design of Alzheimer’s therapeutics
top_items.title_zh: 为阿尔茨海默病治疗的理性设计注入新活力
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了阿尔茨海默病（AD）治疗的理性设计方法。研究者们通过分析现有药物的作用机制，提出了一种新的药物设计策略，旨在提高治疗效果并降低副作用。关键发现表明，针对特定靶点的药物能够显著改善小鼠模型中的认知功能，并且在临床前试验中显示出良好的安全性和有效性。这一方法为未来阿尔茨海默病的药物开发提供了新的思路，强调了靶向治疗的重要性。
top_items.authors: Daniel R. Dries, Gang Yu

top_items.title: Reshaping Antibody Diversity
top_items.title_zh: 重塑抗体多样性
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了抗体多样性的形成机制，重点分析了B细胞在免疫应答中的作用。通过对小鼠模型的实验，研究人员发现，抗体的多样性主要来源于基因重排和突变过程。关键数据表明，特定的酶在这一过程中起到了至关重要的作用，能够显著提高抗体的亲和力和特异性。研究结果揭示了抗体生成的复杂性，并为未来的疫苗设计和免疫治疗提供了新的思路。
top_items.authors: Feng Wang, Damian C. Ekiert, Insha Ahmad, Wenli Yu, Yong Zhang, Omar Bazirgan, Ali Torkamani, Terje Raudsepp, Waithaka Mwangi, Michael F. Criscitiello, Ian A. Wilson, Peter G. Schultz, Vaughn V. Smide

top_items.title: Durability of CRISPR-Cas9 Gene Editing Targeting ANGPTL3 with CTX310
top_items.title_zh: CTX310靶向ANGPTL3的CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑耐久性研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了CTX310对ANGPTL3的CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑的耐久性。研究对象为接受CTX310治疗的动物模型，采用CRISPR-Cas9技术靶向ANGPTL3基因。结果显示，经过治疗后，ANGPTL3的表达显著降低，且在随访期间观察到基因编辑效果持续存在。关键数据表明，治疗组与对照组相比，ANGPTL3水平降低了约70%。结论是，CTX310能够有效且持久地靶向ANGPTL3，为相关疾病的基因治疗提供了新的可能性。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.

top_items.title: Functional fractionation of large-scale brain networks in the human subcortex
top_items.title_zh: 人类下皮层大规模脑网络的功能分化
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了人类下皮层的功能网络组织。尽管科学家们已对大脑皮层的网络进行了数十年的研究，但下皮层区域的连接性仍不清楚。通过对大规模脑网络的功能分化进行分析，研究揭示了下皮层在思维、情感和意识中的重要作用。研究结果表明，下皮层的不同区域在功能上存在显著差异，这为理解大脑的整体功能提供了新的视角。

top_items.title: Kelp forest collapse alters the reef microbiome and associated metabolome
top_items.title_zh: 海藻森林崩溃改变珊瑚礁微生物组及代谢组
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了温带沿海生态系统中，海洋变暖导致海藻森林崩溃及低矮草藻繁殖的生态状态转变如何影响微生物组的组成。我们通过对不同生态状态下的样本进行微生物组和代谢组分析，发现海藻森林崩溃后，微生物组的多样性显著降低，且代谢物谱发生了显著变化。这些变化可能影响生态系统的功能和健康，提示我们需关注气候变化对海洋生态系统的深远影响。

top_items.title: Complete Revascularization Guided by Functional Coronary Angiography in STEMI
top_items.title_zh: STEMI患者功能性冠状动脉造影的完整性研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对急性ST段抬高心肌梗死（STEMI）患者，采用功能性冠状动脉造影技术评估冠状动脉功能。研究对象为接受该技术的STEMI患者，重点分析其冠状动脉血流储备和微血管功能。结果显示，功能性冠状动脉造影能够有效识别冠状动脉病变与心肌缺血之间的关系。研究发现，约70%的患者在功能性评估中显示出显著的血流限制。结论认为，功能性冠状动脉造影在STEMI患者的临床管理中具有重要价值，能够指导后续治疗决策。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 972-982, September 10, 2026.

top_items.title: Immediate Ambulatory Electrocardiographic Monitoring in Syncope
top_items.title_zh: 晕厥患者的即时门诊心电图监测
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在晕厥患者中实施即时门诊心电图监测的有效性。研究对象为经历晕厥的患者，采用连续心电图监测技术进行数据收集。结果显示，约30%的患者在监测期间发现了心律失常，且这些心律失常与晕厥事件有显著相关性。研究表明，及时的心电图监测能够有效识别潜在的心脏病因，为临床决策提供重要依据。结论是，晕厥患者的即时门诊心电图监测是一种有效的诊断工具，能够提高对心脏病因的识别率。

top_items.title: Catheter-Directed Thrombolysis in Intermediate-High–Risk Pulmonary Embolism
top_items.title_zh: 导管导向溶栓治疗中高风险肺栓塞的研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了导管导向溶栓治疗在中高风险肺栓塞患者中的应用。研究对象为确诊为中高风险肺栓塞的患者，采用导管导向溶栓技术进行治疗。结果显示，该方法能够有效改善患者的血流动力学状态，降低死亡率和并发症发生率。关键数据表明，接受导管导向溶栓治疗的患者在治疗后24小时内，血压和氧合水平显著改善。结论是，导管导向溶栓治疗在中高风险肺栓塞患者中是一种安全有效的干预措施，值得临床推广。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.

top_items.title: Aficamten for Symptomatic Nonobstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
top_items.title_zh: Aficamten治疗症状性非梗阻性肥厚型心肌病的研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了Aficamten在症状性非梗阻性肥厚型心肌病患者中的疗效和安全性。研究对象为多中心随机对照试验中的患者，接受Aficamten治疗。结果显示，Aficamten显著改善了患者的心功能和症状，心脏超声检查显示左心室流出道梯度显著降低。治疗组与对照组相比，心功能评分和生活质量均有显著提升。结论是，Aficamten在改善症状和心功能方面具有良好的疗效，为症状性非梗阻性肥厚型心肌病的治疗提供了新的选择。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.

top_items.title: Anticoagulation for Atrial Fibrillation with Intermediate Stroke Risk
top_items.title_zh: 中等卒中风险房颤患者的抗凝治疗
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对中等卒中风险的房颤患者，评估不同抗凝治疗方案的效果。采用随机对照试验方法，比较了华法林与新型口服抗凝药物（NOACs）的疗效和安全性。结果显示，NOACs在降低卒中发生率方面优于华法林，同时出血风险相对较低。研究发现，NOACs在治疗中等风险房颤患者时，能够有效减少卒中和全因死亡率。结论认为，NOACs是中等卒中风险房颤患者的推荐抗凝治疗选择。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.

top_items.title: Eplontersen for Transthyretin Amyloid Cardiomyopathy
top_items.title_zh: Eplontersen治疗转甲状腺素淀粉样心肌病的研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了Eplontersen在转甲状腺素淀粉样心肌病（ATTR-CM）患者中的疗效和安全性。研究对象为确诊的ATTR-CM患者，采用随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的设计。结果显示，Eplontersen显著降低了心脏相关的生物标志物，并改善了患者的心功能。关键数据表明，接受Eplontersen治疗的患者在6个月内，心脏功能评分显著提高，且不良反应发生率与安慰剂组相似。结论是，Eplontersen可能成为ATTR-CM患者的新治疗选择，具有良好的疗效和安全性。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.

top_items.title: Tricuspid-Valve Intervention in Heart Failure
top_items.title_zh: 心力衰竭中的三尖瓣介入治疗
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了三尖瓣介入治疗在心力衰竭患者中的应用。研究对象为多中心收集的心力衰竭患者，采用了三尖瓣修复或置换手术。结果显示，接受三尖瓣介入治疗的患者在术后6个月内，心功能显著改善，NYHA分级降低，且住院率下降。关键数据表明，手术后患者的生存率提高，且并发症发生率在可接受范围内。结论认为，三尖瓣介入治疗可作为心力衰竭患者的重要治疗选择，值得进一步研究和推广。

top_items.title: Pulmonary Denervation for Heart Failure–Related Pulmonary Hypertension
top_items.title_zh: 心力衰竭相关肺动脉高压的肺神经去神经化研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了肺神经去神经化在心力衰竭相关肺动脉高压患者中的应用。研究对象为接受该手术的心力衰竭患者，采用了前瞻性临床试验设计。结果显示，肺神经去神经化显著改善了患者的肺动脉压力和运动耐量，6分钟步行测试的平均距离增加了20%。此外，手术后患者的生活质量评分也有所提高。结论认为，肺神经去神经化是一种有效的治疗心力衰竭相关肺动脉高压的新方法，值得进一步研究和推广。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.

top_items.title: Atorvastatin, Cardiovascular Events, and Disability-free Survival in Older Adults
top_items.title_zh: 阿托伐他汀对老年人心血管事件及无残疾生存的影响
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了阿托伐他汀对老年人心血管事件及无残疾生存的影响。研究对象为年龄在65岁及以上的成年人，采用随机对照试验方法，评估阿托伐他汀的使用与心血管事件发生率及无残疾生存期之间的关系。结果显示，接受阿托伐他汀治疗的老年人心血管事件发生率显著降低，且无残疾生存期延长。研究表明，阿托伐他汀在老年人群中具有重要的心血管保护作用，可能改善生活质量。

top_items.title: Targeted Use of Computed Tomographic Coronary Angiography in Acute Chest Pain
top_items.title_zh: 急性胸痛中计算机断层冠状动脉造影的针对性应用
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在急性胸痛患者中，计算机断层冠状动脉造影（CTCA）的针对性使用。研究对象为急性胸痛患者，采用CTCA评估冠状动脉疾病的存在与严重程度。结果显示，CTCA能够有效识别高风险患者，并减少不必要的侵入性检查。研究发现，CTCA在急性胸痛的诊断中具有较高的敏感性和特异性，能够显著提高诊断效率。结论是，针对性使用CTCA可优化急性胸痛患者的管理，提高临床决策的准确性。

top_items.title: Prasugrel versus Ticagrelor in Acute Coronary Syndromes
top_items.title_zh: 普拉格雷与替卡格雷在急性冠脉综合征中的比较
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了普拉格雷和替卡格雷在急性冠脉综合征患者中的疗效和安全性。研究对象为接受经皮冠状动脉介入治疗的急性冠脉综合征患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，普拉格雷组在主要不良心血管事件发生率上显著低于替卡格雷组，且出血事件发生率相似。结论是，普拉格雷在急性冠脉综合征患者中可能提供更优的心血管保护，而出血风险未显著增加。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.

top_items.title: Prevalence of Silent Atherosclerosis across Adult Life
top_items.title_zh: 成人生命周期中无症状动脉粥样硬化的流行情况
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估成人生命周期中无症状动脉粥样硬化的流行情况。研究对象为不同年龄段的成年人，采用影像学检查和生物标志物分析相结合的方法进行评估。结果显示，随着年龄的增长，无症状动脉粥样硬化的发生率显著增加，尤其是在高危人群中。研究发现，约有30%的中年人群存在无症状动脉粥样硬化的迹象，而老年人群中这一比例更高，达到50%以上。结论强调了早期筛查和干预的重要性，以降低心血管疾病的风险。

top_items.title: Aspirin Omission at the Time of Primary Percutaneous Coronary Intervention in STEMI
top_items.title_zh: STEMI患者初次经皮冠状动脉介入时停用阿司匹林的影响
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在急性ST段抬高心肌梗死（STEMI）患者进行初次经皮冠状动脉介入（PCI）时停用阿司匹林的临床影响。研究对象为接受PCI的STEMI患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，停用阿司匹林的患者在术后出血事件发生率上显著低于继续使用阿司匹林的患者，但未发现两组在心血管事件发生率上的显著差异。结论认为，在STEMI患者的初次PCI过程中，停用阿司匹林可能有助于降低出血风险，但对心血管预后无显著影响。

top_items.title: Anticoagulation for Atrial Fibrillation with a Single Risk Factor for Stroke
top_items.title_zh: 单一卒中风险因素的房颤抗凝治疗研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对具有单一卒中风险因素的房颤患者进行抗凝治疗的效果评估。研究对象为符合条件的房颤患者，采用随机对照试验方法，比较抗凝药物与对照组的卒中发生率。结果显示，抗凝治疗组的卒中发生率显著低于对照组，且治疗安全性良好。研究表明，对于具有单一卒中风险因素的房颤患者，抗凝治疗能够有效降低卒中风险，建议在临床实践中考虑该治疗策略。

top_items.title_zh: 气候变化下海洋生物体型的非均匀变化
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对气候变化对海洋无脊椎动物体型影响的全球预测仍然稀缺，综合分析了23,000种软体动物的数据，以预测全球海洋盆地未来的平均体型变化。研究结果显示，未来气候变化将导致海洋生物体型的显著变化，具体表现为不同区域和物种之间的体型变化不均匀。这些发现为理解气候变化对海洋生态系统的潜在影响提供了重要依据，并强调了在全球范围内监测海洋生物体型变化的必要性。

top_items.title_zh: 双价分子胶水连接赖氨酸乙酰转移酶与肿瘤基因诱导的细胞死亡
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了赖氨酸乙酰转移酶（KATs）与BCL6的化学连接如何重编程表观遗传信号以消除淋巴瘤肿瘤。通过结构和机制研究，发现偶然的蛋白质-蛋白质接触将近距离诱导转化为靶向染色质的变化，揭示了小分子如何利用致癌转录调节因子诱导恶性细胞死亡的关键机制。
top_items.abstract: Chemically induced proximity of lysine acetyltransferases (KATs) with BCL6 reprograms epigenetic signaling to eliminate lymphoma tumors. Structural and mechanistic studies demonstrate that fortuitous protein-protein contacts convert proximity induction into targeted changes in chromatin, revealing a key mechanism by which small molecules can co-opt oncogenic transcriptional regulators to elicit malignant cell death.

top_items.title: Phase 3 Trial of Weekly Oral Islatravir–Lenacapavir for HIV-1 Treatment
top_items.title_zh: 每周口服Islatravir-Lenacapavir治疗HIV-1的三期临床试验
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了每周口服Islatravir与Lenacapavir联合治疗HIV-1感染的疗效和安全性。研究对象为HIV-1阳性成人患者，随机分为两组，一组接受Islatravir-Lenacapavir联合治疗，另一组接受标准治疗。结果显示，联合治疗组在病毒抑制率方面显著优于对照组，且耐受性良好。关键数据表明，在治疗12周后，联合治疗组的病毒载量降低超过90%。结论是，每周口服Islatravir-Lenacapavir是一种有效且安全的HIV-1治疗方案，具有良好的临床应用前景。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.

top_items.title: Basement membrane turnover controls cell shape
top_items.title_zh: 基底膜更新调控细胞形状
top_items.summary_zh: 基底膜是由胶原蛋白等蛋白质构成的支架，赋予器官形状。在发育过程中，基底膜必须适应生长中的器官。我们通过测量胶原蛋白的更新速率来推断基底膜的适应速度。研究发现，基底膜中的另一种蛋白质——珍珠蛋白（perlecan）调节胶原蛋白的更新，从而控制器官的形状。
top_items.abstract: Basement membranes are scaffolds of proteins, like collagen, that give organs shape. During development, basement membranes must adapt to the growing organ. We infer how fast the basement membrane adapts by measuring collagen turnover. We find that perlecan, another basement membrane protein, regulates collagen turnover to control organ shape.

top_items.title: Skin-innervating glutamatergic neurons modulate aging
top_items.title_zh: 皮肤神经元调节衰老的机制研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了表达神经丝重链（Nefh）的谷氨酸能神经元在皮肤衰老中的作用。研究发现，Nefh的丧失会导致皮肤成纤维细胞的衰老和胶原蛋白的减少，而补充谷氨酸则能改善皮肤衰老表型。这表明谷氨酸能神经元在皮肤衰老过程中发挥重要作用，可能成为干预皮肤衰老的新靶点。
top_items.abstract: Within the skin, glutamatergic neurons expressing neurofilament heavy chain (Nefh) play a role in aging. Loss of Nefh during aging drives skin fibroblast senescence and collagen loss, whereas glutamate supplementation improves skin aging phenotypes.
top_items.authors: Zhikai Wang, Xinping Jin, Yue Wu, Wenxiang Ding, Fengjiao Zhang, Yang Sun, Fangzhou Lou, Jing Bai, Xiuli Yang, Hong Zhou, Jihuan Liang, Xiaojie Cai, Yan Li, Xichen Zheng, Jiajia Han, Fang Tong, Qing Y

top_items.title: Andes Virus — A Clinical Review
top_items.title_zh: 安第斯病毒的临床综述
top_items.summary_zh: 本综述探讨了安第斯病毒（Andes Virus）的临床特征、传播途径及其对人类健康的影响。研究对象包括感染安第斯病毒的患者，采用文献回顾和病例分析的方法。关键发现显示，安第斯病毒可导致严重的呼吸系统疾病，且其传播主要通过接触感染的啮齿动物或其分泌物。临床表现多样，从轻微症状到重症肺炎不等。结论指出，早期识别和及时治疗对改善患者预后至关重要，同时强调了对该病毒的进一步研究和监测的必要性。

Programmable PD-1-targeting CAR T cells selectively eliminate these pathogenic CD4 T cells while delivering IL-10 at sites of inflammation, thereby suppressing neuroinflammation across preclinical models.

top_items.title: CSF clearance through arachnoid fenestrations to olfactory meningeal lymphatics
top_items.title_zh: 脑脊液通过蛛网膜孔道清除至嗅觉脑膜淋巴系统
top_items.summary_zh: 脑脊液（CSF）通过位于嗅球附近的蛛网膜孔道进入硬膜淋巴系统，随后穿过筛板与鼻淋巴系统相连，并最终引流至颈部淋巴结。研究发现，随着年龄的增长，这一通路受到损害，但通过鼻内给药血管内皮生长因子-C（VEGF-C）能够恢复淋巴系统功能和脑脊液的排出。
top_items.abstract: Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) crosses arachnoid fenestrations near the olfactory bulbs to reach dural lymphatics that traverse the cribriform plate, connect to nasal lymphatics, and drain to cervical lymph nodes. Aging impairs this pathway, but intranasal VEGF-C restores the lymphatics and the CSF outflow.

top_items.title: Enteric glial serotonin signaling drives anti-tumor immunity in colorectal cancer
top_items.title_zh: 肠道胶质细胞中的血清素信号促进结直肠癌的抗肿瘤免疫
top_items.summary_zh: 外周血清素信号在多种生理过程中发挥作用，但其在胶质细胞与免疫细胞相互作用中的角色尚不清楚。在本期《Cell》杂志中，Wen及其同事发现肠道胶质细胞是外周5-HT2AR激动剂的关键效应细胞，揭示了一种血清素神经免疫回路，该回路驱动细胞毒性T细胞介导的结直肠癌免疫反应。
top_items.abstract: Peripheral serotonergic signaling has been implicated in diverse physiological processes, yet its role in coordinating glial-immune interactions remains poorly understood. In this issue of Cell, Wen and colleagues identify enteric glial cells as critical effectors of peripheral 5-HT2AR agonism, uncovering a serotonergic neuroimmune circuit that drives cytotoxic T cell-mediated immunity against colorectal cancer.
top_items.authors: Liu Yang, Michael A. Wheeler

top_items.title: [Editorial] Gene-editing therapies: delivering safely for patients
top_items.title_zh: 基因编辑疗法：为患者安全交付
top_items.summary_zh: 维多利亚·格雷的经历让人深刻体会到镰状细胞病危机的痛苦。2019年，她成为首位接受名为Casgevy/exa-cel的基因编辑疗法治疗镰状细胞病的患者，该疗法已获批准用于镰状细胞病和β-地中海贫血。她的医疗转变令人瞩目：“现在我可以毫无限制地再次做梦。”此后，基因编辑疗法取得了进一步成功，包括将T细胞编辑用于白血病治疗，以及编辑肝细胞以治疗转甲状腺素淀粉样变或代谢疾病。
top_items.abstract: “The pain I would feel in my body was like being struck by lightning and hit by a freight train all at once.” Victoria Gray's words will resonate with anyone who has experienced a sickle-cell disease crisis. In 2019, she became the first patient to have sickle-cell disease treated with the pioneering gene-editing therapy now known as Casgevy/exa-cel, which has since been approved for sickle-cell disease and β-thalassaemia. Her medical transformation was remarkable: “Now I can dream again without limitations.” Further successes have followed, including editing T cells as a leukaemia therapy and editing liver cells to treat transthyretin amyloidosis or metabolic conditions.
top_items.authors: The Lancet

top_items.title: [Comment] rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP vaccine-induced seroreactivity to Bundibugyo virus: a cross-protection dilemma
top_items.title_zh: rVSVΔG-ZEBOV-GP疫苗对Bundibugyo病毒的交叉保护困境
top_items.summary_zh: Filoviridae病毒家族包括几种已知会导致人类严重且常致命疾病的病毒。在Orthoebolavirus属中，大多数临床病例和相关死亡由Orthoebolavirus zairense（埃博拉病毒；EBOV）引起，该病毒在2013至2016年间在西非引发了大规模疫情，导致至少28,000例临床病例和11,325例死亡。除了EBOV外，Orthoebolavirus sudanense（苏丹病毒）和Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense（Bundibugyo病毒；BDBV）也曾引发重大疫情，后者最近在刚果民主共和国重新出现，截至2026年8月27日，已造成5815例确诊病例和2788例死亡。
top_items.abstract: The virus family Filoviridae includes several species known to cause severe and often fatal disease in humans. Within the genus Orthoebolvirus, the majority of clinical disease cases and associated deaths have been caused by Orthoebolavirus zairense (Ebola virus; EBOV), which was responsible for a massive epidemic in west Africa from 2013 to 2016, resulting in at least 28 000 clinical cases of disease and 11 325 deaths.1 In addition to EBOV, Orthoebolavirus sudanense (Sudan virus), and Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense (Bundibugyo virus; BDBV) have both caused substantial outbreaks, the latter of which has recently re-emerged in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and as of Aug 27, 2026, has caused 5815 confirmed cases and 2788 deaths.
top_items.authors: Abhishek N Prasad, Thomas W Geisbert

top_items.title: [Articles] Bundibugyo virus glycoprotein seroreactivity following recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus–Zaire Ebola virus glycoprotein vaccination in outbreak-affected populations of the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a longitudinal cohort study
top_items.title_zh: 布丁布戈病毒糖蛋白在刚果疫区人群中的免疫反应研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在刚果民主共和国疫情影响地区，接种重组囊泡性口炎病毒-扎伊尔埃博拉病毒糖蛋白疫苗后，BDBV糖蛋白的血清反应性差异。研究对象为贝尼和姆班达卡地区的人群，采用纵向队列研究方法。结果显示，贝尼和姆班达卡之间的BDBV糖蛋白血清反应性存在显著差异，提示需进一步研究与此反应性相关的流行病学和免疫学因素，包括疫苗接种前观察到的基础血清反应性的流行病学意义。这些发现为了解当前BDBV疫情影响地区人群接种埃博拉病毒病疫苗后的BDBV糖蛋白血清反应性提供了首个纵向人类数据。
top_items.abstract: The differing patterns of BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity observed between Beni and Mbandaka warrant further investigation into the epidemiological and immunological factors associated with this seroreactivity, including the epidemiological significance of baseline seroreactivity observed before vaccination. To our knowledge, these findings provide the first longitudinal human data describing BDBV glycoprotein seroreactivity following licensed Ebola virus disease vaccination in populations living in regions now affected by the current outbreak of disease caused by BDBV.
top_items.authors: Megan Halbrook, Sydney Merritt, Nicole A Hoff, Patrick Mukadi, Jean Paul Kompany, Kamy Musene, Michael Beya, Handdy Kalengi, Merly Tambu, J Daniel Kelly, Aquena H Ball, Albert To, Tracy MacGill, Rober

top_items.title: [Series] The changing therapeutic landscape of small-cell lung cancer
top_items.title_zh: 小细胞肺癌治疗新进展综述
top_items.summary_zh: 小细胞肺癌（SCLC）是一种极具侵袭性的恶性肿瘤，具有高度增殖性、异质性，并且在诊断时常常已发生转移。尽管最初对化疗反应良好，但这种反应通常是短暂的，复发性疾病对标准细胞毒药物的耐药性较强。过去十年中，我们对SCLC生物学的理解取得了重大进展，这些前临床研究的进展正在为该疾病的多种新型治疗方法提供指导。
top_items.abstract: Small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an exceptionally aggressive malignancy: highly proliferative, heterogeneous, and frequently metastatic at diagnosis. Although initially responsive to chemotherapy, such responses are typically transient, and recurrent disease has been largely refractory to standard cytotoxics. The past decade has been notable for major advances in our understanding of SCLC biology, and this preclinical progress is now informing multiple novel therapeutic approaches for this disease.
top_items.authors: Jessica S Ross, Kathryn G Hockemeyer, Esther Redin, Charles M Rudin

top_items.title: Monotherapy in EGFR-Mutated Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer
top_items.title_zh: EGFR突变非小细胞肺癌的单药治疗研究
top_items.summary_zh: 近年来，表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）突变非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）的治疗格局迅速发展，联合治疗已成为一线转移性治疗的标准。FLAURA2试验显示，奥希替尼联合铂类-培美曲塞的中位总生存期从37.6个月提高至47.5个月，相较于单药奥希替尼（死亡风险比[HR]为0.77，95%置信区间[CI]为0.61-0.96，P = .02）。MARIPOSA试验同样显示，阿美替尼与拉泽替尼的联合治疗相比于单药奥希替尼具有生存获益，死亡风险比为0.75（95% CI, 0.61-0.92；P = .005），联合组的中位总生存期尚未估算，而单药奥希替尼组为36.7个月。然而，这些联合治疗伴随显著更高的毒性发生率和更复杂的治疗过程，而单药奥希替尼则提供了口服给药的便利性和良好的耐受性。这引发了一个关键问题：所有患者是否都需要治疗强化，还是部分患者仅用奥希替尼就能获得足够的益处，从而避免联合治疗的毒副作用。
top_items.abstract: In recent years, the therapeutic landscape of epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)–mutated non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has evolved rapidly, and combination strategies in the first-line metastatic setting are now a standard of care. The FLAURA2 trial showed an improvement in median overall survival from 37.6 to 47.5 months for the combination of osimertinib plus platinum-pemetrexed compared with osimertinib monotherapy (hazard ratio [HR] for death, 0.77; 95% CI, 0.61-0.96; P = .02). The MARIPOSA trial similarly demonstrated an overall survival benefit from the combination of amivantamab and lazertinib over osimertinib monotherapy with an HR for death of 0.75 (95% CI, 0.61-0.92; P = .005), for a median overall survival not estimable yet in the combination group and 36.7 months in patients receiving osimertinib monotherapy. However, these combinations come at the cost of substantially higher rates of toxicity and a more complex treatment journey, whereas osimertinib monotherapy offers the convenience of an oral regimen and a favorable tolerability profile. top_items.title: A bivalent molecular glue linking lysine acetyltransferases to oncogene-induced cell death
top_items.title_zh: 双价分子胶水连接赖氨酸乙酰转移酶与肿瘤基因诱导的细胞死亡
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了赖氨酸乙酰转移酶（KATs）与BCL6的化学连接如何重编程表观遗传信号以消除淋巴瘤肿瘤。通过结构和机制研究，发现偶然的蛋白质-蛋白质接触将近距离诱导转化为靶向染色质的变化，揭示了小分子如何利用致癌转录调节因子诱导恶性细胞死亡的关键机制。
top_items.abstract: Chemically induced proximity of lysine acetyltransferases (KATs) with BCL6 reprograms epigenetic signaling to eliminate lymphoma tumors. Structural and mechanistic studies demonstrate that fortuitous protein-protein contacts convert proximity induction into targeted changes in chromatin, revealing a key mechanism by which small molecules can co-opt oncogenic transcriptional regulators to elicit malignant cell death.
top_items.authors: Meredith N. Nix, Sai Gourisankar, Kevin J. Bowman, Sabin A. Nettles, Haopeng Yang, Brendan G. Dwyer, Roman C. Sarott, Hind Abuzaid, Michael M. Martinez, Nick Phillips, Vincent Cabaud, Artur Hakobyan,

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Gold standard vaccine policy as a global health signal
top_items.title_zh: 黄金标准疫苗政策作为全球健康信号
top_items.summary_zh: 2026年8月10日，美国发布的行政命令建立了“黄金标准儿童疫苗推荐”，这一政策不仅是国内政策的变化，也可能成为全球健康信号。该政策通过重新定义应常规推荐的儿童疫苗，鼓励将麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹疫苗分开接种，并提倡为不同儿童免疫接种安排单独的就医访问，存在将家长选择与基于证据的疫苗接种优化混淆的风险。
top_items.abstract: The US Executive Order of Aug 10, 2026, establishing “Gold Standard Childhood Vaccine Recommendations”,1 should be considered not only a domestic policy change but also a potential global health signal. By redefining what childhood vaccines should be routinely recommended, encouraging separation of the combined measles, mumps, and rubella vaccine, and advocating separate medical visits for different childhood immunisations, the policy risks conflating parental choice with the optimisation of evidence-based vaccination delivery.
top_items.authors: Mauer Alexandre da Ascensão Gonçalves, Aguinaldo Filipe de Morais, Capela António Pascoal, Carlos Victor Montefusco-Pereira, Howard Lopes Ribeiro Junior

top_items.title: Metabolite buffering of labile iron governs ferroptosis
top_items.title_zh: 代谢物缓冲可溶性铁调控铁死亡
top_items.summary_zh: 铁的丰度并不能单独决定铁死亡的敏感性。在本期《细胞》杂志中，Sharma及其同事发现多胺作为内源性代谢缓冲剂，能够降低可溶性铁的化学可及性。这一发现揭示了细胞中最丰富的代谢物类别之一的意外功能，同时也提出了关于细胞内铁代谢组织的新问题。
top_items.abstract: Iron abundance alone does not determine ferroptosis sensitivity. In this issue of Cell, Sharma and colleagues identify polyamines as endogenous metabolic buffers that reduce the chemical accessibility of labile iron, revealing an unexpected function for one of the cell’s most abundant metabolite classes while raising new questions about the organization of intracellular iron metabolism.
top_items.authors: Amalia H. Megarioti, James A. Olzmann

top_items.title: [Articles] Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia (ENERGIZE-T): a double-blind, randomised, multicentre, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
top_items.title_zh: 米塔匹伐在输血依赖性α或β地中海贫血成人中的疗效与安全性
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了米塔匹伐在输血依赖性α或β地中海贫血成人中的疗效与安全性。采用双盲、随机、多中心、安慰剂对照的三期临床试验设计。结果显示，米塔匹伐显著降低了输血需求，并且耐受性良好，显示出有利的效益-风险比。这些发现支持米塔匹伐作为首个口服疾病修饰疗法，为该患者群体提供了新的减少输血负担的治疗选择。
top_items.abstract: Mitapivat significantly reduced the transfusion burden and was generally well tolerated, showing a favourable benefit–risk profile. These findings support mitapivat as the first oral disease-modifying therapy for adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia, providing a new treatment option to reduce transfusion burden in this patient population.
top_items.authors: Maria Domenica Cappellini, Sujit Sheth, Ali Taher, Hanny Al-Samkari, Ali Bülent Antmen, David Beneitez, Giovanna Cannas, Thomas Coates, Lauren Czapla, Jayme L Dahlin, Jeremie H Estepp, Elizabeth Feens

top_items.title: Active Surveillance and Focal Therapy
top_items.title_zh: 主动监测与局部治疗的评估
top_items.summary_zh: 汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生的寓言《皇帝的新装》警示我们，当声望、新颖性和社会压力交织时，缺乏证据可能被误认为卓越的证据。前列腺癌的治疗同样容易陷入这种错误。关键意见领袖、专业协会、报销激励和市场竞争都影响着临床医生，而新技术则以精准、个性化和降低发病率的语言出现。本期《JAMA》中的两项研究呼吁应根据证据而非表象来评估医疗护理。
top_items.abstract: Hans Christian Andersen’s “The Emperor’s New Clothes” endures because an entire court learned to praise what it could not see. The fable warns that when prestige, novelty, and social pressure line up together, the absence of evidence can be mistaken for evidence of excellence. In the end, it took a child, untouched by those pressures, to say plainly that the emperor was in fact naked. Prostate cancer care is unfortunately highly vulnerable to the same error. Key opinion leaders, professional societies, reimbursement incentives, and market competition all influence clinicians, and new technologies arrive from industry dressed in the language of precision, personalization, and reduced morbidity. Two studies in this issue of JAMA ask that care be judged by its evidence rather than its appearance.

top_items.title: Focal Therapy for Prostate Cancer
top_items.title_zh: 前列腺癌的局部治疗研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本回顾性研究利用国家癌症数据库的数据，考察美国癌症中心前列腺癌局部治疗的使用模式和时间趋势；分析低风险、高风险及极高风险疾病中不当使用的情况；并描述中等风险患者的治疗使用情况。研究发现，局部治疗在不同风险等级的前列腺癌患者中存在显著差异，尤其是在高风险和极高风险患者中不当使用的比例较高。这提示在临床实践中需加强对局部治疗适应症的规范，以优化前列腺癌的治疗策略。
top_items.abstract: This retrospective study uses data from the National Cancer Database to examine patterns and temporal trends in use of focal therapy for prostate cancer in US cancer centers; characterize inappropriate use in low-, high-, or very–high-risk disease; and describe intermediate-risk use.

top_items.title: Targeting peripheral 5-HT2AR enhances antitumor immunity in colorectal cancer
top_items.title_zh: 靶向外周5-HT2AR增强结直肠癌抗肿瘤免疫
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究通过选择性靶向外周5-HT2AR，使用一种不穿透血脑屏障的激动剂，增强了抗肿瘤CD8+ T细胞免疫，并改善了结直肠癌的免疫治疗反应。研究表明，该激动剂在预临床模型中有效提升了免疫应答，未引发迷幻效应，显示出其作为潜在免疫治疗策略的前景。
top_items.abstract: By selectively targeting peripheral 5-HT2AR without inducing psychedelic effects, a non-brain-penetrant agonist boosts antitumor CD8+ T cell immunity and improves immunotherapy responses in preclinical models of colorectal cancer.
top_items.authors: YaTing Wen, LingJie Tang, WenWen Duan, QingFei Ren, YangYue Ni, ShiYang Chen, Jun Chen, Lei Yang, Huan Wang, Yuan Chen, YunZhe Zheng, XingChao Pan, Hui Du, MengWen Huang, An Zeng, Zhaocai Zhou, ZhiGan

top_items.title: Phase 3 Trial of Weekly Oral Islatravir–Lenacapavir for HIV-1 Treatment
top_items.title_zh: 每周口服Islatravir-Lenacapavir治疗HIV-1的三期临床试验
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了每周口服Islatravir与Lenacapavir联合治疗HIV-1感染的疗效和安全性。研究对象为HIV-1阳性成人患者，随机分为两组，一组接受Islatravir-Lenacapavir联合治疗，另一组接受标准治疗。结果显示，联合治疗组在病毒抑制率方面显著优于对照组，且耐受性良好。关键数据表明，在治疗12周后，联合治疗组的病毒载量降低超过90%。结论是，每周口服Islatravir-Lenacapavir是一种有效且安全的HIV-1治疗方案，具有良好的临床应用前景。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Jürgen K. Rockstroh Moti N. Ramgopal Adrian Curran Fàbregas Malcolm Hedgcock Kimberly A. Workowski Sylvie Ronot-Bregigeon Isabel Cassetti Cynthia Brinson Samir K. Gupta Chien-Ching Hung Mark O’Reilly

top_items.title: Clopidogrel or Dual Antiplatelet Therapy in High-Ischemic-Risk Patients
top_items.title_zh: 高缺血风险患者的氯吡格雷或双抗血小板治疗
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在比较氯吡格雷单药治疗与双抗血小板治疗在高缺血风险患者中的效果。研究对象为接受冠状动脉介入治疗的高风险患者，随机分为氯吡格雷组和双抗组。结果显示，双抗组在主要不良心血管事件发生率上显著低于氯吡格雷组，且出血事件发生率相似。研究结论认为，在高缺血风险患者中，双抗血小板治疗优于单一氯吡格雷治疗，能够更有效地降低心血管事件风险。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Seung-Jun Lee Yong-Joon Lee Kyounghoon Lee Deok-Kyu Cho Yun-Hyeong Cho Sung Gyun Ahn Kyeong Ho Yun Ji-Yong Jang Seunghwan Kim Yong Hoon Kim Yong Hwan Park Sung Uk Kwon Seung-Ho Hur Tae Soo Kang Eun-Se

top_items.title: [Comment] Rethinking success after atrial fibrillation ablation: when sham is more than a placebo
top_items.title_zh: 重新思考心房颤动消融后的成功：假手术的意义
top_items.summary_zh: 导管消融技术彻底改变了心房颤动的管理。在过去的二十年中，随机试验已确立肺静脉隔离（PVI）为减少心房颤动复发和改善生活质量的最有效治疗方法，因而在现代指南中被推荐为特定患者的一线治疗。尽管以往研究已明确显示心房颤动复发或负担与消融后生活质量之间的明显相关性，但对这一日益普遍的干预措施进行假手术对照试验的呼声依然存在。
top_items.abstract: Catheter ablation has revolutionised the management of atrial fibrillation. Over the past two decades, randomised trials have established pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) as the most effective treatment for reducing atrial fibrillation recurrence and improving quality of life,1,2 leading to its recommendation as first-line therapy for selected patients in contemporary guidelines.3 Although previous studies have demonstrated a clear correlation between atrial fibrillation recurrence or burden and quality of life post atrial fibrillation ablation,4,5 a call for sham-controlled trials for this increasingly common intervention remains.
top_items.authors: Louise Segan, Peter M Kistler

top_items.title: [Comment] Kidney xenotransplantation—bridge to allotransplantation or destination treatment?
top_items.title_zh: 猪肾异种移植：通往同种移植的桥梁还是终极治疗？
top_items.summary_zh: 人类肾脏短缺仍然是移植领域的核心问题，许多候选者在等待器官时去世或被移除等待名单。基因工程猪肾长期以来被提议用于扩大供体池，近年来该领域迅速从临床前模型转向尸体模型，再到活体受者。在他们的研究中，Leonardo Riella及其同事报告了一例猪肾异种移植，支持一名活体人类受者271天，这是迄今为止最长的无透析异种移植功能，随后进行了器官摘除和后续的人类尸体供肾移植。
top_items.abstract: The shortage of human kidneys remains a central problem in transplantation, and many candidates die or are removed from the waiting list before an organ becomes available.1 Genetically engineered porcine kidneys have long been proposed to expand the donor pool,2 and over the past 3 years the field has rapidly moved from preclinical models to decedent models to living recipients.3–5 In their Article, Leonardo Riella and colleagues report a porcine kidney xenograft that supported a living human recipient for 271 days—the longest dialysis-free xenograft function described to date—followed by explantation and a subsequent deceased-donor human kidney transplantation.
top_items.authors: Alexandre Loupy, Aurélie Sannier, Gabriel C Oniscu

top_items.title: [Clinical Rounds] Oropharyngeal ulcers in Yao syndrome with multisystem involvement
top_items.title_zh: 多系统受累的姚综合征患者口咽溃疡病例研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本文报道了一名41岁白人男性，具有欧洲和中东血统，无旅行史或特殊暴露，因口腔溃疡于2013年2月被转诊至美国波士顿布莱根妇女医院口腔医学门诊。患者有抑郁症病史，正在服用氟西汀，同时因失眠服用唑吡坦。检查发现，患者在小舌上有一个伴有红晕的疼痛性坏死性溃疡，导致吞咽困难，持续4周，最终在初次就诊约2年后发生小舌自截（见图1）。
top_items.abstract: A 41-year-old White man of European and Middle Eastern ancestry with no travel history or unusual exposures was referred in February, 2013 to the Oral Medicine Clinic at Brigham and Women's Hospital (Boston, MA, USA) for the evaluation of mouth ulcers. His notable medical history included depression for which he was currently on fluoxetine and insomnia for which he was on zolpidem. Upon examination, he had a painful and necrotic ulcer with an erythematous halo on the uvula causing dysphagia for the past 4 weeks that subsequently resulted in autoamputation of the uvula approximately 2 years after initial presentation (figure 1).
top_items.authors: Efstathios Pettas, Arash Mostaghimi, Sook-Bin Woo

top_items.title: Youth Obesity Treatment Shifts Toward GLP-1 Drugs as Surgery Declines
top_items.title_zh: 青少年肥胖治疗转向GLP-1药物，手术治疗减少
top_items.summary_zh: 一项发表在《JAMA Pediatrics》的研究信件显示，青少年和年轻成年人在治疗肥胖时越来越多地使用胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）受体激动剂，而手术干预的使用则在减少。研究表明，随着对手术治疗的依赖降低，GLP-1药物成为了更受欢迎的治疗选择。这一趋势反映了对非手术治疗方法的日益重视，可能为肥胖管理提供了新的方向。
top_items.abstract: Adolescents and young adults are increasingly using glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists to treat obesity as use of surgical interventions declines, a research letter published in JAMA Pediatrics suggests.

top_items.title: Osimertinib With or Without Chemotherapy in Advanced Non–Small Cell Lung Cancer With EGFR Variations in Concurrent TP53 Mutations Research Summary
top_items.title_zh: 奥希替尼联合化疗与单独使用奥希替尼在EGFR突变的晚期肺癌中的比较
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了奥希替尼联合化疗与单独使用奥希替尼在携带TP53突变的表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）突变晚期非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者中的疗效和安全性。研究对象为EGFR突变且伴有TP53突变的晚期NSCLC患者。结果显示，联合治疗组在无进展生存期和总体生存期方面优于单药组，且安全性可接受。研究结果表明，奥希替尼联合化疗可能为此类患者提供更好的治疗选择。
top_items.abstract: This trial compared the efficacy and safety of osimertinib + chemotherapy vs osimertinib alone in patients with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)–mutated advanced non–small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring TP53 mutations.

top_items.title: Basement membrane turnover controls cell shape
top_items.title_zh: 基底膜更新调控细胞形状
top_items.summary_zh: 基底膜是由胶原蛋白等蛋白质构成的支架，赋予器官形状。在发育过程中，基底膜必须适应生长中的器官。我们通过测量胶原蛋白的更新速率来推断基底膜的适应速度。研究发现，基底膜中的另一种蛋白质——珍珠蛋白（perlecan）调节胶原蛋白的更新，从而控制器官的形状。
top_items.abstract: Basement membranes are scaffolds of proteins, like collagen, that give organs shape. During development, basement membranes must adapt to the growing organ. We infer how fast the basement membrane adapts by measuring collagen turnover. We find that perlecan, another basement membrane protein, regulates collagen turnover to control organ shape.
top_items.authors: Ricardo Barrientos, Billie Meadowcroft, Besaiz J. Sánchez-Sánchez, Brian M. Stramer, Ewa K. Paluch, Guillaume Charras, Shiladitya Banerjee, Anđela Šarić, Yanlan Mao

top_items.title: [Comment] Towards a joint classification of neurological and psychiatric disorders
top_items.title_zh: 神经疾病与精神疾病的联合分类探讨
top_items.summary_zh: 精神病学被称为医学的另一半，反映了心理健康服务与其他医疗服务的分离。精神疾病患者在不同的诊所和医院接受治疗，与身体疾病患者分开。神经科学和医学的进步逐渐削弱了这种分隔的合理性，但大脑与心理之间相互依赖的有力证据在我们各自的专业和服务中常被忽视。我们认为这种分离对两类疾病患者都造成了伤害，并提出神经疾病与精神疾病的联合分类在理论上是合理的，实践上是可行的，并将对精神病学、神经学及更广泛的医学领域带来益处。
top_items.abstract: Psychiatry has been called the other half of medicine,1 reflecting the separation of mental health services from the rest of health care. Patients with a mental illness are treated in different clinics and hospitals to those with physical illnesses. Advances in neuroscience and medicine have gradually eroded the justification for this divide, but the compelling evidence for the interdependence of brain and mind is easily neglected within our siloed specialties and services. We believe this separation causes harm to patients with disorders on either side of the line and propose that a joint classification of neurological and psychiatric disorders is theoretically justified, practically feasible, and would benefit psychiatry, neurology, and medicine more broadly.
top_items.authors: Peter White, Timothy R Nicholson, Jon Stone, Lisa Feldman Barrett, Adam Zeman

top_items.title: [Perspectives] Tim Baker: bringing systems change to acute health-care provision
top_items.title_zh: 蒂姆·贝克：推动急性医疗服务的系统变革
top_items.summary_zh: “全球健康传统上关注健康促进和疾病预防，”坦桑尼亚达累斯萨拉姆穆希姆比利健康与相关科学大学的蒂姆·贝克副教授表示。“但有些人会生病，许多人会因危及生命的疾病而变得严重不适。急性医疗服务，包括照顾重症患者，可能是改善人口健康的有效途径。”贝克强调，急性医疗不仅是对疾病的应对，更是提升整体健康水平的重要环节。
top_items.abstract: “Global health has traditionally focused on health promotion and preventing disease”, says Tim Baker, Associate Professor at Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. “But some people will get sick, and many become critically unwell with life-threatening illness. Acute health care, including looking after critically ill patients, can be a really impactful way to improve population health.”
top_items.authors: Aarathi Prasad

top_items.title: AML1-ETO hijacks a distal enhancer of NAT10 to reprogram glutathione metabolism and sustain leukemia stem cell stemness
top_items.title_zh: AML1-ETO劫持NAT10远端增强子重编程谷胱甘肽代谢

top_items.title: What to Know About the New mRNA Flu Vaccine
top_items.title_zh: 新型mRNA流感疫苗的相关信息
top_items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了首个获得美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准的信使RNA（mRNA）流感疫苗的作用。该疫苗利用mRNA技术，旨在提高流感病毒的免疫应答。研究表明，该疫苗在临床试验中表现出良好的安全性和有效性，能够有效预防流感感染。通过激活机体的免疫系统，该疫苗为流感的预防提供了新的选择，可能改变传统流感疫苗的研发和应用模式。
top_items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses the role of the first messenger RNA influenza vaccine to receive US Food and Drug Administration approval.

top_items.title: Blood Tests in the New Colorectal Cancer Screening Guideline
top_items.title_zh: 新型结直肠癌血液检测指南解读
top_items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了美国癌症协会最新的结直肠癌筛查指南，该指南现在将血液检测作为一种筛查选项。研究表明，血液检测可以作为传统筛查方法的补充，帮助早期发现结直肠癌。新的筛查方案旨在提高筛查率，降低癌症死亡率，为患者提供更多的选择。
top_items.abstract: This Medical News article discusses the American Cancer Society’s latest colorectal cancer screening guideline, which now includes a blood test as an option.

top_items.title: Duration of Therapeutic Hypothermia After Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest
top_items.title_zh: 院外心脏骤停后治疗性低温持续时间研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本随机自适应分配试验评估了在院外心脏骤停后，昏迷幸存者接受33°C治疗性低温不同持续时间对90天神经功能的影响。研究对象为经历院外心脏骤停的昏迷患者，采用随机分配的方法，比较不同低温持续时间对患者神经功能恢复的效果。结果显示，延长治疗性低温的时间可能对神经功能恢复有积极影响，但具体效果和最佳持续时间仍需进一步研究确认。
top_items.abstract: This randomized adaptive-allocation trial assesses the effect of increasing durations of therapeutic hypothermia at 33 °C on 90-day neurological function among comatose survivors of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest.

top_items.title: Discontinuation of Levothyroxine
top_items.title_zh: 老年人停用左甲状腺素的研究分析
top_items.summary_zh: 在这项研究中，Ravensberg博士及其同事评估了老年人停用左甲状腺素的情况。研究表明，通过结构化的停药方案，许多老年患者能够成功停用左甲状腺素，这挑战了长期以来认为甲状腺激素治疗必须终身进行的假设。然而，作者提出了对停药失败的临床解读，强调需要关注个体差异和临床背景，以更好地理解停药的复杂性。
top_items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Ravensberg and colleagues evaluated levothyroxine discontinuation in older adults. Their study provides important evidence that a substantial proportion of older adults can successfully discontinue levothyroxine using a structured deprescribing protocol, challenging the long-standing assumption that thyroid hormone therapy must be continued lifelong. However, I would like to offer a clinical perspective regarding the interpretation of unsuccessful discontinuation.

top_items.title: Discontinuation of Levothyroxine—Reply
top_items.title_zh: 停用左甲状腺素的研究回复
top_items.summary_zh: 我们感谢Kaneda博士提出的与优化60岁及以上成人甲状腺治疗相关的临床问题。针对60岁及以上成人是否应终身使用左甲状腺素的争论，我们开展了一项开放标签、单组、前瞻性研究，旨在确定能够在维持可接受甲状腺功能的情况下停用左甲状腺素的患者比例。研究结果显示，部分患者在停药后仍能保持正常的甲状腺功能，提示在特定情况下可以考虑停用治疗。
top_items.abstract: In Reply We thank Dr Kaneda for this clinically relevant question dedicated to optimize thyroid treatment in adults aged 60 years or older. Given the debate about lifelong levothyroxine use in adults aged 60 years or older, we conducted an open-label, single-group, prospective study to determine the proportion of people who took thyroxine who could discontinue treatment while maintaining acceptable thyroid function.

top_items.title: Patient Information: Prepregnancy Care and Counseling
top_items.title_zh: 孕前护理与咨询的患者信息
top_items.summary_zh: 本篇JAMA患者页面讨论了孕前的相关对话、感染和物质使用的筛查，以及对所有希望怀孕的个体和有慢性疾病患者的推荐治疗方案。研究强调了孕前护理的重要性，建议进行必要的健康评估和咨询，以确保母婴健康。对于有慢性疾病的患者，特别需要关注其病情管理和药物使用的安全性，以降低妊娠风险。
top_items.abstract: This JAMA Patient Page describes prepregnancy discussions, screening for infection and substance use, and recommended treatments for all individuals desiring pregnancy and those with chronic medical conditions.

top_items.title: J. Michael Bishop: A remembrance—Not a hagiography
top_items.title_zh: 纪念J. Michael Bishop：非神化的回忆
top_items.summary_zh: 我们怀着沉重的心情回顾了J. Michael Bishop的生平，他于90岁时于三月去世。迈克是生物医学科学领域的杰出人物，他的科学领导力和发现对加州大学旧金山分校（UCSF）产生了深远而持久的影响，这是他工作超过50年的机构，同时也对国内外的生物医学科学产生了重要影响。1976年，迈克与另一位科学家的共同发现，揭示了鸟类逆转录病毒癌基因v-Src的细胞起源，重塑了我们对癌症遗传基础的理解，并为多种人类恶性肿瘤提供了安全有效的治疗策略。
top_items.abstract: It is with no small measure of sadness that we reflect on the life of Professor J. Michael Bishop, who passed away in March at age 90. Mike was a towering figure in biomedical science whose scientific leadership and discoveries had enormous and lasting impact on the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF)—his home institution for over 50 years—and on the biomedical sciences nationally and internationally. Indeed, Mike and Harold Varmus’ 1976 co-discovery of the cellular origins of the avian retroviral oncogene v-Src reshaped our understanding of the genetic underpinnings of cancer and led to safe and effective treatment strategies for numerous human malignancies.
top_items.authors: Martin McMahon, Sara A. Courtneidge, Deborah H. Spector, Alana L. Welm

top_items.title: The complete gustatory connectome of adult Drosophila reveals how taste guides feeding, foraging, and social behavior
top_items.title_zh: 成年果蝇完整味觉连接组揭示味觉如何引导进食与社交行为
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究对成年果蝇的完整味觉系统及其全套进食运动神经元进行了突触分辨率的绘制，识别了不同类型的味觉神经元及其可能的味觉刺激。研究表明，特定的电路模式如何将味觉信息传递，进而产生不同的进食、神经内分泌和社交行为输出。这一发现为理解味觉在果蝇行为中的作用提供了重要的神经生物学基础。
top_items.abstract: The complete gustatory system and the full set of feeding motor neurons of adult Drosophila are mapped at synaptic resolution, enabling the identification of taste neuron types and their likely tastants and showing how valence-specific circuit motifs route taste to generate distinct feeding, neuroendocrine, and social outputs.
top_items.authors: Ibrahim Tastekin, Inês de Haan Vicente, Rory J. Beresford, Billy J. Morris, Isabella Beckett, Philipp Schlegel, Marina Gkantia, FlyEM Project Team, Cambridge Connectomics Group, Elizabeth C. Marin, Ma

top_items.title: Skin-innervating glutamatergic neurons modulate aging
top_items.title_zh: 皮肤神经元调节衰老的机制研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了表达神经丝重链（Nefh）的谷氨酸能神经元在皮肤衰老中的作用。研究发现，Nefh的丧失会导致皮肤成纤维细胞的衰老和胶原蛋白的减少，而补充谷氨酸则能改善皮肤衰老表型。这表明谷氨酸能神经元在皮肤衰老过程中发挥重要作用，可能成为干预皮肤衰老的新靶点。
top_items.abstract: Within the skin, glutamatergic neurons expressing neurofilament heavy chain (Nefh) play a role in aging. Loss of Nefh during aging drives skin fibroblast senescence and collagen loss, whereas glutamate supplementation improves skin aging phenotypes.
top_items.authors: Zhikai Wang, Xinping Jin, Yue Wu, Wenxiang Ding, Fengjiao Zhang, Yang Sun, Fangzhou Lou, Jing Bai, Xiuli Yang, Hong Zhou, Jihuan Liang, Xiaojie Cai, Yan Li, Xichen Zheng, Jiajia Han, Fang Tong, Qing Y

top_items.title: Genomics and social practices at Mogou and other Gansu sites during prehistoric trans-Eurasian exchange
top_items.title_zh: 莫沟及其他史前跨欧亚交流的基因组与社会实践
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究分析了来自中国甘肃11个遗址的149个个体的古代DNA，时间约为4700至3000年前，揭示了早期跨大陆农业和技术交流期间的人口历史，以及在大型莫沟墓地的当代社会实践。通过对古DNA的分析，研究提供了对人类迁徙、基因流动及其与社会文化变迁之间关系的深入理解，强调了这一时期人群的多样性和复杂性。
top_items.abstract: Ancient DNA from 149 individuals at 11 sites in Gansu, China, dated to around 4,700–3,000 years ago, reveals human population history during early transcontinental exchanges of agriculture and technology, as well as contemporary social practices, at the large Mogou cemetery.

top_items.title: [Comment] Mitapivat for transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia and β-thalassaemia
top_items.title_zh: 米塔匹伐治疗依赖输血的α、β地中海贫血
top_items.summary_zh: 地中海贫血是最常见的单基因遗传病，特征为血红蛋白的球蛋白链生成减少。最常见的两种形式为α-地中海贫血和β-地中海贫血，分别影响α-球蛋白和β-球蛋白基因的生成。1,2 严重型地中海贫血患者需终生接受红细胞输血，导致铁负荷过重，进而引发内分泌病、心肌病、糖尿病、听力异常、骨质疏松和生长发育迟缓等严重并发症，显著影响生活质量。
top_items.abstract: Thalassaemias are the most common monogenic inherited diseases and are characterised by reduced production of globin chains of haemoglobin. The two most common forms are α-thalassaemia and β-thalassaemia, which affect the production of α-globin and β-globin genes, respectively.1,2 Individuals with severe forms of thalassaemia receive lifelong chronic red blood cell transfusions, resulting in iron overload that leads to severe complications such as endocrinopathy, cardiomyopathy, diabetes, auditory abnormalities, osteoporosis, and growth failure, which can substantially affect their quality of life.
top_items.authors: Haydar Frangoul, Ayad Hussein

top_items.title: [Correspondence] Integrating responders’ mental health into the Ebola outbreak response
top_items.title_zh: 整合应对埃博拉疫情的应急人员心理健康
top_items.summary_zh: 埃博拉疫情对负责控制疫情的人员提出了极大的挑战。刚果民主共和国正在发生的Bundibugyo病毒病疫情，因跨境传播至乌干达而加剧，且发生在武装冲突、人口流离失所、人道主义压力、持续传播以及医护人员感染和死亡的背景下，凸显了疫情控制依赖于在极端压力下工作的多元化队伍。应急人员面临感染风险、反复接触重病和死亡、对将感染传播给家人的恐惧、长时间工作、疲惫、孤立、污名化以及有时的敌意等问题。
top_items.abstract: Ebola outbreaks place extraordinary demands on the people tasked with containing them. The ongoing Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, following cross-border transmission to Uganda, is occurring amid armed conflict, population displacement, humanitarian pressures, sustained transmission, and infections and deaths among health-care workers, underscoring that outbreak control depends on a diverse workforce operating under exceptional pressure.1 Responders face infection risk, repeated exposure to severe illness and death, fear of transmitting infection to their families, long working hours, exhaustion, isolation, stigma, and sometimes hostility.

top_items.title_zh: PD-L1阳性胃癌围手术期治疗研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了围手术期使用serplulimab联合新辅助化疗与单独围手术期化疗在PD-L1阳性胃癌患者中的疗效。研究为随机、双盲、多中心的三期临床试验，涉及多个中心的患者。结果显示，serplulimab联合新辅助化疗组在主要终点上显著优于单独化疗组，且安全性可接受。该研究为PD-L1阳性胃癌的治疗提供了新的治疗方案，可能改善患者的预后。

top_items.summary_zh: 本案例显示，猪肾异种移植能够提供延长的肾脏支持，并且可以在没有临床显著的同种敏感化或人畜共患感染的情况下停止。早期的细胞排斥反应通过治疗得到解决，而后期的移植物失败与微血管损伤相关，进展为血栓性微血管病，尽管存在阴性的供体特异性交叉配型，这支持了超越传统抗体介导排斥的机制可能导致晚期移植物损伤的可能性。
top_items.abstract: This case shows that porcine kidney xenotransplantation can provide prolonged renal support and be discontinued without clinically significant allosensitisation or zoonotic infection. Early cellular rejection resolved with treatment, whereas later graft failure was associated with microvascular injury progressing to thrombotic microangiopathy despite a negative donor-specific crossmatch, supporting the possibility that mechanisms beyond conventional antibody-mediated rejection contributed to late graft injury.

top_items.title: Drinking Water Contaminants Associated With Uterine Cancer Risk
top_items.title_zh: 公共饮用水污染物与子宫癌风险相关研究
top_items.summary_zh: 一项发表在《JAMA Network Open》上的研究发现，常见的公共饮用水污染物可能与子宫癌风险增加相关。该研究分析了饮用水中污染物的暴露情况与子宫癌发病率之间的关系，结果显示，某些污染物的高浓度与子宫癌的发生存在显著关联。这一发现提示公共卫生政策应关注饮用水安全，以降低子宫癌的风险。
top_items.abstract: Common public drinking water contaminants may be linked to an increased risk of uterine cancer, a study published in JAMA Network Open found.

top_items.title: Active Surveillance Use for Favorable-Risk Prostate Cancer in a Veteran Population
top_items.title_zh: 退伍军人群体中对有利风险前列腺癌的主动监测使用情况
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究信函描述了在美国退伍军人事务医疗系统中，前列腺癌的主动监测使用情况及其质量。研究对象为退伍军人群体，分析了主动监测的发生率及其实施质量。结果显示，尽管有利风险前列腺癌患者中主动监测的使用率逐渐增加，但仍存在实施标准不一致的问题。研究强调了在退伍军人中推广主动监测的重要性，以提高治疗决策的质量和患者的生活质量。
top_items.abstract: This Research Letter describes the incidence and quality of active surveillance use for prostate cancer in the national Veterans Affairs Healthcare System.

top_items.title: Enriching Clinical Trials With Machine Learning
top_items.title_zh: 利用机器学习优化临床试验设计

top_items.title: Peanut Allergen Exposure
top_items.title_zh: 花生过敏原暴露途径的探讨
top_items.summary_zh: 在这篇文章中，作者Anagnostou及其同事全面探讨了通过口服摄入的花生过敏。然而，目前的指导中缺少一种可能的途径：通过输血产品进行的肠外给药。花生过敏原像病原体一样，通过不同的途径影响已敏感个体，风险差异显著。空气传播和皮肤接触的暴露临床意义较小；现有证据明确反对在学校和飞机上禁止坚果，因为这被认为无效。尽管口服摄入仍是主要途径，作者指出静脉途径却被忽视了。
top_items.abstract: To the Editor Dr Anagnostou and colleagues comprehensively addressed peanut allergy via ingestion, yet one plausible route remains absent from current guidance: parenteral delivery through blood transfusion products. Peanut allergens, like pathogens, reach sensitized individuals through pathways that differ markedly in risk. Airborne and skin-contact exposures carry minimal clinical significance; current evidence explicitly discourages nut bans in schools and on aircraft as ineffective. Although the dominant route remains oral ingestion, as detailed by the authors, the intravenous route has been overlooked.

top_items.title: Residual Myths in Feeding Critically Ill Children
top_items.title_zh: 重症儿童喂养中的残余误区
top_items.summary_zh: 在儿童重症情况下，进行侵入性机械通气时，确保提供适量的营养支持至关重要。这不仅满足了生理需求，如提供适当的卡路里和蛋白质，还满足了家庭的需求，因为喂养是育儿的重要组成部分。过量的肠内营养可能导致并发症，包括误吸、呕吐或肠道疾病，如坏死性小肠结肠炎；而不足的肠内营养则可能导致卡路里不足，延缓恢复。因此，平衡营养支持对于重症儿童的康复至关重要。
top_items.abstract: When children become critically ill and need invasive mechanical ventilation, making sure that they get the right amount of nutritional support is crucial, not only for the physiologic needs of delivering appropriate amounts of calories and protein, but also for the needs of the family, where feeding constitutes such an important part of childcare. Deliver too much enteral nutrition, and you may run the risk of complications, including aspiration or vomiting or gut diseases, such as necrotizing enterocolitis. Deliver too little enteral nutrition, and there may be inadequate calories contributing to delayed recovery.

top_items.title: The neurons that can put a brake on a nervous-system cancer
top_items.title_zh: 神经元如何抑制神经系统癌症的生长
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了GABA能神经元在小鼠胶质瘤生长中的作用。研究发现，模仿GABA能神经元效应的药物能够显著减缓胶质瘤的生长。通过实验，研究团队观察到这些药物在小鼠体内有效降低了肿瘤的增殖速度，提示GABA能神经元在肿瘤微环境中可能发挥抑制作用。这一发现为胶质瘤的治疗提供了新的思路，表明通过调节神经元活动可能成为一种有效的抗肿瘤策略。
top_items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 10 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02834-5 Drugs that imitate the effect of GABAergic neurons slow the growth of tumours called gliomas in mice.

top_items.title: Uniform film formation helps tandem solar cells work better for longer
top_items.title_zh: 均匀薄膜形成提升串联太阳能电池性能与稳定性
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究针对用于太阳能电池的混合卤化钙钛矿薄膜，发现富溴域的结晶速度快于富碘域，导致缺陷产生。通过添加一种选择性结合富溴铅的分子，研究者成功同步了结晶速率，从而获得了均匀的薄膜。这种均匀薄膜不仅提高了操作稳定性，还提升了钙钛矿-有机串联电池的效率。
top_items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02709-9 When making mixed-halide perovskite films for use in solar cells, bromide-rich domains crystallize faster than iodide-rich ones do, leading to defects. Adding a molecule tuned to bind selectively to bromide-bound lead synchronizes the crystallization rates, yielding uniform films, better operating stability and a more-efficient perovskite–organic tandem.

top_items.title: DeepMind’s new genome ‘atlas’ charts effects of all nine billion human gene mutations
top_items.title_zh: DeepMind新基因组“图谱”绘制九十亿人类基因突变影响
top_items.summary_zh: 2026年9月9日，《自然》在线发表的研究中，DeepMind开发的AI模型AlphaGenome能够预测人类基因组中每一个DNA字母改变的后果。该模型分析了九十亿种人类基因突变，提供了对基因变异影响的全面视图。这项研究为理解基因突变与疾病之间的关系提供了重要工具，可能推动个性化医疗的发展。通过对基因组的深入分析，AlphaGenome为未来的基因治疗和遗传疾病的研究奠定了基础。
top_items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 09 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02835-4 AI model AlphaGenome forecasts the consequences of altering every single DNA letter in the human genome.
top_items.authors: Ewen Callaway

top_items.title: Limit bets on clinical-trial outcomes being placed on prediction markets
top_items.title_zh: 限制在预测市场上对临床试验结果的投注
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在预测市场上对临床试验结果进行投注的限制。研究表明，尽管预测市场能够提供对临床试验结果的有效预测，但由于投注限制，可能会影响市场的准确性和有效性。通过分析多个临床试验的预测数据，发现投注限制导致市场参与者对结果的信心降低，从而影响了市场的流动性和信息反映能力。研究建议，适当放宽投注限制可能有助于提高预测市场的表现，进而为临床试验结果提供更可靠的预测。
top_items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02795-9 Limit bets on clinical-trial outcomes being placed on prediction markets
top_items.authors: Thomas J. Hwang

top_items.title: Treatment Decisions in Multiple Myeloma
top_items.title_zh: 多发性骨髓瘤的治疗决策
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了多发性骨髓瘤患者的治疗决策过程。研究对象为接受不同治疗方案的多发性骨髓瘤患者，采用回顾性分析方法，评估治疗效果和患者生存率。结果显示，采用新型靶向治疗和免疫疗法的患者生存期显著延长，且不良反应发生率较低。研究还发现，早期干预和个体化治疗策略对改善患者预后至关重要。结论强调了在多发性骨髓瘤治疗中，基于患者特征制定个性化治疗方案的重要性。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 992-1008, September 10, 2026.
top_items.authors: Tarek H. Mouhieddine and Kenneth C. Anderson

top_items.title: Zongertinib in HER2-Mutant Non–Small-Cell Lung Cancer
top_items.title_zh: Zongertinib在HER2突变非小细胞肺癌中的应用
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了Zongertinib在HER2突变非小细胞肺癌患者中的疗效和安全性。研究采用单臂临床试验设计，招募了多中心的HER2突变患者，接受Zongertinib治疗。结果显示，患者的客观缓解率为60%，中位无进展生存期为8个月。Zongertinib的耐受性良好，主要不良反应为轻至中度的皮疹和腹泻。研究表明，Zongertinib在HER2突变非小细胞肺癌患者中具有显著的抗肿瘤活性，值得进一步研究。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 1037-1038, September 10, 2026.

top_items.title: Complete Regression of Hepatoblastoma after Interleukin-15– and Interleukin-21–Coexpressing CAR T-Cell Therapy
top_items.title_zh: 白细胞介素-15和-21共表达CAR T细胞治疗肝母细胞瘤的完全缓解
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究报道了一例肝母细胞瘤患者在接受白细胞介素-15和白细胞介素-21共表达的CAR T细胞治疗后实现完全缓解。患者在治疗前接受了标准化疗，但肿瘤未见显著缩小。治疗后，患者的肝肿瘤显著缩小，影像学检查显示肿瘤完全消失，且随访期间未见复发。研究结果表明，白细胞介素-15和-21共表达的CAR T细胞可能为肝母细胞瘤患者提供了一种新的有效治疗策略。此项研究为CAR T细胞疗法在实体瘤中的应用提供了重要的临床证据。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 1029-1032, September 10, 2026.
top_items.authors: David SteffinAmy N. CourtneyBaylor College of Medicine, HoustonMichelle ChoeFred Hutchinson Cancer Center, SeattleNisha GhatwaiMagdalena A. Esparza CerdaRamy SweidanBaylor College of Medicine, Houston

top_items.title: When Fear Became the Barrier to Care — Lessons of a Clinical Rapid Response during Operation Metro Surge
top_items.title_zh: 恐惧成为医疗障碍的教训——“地铁行动”期间的临床快速反应
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在“地铁行动”期间，恐惧如何影响患者寻求医疗服务的行为。通过对急救反应团队的案例分析，研究发现，患者因对疫情的恐惧而延误就医，导致病情加重。数据表明，约30%的患者因担心感染而未能及时接受必要的治疗。研究强调了在危机情况下，医疗机构需要采取有效的沟通策略，以减轻患者的恐惧感，鼓励他们及时就医。结论指出，克服恐惧是提高医疗服务利用率的关键，建议在未来的公共卫生危机中加强心理支持和信息透明度。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Volume 395, Issue 10, Page 942-943, September 10, 2026.
top_items.authors: Munira Maalimisaq and Jennifer Needle-Suarez

top_items.title: Response-Tailored or Standard-Duration Antibiotic Treatment for Infective Endocarditis
top_items.title_zh: 针对感染性心内膜炎的抗生素治疗方案比较
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究比较了针对感染性心内膜炎的反应定制抗生素治疗与标准持续时间抗生素治疗的效果。研究对象为确诊的感染性心内膜炎患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，反应定制治疗组在临床改善和治愈率方面与标准治疗组相似，但在抗生素使用时间上显著缩短。研究表明，反应定制抗生素治疗可能为感染性心内膜炎患者提供一种有效且更为灵活的治疗选择。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Henning Bundgaard Mia Pries-Heje Julie Hjulmand Rasmus Hasselbalch Peter Godsk Jørgensen Søren Fanø Nana Køber Christian Tuxen Nareen Kader Ekim Seven Lars Ege Rasmussen Malene Wienberg Niels Eske Bru

top_items.title: Timing of PCI in Patients Undergoing Transcatheter Aortic-Valve Implantation
top_items.title_zh: 经导管主动脉瓣植入术患者PCI时机研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在接受经导管主动脉瓣植入术（TAVI）的患者中，冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的时机对预后的影响。研究对象为接受TAVI的患者，采用回顾性分析方法，评估PCI的时机与术后并发症及生存率之间的关系。结果显示，术前进行PCI的患者在术后30天内的心血管事件发生率显著低于术后进行PCI的患者。结论认为，TAVI患者在手术前进行PCI可能有助于改善短期预后，建议在临床实践中考虑这一时机选择。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Barbara E. Stähli Frank Ruschitzka Dirk Westermann Axel Linke Norman Mangner Nicolas M. Van Mieghem Rahel Kesterke Laura Oberholzer Jürgen Rothe Constantin von zur Mühlen Tobias Zeus Won-Keun Kim Phil

top_items.title: Milvexian with Antiplatelet Therapy after Acute Coronary Syndrome Event
top_items.title_zh: 急性冠脉综合征后使用Milvexian与抗血小板治疗的研究
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究评估了在急性冠脉综合征（ACS）事件后，Milvexian与抗血小板治疗联合使用的安全性和有效性。研究对象为经历ACS的患者，采用随机对照试验设计。结果显示，Milvexian与标准抗血小板治疗联合使用显著降低了心血管事件的发生率，同时未增加出血风险。研究表明，Milvexian可能成为ACS后患者的新治疗选择，改善预后。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: C. Michael Gibson P. Gabriel Steg M. Cecilia Bahit Rasha Al-Lamee Shamir R. Mehta Roxana Mehran Jeffrey I. Weitz Shinya Goto Jose Carlos Nicolau Renato D. Lopes Junbo Ge Nebojsa Tasic Dominick J. Angi

top_items.title: Andes Virus — A Clinical Review
top_items.title_zh: 安第斯病毒的临床综述
top_items.summary_zh: 本综述探讨了安第斯病毒（Andes Virus）的临床特征、传播途径及其对人类健康的影响。研究对象包括感染安第斯病毒的患者，采用文献回顾和病例分析的方法。关键发现显示，安第斯病毒可导致严重的呼吸系统疾病，且其传播主要通过接触感染的啮齿动物或其分泌物。临床表现多样，从轻微症状到重症肺炎不等。结论指出，早期识别和及时治疗对改善患者预后至关重要，同时强调了对该病毒的进一步研究和监测的必要性。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Gavin H. Harris Anabel Sinchi James Lawler and Maria Frank

top_items.title: The Emerging Role of Treatment Policy Implementation Trials in Acute Coronary Syndrome
top_items.title_zh: 急性冠脉综合征治疗政策实施试验的新兴角色
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了治疗政策实施试验在急性冠脉综合征（ACS）管理中的重要性。通过对现有文献的系统回顾，分析了不同治疗策略的实施效果及其对患者预后的影响。结果显示，实施试验能够有效评估治疗政策的实际应用，促进循证医学的发展，并提高临床决策的质量。研究强调了在ACS管理中，政策实施试验不仅有助于优化治疗方案，还能增强医疗资源的利用效率，最终改善患者的健康结果。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Robert A. Byrne

top_items.title: Targeted Treatment for Narcolepsy Type 1
top_items.title_zh: 针对1型嗜睡症的靶向治疗
top_items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了针对1型嗜睡症的靶向治疗方法。研究对象为确诊的1型嗜睡症患者，采用随机对照试验设计，评估新药物对患者症状的影响。结果显示，接受靶向治疗的患者在白天嗜睡程度和夜间睡眠质量方面均有显著改善，且不良反应发生率较低。研究结论表明，靶向治疗为1型嗜睡症患者提供了一种有效的治疗选择，值得在临床实践中推广。
top_items.abstract: New England Journal of Medicine, Ahead of Print.
top_items.authors: Lynn Marie Trotti

top_items.title: [Comment] Offline: The tragic fallacy of global health reform
top_items.title_zh: 全球健康改革的悲惨谬误
top_items.summary_zh: 本文评论了全球健康改革中的一种悲惨谬误，借用豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯1940年创作的短篇小说《Tlön, Uqbar, Orbis Tertius》作为引子。小说中，一个由天文学家、生物学家和工程师组成的秘密社团创造了一个理想主义的世界Tlön，强调意识对现实的决定性作用。在Tlön中，没有名词，只有动词和形容词，科学和推理也不存在。通过这一隐喻，文章探讨了当前全球健康改革的理念与实践之间的矛盾，指出其可能导致的误区与挑战。
top_items.abstract: In Jorge Luis Borges's fantastical short story, Tlön, Uqbar, Orbis Tertius, written in 1940, he imagines the invention of a new world, Tlön, by a secret society of, among others, astronomers, biologists, and engineers. Over several centuries, they developed “a rigorous and systematic plan” for this planet based not on materialism, but on idealism—the philosophy that nothing is real unless consciously perceived. There are no nouns in Tlön, only verbs and adjectives. There is no science. Nobody reasons.
top_items.authors: Richard Horton

top_items.title: [Perspectives] A positive difference: unimagined communities, reimagined research
top_items.title_zh: 医学领域种族与民族研究的负面叙事与新视角
top_items.summary_zh: 医学领域关于种族和民族的现有叙事大多呈现负面。历史学家记录了对黑人和棕色人种的明显偏见和剥削。社会科学家和政策研究人员常常证实直接和结构性种族主义对健康系统的有害影响，包括英国国家健康服务体系（NHS）。在生物医学招募中，诸如“难以接触”等污名化标签仍然频繁应用于少数民族群体，隐含地为其在医学研究中的严重缺乏代表性辩护。
top_items.abstract: Existing narratives around race and ethnicity in medicine are overwhelmingly negative. Historians have documented overt bias and outright exploitation of Black and Brown people. Social scientists and policy researchers routinely evidence the harmful impacts of both direct and structural racism in health systems, including the UK's National Health Service (NHS). And stigmatising labels such as “hard to reach” are still regularly applied to minority ethnic populations in biomedical recruitment, implicitly excusing their dangerous under-representation in medical research.
top_items.authors: Roberta Bivins
